en: I only teach students who have already mastered the basics. You must seek out the night elf Darianna in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. Her skills will be a perfect complement to yours.
Training you further is beyond my abilities. Speak to Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He is always glad to help talented students.
Greetings, $c. I can assist you in recovering lost companions.
Greetings, $c. I can help stable your pets or assist you in recovering lost companions.

The infernal is one of the most powerful demons a warlock could hope to have at $Ghis:her; side in battle. The creature is stong, well-armored, and delivers devastating blows upon any foe. If you were to choose to put the spirit of an infernal into your weapon, you would gain some of those benefits--greater health and regeneration and the like.$B$BIf you wish to know more about felhounds, then you should speak to Wytula across from me.

The felhound... a vicious creature indeed. It is not as physically strong as an infernal, but a wise warlock knows that brute force is not always the answer--if it was, you would have chosen the path of a warrior instead, wouldn't you?$B$BThe felhound draws upon the mana of its foes, using that and its quickness to overcome enemies. Its strength comes from the arcane and using that arcane power for its own ends.$B$BIf you wish to know more about infernals, then you should speak to Magaz across from me.
Gosh, I'm sorry. I don't have anything new to teach you. How about you go talk to Simon Tanner in the Old Town section of Stormwind? He's a human with big muscles and dreamy red hair.
How's it going? I love the smell of leather; don't you?
The ghostly figure looks at you with mistrust in her eyes and remains silent.
Open your mind, wanderer, and we shall begin.
You have truly accelled in your knowledge of enchanting. There is much more to learn, if you are willing. Speak to Taladan, in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus.
Good day, $gsir:ma'am;. I'd shake your hand, but as you see, I'm in the middle of something. May I be of assistance?
You've made a good start, but you still have a great deal to learn, $N.
I'm sorry, $N, but I have no time to spend on novices. You want someone closer to your own skill level. Try the night elf Milla Fairancora, in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.
There are still lessons you must learn from others before my knowledge may be shared with you. Be diligent, and do not give up hope.
Your education is nearly complete. One final task is all that stands between you and the culmination of all your efforts.

"Darnassae?"$B$BThe night elf druid looks at you expectantly, but it is clear you cannot verbally communicate with her.  Undaunted, she points to herself and smiles.  She points at you and smiles once more.  She finally motions several times down the path to the north.$B$BPerhaps she is indicating that there is a druid you can speak to further up the road?
Pleased to meet you, $c.
I have suffered, but now I can feel it slowly fading from me. I feel... free.
The corruption of Felwood has trapped my spirit here... I may never rest...

npc: Aska Mistrunner; Duhng; Eunice Burch; Mudduk
en: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

npc: Auld Stonespire; Bluffwatcher; Bounty Hunter Kolark; Chepi
en: It seems like love is drifting on the wind. I hope that I won't be left out.
<The Baron lifts his manacles.>$B$BCome on then, $c. Do ye trust me?
Missing US text
What're ye starin' at, $r? Come ta torment the condemned?
Can you not sense the anguish of the Earth Mother for her lost children, the undead? Speak quickly, $N. Every second costs me dearly. We must help them find their way back to her!
I cannot in good conscience spend time training novices while our allies, the undead, are suffering so terribly. Please speak with Kray over there instead; he can help you for now.

I can't say enough about yer work, truly amazing things that ye can do with a hammer and an anvil. Now, don't be tellin anyone that I suggested ye go find a goblin to teach ye but that's exactly what I'm gonna do. Brikk Keencraft is his name, and last I heard he was operating a shop down in Booty bay.
Hmm... well you seem capable enough. If you truly desire to learn, then nothing will stand in your way! I will guide you through your first steps on what I hope will be a long and fulfilling path.

npc: Brek Stonehoof; Brom Killian; Dank Drizzlecut; Geofram Bouldertoe
en: I can instruct you in mining.  Interested?

npc: Brohann Caskbelly; Furen Longbeard; Kathrum Axehand; Morgg Stormshot
en: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye $g lad : lass;, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.
I would train ye if I could, but ye need the services of someone a bit more... what's the word? Brainy! Look for Trixie Quickswitch in Ironforge. Tell 'er Bronk sent ye!
Lookin' to be an engineer, eh? Well, by Muradin, ye've come to the right place!
If you're looking for a flight back to Rut'theran Village, then you should talk to my night elven counterpart, Silva Fil'naveth.
What you doin' wanderin' around here?  Why them small fries not in da shackles?!
We must take what is ours. Our survival depends on it.

Ahoy, $N! Not a pretty picture, is it?$B$BThe Horizon Scout at the bottom of the sea, my crew in shambles, and our cargo and passengers strewn about like so much debris that you'd think this was one of Stormwind's canals after a festival.$B$BAnd that's not where the trouble ends...
You'll have to give me a moment, $c, the naga are attacking us right now. I'll speak to you as soon as the attack is done!
As you inspect the cage and the Night elf inside, you get an odd sense of deja vu. For some reason she does not make eye contact with you--it is almost as if you are not there to her.
With all the Siege Engines nearly complete, I'm getting a bit bored!$B$B$B$BYou're not an engineer, are you? Care to compare blueprints...?

Hmm, your work is allright but it's nowhere near the quality I look for in a student. Go talk with Smith Argus in Goldshire, I'm sure he can teach you some basics. Then when you're done, come on back to me and I'll give you a little test to make sure you are ready.

Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.
You do fine work, but it's a bit rough around the edges. Don't worry about it, it will come with practice. Speaking of which, how about we see what you've been working on?
Welcome to Grom'gol, $C. Before we get off on the wrong foot, I'll have you know that I won't have slackers in my Base Camp.. I expect a healthy $R like you to pull your own weight around here.

npc: Cylina Darkheart; Dane Winslow; Dannie Fizzwizzle; Gina Lang
en: Sorry, but my services are only of use to warlocks.

npc: Cylina Darkheart; Dane Winslow; Dannie Fizzwizzle; Gina Lang
en: Weary of one of your demonic charges? Hoping for one with a more pleasing name?$B$B$B$BFor a price, I can assist you in the obliteration of a current minion so that you may summon an entirely new one...
Who sent you here? You're not ready for my instruction yet! You'll be told when you're ready.
You're doing very well in the art of tailoring, I must admit. Now, let's see how good you REALLY are...
The battle is over, and the people of Darrowshire are saved.$B$BThey are saved, $N, because of you.  You are truly a hero of Darrowshire.
<Deathguard Simmer looks at you expectantly.>
I would be delighted to aid you in the commencement of your pursuit! Let me grab my spinner and we'll get started...
Your current aptitude exceeds my instructional capabilities. You should enquire further with my fellow Gnome Trixie Quickswitch in Ironforge!
You are not yet powerful enough, $c.  Move along.
Ye've got a little skill on ye. Enough to learn ye a few things I wager. Let's see what I can teach ye, shall we?
Another new face? It's so good to meet you. I'm Dellylah.
What you want?
Derak Nightfall, at your service!

I'm not amused by your audacity in coming to me for training. Go through the archway and down the ramp to the southeast, and talk to Doctor Martin Felben. He is a Forsaken who can teach you the basics.
Very well. Cut another lump of flesh from one of these specimens. Let us test what you've learned so far, and we can progress from there.
It has been years since I have thought with my heart, but it's all flooding back.
I love a good challenge; don't you? Aye, of course ye do. An' that's why you're about to do exactly what I say.

I'm not here to teach babes fresh out of the cradle. Ye've nowhere near the amount of skill I require in my students. In fact, ye're a sad figure of a $glad:lass;, an' I'll thank ye not to stand there jibber-jabberin' at me.
I will never call Brackenwall Village my home. To do so is to give up hope of reclaiming our rightful lands.
It is not for us to judge these atrocities. Ivus will pass judgement once he arrives.
The Arch Druid believes that Ivus the Forest Lord will come once he is made aware of the destructive forces within this valley.
We have been sent here from Darnassus to aid the Stormpike in their time of need.
Do you mock me while I am unable to defend myself, bound to this ball of iron?
We're glad to have your help.
$N, it is good to see you.  Our war with the other elemental lords yet rages, but your efforts help ensure our victory.
You've served our cause with great loyalty, $N.  Allow me to present you with an unending source of our elemental quintessence.

I'm a simple man who knows a few things about tailoring, but you need more assistance than I can provide. I have heard of a Night Elf who is quite an accomplished tailor. He resides in Stormwind, in the Magic District.
So you would like to learn a few things? I would be happy to get you started!
Things can get a little stuffy here in Nethergarde.  Sometimes a dwarf just needs a brew to take her mind off her duty for a bit.
Even in this remote corner of the world, know that Hellscream's eyes are upon you.
Make it quick, $r.
Oh dear.  Things aren't looking good for Felix.

Enjoying the festival, $c?$b$bWhile the Flame Keepers tend to the fires of the present, I am more of a historian, keeping close the festivals past. I'm also, of course, documenting this year's festivities. Things are going well thus far, don't you think?$b$bYou know, $n, there is power inherent in all festival fires burning throughout the holiday. We're taking care of ours, but I'm certain there are sacred flames burning deep within our enemy's cities...

Well, I declare! It's a new student! I'll gladly teach you everything I know once you have a little more skill. Go talk to Gretta Finespindle over there, would you? She'll have you up to speed in no time.
Fantastic! Aren't you the industrious one? Well, let's get started, shall we?
Hmm well, I can't help you quite yet! You have to learn the basics first. Why don't you go see Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind!
You're working your way up??? higher than me, at this point! You should talk to Springspindle Fizzlegear in Ironforge! He'll show you more than I ever could!
Welcome to Booty Bay, $r.
Let's see how competent you are, shall we? If you perform this task to my liking, I'll spend the time to teach you!
This is a waste of time, mine and yours! Go see Graham Van Talen if you want to begin your instruction! He's standing to my left over there.
What do you think I could teach you? Roxxik would do a much better job. You can find him in Orgrimmar. Now be off!
On behalf of the illustrious and still neutral Steamwheedle Cartel, I hope you enjoy your stay.$B$BRemember, everyone is welcome in Gadgetzan! Everyone except pirates.
We're here to protect Gadgetzan interests in Un'Goro and that's none of your business.
What is it?

Kneel beside me, friend. I caught a bullet during that last raid.$B$B<Gann grunts in pain as he tries to shift position. His left hand clutches a wound, blood welling between his quivering fingers.>$B$BWhen the dwarves first invaded the Barrens, I contented myself with harassing their diggers and sabotaging their equipment. I should've struck a killing blow when I had the chance.
Keep your eyes open, $c. Even Durotar is not safe from our enemies.

Hail $c. Didn't I see you recently at an exclusive gathering? You look familiar, but then again this city is a busy place.$B$BIf you attended that convention, then surely you were given a secret code. Tell me your code and I will give you a special prize in return.
Looking for a tabard?
Good! I can tell that my efforts will not be wasted!
You'll need more training before I can share my knowledge with you, I'm afraid.
I don't suppose you're here to talk about my lovely Kali. Fine, then. Potions it is. Anyone ever tell ye you've got a one-track mind?
What do I look like, the Grand Poobah of enchanters? Your skills require the guidance of an Artisan! Go find Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora.
Your will is strong, and your intent is clear.$B$BPerhaps you are worthy...
Well done! You have that spark in your eye, I know it well, it's the same spark I had when I was but a pup! Now, let's see if I can't teach you something.
You are unfit to train with me, stranger. Spend some time with my assistant Jhag over there.
A treasure hunter's life is a treacherous one. Don't be foolin' yerself.
Gordo like picking flowers. Pick flowers kind of like killing.
It drafty out here.
Johaan say Gordo need a tailor to fix Gordo tummy.
Simmer say Gordo got guts, but got no brains.  Why he mean?
Engineering will provide you with the skills and knowledge to dismantle your opponents! Let me show you how...
You are ready for greater things! See Franklin Lloyd, to my right. He will guide you from now on.
What? Why are you bothering me? Why, I bet you can't even create a high quality robe! Go talk to Snang and come back when you're worthy of my talents!
You need to learn from someone who knows more than I do. Go talk to Josef Gregorian in Undercity. Well, what are you still doing here?
Greetings, $glad:lass;. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...
Oh, goody, something else to do while I wait! You're a real life-saver, $N!
How may I help you?
Woohoo! They are into it now!
I would be happy to take you under my wing. Let us begin.
It is time for you to journey to Darnassus and speak to Me'lynn. She will guide you from now on.
Dig rats make some surprisingly tasty stew.
$N, was it? That is a mighty fine piece of work ye have there. I'll take ye on, train ye how to make armor fit fer King Magni himself.
Welcome back to the Great Forge, $N. Ye come to visit an old Dwarf or do ye think yer ready for the next step in yer training?
Welcome to Theramore.
I remember when my brother and I would camp alone in the Azshara wilderness. Look at it now.
I only wish I had more students like you. Not many will venture so far into enemy territory. I salute your courage.
How do you do, $c?

You are not known to my people.  A kodo is a mighty steed, and it is the product of love and care by my people; such is not given onto strangers.  Until the elders of Thunder Bluff consider you to be exalted, I cannot offer you the sale of a kodo.
And you are?
Can you not see that I am busy here?
Do not waste my time.  What is it you want?
Yes?  What do you want?
Train hard, train every day. And when you have perfected your skills, return to me.
Welcome to Tinker Town!
Speak not your vulgar language to me!  Only Hydraxis can stand it.
Speak with Hydraxis.
You have no business with me, little one.
Welcome to Camp Mojache, brave $C. How may I assist you this day?
I've got plenty of great recipes for you to take a look at, and at discounted prices, too!

Oh, you've got oodles of things to learn still. I would teach you everything if I could, but I'm still learning too! Why don't you talk to Trixie Quickswitch in Ironforge, she'll help you further your education!
You want to train? With me? Fantastic! The only thing better than assembling bullets and explosive devices is to share that knowledge with someone else! Let's get started!
To die in battle is glorious! But, with what I teach you, maybe you not die so quickly, hm?
You come to wrong place. Talk to the expert Godan over there. You learn more from him.
Leave off. I don't have anything for the likes of you.
Good! I can tell that my efforts will not be wasted!
You require the instruction of a true master! Go to Daryl Stack in Tarren Mill and embrace your destiny!
A darkness had fallen over my eyes, but you tore me from my unholy reverie.  You saved me, $N.$B$BAnd now I beg you... to forgive me.
I must have lived a charmed life, $N. To return to the world as a member of the Forsaken and the Apothecary Society... I couldn't have asked for a more suitable fate.
What is it, $c?
It's good to hear the voices of others here in Forest Song again. I'd begun to feel as though I might be the last of the kaldorei ever to set eyes on these lands before their descent into corruption.
The Emerald Dream has become a dangerous place. I grow increasingly concerned for those who have sacrificed their waking life in Azeroth in hopes of saving it.
$N, it's good to see you again!  Are you having fun at the Faire?$B$BWant to arm wrestle?  No, of course not... you want to keep your arm!
Get it over with you filthy $r.$B$B<Kharan lowers his head, exposing his stubby neck.>
What!
At dis point you know as much as I do, mon. Maybe you go see Magar in Orgrimmar. He not be da happiest tailor around, but he help you anyway.
Dat's da attitude! Grab a needle and thread and let's get jammin'!
A foul wind blows from the East, $c.
You are eager, that is good. However, you are not yet ready to train with the likes of me.

You have nearly reached the pinnacle of your training. To become the greatest enchanter you can possibly be, you have one more instructor to seek out. Her name is Annora, and you may find her in Uldaman.
Your skills are truly becoming extraordinary. Now, let us continue your training...

Please, please, please tell me you are here to get me out of these shackles.  There's got to be a key somewhere...$B$BAt the very least, maybe you can take out Guard Slip'kik.  I think I might be able to help you out!$B$BSee that broken trap over yonder?  The ogres are too stupid to figure out how to fix it.  Clearly, it needs a thorium widget and some frost oil.  If you fix it, I bet you could lure Slip'kik into it, and BLAMMO - trapped ogre guard!
After all these years of fighting, now everyone's falling in love!
I must have broken hundreds of vials when I first began brewing potions. The glass was so fragile in my clumsy hands. I hope you are more cautious than I was.
Teaching is not a one-sided trade, $N. As I teach you, I learn more myself, and my understanding grows.

Speak quickly; I don't have time to waste on idle chatter. The Forsaken have become a force to be reckoned with, but there is still much to do in a given day. This city doesn't run itself.$b$bWhat do you want?
I will teach you what I can. Each lesson is a gift from the Goddess herself. Use her gifts wisely, and you shall not falter.
Your skills are beyond my reach. It is time for you to face new challenges. Taladan will help you prepare. He is standing by the table there.

Welcome, $N. I am Landro Longshot - manager of the Black Flame. Perhaps you've not heard of the Black Flame until now. That doesn't surprise me; we work to keep things that way. We prefer to avoid... factional entanglements.$B$BThe Black Flame specializes in providing the finest services and entertainment money can buy, whether they happen to be hard to find items, gladiatorial combat, or lucrative games of chance.$B$BAre you here seeking something specific?$B

Look at these samples! What does it mean? What does it mean? I'm going to need time, time to look at all this information. And I'll need more information. Information I can't get... damn! Think, Laris, think!$B$BWhat are you going to do? What?!$B$BThere has to be a solution!
No, no, you'll need FAR more training before you're ready to learn from me! Go talk to that uptight dabbler Malcomb Wynn. He's the one buried in books over there.
Well, I've seen better. But, you have potential, I won't deny it. Pay attention and you just might learn something!
Very well, let your journey of tailoring begin.
You can learn from me in time, but not yet! Why don't you start out by talking to Sprite Jumpsprocket to my right here. You can check in with me after you've gotten your feet wet!
My teachings would be too advanced for you at this stage. If you wish to learn more of potions, speak with Tel'Athir here instead.

A Sulfuron ingot?!??! Impossible! I must have it! I must! I must!$B$B$R, I am authorized to make you a grand deal for that ingot. Perhaps you would be interested to know the secrets of the Hand of Ragnaros? Sulfuras, idiot! The legendary hammer of the Firelord.
<Lydros reaches into his robe and presents you with a dull, flat elven blade.>$B$BIn ages past, well before even the War of the Ancients, there existed this blade.
Only the most valiant and honorable amongst the tribe can earn the honor of being laid to rest at Red Rocks.
You are not ready. Speak to Betty Quinn, she's standing by the stairs over there. Return to me when you have achieved a higher enlightenment.
You've got to try some of this beer.
Elune's grace upon you.  How can I serve?
Expertly accomplished! Now, let us continue your education...
Your knowledge is great, traveler. You must learn from one who is wiser than I. Many tales have been told of the wisdom of Josef Gregorian. You may find him in Undercity.
<The Major nods curtly.>
Eh, well you've made it this far... go see Lavinia Crowe by the other bookshelf there. If you don't mess things up with her, maybe you can learn some more.
You don't look like much to me, but who knows, maybe there's an enchanter hidden in there somewhere!
You've become quite the hunter, $N! Not only have you proven your skills, you also bested Daryl, which gets you extra points in my book!$B$BYou're welcome here any time.
Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up!  I hope you have good news, $n...
What brings you to a bunch of old, washed-up desert dogs like us?

Is this the best they could do?$B$B<Omarion musters the strength to laugh.>$B$BYou do not possess the resolve to face a monster like Kel'Thuzad. You will crumble before his minions - just like those that have come before you...$B$BLeave me here to die. I refuse to return to a world that champions the likes of you.
There are basics that must be learned. Trianna is standing nearby, speak with her and return to me later.
You have done well, traveler. I am proud to call you my student!

Ah, a fellow warlock who has proven $ghis:her; worth to some degree.$B$BI am pleased to meet your acquaintance. My name is Menara Voidrender... and not without just cause.$B$BYou seem powerful and well-learned enough that other tools... more powerful tools... would be welcome and not foolishly imparted. If this is true, then speak to me further. If not, well then, you know your way  back to the docks and off into the ocean.
Have you spoken to either of my acolytes inside the tower yet, $N? We cannot complete your orb until you've done one of their tasks. Speak to them now, if you're ready.

Kar Aman, $N. You look to be a strong $c--you would do well to mind yourself in this area. Touching things you know nothing about, or showing disrespect to your elders is just cause for punishment.$B$BYou may not respect me or my companions, but you will learn to respect our power if you prove foolish enough.$B$BNow, enough with the pleasantries, was there something I can do for you?
Ready for another lesson? All right, then. First, relax. You gotta stay loose to stir a potion just right.
You got questions, but they be too big for me to answer, $N. You be needin' to have words with the orc Yelmak in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He'll help you out.
Across the lands our fires burn strong and true!
Have you danced at the ribbon pole yet?
I admire the skill that torch jugglers have.
The Midsummer Fire Festival has something for everyone to enjoy!
It takes a lot of dedication to train and ride a Venomhide.
I know a few things. You want me to show you?
You know who can really show you some things? Nogg! You go find him in Orgrimmar.

Your skill in blacksmithing is exceptional, $N. The time has come to make a decision. There are two paths you may choose: The way of the weaponsmith or the art of the armorsmith.$B$BBe warned, when you have chosen to dedicate yourself to a path, there is no going back. The discipline each path requires leaves no room for hybrids.
My apologies, but you have already learned everything I know. The night elf Faldron could offer you further training, however. Look for him in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.

It... It's foggy, $N. I can't see anything! Wait... Wait a minute. I see... I see Doctor Weavil's hideout. It... YES! I believe he is holding a chapter of the book!$B$BLet me see if I can zoom this thing out to get a better vantage point.$B$B<Narain appears to be going cross-eyed.>$B$BAlcaz Island! That devious bastard is on Alcaz Island!
Care to purchase some piratey items?

To catch Gahz'ranka, you'll need a special Mudskunk lure.  I make 'em myself!$B$BBut you need more than just the lure; you need some mudskunks too... you need to place them in the lure to give it a rank old smell!$B$BWhen you have the mudskunks, throw the lure off Pagle's Point in Zul'Gurub... and then grab a drink and wait... but not too long, because Gahz'ranka is sure to come a'stomping!
You have earned the privilege of training with a higher instructor. Go see my pal Roxxik there.
You have not yet earned the right to train with me. See Thund first, over by the table. Come back when he says you're ready!
You have passed your test, well done! Your training may now continue.
Welcome to Dolanaar, $c. Let me know if you need any recipes or basic cooking ingredients.
What?

Welcome to Thorium Point. As Overseer, I'm responsible for all the activities of the Thorium Brotherhood.  While that mainly involves mining, smithing, and some minor guard duty, we've lately become more of a martial organization... out of necessity.
Now, answer me this, $N:$BWhich creature became the Lich King before spreading the plague across Lordaeron?
You have completed Teronis' mission, and I appreciate all you have done, $N.

Hail $c. Didn't I see you recently at an exclusive gathering? You look familiar, but then again this city is a busy place.$B$BIf you attended that convention, then surely you were given a secret code. Tell me your code and I will give you a special prize in return.
Missing US text
You should talk to Winstone. I hear he's looking for thieves with your skill.
You're shaping up nicely, $N. I've heard good things...
Missing US text
Try to ignore the firm, feathery behinds of the harpies... the creatures are really quite deadly!
How can I share my secrets with a beginner? Try speaking with Victor Ward first.
You have worked your way up, time to see the boss. Go to Josef and tell him you are ready.

How dare you ask me for training, maggot? What were you hoping for, you slack-jawed yokel, a lecture on the proper uses of silverleaf? Out! You're lucky I don't thrash you senseless for wasting my time.
Sorry $g lad : lass;, ye aren't quite up to the challenge of learning from me. Go see my son Groum, it would make his day to get a new apprentice.
I can't teach what I don't know! If only there was someone else who knew more than I do... wait, there is! Go see Buzzek Bracketswing in Gadgetzan!
Nice going! I knew I was right about you, no matter what those other people said. Ha! I'm kidding! Okay, on with your lessons.
Nice try, but you'll need some more experience before training with me! Back to the trenches!
May the Sun's light protect you, $c.
Oh hi! My name's Sarah. What can I do for you?
A fine display of worthiness. Your instruction may now continue.
Speak with Lawrence Shneider at Duncan's Textiles around the corner to the left. He is adept at dealing with beginners.
You are beyond my level of expertise. Georgio Bolero, the master of Duncan's Textiles around the corner could help you advance your skills.

Another student. Wonderful. This is why Lydon belongs to the Royal Society of Snobs and gets to do research, and I'm stuck being an instructor. If I win another teaching award, I'll never live it down!
Don't waste my time. I have research projects older than you. Go talk to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. He's a Forsaken who can probably manage to teach you the basics.
Missing US text

The forces of the Sentinel Army hold back the Horde across all of Kalimdor. While the war continues in Ashenvale and Stonetalon, our forces are also needed here, to protect these remaining wilds and prevent our enemies from gaining further footholds.

The Shattered Hand's influence dominates these lands. We are the veil which covers Kalimdor: The protectorates, the police, the judges, the jury, and ultimately, the executioners. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.$B$BUnderstand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.
All of Nature's might is at my disposal, puny mortals. Let us see which of my many forms it will be that ends your suffering!
All of a sudden they were everywhere.

All of a sudden you're a 'Defender of the Alliance' are you?! Well, I suppose you'll be wanting to head to the Champions' Hall now. It's over in Old Town, but they won't let you in unless you're an officer, so you might just have to settle for talking to Officer Areyn outside. Move along now.

All of our collections are completed, $c. That which we have assembled is in the process of being transported to Cenarion Hold in Silithus, and the last of it should take no more than a day to arrive. The Ahn'Qiraj War can then start once that is done and someone brave and foolish rings the gong right outside of the gates down there.

All of the Horde's war effort tasks are completed, young $c. Now we need but wait for the Alliance to also finish theirs and all will be ready for the Ahn'Qiraj War. Except perhaps for the gathering and reunification of the pieces to the Scepter of the Shifting Sands?

All of the collecting is done and the finished goods are being shipped over to Silithus as they're being completed. Looks like less than $2113w days until all of it is over there. After that we just need to get someone to ring that gong and open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj. Then the real fun begins.

All of the fish and everything else is on its way to Silithus, and should be there in less than $2113w days. After that someone's going to have to ring that gong with the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to start the war.

That is when the Ahn'Qiraj War will begin. May the Earth Mother watch over all of us then.

All of us, working collectively, have accomplished a great task. Now an even greater one confronts us. We only await the completion of the Horde's gathering efforts and then we shall all confront the Silithid and their masters together.
All of you fought hard and valiantly. It makes me proud to see the warriors you have become.
All present and accounted for, SIR!
All requests for my work must be made in person by the buyer. Orwin often asks me to reconsider, but my priorities lie here. Look around you: many of these fighters rely upon me for their armor.

All right now. Aside from the obvious distractions a minion like this will provide against your more masculine foes, she is also capable of dealing out impressive amounts of damage. However, her fragile endurance makes her almost useless as a shield.
All right people, look alive!

All right then... I know the way to and from Gadgetzan.  What I need for you to do is to keep the beasts off of us.  I've trained Dadanga how to defend herself pretty well, but we can't handle the overgrown madness out there for long.  Let me know when you're ready to go, $N.
All right!  Party time!
All right, I think I can make it on my own from here.  I don't know who you are... but I owe you one.  Thank you!
All right, Reavers!  The orders are here!  To battle!
All right, boss. You sure though? Just seems like a waste of good practice.
All right, watch my back while I get you some of this ore.
All right, you guys! Time to get up
All right, you lazy bums, time to get up and get started. That bridge isn't getting built on its own.
All right.  It's made!
All that official business is handled up in Stormwind these days.  You could stop by the Stormwind Visitor's Center if you want to start a guild.
All the bottles on this table are potions I brewed today. And they say a watched pot never boils. Ha!
All the fisherman have moved to Darnassus with the recent attacks around Lake Al'Ameth.  You should try looking for someone to train you there.
All the resources have been gathered.  Yippee!

All the roguish types hang out in The Forlorn Cavern, north of the gates of Ironforge.  I'd wager ye'll find Fenthwick there, no doubt counting the coin of another cut purse.  I'll catch him one of these days!  

In the meantime I'll have my eye on you as well, $glad : lass;.
All they be doin' is a little huntin' and gatherin'. Where's the harm in that??
All those official types reside in Ironforge.  Ye'll be wanting to check out the Ironforge Visitor's Center for guild creation papers.
All those who betray Ragnaros must die!
All will be well children.  The Light shall see to that!
All will know of what has transpired here in this accursed temple, hero. It will be written about in history books - the tales told as legend from Azeroth to the far reaches of the Nether itself!
All you $R want is my weed.
Allow me to get some water for the inking reagent.
Almost done...
Almost perfect shot! It's a bit off but I can see where Grumlar would miss with it. He couldn't hit the broad side of a barn.
Alms for the poor?
Alright I'm going! Stop yelling!
Alright you sorry sacks of bones. Let's see what you've got. Strike your opponent, and don't stop till I say so.
Alright! Alright! We surrender... Just put your weapons down, I'll cooperate!
Alright, $N, your transponder is ready!
Alright, I'll sign writs now. Bring 'em to the front, maggots.

Alright, alright. Anyhow, so I sorta slipped into the shadows.$B$BThat didn't sit too well with Windsor, seeing as how he was already extra cranky. Well he started spinnin' old Ironfoe around and screaming like a mad man at the orcs.
Alright, alright. You two can go play just stay in town. No sneaking off to bug Warg and Khara down by the water.
Alright, everything looks in order. Let's get this show on the road.
Alright, we're getting close to the excavation site, so we have to proceed carefully. Engage underwater breathing apparatus...
Alright, we've just gotten word that a caravan is leaving from Thelsamar. It's time to move! Go go go!
Alright. Where?

Alrighty then! So I was down at the lava pits of the Molten Span, testing out my lava suit. Everything was going great. I was even able to swim around in that stuff without suffering a single injury!$B$BSo there I am, minding my own business, doing a few backstrokes, when out of nowhere this thing swallows me up whole! Had it not been for my lava suit and built in food pellet dispenser, I would have been done for!
Alterac Valley
Alterac Valley - Alliance Quatmaster Greeting Option Default

Alterac Valley has been home to the Frostwolf Clan for years; we will not let the dwarves and their Alliance trespass!  And so we battle!$B$BTo win back Alterac, defeat their general Vanndar Stormpike, in Dun Baldar.$B$BFor the Horde!
Althea, there are reports of strange happenings at the graveyard.  Ello believes it portends an attack on Darkshire.

Although I am flattered by your confidence in my abilities, teaching you is beyond my skill. You must go to the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, and speak with the night elf Ainethil. She can help you.
Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.
Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

Always a good skill to have that Survival is.

Kaerbrus is who you are looking for. He's usually around the moonwell in the Park.
Always double-check your measurements before you begin to cut the leather. We cannot afford to waste materials.
Always so negative. The chances of that happening are between zero and none.
Am I busy? What's that supposed to mean? Do you think I just stand here all day, twiddling my thumbs? If you're here to buy something, talk to Handor.
Am I carrying any letters addressed to $N? Why, no!  Looks like it's time for you to die!
Amakkar, where do you think Warlord Goretooth is going to send us? I don't think I can handle another tour in the Steppes.
Amazing to see little flowers persist in the cold of Dun Morogh...  but ye won't find any herbalists out here.  Ye'll have to go to Ironforge to get some training in that profession.
Amazing!  It worked!  $N, I have your armor.
Amazing! How did you manage a permanent dominate?
Amazing! I feel... renewed. My strength returns!
Amazing! I think I have found it, $N!
Amazing! I've never spoken to a ghost. I wish to learn!

Amazing, aren't they? All these artifacts and remains.$B$BI'm not sure what I'm more impressed by, their size, or the stories that go along with them. There's so much to study and learn. And the connections we can make...$B$BDid you know rumor has it that many races have the same heritage as Night elves?
An Alchemy trainer is what you need?  Well, I just came from there, I did.  Ye'll find Ms. Berryfizz over in Tinker Town where the gnomes gather.

An Alliance Commendation Signet is awarded to a $g hero : heroine; who goes above and beyond the call of duty to the Alliance.  Various Commendation Officers for the factions of the Alliance are located in all of the major cities; speak with the one with whom you'd like to raise your reputation, and give them the number of signets they ask for!$B$BBy the way, during the war effort here, if you'd rather receive a material reward for your signets in lieu of reputation, seek out Field Marshal Snowfall.
An Ash'ari Crystal has been restored!

An alchemist?  No trouble at all $c.  Ainethil, in all her labor and toil, has become the most accomplished alchemist in the Craftsmen's Terrace.  I would head over there on the double if I were you. On the double!  Now off with you!
An amazing discovery you have made. I would love an opportunity to look at all of the failed experiments.

An excellent question! We have many things for sale here at the faire. If you are interested in food and drink, then head over to Stamp and Sylannia's booth. My favorite is the Darkmoon Special Reserve.

If you'd rather purchase something more exotic, then Lhara may have just the thing for you. She specializes in rarities from all over the world.

And then there is Flik running around here somewhere. If you can grab him he sells balls for throwing and frogs to keep as pets.
An honor to see you again, $N.
An interesting response to my question... and the wrong one.
An interesting turning of events.
An orc - a true orc warrior - wishes for one thing: To die in the glory of battle against a hated enemy.

An unspeakable horror dwells here, mortal.  C'Thun and his worshippers are not just an affront to nature, their existence presages destruction for Azeroth as we know it.$B$BMerithra sacrificed herself a thousand years ago along with Caelestrasz and Arygos because they knew this as well.  We're here because of our oath to return for them, but we're also here because C'Thun must be stopped!
Anachronos, I have lost the signet ring. Could you supply me with a replacement?
Anathera and Latherion fought back to back where the battle was thickest. Two lovers determined to survive the war together.
Anathera!
Anathera... I cannot bear to face the rest of eternity without you by my side... If you are taken from me, then let this be the day I also return to the earth...
Anaya...? Do my eyes deceive me? Is it really you?

en: Ancient forces stir - forces that have not been seen or felt for thousands of years. The world weeps, $r. Perhaps a new sundering comes. A sickness born from within...$B$BThe foulness has begun to seep into our lands. From the Dream come nightmares. Nightmares to befoul us in our waking hours...
Ancients, rise!
And I am determined to find out more... So if you need my help again, you know where I'll be.
And I was suited to see this?
And I wish I could join you $N. Head over to Stormwind Keep. You'll find Thelman Slatefist in the King's audience chamber. He will aid you in getting to Alterac Valley.
And STAY dead!
And Shindigger Stout too!  Thank the Light!  I was parched!

And a good day to ya, brave $c.  I know ya be lookin' for a fine steed.  There's no finer steed than a raptor under your reigns, lemme tell you $g mon : sis;!  Take a look at the ones I got to offer - bred from the fiercest stock anywhere.
And a great deal of honor you shall have, I am sure.  Speak with Martin Lindsey at the Pools of Vision.  It is a cave located in the side of the Spirit Rise.
And crossing the line is the gnome car! The gnomes win!
And did he?
And finally the candle... to burn those who would thwart you!
And find it he did. After quickly advancing through the ranks of the Cult, the Lich King himself granted Ras immortality. Thus was born Ras Frostwhisper, the lich.$B$BNow do you understand?
And for our gods?
And for the ladies, roast baby boar. Enjoy!

And go where? It was all that we knew; all that we had known and all that we would ever know.$B$BEventually, we lost contact with the Barovs and ultimately, were separated from the household. We knew not what happened to the other servants, only that there were screams. Tortured screams.$B$BKnowing that we had nowhere to go, Lucien and I were forced to hide in our quarters. During the day, when the school was relatively quiet, Lucien would sneak out to scrounge up food and drink.
And if you do not, then I am truly lost.
And it's the $n coming through turn one!
And might I add, that dress is lovely! You must tell me where you got it from.
And modest too... Perhaps it is your time, then, $N.$B$BAre you prepared to enter the fortress of the Blackrock orcs? To wreak havoc? To tear asunder the foundation of the mountain citadel?
And now for a quick look at these gems.

And now the war, it be comin' soon. All that be left is the sendin' of all these goods and weapons to the Cenarion Hold in Silithus, and that is gonna be done within $2113w days. Then some brave soul is gonna have to be ringin' the gong near those Ahn'Qiraj gates to open 'em and start the war.

And now the war, it be comin' soon. All that be left is the sendin' of all these goods and weapons to the Cenarion Hold in Silithus, and that is gonna be done within a day. Then some brave soul is gonna have to be ringin' the gong near those Ahn'Qiraj gates to open 'em and start the war.
And now you know why I live in a crater.
And now, even those nations that you would have called allies have recoiled and joined forces with us... Yes, old one, do not look so surprised.
And now... the final step!
And one time, at camp, I caught a fish that was bigger than I am!!
And should one die, two shall rise!
And so it begins...
And so the knights stood before the charging Horde and held their ground as a thousand berserk orcs came through the valley.
And stay down!
And thank you, $N.  Without your aid I may never have found my way to the Forsaken.
And that's how Lothar killed thirty six orcs with his bare hands!
And the Tastyfish have gone for the week!   I will remain for another hour to allow you to turn in your fish!
And then the Tauren said, '13 INCHES!'
And then the rabbit just bit his head off... I swear.

en: And they're off!
And this is Comar Villard. Two weeks married, his wife was spirited away from the safety of Menethil Harbor.
And to think, one day you might be the one that the stories of legend are about!
And ultimately, it was Ragnaros that named me when I was reborn as an acolyte of fire: Lathoric... Lathoric the Black.
And what do you say?
And you did...
And... do you expect to defeat the Primal Gods?
Annalise... You're right. I-I can't do this. I must find another way.
Annalise? Annalise! No, don't leave me!
Annalise? Is that you?
Another Alchemist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.
Another Engineer! Hey, this is a great chance for me to show off some new gadgets I've been building!
Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.
Another Survivalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.
Another Tracker, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.
Another day gone by...
Another entrepreneur, eh? Well, the Auction House can be found in the Trade District.  Not far from the bank.
Another fool falls for the trap!
Another fool falls to the Defias Brotherhood.
Another glorious day of fishin' is ahead of me, Khara. I best get movin'.
Another good day indeed.
Another herd brought in successfully!
Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?
Another lovely day on our beautiful island.
Another material $gboy : girl; are we?  Well, if you are obsessed with your precious items then you will probably want to store them at the Darnassus Bank in the center of our city.
Another question on the first chain ANSWERED!
Another student, eh? All right. I'll see what I can do to help you out.
Another victory for the Defias Brotherhood!
Another wave, hold the line!
Another way? Do tell...

Ansekhwa, da tauren weapon master, is on da Thunder Bluff lower rise.  He teach one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

Archibald, da undead weapon master in da War Quarter of da Undercity, train good with crossbows, daggers, one and two-handed swords and polearms.

Sayoc, da ugly orc right here, can teach da ways of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons mon.

Ansekhwa, the tauren weapon master, is on Thunder Bluff's lower rise.  He can train one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

Hanashi, standing next to me here, can instruct in the use of bows, one and two-handed axes, staves and all manner of thrown weapons.

Archibald, the undead weapon master in the War Quarter of the Undercity, can teach the use of crossbows, daggers, one and two-handed swords and polearms.
Answer cannot be seen through the twisting nether.
Anthion, I seem  to have misplaced the banner you created for me.
Anthion, I seem to have misplaced the banner you created for me.
Anti-escape countermeasures activated. Self-destruct in t-minus 20 seconds....
Antonio Perelli's miracle elixirs for sale!
Anu therador mali $c.  Where can I guide you to?

Any chance to fight against the Horde, especially orcs, is a good time if you ask me. You'll find plenty of battle in Warsong Gulch, that you will. Head on over to the Hall of Arms and speak with Lylandris. She'll set you on your way.
Any friend of the animals is a friend of mine.  The Hunter's Hall is what you seek.  It sits atop the Hunter Rise.
Any one else ready to feel the wrath of the Defias Brotherhood?
Anya Maulray at inn on upper ring of Trade Quarter.
Anyone see anything? What happened?
Anyone suspicious is to be taken down quickly. Get to your posts as quickly as possible!
Anyone want to take a break?  Well too bad!  Get to work you oafs!
Anything else I should know about the Earthen?
Anything else?
Apply the Gordok war paint!
Arathi Basin
Arathi Basin place to take from soft humans.  Sir Malory Wheeler send you there.
Arathi Basin was once our home, and will be again with your aid!  Will you help us $c?
Arcanum? That sounds very familiar.
Archibald who you look for.  He outside weapon merchant shop on inner ring of War Quarter.
Are the Blasted Lands currently under attack?
Are the Burning Steppes currently under attack?
Are the Eastern Plaguelands currently under attack?
Are there any areas you can think of that would be so untouched?
Are these lands not beyond healing? They look pretty beat up.
Are they all... dead?

Are ye really askin' me where the Blacksmith is?  Have ye not heard of The Great Forge!?  All our best blacksmiths gather there to craft their weapons and armor!  

It's dead smack in the middle of Ironforge, and that's where you'll find one of our most brilliant blacksmiths, Bengus Deepforge.
Are you a student of the medical sciences?
Are you blind youngling? Shayis is standing right outside.

Are you daft? Did you miss the BONY SKELETAL CREATURES littering the landscape on your way over here?$B$B<Rohan sighs.>$B$BIf you're the outdoor type, you'll find skeletal creatures all over both the Western and Eastern Plaguelands. Trust me, you can't miss 'em - they certainly won't miss you if they get the chance.$B$BIf you're a dungeon type, Stratholme and Scholomance are definitely the place to be for bone fragments.
Are you daft? Who else would I be talking about? Yes, the girl - Mistress Mar'alith. Anyhow, she was back and not in too good of a mood. That's when the demands started flowing.
Are you going to let an injured dwarf do all the work for you?
Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.
Are you here to fight for us at Warsong Gulch?  Lok'tar Ogar $c!
Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?
Are you kidding me? You must be kidding me! Either that or you think I'm a clown here to amuse you. Is that what you think? That I'm a clown? Huh, is it! You think I'm a clown don't you!

Are you mad? Do you know what manner of beast inhabit that place? The worst that can happen is that we'll have to scoop up your remains with a shovel. We've lost some good dwarves to those awful monsters.$B$BSo the answer is no. If you're bent on getting to the Searing Gorge, you'll have to find another way.
Are you new here?  Well, tell me what you're looking for then.
Are you piggies hungry? I have some food for you...
Are you ready to fetch, boy?

Are you reporting for duty, $c? All of the war materiel for both the Horde and the Alliance is completed and being shipped to Silithus as we speak. It should all arrive in less than $2113w days. I hope that someone has found the different pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and put them all together.

Are you reporting for duty, $c? All of the war materiel for both the Horde and the Alliance is completed and being shipped to Silithus as we speak. It should all arrive in less than a day. I hope that someone has found the different pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and put them all together.
Are you sure you weren't followed here? I have a very bad feeling all of a sudden...
Are you the Earthshaper capable of creating Elementium?
Aren't the patterns beautiful? Each one speaks with its own voice.
Aren't you a little short for your kind?
Argh! What was that? It's not supposed to work like this!
Argh! You're hopeless!
Argh, I need help here!
Argh, the pain. Will it ever leave me?
Argus is the resident blacksmith of Goldshire.  I'm sure he could teach you the Blacksmith's profession.
Aright *hic*... Say, you look familiar *hic*. Have I ever told you about the time me and Windsor fought off thir, er... a thous... a million orcs?$B$BOh settle down friend, this is a good one!
Armand Cromwell always on dock in Magic Quarter.  Fish in green goo taste extra good.  You try.
Arnok makes good bandages.  Find him at the Survival of the Fittest hut on the shore of the lake next to Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  It's above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

Around this reindeer's neck is a tag with the Smokywood Pastures logo on it and a name - "Metzen".$B$BMetzen looks at you with sad, forlorn eyes.  It is almost as if the reindeer has been immobilized by some unseen force.
Arr!   There be nothin I like to see better than folks fightin to the death in the arena.   If you be here at the right time maybe you can be one of them!
Arrr, Me Hearties!   I be havin' some extra Treasure that I be givin' away at the Gurubashi Arena!  All ye need do to collect it is open the chest I leave on the arena floor!
Arthur Moore in Rogues' Quarter inner ring is one who teach leatherworking.

As I understand it dear, everything has been gathered and the final materiel is being assembled and shipped off to Cenarion Hold. The last of it should arrive in less than $2113w days. Once our equipment and forces are all there, the bearer of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands can ring the gong near Ahn'Qiraj to open the gates. Then the war will begin.

As I understand it dear, everything has been gathered and the final materiel is being assembled and shipped off to Cenarion Hold. The last of it should arrive in less than a day. Once our equipment and forces are all there, the bearer of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands can ring the gong near Ahn'Qiraj to open the gates. Then the war will begin.

As I was saying, I held onto that scepter shard for a good five-hundred years and it was nothing but trouble. It attracted all kinds of attention - the wrong kind of attention. I want to be left alone to my studies not babysit some would be hero's ticket to glory. So... I gave it to the fish.

As a culture we believe in letting nothing go to waste.  When we are forced to slay a creature we take what we can to make sure its sacrifice was not in vain.  

If you wish to learn the proper way to take the skin of a slain beast, then seek out Eladriel in the Craftsmen's Terrace.

As a young night elf in Darkshore, I crossed paths with a group of unsavory individuals known as the Twilight's Hammer. A group of them befriended me and shamefully, I ended up eschewing my faith in Elune and embracing the vitriol of the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BIt was not until a vision came to me from Elune, that I woke up from the malaise that I had fallen into as a follower of the old gods.$B$BIn repentance, I began work on my prayer to Elune.

As acting Taskmaster of this here compound, it is my duty to make sure that there is a certain level of tedium involved with all forms of business, work, rest, and relaxation that may take place here.$B$BIf you find anything that you are asked to do to be too easy and hassle free, report to me immediately.
As deadly as the silithid seem, they are but tame creatures compared to their Qiraji overlords.
As good as I told you it would be, yes?
As if I don't have better things to do in my old age than carry buckets of water.
As if I had all eternity.
As long as those dwarves stay over there we'll have no trouble.  Where are you heading $N?
As members of the Horde, we must contribute to our community to ensure that it continues to thrive. Thus, I am certain you will gladly aid us by undertaking a small task I have for you.
As nice as Gadgetzan is compared to Un'Goro, I have some good folks counting on us to bring them some supplies.  If you're ready to go, then so are Dadanga and I.  Let's mount up!
As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.
As to your warning - worry not. Our troops are all aware of the chain of command. We fight united. Let us hope your own troops remember that...

As we were making our way across the Burning Steppes, we were ambushed. It must have been a hundred of them... Dark Iron dwarves! They were shifting out of the walls, from the rocks in the Steppes; out of every crevice, nook, and cranny in sight. They swarmed us, overwhelming the guards and the few brave heroes that had agreed to assist us on this mission.$B$BOne thing was clear: This was a highly orchestrated ambush. It was as if they knew every move we would make before we made them...

As you can see, I am but one man with a lumbering oaf of a squire. The might of the Dark Iron dwarves and the beasts held in the grip of Ragnaros would surely overwhelm me alone, but I have the utmost confidence that such a brave and ambitious adventurer such as you would have no problem handling the denizens of the cauldron. Should you choose to assist me, I shall reward you with riches and wealth beyond your wildest dreams.
As you fall in battle, we continue to grow in strength. There is only one inevitable outcome. Prepare for your end!
As you wish sir.
As you wish, $c.
As you wish, Eitrigg.
As you wish, Vaelan.
As you wish, sir.
As you wish...
Ashbringer...
Ask Kibler about the treasure! SQUAWK!
Ask me how to get a free drink at the Blue Recluse!
Aspiring to join our ranks one day?  Sark Ragetotem can help you on your way.  He's in the Hunter's Hall.
Assassins! Guards! Guards!
Assassins... save... th... Magistraaa...
Astaia has fished up some curious treasures over the ages she has spent fishing.  Why don't you go see her over in the Tradesman's terrace and have her show you some of them.
Astor? Taken your bloody time getting here, so let's not waste any time, shall we?
Astounding!  So then indurium is the key!
Astounding. You managed to dominate her, yet she retains self awareness and function. How did you do it?
At last - one among you is worthy of my knowledge. Worry not - I have probed your thoughts, no harm will come to you.

At last! I am finally free from this cell!$b$bThe Kirin Tor sent me from Dalaran to investigate Arugal's progress with the undead here in Silverpine Forest. Little did we know that the wizard had lost his grasp on sanity.$b$bI must report this mess at once! But before I leave, allow me to undo the magical lock on the courtyard door.$b$bYou defeated Rethilgore, perhaps you will survive what lies beyond....
At last! Naralex awakes from the nightmare.
At last! Naralex can be awakened! Come aid me, brave adventurers!

At last! Someone to free me from this cell!$b$bHigh Executor Hadrec sent us to gather information on the Keep so that a plan could be formulated to overthrow Arugal once and for all.$b$bBut the old wizard has many tricks up his sleeve and we were detected by a magical ward. I was thrown in this prison. Vincent was not so lucky.$b$bI must return to Hadrec to debrief him at once. But first I will pick the lock to the courtyard door for you. Perhaps you can try your luck against the foes that lurk beyond.
At last, I am free of the corruption that once bound me to this place...
At last, I have caught up with you, Nefarian. Surely you did not think you would escape the might of the other Aspects?
At last, it ends....
At last, my soul is free!
At last, the agony ends. I have failed you my Queen. I have failed us all...
At last, the curse is lifted. Thank you, hero.
At last, the serum is complete, $n. Now, come closer. We must talk.
At least we wouldn't be around to have to clean it up.
At the southeast edge of town is the Gallows' End Tavern.  Go there and head upstairs, and you'll find Dark Cleric Beryl inside the reading room.
At this point, I will summon someone to examine the pendant, and find a hidden compartment...
At this rate I could have gathered them myself!
Athrikus came to us. He told us that he could save us from harm. He cast a spell upon us to protect us from harm.
Athrikus points at you as he bellows forth words that scrape apart the inside of your ears. They are the last thing you hear.
Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian. The staff handed down through the ages to each of the Guardians of Tirisfal. The staff corrupted by Sargeras. The staff of the last Guardian. The staff of Medivh.
Attack!  For the Horde!
Attack!!
Attacked! Help get this $n off of me!
Atten...HUT!
Auction House
Avert your eyes, children. The bloodrage has taken over...
Aw! The captured sprite darters didn't make it. What will we do?
Awaiting orders from my superiors.
Awaiting orders!
Awaiting orders, sir. On your command, I shall unleash hell upon them!
Awake, ye servants! Defend the Disks!
Away to Thunder Bluff to the north is where your journey takes you then friend.  Once there seek out the wisdom of one of the Bluffwatchers who can tell you directly where to find whom you seek.
Awe inspiring, master. Your ineptitude is awe inspiring.
Aww, what rotten luck! My skills aren't good enough to be of any use to you. Oh well. Talk to Fimble Finespindle over there by the loom. He's been working with leather for longer than I have.
Awww Mom! It's hardly dark yet! Can we play for a bit longer please?
Aye $g lad : lass; are ye ready to head to Alterac Valley and give the Horde a taste o' what they been asking for?
Aye and thanks for letting me carry my own hand back to the priests that night.
Aye sure, just as long as we get to hit the arena right after!
Aye there you go lad, your favorite brew.

Aye, I could tell just by looking at you, $N. You remind me very much of myself as a young warrior of the Horde.$B$BYou will undoubtedly go far in life and even further in death.$B$B<Goretooth salutes.>

Aye, I did. Much to the dismay of the lesser Mograine, I made my way back to the Scarlet Monastery. I shouted and screamed. I told the tale to any that would listen. And I would be murdered in cold blood for my actions, dragged to this chamber - the dark secret of the order. But some did listen... some heard my words. Thus was born the Argent Dawn...
Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?
Aye, Remulos. Prepare the mortal races.

Aye, but I know it by its true name - Eldre'Thalas.  It was a bastion of magical power for the night elves many, many years ago.$B$BYou know of Eldre'Thalas, young one?  One might say that is coincidental to my current plight... but I am one not to believe in coincidence.
Aye, everyone wants to ride the tram, it's a real hoot and a half.  Well, if ye want to find the tram, it's located over in Tinker Town just east of the gates of Ironforge.
Aye, it appears as if ye have learned quite a bit, I'm impressed. But do ye know how many I have that seek to be my apprentice? Tell ye what, do a small task fer me and I'll take ye on.
Aye, it's a cold one today, but ne'er too cold to offer you my fine wares!
Aye, lads!  Things are about to get quite ugly.
Aye, tell your friend there Tongus if he dont take care of his tab here, i'll be making an appearance with old Steelhead!

Aye, the Highlord Mograine: A founder of the original order of the Scarlet Crusade. A knight of unwavering faith and purity; Mograine would be betrayed by his own son and slain by Kel'Thuzad's forces inside Stratholme. It is how I ended up here...
Aye, you look the type to be a leader.  Here to organize a guild to fight for the Alliance?

Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the Darkspear, then you can start by donating valuable resources for those in need!  Textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know.$B$BRather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the Darkspear!

Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the dwarves of Ironforge, then you can start by donating valuable resources!  Ironforge finds itself running low on cloth piece; textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know!$B$BRather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the dwarven people of Ironforge!
Azure Templar!  I hold your crest of beckoning.  Heed my summons!
BANG! BANG! BANG!  I'm beefing up the car!!!
BETRAYER!
Babba booey....
Baby wants her dolly!
Back from a long journey? Rest and relax at the Pig and Whistle!
Back off or I'll cut you in half.
Back to the drawing board.
Backhands $n solidly across the face.
Bad hang nail
Bad, $N. $N, bad!
Bagh! Back to work for me! Thank you kindly Belm.
Bah!  $N, this foot won't budge!

Bah!  Mailboxes...  all I get is junk mail lately!  

Increase the size of this... decrease the size of that... act now for your free Sword of Dragonslaying.  I have to change my mailbox number every other month!  

Well, ye can't say I didn't warn ye.  If you're looking for the mailbox it's just outside the Stonefire Tavern.
Bah! By the time you got in range of old Trollplow you would be in reduced to rubble!
Bah! Failed again!
Bah! My power rules here!
Bah! Now pet eat you!
Bah! That's no fun!
Bah! You wouldn't know a great steam engine if it smacked you upside the head!
Bah, it isn't here.  Where did I have that blasted thing at last?
Bah, it's not here.  I wonder where I left it last...
Bah, that's goblin work!  Still, we have an orc here in Razor Hill that will teach you of such things.  Look for Mukdrak over near the forge.
Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!
Balance has been restored!
Bale can teach you the ways of survival.  Look for him on the Hunter Rise.
Balthus Stoneflayer is the one to see about Skinning.  If it can be skinned, he can teach ye how.  Just walk yerself over to Finespindle's Leather Goods on the northern side of The Great Forge.

Bandages you say? Yes, well, if memory serves from the last time I was told, it would appear that the Alliance has created $2076w of $2077w linen bandages, $2082w of $2083w silk bandages and $2088w of $2090w runecloth bandages.

Bandages, anti-venoms and such things, these are the inevitable necessities of life on the plains.  Vira Younghoof can teach you this knowledge.  You can find her in the long house on the west side of Bloodhoof Village.

Bandages? Why, do you intend to survive long enough to need them? Har! Very well, $r, I will tell you. Of the $2080w wool bandaged needed, we have collected $2079w. Also to date, we have taken in $2085w out of $2086w mageweave bandages, and $2089w of $2090w runecloth bandages asked for.
Bank
Bank in Trade Quarter central tower.  You not miss it.
Bank of Ironforge
Bank of Stormwind
Banker option
Barely hit the target that time. Hmmm,... maybe I need to adjust back to the right.
Baristolth, I have lost my badge and require a replacement.
Barnil, I seem to have misplaced Chapter I.
Barnil, I seem to have misplaced Chapter II.
Barnil, I seem to have misplaced Chapter III.
Barnil, I seem to have misplaced Chapter IV.

Based on the sample of the toxin you provided for us, we think you will need the following: an arcane quickener, five somatic intensifiers, and and four pieces of runecloth.  With the vitreous focuser in tow, acquire the intensifiers from zombie or ghoul undead here in the Plaguelands!$B$BOnce you have these items, you should be able to load the counter agent into that cauldron.

Based on the sample of the toxin you provided for us, we think you will need the following: an arcane quickener, four ectoplasmic resonators, and four pieces of runecloth.  With the vitreous focuser in tow, acquire the resonators from wraith and ghostly undead here in the Plaguelands!$B$BOnce you have these items, you should be able to load the counter agent into that cauldron.

Based on the sample of the toxin you provided for us, we think you will need the following: an arcane quickener, six osseous agitators, and four pieces of runecloth.  With the vitreous focuser in tow, acquire the agitators from skeletal undead here in the Plaguelands!$B$BOnce you have these items, you should be able to load the counter agent into that cauldron.
Bash it!
Bat man on upper level of Trade Quarter.
Battle!  I can smell your fear, $c!
Battlemaster
Battling that band of Twilight Hammer in the Morass, I could think of better places for a war.
Bawk, bawk, bawk!  Happy Hallow's End, $N!

Be advised, $g Jackson : Princess; - I am in no mood for any comment that you think is cute or funny.  I am here to make sure that the Arch Druid's research proceeds as planned, and my orders are to weed out all non-hackers who do not pack the gear to serve in my beloved Cenarion Circle.
Be alert!  The orcs and their allies are close!
Be alert, you lazy mules!
Be bathed in my power! Drink in my might! Battle for the glory of the Horde!
Be bathed in the power of the Warchief! Drink in his might! Battle for the glory of the Horde!
Be careful out in the desert, $c.
Be cleansed by blade, filth!
Be cleansed!
Be gone!  I hold counsel with Dreadlords, and the matters we discuss are not your concern!
Be gone, infidel!  May the power of the Abyss smite you down!
Be healed, $g priest:priestess;.
Be healed, my pets!
Be lifted by $N's accomplishment! Revel in $g his:her; rallying cry!
Be on the alert! The Blackwood furbolgs are numerous in this area...
Be on your guard!
Be on your guard! There are reports of a humungous worm close to Hive'Zora!
Be patient, $N. The torch is almost complete.
Be quiet!  Can't you see the master is speaking?
Be safe, Antonio.
Be silent!  Do you think our plagued dragons will hatch and train themselves?
Be silent!  I cannot afford to miss even a moment of this lecture!
Be strong, Fizzule!
Be sure to catch all the amazing sights and wonders of the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town!
Be sure to read over the notes in my journal, $N. You will find them to be invaluable in overcoming the tower's defenses.
Be sure to stick around for the next firework show!  Starting at 6PM, they're every hour on the hour!
Be sure to tell Greatfather Winter what secret surprise you'd like to get this Winter Veil!
Be sure to try our Dark Iron Ale.  I hear the dwarves around here can't get enough of it.
Be warned that even your creators are fallible.

Be warned, mortal, it is exceptionally rare that one of the lesser clans in this citadel would hold such an item. Your search could take decades. I recommend you destroy these beasts without impunity.
Bear witness to the undeniable power of your Warchief! Be lifted by the rallying cry of your dragon slayers!
Bears??

Because the blade can never be too sharp nor the armor too tough a talented enchanter will always be needed.  Such an enchanter is Taladan, who can show you how to properly weave enchantments to improve your weapons and armor.  Seek him out in the Craftsmen's Terrace.
Because you are still alive and my hands aren't gripped firmly around your stubby little neck.

Because you have aided me, I will tell you what I know of this land and of the things there are to see. My knowledge is not vast, but perhaps I can point out some things that might interest one such as yourself.
Become a mentor for one of our orphans during the Week of the Wardens!  For the Horde!
Become a mentor for one of our orphans during the Week of the Wardens!  Huzzah!
Been a tough day? A nice ale should loosen those worries right up.
Been waitin' for ya, $N. Glad to see you've come through. Do you have the shipment?

Before I leave this place, I make one final offering to you, Lord Staghelm. Should a time arise in which you must gain entry to this accursed fortress, use the Scepter of the Shifting Sands on the sacred gong. The magic holding the barrier together will dissipate and the horrors of Ahn'Qiraj will be unleashed upon the world once more.
Before beginning a hunt, it is wise to ask someone what you are looking for before you begin looking for it.

Before his banishment, Deathwing was attempting to create impure offspring. Half breeds that would not only be immune to the innate natural powers and abilities of their Aspects but also under the complete control of Deathwing.$B$BIt seems that where his father failed, Nefarian may have succeeded - at least partially.$B$BIt was Ysera, Aspect of Dreams, who saw the abominations and forced us to act. If these 'Chromatic' dragonkin exist, they must be destroyed.

Before my death, I was a librarian; I had nothing to do with wars and plagues. I never asked to become this. On the other hand, now that my mind is my own again, I'm not about to surrender without a fight.
Before the Scourge came, I had a great business.  I bought and sold everything.  Everything!$B$BAnd my prices were INSANE!$B$BJust ask anyone.  Anyone who's not dead.
Before the plague came, I knew nothing about leather. Now I know enough to teach others. Death's left me with a lot of time on my hands.
Before your learning may begin, I must ask of you a favor...
Begging your pardon, Lady Prestor. That was not my intent.
Begin the ritual, my servants.  We must banish the heart of Hakkar back into the void!
Begone foul creatures!  Go back to the void your master shaped you from!
Begone foul creatures!  Your kind has no place in this world.
Begone, mortal. You are not worthy of my knowledge.
Begone, uncouth scum!  The Alliance shall prevail in Alterac Valley!

Behind me is the Altar of Zanza, a sacred place for us Zandalar.  We pray here to bolster our resolve in preparation for war against the Blood God, Hakkar.$B$BProve yourself to the tribe by using the altar to destroy any of the Hakkari Bijous you might find inside Zul'Gurub.  Also, I will trade you Honor Tokens our tribe uses for sets of coins you may find in Zul'Gurub.  Bring me the coins that I seek, and you will be rewarded!
Behold the might of the Alliance! The dread lady, Onyxia, hangs from the arches! Let the rallying cry of the dragon slayer lift your spirits!
Behold!  The Blue Recluse holds a feast in $g his:her; honor!
Being part of the Explorers' League, I've been hunting for artifacts in the area. Winterspring is said to contain very magical items... Most are highly guarded.
Believe me when I tell you this: You're gonna wish you weren't born, sissy!
Belm says pay your bill or he'll break your face.

Bena works like one possessed. Day and night I have seen her bent over these potions, often going without sleep or food. I know our undead allies need help, but I begin to fear she will do herself an injury.
Berte! Evalyn! It's getting dark. Come inside.
Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.
Best ale in Stormwind, Langston. Thanks.
Best be on my way. Khara will be expecting me soon. See ya tomorrow X.
Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?
