en: Best drinks in Stormwind!
Best weapons in the Barrens here!
Bethek
Betina, I'd like a replacement Rune of the Dawn please!
Betina, I'd like a replacement Seal of the Dawn please!
Betsy! Give me Betsy back!
Better luck next time, $N.

Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.
Between the colors, a path.$B$BBlink across in light.$B$BFrom the water, you emerge.
Between the light and the dark, there is shadow... and those shadows have powers you have yet to see.
Between the orange and the purple passageways near the doors to Maraudon, you will find a third path.$B$BThe scepter you hold in your hands is the key.
Beware Marduk!  Beware, or your strength will wither.

Beware of entering Frostwolf territory, soldier. The whole damn place is booby trapped! Landmines galore! Speak with our explosives expert in the first tower on the front lines for more information. I am certain that he could teach you how to diffuse the situation.
Beware!  A $N is upon us!
Beware!  Beware!  A threat lurks in the wild!  Night Watchers, be on the alert!
Beware!  The $r $n attacks us at Winterax Hold!
Beware!  The Kolkar attack!
Beyond this corridor, Naralex lies in fitful sleep. Let us go awaken him before it is too late.
Bijou knows where treasures are hidden.
Bijou lost! SQUAWK! *cough*
Billy says Fizzles used to be a great wizard. But he got turned into a rabbit when one of his spells went bad.

Bixi Wobblebonk, the gnome weapon master, is wandering about in this shop.  She can teach crossbow, daggers and throwing weapons.

Woo Ping, the human weapon master at Weller's Arsenal in Stormwind, teaches crossbow, daggers, one and two-handed swords, polearms, and staff.

Ilyenia Moonfire, the night elf weapon master, resides at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus where she teaches bow, daggers, fist weapons, staff and throwing weapons.

Black, grey and dark purple are the prescribed colors.  See to it that you don't stray onto the wrong side of fashion street friend.  Bowen Brisboise can help to see that you don't.  You'll find him inside Cold Hearth Manor on the other side of the bridge to the southwest of town.
Blackfathom Deeps
Blackfathom Deeps can be found at the north end of Zoram Strand along the coast of Ashenvale.
Blackrock Depths
Blackrock Mountain lies between Searing Gorge in the north and Burning Steppes in the south.
Blackrock Spire

Blacksmith?  Nope, our last one turned back into one of those mindless Scourge.  There's one in the Undercity though to the south of town though.  Undercity is underneath the Ruins of Lordaeron, clever name, huh?  Just take the elevators down at the back of the ruins and then you can talk to one of the Undercity Guardians.  They should be able to point you in the right direction.
Blacksmithing
Blast... ogres.  I forgot about these buffoons.  There's no easy way around them, so expect plenty of fighting.  Look sharp!
Bless you, mortals, for this release...Hakkar controls me no longer!
Blessings of the Earth Mother upon you.
Blood and souls for Hakkar!  HAHAHAH!
Bloodscalp, Sandfury, Skullsplitter, Vilebranch and Witherbark. They all pledge their allegiance to Jin - their souls to Hakkar. You have lost.
Bloody... Must have been the goblins... Let's see how bad the damage is.
Blue is the Winner! Congratulations Blue!
Blue plus red... I predict...
Blue team, Winner!
Blue wins! Prepare for the next round.
Bodley, tell me what's going on.
Books have been disappearing as of late. The Lorekeeper and his assistants are in a frenzy. They suspect foul play within Eldre'Thalas.
Borgosh! $N is ready to be trained.

Borgus used to work at the Great Forge but I hear he moved down to Stormwind when they finished rebuilding. Rumor holds that he started a shop in the Dwarven District with a man named Kathrum Axehand.
Both the Horde and Alliance captains have fallen!  Defeat Drek'Thar before it's too late!

Both the Horde and Alliance captains have taken to the field.  Our Captain Galvangar directs the Frostwolves from Iceblood Garrison, and his rival, Captain Balinda Stonehearth, hides in her Stonehearth Outpost.$B$BThe battle has begun!
Bow down! Kneel before the Ashbringer! A new dawn approaches, brothers and sisters! Our message will be delivered to the filth of this world through the chosen one!
Bow in my presence, insect! Surely you can feel the power I hold over you.
Box stupid. Lumurk sleepy.
Boy, you couldn't fix a sandwich without someone tellin' ya how to do it.
Boys and girls - children of all ages - the Darkmoon Faire has arrived!  Huzzah!
Brace yourself for the glorious impact, Impsy!
Brace yourselves!
Brahaha! Tha look on their faces as old Trollplow's gun came swiveling around to meet them! Their saws couldn't even touch me!
Brain encaved... mortar... bas... hed... leaking... dyin... g...
Brains...
Brandur Ironhammer would be the one ye'd want to see.  Ye can find him in the Hall of Mysteries north of the gates of Ironforge.
Brash. Master Ravenholdt does not like brash.
Brave $c, thank you for rescuing me! I am sure Marshal Marris will reward your kind deed, $N.
Bravely fought Narrisha. We will get you next time Red Team!
Bravo! Bravo! Good show. What? You thought I was dead?
Bravo, Gerard, you have exceeded yourself, yet again.
Bread here! Loaves of your favorites! Nice and fresh!
Breathtaking. Children, when we return to the school, you will each give an oral report on one of these legendary people.
Brek Stonehoof can be found at Stonehoof Geology on the lower rise and can teach you the proper way to harvest precious ores and gems.
Bring it on!
Brock. Torren. I am going inside for an ale and to warm myself by the fire.
Broke both me legs that night. How could I forget?
Brom Killian teach you how dig up shiny for me.  Him on inner ring of War Quarter.
Bronzebeard's gone missing again! That dwarf sure didn't get any of his brother's good senses.
Brother Wilhelm often trains with Lyria Du Lac out in back of the smithy in Goldshire.  You could probably learn a thing or two about being a paladin from him.
Brzt... click... whir...

Built twelve thousand years ago by a covert sect of night elf sorcerers, the ancient city of Eldre'Thalas was used to protect Queen Azshara's most prized arcane secrets. Though it was ravaged by the Great Sundering of the world, much of the wondrous city still stands as the imposing Dire Maul. The ruins' three distinct districts have been overrun by all manner of creatures - especially the spectral highborne, foul satyr and brutish ogres.

Buliwyf, the dwarven weapon master at the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, teaches fist weapons, guns, one and two-handed axes and one and two-handed maces.

Bixi Wobblebonk, the gnome weapon master at the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, teaches crossbow, daggers and throwing weapons.

Bullseye! That blasted dwarf doesn't know what he is talking about. Only thing wrong with Grumlar's gun is Grumlar's aim.
Burn in hate, $r.
Burninate's the name, smithin's my game... and, erm... I sell a little food and water on the side. Care for some meat?
Burning Steppes - Tablet of the Seven
Burp! Hon, that was really good. Not only do you know how to catch a fish but you sure do know how to cook one.
Business must be good down at the bazaar.  I'll get him resupplied right away!
But I do know this - love makes the heart and body weak. It can be exploited. Without your love, I have only my work, Annalise.
But for now, your death will have to suffice...
But his son is dead.
But if we stabilize it with an anchor thread at the appropriate energy crux then it should work.

The colossal boar was defeated, and over time in the areas where his blood fell, massive thorn-ridden vines sprouted to life. The quilboar came to occupy these regions and hold them sacred. The heart of these massive thorn-colonies is the Razorfen. Razorfen Kraul was conquered by the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who some speculate has been negotiating with agents of the Scourge for some insidious purpose.

Fight for your families!  Don't give up!

Fight!

Finally, I am free! I come home soon, my dear!

Find Kaplak on top of the burrow in the southwest section of town.

Find me something good, you dogs!

First Aid?  Well ye don't look hurt to me.  If yer really interested in learning First Aid, then Nissa Firestone is the one to learn from.  Go see her over by The Great Forge in her shop, The Ironforge Physician.
First Kormok crush your bones!  Then Kormok burn your soul!

Five tickets or two-hundred and fifty, it doesn't matter friend, everybody is a winner!
Flee while you can mortal!

Fluffy! Fluffy stop running!

Follow me.

Foolish $N, you serve me now!
Foolish mortal, I will rend your soul in two once I am released!

Foolishly you have sought your own demise. Brazenly you have disregarded powers beyond your understanding. You have fought hard to invade the realm of the harvester. Now there is only one way out- to walk the lonely path of the damned.
Fools! Our cause is righteous!
Fools, I knew that if I played upon my brother's feeble emotions, he would send 'rescuers.'
Fools.
Footmen, make a line!

For 10,000 years I have ruled this kingdom. In that time, I have heard many fascinating tales from those that would walk the hallowed grounds of the House of Shen'dralar.$B$BAs I am bound to this place, I often exchange stories with visitors. For Broxigar!
For Darrowshire!
For Kalimdor!
For a limited time only, Crunchy Frog available exclusively here at the Darkmoon Faire.

For many hundreds of years Alassin has cared for the animals that our hunters befriend.  His care of animals is highly sought for by the hunters around here.  If you seek him as well, then look for him in the Cenarion Enclave.
For millennia this being lay dormant beneath the world - biding its time. From its prison it waited for the exact moment at which to strike back at those that would see it harmed.
For our Masters!
For reasons I cannot understand, Elder Thunderhorn has gone to the Slithering Scar in Un'Goro Crater.
For so long I have drifted in my cursed form. You have freed me... Your hard work shall be repaid.
For the Alliance!
For the Blue!
For the Dark Strand!
For the Dragonmaw!

For the Legion! For Kil'Jaeden!
For the Red!

For the love of all that is holy and dear, please tell me that you've come to deliver us from this forsaken land.  Though I'm with Marshal Expeditions, I would give you the gold teeth from my mouth to climb inside your backpack and leave this place.
For the time being, that area is free of Scourge influence. I fear it will only be a matter of time before they return.
Fordring shall never see his son.
Forget about it!
Forgive me, father! Please...
Forty-two... forty-two... forty-two what?  It could be anything!  Forty-two... hmmm...
Forward, my minions! Forward! Let none stand in our way!

Free drinks at the Blue Recluse!

Freedom!
Fresh Bread! Get your oven fresh bread here!

Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
Fresh meat!
Fresh troops flood to Iceblood Garrison!  Captain Galvangar will soon arrive, and a new battle will soon begin!
Freshly baked bread for sale!

Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!$B$BOur once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages! Friendly.

From way downtown!

Frustrated by the Dalaran wizards' lack of progress against the undead during the Third War, the Archmage Arugal elected to summon the extra-dimensional worgen to bolster his side's diminishing ranks. The wolf-men slaughtered the Scourge, then quickly turned on the wizards themselves and laid siege to the keep of the noble, Baron Silverlaine. The fort quickly fell into shadow and ruin. Driven mad with guilt, Arugal adopted the worgen as his children and retreated to the newly dubbed 'Shadowfang Keep'.

Funny you should ask... I just received an update on that. Thus far, the Alliance has gathered $2060w of $2061w light leather, $2063w out of $2064w medium leather and $2069w of $2071w thick leather skins.
GOOOOOOOAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLL!
GOR'TESH DEAD?!?!

Give me a couple minutes, $N. There was some excitement in here a moment ago, and I just want to make sure things have died back down. I'll talk to you soon enough.
Give me a moment while I calibrate the transponder to your height and weight specifications, $N.

Give me a moment; there are a lot of numbers to remember here. It looks like we have $2066w of $2067w heavy leather skins collected. As well, we have $2070w out of $2071w thick leather, and $2073w of $2074w rugged leather stockpiled.
Give me one of your magic items.

Give me the contract.

Give me the vessel, Highlord.

Give of your hearts and your purses! Give to the children of Stormwind who have lost their parents.

To get started you'll want to talk to Chronos, Kerri Hicks, Ringling and Yebb Nebblegear to see who you can best help. They always have something that needs doing to improve and expand our attractions.

Then when you have enough tickets, speak with Gelvas Grimegate and he will give you a list of prizes to choose from.
Gloom'rel, tell me your secrets!

Glory and blood for the Old Gods!

Go to the Shady Rest Inn and follow the tracks. See where they lead and report back to me.
Go to the Valley of Honor and seek out Xon'cha near the stables.
Go to the Valley of Strength and look for the Bank of Orgrimmar to the south of the Sky Tower.
Go with grace, and may the Lady's magic protect you.
Go with speed... <cough cough> Find... <cough> Ryedol...
Go, my servant.  Send word of Stonetalon to Apothecary Zamah.

Goddess, grant me the power to overcome my enemies! Hear me, please, my need is desperate and my cause is just!

Gonna make a guild, are ya? Good luck to ya then!

Talk to Aldwin Laughlin in the Stormwind Vistor's Center. It's in the Trade District right as you come in from the Valley of Heroes.
Good blades, solid axes. I have nothing left to teach you in the making of weapons $N. Take your pride and courage before Kelgruk Bloodaxe, he will forge them into the skills you will need.
Good boy! Now put it back on the bone pile.
Good bye, Goldshire. I'll be back soon enough-- perhaps a week's time.
Good day citizen.  How may I assist you?

Good day to you, Syurna. I am in need of training.
Good day to you.

Good day, Elling!  Hullo Elaine!  Let me have a wheel of bleu cheese, eh?

Good for nothing Kobolds!
Good for you, $c!  Our battlemaster, Thelman Slatefist, can be found in the King's audience chambers inside Stormwind Keep.  He will help you get to Alterac Valley.
Good idea!
Good job you two.  Now go have a seat.
Good luck out there, $N.
Good luck to you, $N. And don't forget... get that script before finding Gazin.
Good luck, $N!
Good luck, $N. And remember, find Muiredon once you've accomplished the task.
Good luck. Sorry I can't take you with me!
Good night, gents. Sleep well.

Good ol' Erma, she's been taking care of the local animals for years now.  I'm sure she'd be happy to take care of any you'd like to put up.  She can be found right outside of the Lion's Pride Inn.
Good ol' Thamner bandaged me up just the other day when I had a run in with a nasty trogg.  I'm good as new I tell ye!  I'm sure Thamner would be happy to show ye how to make a good bandage.
Good people of Goldshire, come take advantage of my incredible prices on rare goods. I shall not return for some time!

Good question, $c. Last I was informed; we have managed to collect $1997w copper bars out of $1998w needed. Additionally, I am told that we have $2002w iron bars out of $2003w, and $2011w out of $2012w thorium bars requested.

Good question, $r. In my younger days I was footloose and fancy free without a care in the world. In those days I would sing in a barber shop quartet out of Stormwind known as the Four Dons. That's where I learned how to craft the Bonescythe digs.
Good thing someone here has tracking!  Look for Shim'la in the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor.
Good to see you again, Amy. Be safe, luv. I'm off to Goldshire now.
Good work, $N!  Complete your trial by speaking with me.  Time continues to slip away until you do so!
Good work, one and all!  The Scourge at the castle have been defeated.
Good work, soldier. I need to get back to base camp! Will you cover me?
Good work, soldier. Now we light the fires and spite their ire!
Good, good.  Now bow to each other.
Good, good. Keep it up and this bridge'll be done in no time.
Good, you've got some grit! I like that. Well then, let's get going!
Good. In order to carry out my plan, we must first create a lifestone. Are you prepared to act?
Good. You are showing promise to join the elite ranks. Now, more practice.
Goodbye, cruel world... I'm leavin' you today... goodbye... goodbye... goodbye...

Gorzeeki tells me that you have brought him all that he needs for the Bell of Dethmoora, the Wheel of the Black March and the Doomsday Candle.$B$BWell done, $N!  You are almost ready to perform your ritual and bind a dreadsteed!

Graham Van Talen in Rogues' Quarter on outer ring of Undercity.

It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Horde Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from Thunder Bluff for your duty and service.

Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of the Darkspear tribe.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Horde Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from the Darkspear tribe for your duty and service.

Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of the Gnomeregan Exiles.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Alliance Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from the Gnomeregan Exiles for your duty and service.

Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of the Undercity.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Horde Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from the Undercity for your duty and service.
Greetings, $c!  Welcome to the Cathedral of Light!
Greetings, $c.
Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?
Greetings, $c.  I am Exzhal, Servitor of Rastakhan.

Greetings, $c.  I am Miranda Breechlock - one of but a few authorized equipment and materiel quartermasters for the Dawn.$B$BAs you fight evil under our commission - all the while earning our respect and trust - you'll earn valor tokens from Duke Zverenhoff.  Tokens serve two purposes: use them to gain increased standing within our ranks, or use them as tender in acquiring special items.$B$BAs you improve your standing with the Dawn, you'll discover that more items will be made available to you.
Greetings, $c.  I pity your kind, for the secrets of true magic are beyond you...

Greetings, $c.  It is the time of the Harvest Festival - a time of great bounties and a time of remembrance.  We partake of feasts to celebrate all we have to be thankful of, and we remember our ancestors and past heroes to give thanks to the legacy they gave us.$B$BPlease feel free to partake of the feast being offered here.  Also, I am offering some fireworks to help celebrate this joyous time of year.
Greetings, $c.  Though time and drink have dulled my outer senses, my inner eyes remain strong.
Greetings, $c.  Welcome to Cenarion Hold.  From here we will strike against the silithid where they're at their strongest.  I hope you've come to lend a hand.
Greetings, $c.  What may this humble servant of the Feathermoon Stronghold do for you today?

Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.$B$BWhile you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

Greetings, $c. Don't have too much time to talk--I'm just using Chillwind as a camp to get some rest before heading to Hearthglen. I've heard word that before they went crazy, the Scarlet Crusade had a mage working for them who was trying to create powerful bows and guns for their soldiers. I'm not sure if he succeeded or not... the Crusade killed him before any of his finished product made it out. Maybe they killed him to keep it a secret... or maybe they distrust the arcane that much.

Greetings, $c. For some, the hunter is a way of life, a chosen profession. For others, it is something of a pastime, a badge of courage, or a rite of passage depending on your tribe.$B$BFor me, race and profession mean nothing--it is the testing of your spirit and mind that I respect. For one to stand against the forces of nature and test all of their skills is the true mark of honor.$B$BIf you wish to test yourself and earn my respect, then speak to me more.
Greetings, $c. Have you spoken with Fahrad yet?

Greetings, $c. I am Field Marshal Snowfall, commander of the war effort here. We've a hard road to plow ahead of us, $g lad : lass;, so if you can help out, please do so. And feel free to ask questions.
Greetings, $c. I am Leoren, stable master of Cenarion Hold.
Greetings, $c. I am Rexxar, champion of the Horde, servant of Thrall, master to the beasts of the wilds.

Greetings, $c. I trust that you bring me good news concerning the Worldwide Invitational event? If you are, then surely that means you were given a secret code to tell me. In return for your code I will give you a gift of one of the panda cubs that I take care of.$B$BJust whisper it in my ear when you are ready.
Greetings, $c. Is there something I can help you with?

Greetings, $c. It is good to see you interested in helping with the war effort. The collectors here are organizing the gathering of various stockpiles of goods so that we will be prepared when the time comes.$B$BI am in charge of obtaining $2106w baked salmon to store away for those involved in the fighting at Ahn'Qiraj. The last time that I counted, we had collected $2105w.
Greetings, $c. Please be brief in how the Kirin Tor may be of service to you.

Greetings, $c.$B$BThose Sentinels over there have allowed me to share their camp as long as I promise no trouble will follow--I am sure you can appreciate the need for diplomacy while here, yes?$B$BI am here investigating disturbances to the land, and since it aids their cause also, they have agreed that my presence here could only aid the tenuous alliance between all of Azeroth's races. If you wish to aid me, then I would appreciate it, but regardless, please try not to cause any trouble.

Greetings, $r $c. I am Commander Stronghammer, the ambassador representing the Alliance here. If you have any questions concerning the status of Alliance collections for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, $g lad : lass;, don't hesitate to ask.
Greetings, $r.
Greetings, $r. I am Franclorn Forgewright. Are you here to learn of the Spire and of Dark Iron?

Greetings, $r. The war materiel is gradually being sent on its way and should be at Cenarion Hold within $2113w day's time. We can only hope that once it is there that someone, having assembled the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, will step forward to ring the gong and open the gates.

Greetings, $r. The war materiel is on its way and should be at Cenarion Hold within a day's time. We can only hope that once it is there that someone, having assembled the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, will step forward to ring the gong and open the gates.
Greetings, ancient one. I have done all that has been asked of me. I now ask that you grant me Lok'delar.
Greetings, ancient one. I have done all that has been asked of me. I now ask that you grant me Rhok'delar.
Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.
Greetings, citizen.
Greetings, citizen. I ask that you move along if you have nothing to ask of me.
Greetings, friend!  Can I interest you in some ectoplasmic capacitors?  Or perhaps a nice omni-directional spectral assimilator?
Greetings, mortals!  I have been activated by the Discs of Norgannon to assist you!
Greetings, my friend.  May the Dawn keep you well in these troubled times.
Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.
Greetings, soldier. Are you here to help the cause?
Greetings, soldier. Intelligence has reported that the Winterax trolls to the west have taken a master goblin engineer prisoner. Perhaps you should investigate?
Greetings, traveler! Care to delve into the mysteries of the arcane? Hm?

Greetings, traveler. As long as you remain within the walls of the Cenarion Hold, you will be safe from harm.$B$BBe wary when leaving the protection of the Hold as the silithid have been swarming as of late.

Greetings, traveler. It was here, nearly 1,000 years past, that the Qiraji began their march of destruction across Kalimdor.$B$BThousands of lives were lost during the war, most in this cursed desert during the initial invasion.$B$BI am one of only a few that remain, chained to both the past and the present. I know not why I am to remain stationed here but I know that I must.
Greetings, young $c.

Greetings, young $c. In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj against the Silithid, the Alliance has asked me to head up their collection of purple lotus. This flower has many uses that I am aware of, and thus, I have agreed to help them attain $2055w. To date we have collected $2053w.
Greetings.  Do you seek instruction in art of war?
Greetings.  I am Chronos - He Who Never Forgets.  My memory is without flaw, and exact to the most minor detail.$B$BTrust me.
Greetings.  I'm a female mage trainer, and you're a mage.
Greetings.  I'm a gnome mage trainer, and you're a mage.
Greetings.  I'm a mage trainer, and you're a mage.
Greetings.  I'm a warlock trainer, and you're a warlock.
Greetings.  I'm a warlock trainer, but you're not a warlock!
Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.
Greetings.  If you are here for leather goods, then you will find my wares well crafted.
Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.
Greetings.  You seek instruction in the art of war?
Gremlock doesn't always have the best of luck with cooking, but he does have some tasty recipies worth learning.  Go chat him up in the Thunderbrew Distillery and see what he'll teach ye.
Gri'lek, of the Iron Blood$B$BThe wanderer.  May his strength and lust for battle pierce the ages.  $B$BGri'lek now dwells far from here.  One day, he may return...
Grimclaw?! Easy there, my friend... where is your master Volcor?

Grimnur Stonebrand will tell ye some whoppers about the one that got away, but he's still one o' the best fishermen around.  He's got a shop set up in The Forlorn Cavern called the Traveling Fisherman.

Grrr, what do you want, $r? Oh, you must be here about the lean wolf steaks for the impending Ahn'Qiraj War. Yes, you heard right, I'm collecting them, what about it? Do you have a fresh stack for me? I only need $2096w, and it looks like we have $2095w right now.
Grrr...
Grrrr! Idiots!
Grrrr... fresh meat!
Grrrrr!
Grumble, grumble...
Grumble...
Grumnus be your man, $N. He'll school you in the art of the armorsmith.
Grunts! Attack!
Grurk open soon. Then we split treasure.
Grurk stupid? You try open box! Maybe you smart as gnome???
Gryfe do his job! Gryfe go now!!!
Gryphon Master

Gryphons, eh? Never really cared for the beasts but to each their own.

You can find Dungar Longdrink on the rampart in the Trade District.
Guard duty, I hate guard duty.
Guard, Bring forth the prisoner. Place him in the Circle of Binding.
Guardians! Defend Sen'jin!
Guards to your posts! They must be after the Magistrate again. He must be protected! They could come from any direction!
Guards!
Guards! Guards!
Guards! Help me!
Gubber, I don't have a fishing pole.
Gubber, I don't know how to fish.
Guess there's nothing more to be done. Blast!
Guild Master
Gul'dan is my answer.
Gul'dan. Not a name many have heard on Azeroth.$B$BUnfortunately, not the correct answer.
Guse is joining the battle! Time to take out the Stormpike filth!
Guse? Jeztor? Are they... flat spin?? Seas of Southshore??
HAVE YOU RUN OUT OF SHIPS TO SEND?  WHERE'S YOUR COURAGE?
HELLO WORLD!
HELP! ASSASSINS HAVE COME TO KILL ME!
HELP!!!!
HEY! HEY YOU! $R! Get me out of here!
HEY! No fair!
HOLD THE LINE! LET NOTHING THROUGH!
Ha ha! I have Betsy!
Ha ha, $N! I won't ever forget the look on Daryl's face when you showed him that head!
Ha! I'd take the sound of a Crater Cannon XT blasting off a shell over that any day!
Ha! I'm more afraid that those old holes and gashes would burst that thing and I would be showered by the shrapnel!
Ha! Now your death is ensured!
Ha! You ain't got what it takes... yet! Come back to me after you've learned a few things!
Hah!  Eternal undeath to the cursed Agamands!
Hah!  Let us see the wooden human wave!
Hah!  This tauren wants a kiss!
Hah!  Tirth's been looking for him for days, but he doesn't want to be found.  He's chicken!
Hah! Daryl, you should have seen the look on your face! You half jumped out of your skin!
Hah! Serves you right, you filthy trogg!!
Haha! Alterac and Hillsbrad shall come under our rightful rule once again now that the Magistrate has fallen. Retreat!
Haha! Perfect!

Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.
Haha! Sturdy old Trollplow has just a few meager battle scars!
Haha, $g boyo : girlie;! The Alliance has gathered everything that we're needin' to get this here war started! Maybe the Horde will catch up soon?

Haha, you be pullin' me leg mon. Pele'keiki know that you know we Horde already be havin' all the war stuff we be needin'. Now we just waitin' on that Alliance to get all theirs and we startin' up the war.
Hahah!
Hahah!  $N, you make quite a partner!
Hahah!  Revenge is mine!
Hahah!  That was funny!  Funny wooden human!
Hahaha, your guards no match for Scourge!
Hail $N!  New Champion of The Affray!

Hail $g brother : sister;... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.$B$BWe tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!
Hail citizen.  Do you need directions?

Hail friend - a moment of your time, if I may...$B$BWe have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing Teldrassil.  Were the constant strife of the times not enough, we now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of night elves everywhere in helping us out!
Hail the Lich King!
Hail to da new king!
Hail to thee $N.  Do you wish me to aid you in your journey to Warsong Gulch?
Hail!  You look familiar... have we met before?$B$BWell if we have met, then... surely you were given a secret code. Tell me your code and I will give you a gift!
Hail, $c!

Hail, $c!  Our supply level is high, and we are ready to launch a ground assault through the Field of Strife.  Perhaps if your renown was greater, I would trust you to deliver the assault orders.$B$BSo get out there and fight the Alliance!  Show me you're a trusted and capable member of the Horde!
Hail, $c!  Welcome to the celebration!

Hail, $c.  The Ironforge Brigade is stationed here to keep an eye on Hive'Zora.  The Cenarion Circle druids have been monitoring silithid movement and they're anticipating something major in this area.
Hail, $c.  There is a great need and even greater honor and renown to be had in Alterac Valley at this time. Will you join our fight against the Stormpike Guard?
Hail, $c. As you may know, we've completed all collections necessary for the Alliance's role in the upcoming war. Now it's up to the Horde to finish with theirs and we'll ship out to Silithus.

Hail, $c. I trust you are here to inquire on the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. We are going to need a great deal of assistance.$B$BThe war effort is a united effort between the Horde and Alliance to prepare for the impending war against the Silithid and their masters in Ahn'Qiraj. In Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, we are collecting a vast number of goods to create war materiel, and these gathering tasks are what we need your help with.$B$BCan I convince you to speak with our commander about helping out?
Hail, $c. You look familiar... have we met before?$B$BWell if we have met, then... surely you were given a secret code. Tell me your code and I will give you a gift!

Hail, $r! I am Lieutenant Haggerdin, officer in charge of recruitment for the Stormpike Guard.$B$BAs you gain prestige and notoriety among the Stormpike, return to me and I shall see about upgrading your insignia. Also, should you ever lose your insignia, I am able to supply a replacement.
Hail, Loramus. I bring word from the Blasted Lands.

Hail, adventurer. I am Rin'wosho, trader of Zuldazar. I come from the South Seas and bring many exotic goods and items from my homeland.$B$BPerhaps if you prove your worth to my tribe, I shall barter.  If you have any of my tribe's Honor Tokens, then perhaps we shall barter even more.
Hail, champion. The tale of your deeds will be told throughout the ages. Perhaps one day, a statue of you will stand amongst the heroes of Stormwind.
Hail, traveler! What brings you to my doorstep?
Hail, what ya want?
Hakkar shall live again!
Hakkar will rule the world!
Haleh, I have lost the Drakefire Amulet. Could you fashion another?
Half way there...
Hamhock in trouble! Hamhock need help!
Hammertoe, you're as smart as you were stubborn in life and even in death. What can you tell me, ole friend?
Happy Hallow's End!  Do you like my mask?  Very scary!
Happy Hallow's End!  How do you like my mask?  Very scary!
Happy Hallow's End, $c!
Har! You scared I'll hurt your little dainty racer?
Harroc, get a box of tools for, $n.

Has the Prince recanted the tale of the Ashbringer? It is our most favorite of his stories. His favorite is the followup to the Ashbringer. Of course, nobody has ever been able to get that story out of him.

Has the sun risen already?  There are just never enough hours in the night!  Well, Saelienne will take good care of you.  You can find her tending to her guests over in the Craftsmen's Terrace in northeastern Darnassus.
Have I forgotten? Of course I have... I have forgotten about love, happiness... of life itself.
Have a drink, $c.  It might be your last!
Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.
Have a taste of Frostmane magics.
Have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil!  Start it off right with treats from Smokywood Pastures!
Have almost have all the silithst we need!  For the Horde!
Have fun in Booty Bay, $n!
Have you any Darkmoon Faire Cards?  Come speak with me to learn more about them if you dare!
Have you any idea what I go through to bring these incomparable valuables to sell?  Come see them all for yourself!
Have you come for further training? Shake the dust of the road from your garments, then, and let us get to work.
Have you come from the Burning Steppes?  Do you have my black dragon eggs?

Have you come here for instruction in the art of making potions? You were mistaken if you thought that I would offer such a privilege to you, unearned. Go, and do not return to me until you have greater skill.
Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

en: Have you come to save this world? To cleanse it?
Have you come to seek the knowledge of Hgarth?
Have you ever heard of a place called Dire Maul?
Have you freed Drull yet? I don't know where he's being held.
Have you heard the one about the ogre, the goblin and the $r?
Have you made contact with Ivus, Arch Druid?
Have you seen Petra or Dadanga around?

Have you seen all the wonderful things here in Ungoro Crater, $N? It's simply amazing. Not as amazing as some of the things I can make with my skill at engineering, but for it being all natural here... it's not too bad.$B$BMy uncle Remtravel loves old stuff like this place. I'm following in his footsteps kinda--I want to discover new things from lost cultures too!

Have you seen the befouled water elementals in our lake, $N? It is a sorry sight, but I do not know where they are coming from.$B$BYour name has been mentioned in conversations past, perhaps you could help me with this problem.$B$BThe first thing we must learn is who is in control of these elementals.
Have you tried our bread? Baker Masterson must be the most gifted chef to have ever lived!
Have you tried that Thunderbrew Lager?  It's good stuff!

Have you? Then you know how weak and pathetic the high elf version of troll magic was?$B$BThe high elves could not understand why a people with their magical affinity could not contend with the powers of troll voodoo. This was an inconceivable notion for the pale skins to understand. They were resigned to using the bastardized version of troll enchantments. I believe they called them 'Arcanum.'

Haven't you been listening? No, I very much doubt we would be having this conversation had Kel'Thuzad formed the staff. Kel'Thuzad holds the head. His underlings hold forty splinters of Atiesh. The last piece - the base - was uncovered by Brann Bronzebeard. He was last seen in the Silithus desert; undoubtedly doing his best to stay as far away as possible from the relentless seekers Kel'Thuzad has dispatched into the world.
Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.
Having a good time?
Hazza'rah, the Dreamweaver.$B$BHis is the power of nightmares, and may his foes ever sleep.$B$BHazza'rah now dreams near the edge of madness.
He cannot be defeated. <The relic burns to nothing. The memories it held are now your own. This city was destroyed by a being not of this world.>
He dead.

He grows fatter and more corrupt with each passing day. Ye can smell the stink comin' off o' his body. He be dirty, an' I dun just mean he be needin' a wash.$B$BEnough babblin' from Hulfdan. Where did ye come from and how can me help ye, $c?
He he!  This will be a great hiding spot.
He is not a chicken, and no you may not pet him. Now be on your way before I give you a closer look at his beak.
He must be overwhelmed with work at the Monastery. But still, he should have returned by now.
He puts the rock into the hole!
He really couldn't help it...
He shoots, he scores!
He worried that his power weakened, that soon even we last of his precious soulgems would fade and die.
He'll bring you mead$bHe'll bring you beer$bA grinning face from ear to ear$bHe's served us all from year to year$bWe call him Smiling Jim.
He'll bring you mead, he'll bring you beer...
He's mine...
He's served us all from year to year...
He's your husband, woman. How am I to know where he is?

He... hello, $N. Sorry, I'm recovering from my wounds.$B$BThose Scarlet Crusaders are tougher than I had given them credit for. They almost did me in.$B$BYou should be careful too. I'd hate to see them get the jump on you.
Head north up the road to Orgrimmar.  You can ask one of the grunts there for directions to the Cooking Trainer.
Head on over to the Blue Recluse. Where everybody knows your name!
Healing is for those who cannot endure pain.  However if you must, seek out the Spirit Lodge on the lake in the Valley of Spirits, up and above the Valley of Strength to the west.
Hear me, denizens of the Crater!  I come to burn this land of its impurity!
Hear that? $n, here says that human deserter Reethe might have been the one who burned down the inn!
Hear ye! Hear ye! *pant pant* Be warned citizens of Southshore: assassins are heading to our fair town!
Hear ye, denizens of Tanaris! Let it be known that $N is an exalted member of the Mithril Order. A blacksmith of honor, dedication, and infinite patience. Three cheers for $N!
Hear ye, hear ye! I'll pause to sell my wares for only a short time here in Lakeshire. Come to the town hall with haste!
Hearthglen?? But...
Heck'va fight ya put up Jarad. Gots'ta keep that shield up more next time. Lana! Yer in!
Heeeeeeeeeeeeellllllllllllllllllllllllp!!!
Heeellp meee... ri... ribss... bro... broken.
Hegnar Rumbleshot, at your service!
Heh, bombs, us like bombs.  Graham Van Talen show you how to make.  He in outer ring of Rogues' Quarter.

Heh, heh... Quite the inquisitive one, aren't ya, $n? Well, here's what you need to do.$B$BNorth of here, in the old ruins, lives a very disagreeable gnoll by the name of Miblon Snarltooth. He guards the only Evoroot I know of, but he watches it night and day! Seems like he never even sleeps!$B$BWhat you can do, is bribe him. I can sell you some bait that he'll find tasty -- just put it down near him and that will distract him long enough for you to grab the Evoroot. Good luck!
Hehe, wimp.
Hehe... I made a pun, didn't I? Druidic in nature... I'm so funny.
Hehehe! Things go boom!

Hehehe, how you doin' mon. You gonna help Pele'keiki great deal he be thinkin'. We be needin' a bombastic amount of the firebloom herb to be preparin' right for the Ahn'Qiraj War. The Horde, they say, 'Pele'keiki, you get us $2051w of the fire petals right quick'.$B$BPele'keiki tell you now, he only have $2050w firebloom, but you gonna add to that real soon, right mon?
Helene Peltskinner has had years of experience skinning animals for Adele Fielder to make leather items.  You can find Helene in her house by Crystal Lake.

Hello $c, and welcome to the Darkmoon Faire. There is so much to do here at the faire that it can be a little overwhelming for our first time visitors. That's why I'm here to help. Do you have any questions?
Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Hello Sovik, I wish to browse your goods.
Hello Zando'zan, I would like to learn lockpicking.

Hello again, $N!  It's good to see you!  Our Darkmoon Faire is quite a show, don't you think?$B$BThere is quite a lot to see!  So look!  Look, and perhaps, one day, even more will be revealed to you...
Hello again, $N.  Did you think I would forget you?$B$BI knew you would not.  You are a clever $c who knows a person with perfect memory when $ghe:she; sees him.
Hello again, Antonio. Thank you again for the hat for my wife. She adored it.
Hello friend.

Hello once again, $N.  I sense that the flow of time remains threatened by forces that are quite powerful indeed.  Your continued assistance is always welcomed by the bronze dragonflight.$B$BWhile the past is set in its ways, the future is always changing.  The decisions you make in the here and now help guide that change.

Hello stranger, and welcome to the untamed majesty of Un'Goro Crater!$B$BMy name is Williden Marshal.  My sister, our companions, and I make up Marshal Expeditions - scientists and explorers of Azeroth's wild and great unknown.$B$BWe've hit a bit of a rough patch here, and we're looking for some help if you have the time!
Hello there $g mister : ma'am;... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

Hello there $glad:lass;... the name's Oglethorpe and I may be responsible for one of the amazing gnomish devices you might possess!  If it blew up, then it wasn't me; if it made you rich though, we can discuss royalties!$B$BOh, and if you're from Gnomeregan, you can just take two ninety degree angles, smash them together, and start marching.  I have nothing to say to you.
Hello there! My name's Jenna! And you?

Hello there, $N.  I am known as Chronormu, but you may call me Chromie.  I am comfortable with such familiarity.$B$BNow - how did I know your name, you ask?  I am one of the bronze dragonflight, forever attuned to the ebb and flow of time.  You could say that we have met before.  To that end, we shall also meet again.$B$BI hope that my choice of visual demeanor does not disturb you; while I might be charged to be a sentry of sorrowful places, I choose not to drown in the sorrow of the locale.

Hello there, my name is Petra.  To my right is my kodo, Dadanga.  We're with Marshal Expeditions - been so for a few years now, ever since Dadanga was a babe.$B$BIf you have any lit torches or any open sources of flame, I'd like to ask you to keep them stashed if you could.  Dadanga dislikes smoke.
Hello young $g Master:Mistress;. I am Eva Sarkhoff and this is my husband, Lucien. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

Hello!  And welcome!  I'm afraid my booth is not open... many repairs are needed...$B$BBut I am still bound by blood oath to put a smile on your face.  So please, smile, or I must cut off my hand and consume no living flesh until it regenerates...
Hello!  You're just the person I was looking for.  Take a seat and listen, because I have a plan that will make us both rich!
Hello! I am a Rogue in need of training.
Hello! What brings you to Winterspring? These cold and vast lands may seem dismal, but this is a place of many secrets...

Hello, $C.  I hope you've come to bolster our ranks.  Beasts and thieves are spilling into our beloved Elwynn, and we barely have enough men to keep the roads safe!$B$BAnd if you haven't done so, read that notice about Hogger.  He's a beast in yonder woods that must be dealt with.
Hello, $N! I am master engineer, Scooty.
Hello, $N! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!
Hello, $N.
Hello, $N. Are you interested in outdoor survival? Sustenance off the flaura and fauna of the lands!$B$BYou could learn a thing or two from me, that is, if you're interested.
Hello, $N. I train and care for young hippogryphs here; feel free to have a look around.

Hello, $N. Should you require assistance in completing your mission, you have only to ask. My guardian, Raze, can assist you in defeating the shadowsilk poachers. Use this Staff of Command to command Raze in battle. He is trained to ONLY attack shadowsilk poachers.
Hello, $N. Welcome to Refuge Pointe.
Hello, $c!  Welcome to the races at the Shimmering Flats!

Hello, $c! I've went around and asked, and it looks like all of us here have collected everything that the Alliance needs to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War. Now we just need to encourage the Horde to do the same and then we'll be able to ship it all over to Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

Hello, $c, good of you to show up. Allow me to be succinct; we are gathering supplies for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. We wouldn't want to have more casualties than necessary, now would we? I have the responsibility of coordinating the collection of $2086w mageweave bandages. To date we have garnered $2085w. Care to assist?

Hello, $c. From what I've been told, everything's been collected, and all of the materiel for the war is being shipped over to Silithus as we speak. It should all be there in less than $2113w days. Once that's done, and the gong has been rung with the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, the war will really begin.

Hello, $c. From what I've been told, everything's been collected, and all of the materiel for the war is being shipped over to Silithus as we speak. It should all be there in less than a day. Once that's done, and the gong has been rung with the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, the war will really begin.

Hello, $c. I am Jessir Moonbow. I have come from Darnassus seeking two friends who came looking for signs of the Shadow Council in Felwood.$B$BIt seems those vile creatures who claim responsibility for much of the orcish race's suffering seeks to regain some of its power.$B$BMy two friends went looking in Jaedenar to prove one way or the other what was happening.$B$BI expected them to be here when I arrived, but now they are days late.

Hello, $c. I am collecting linen bandages here for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort; an effort that will put us all to the test, but strengthen us for the war to come. I can assure you that any bandages that you choose to donate will be put to good use in helping to save the lives of our soldiers when the time comes. I am in need of $2077w, and to this point have managed to collect $2076w. Will you assist us?

Hello, $c. I trust that you bring good tidings concerning the Ahn'Qiraj War preparations. I myself have been placed in charge of all accumulation of rugged leather for the Horde; a task to which I feel uniquely qualified. Never underestimate the utility of a sharpened knife.$B$BAs to the rugged leather, we currently have $2073w out of $2074w needed.

Hello, $c. I'm sure that I don't need to inform you of the gravity of our situation here. We need to gather many goods, and in most cases assemble them into materiel, to be transported to Cenarion Hold in Silithus. This is no small effort.$B$BRecently in the Molten Core we discovered something called a singed corestone. Our blacksmiths and engineers tell us that they can put them to good use, so I'm supervising their accumulation here. As of now, out of $2110w needed, we've managed to collect $2108w.

Hello, $c. I've set up camp here at the Bulwark to make my preparations for my journey into the Plaguelands. I've heard rumor that a great human wizard took up residency in Hearthglen not terribly long ago. He was commissioned by the Scarlet Crusade to fashion their warriors and hunters new bows and guns. It's said that he completed a remarkable weapon before the Crusade killed him.$B$BI guess their mistrust of the arcane has grown.
Hello, $c. Please excuse me as I am having a conversation with Rimblat. He believes that even this land is not beyond saving.
Hello, $n.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!
Hello, $n. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.
Hello, Antonio. It's good to see you safely made it here again. Let me know if you need anything.
Hello, Charys. I have my list, could you get me all of that, especially the last ingredient.
Hello, Eitrigg. I bring news from Blackrock Spire.
Hello, Frankal. I've heard that you might have some information as to the whereabouts of Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.
Hello, Rayne. What brings the Cenarion Circle to the Plaguelands?
Hello, Rutgar. The Commander has sent me here to gather some information about his missing wife.
Hello, Selarin. I'm afraid I cannot help you at the moment, but perhaps some of the adventurers here in Auberdine can...
Hello, brother.
Hello, hello, Amy. It's good to be back in Lakeshire and to see you, milady.

Hello, how are you feeling today, $c? Well, I hope. You may be wondering what is going on here. There's a war at Ahn'Qiraj that is being planned and prepared for. We and the Horde are preparing as best we can for it.$B$BTo that end, the Alliance has asked me to supervise the collection of silk bandages here. To date we've managed to put together $2082w out of $2083w needed. Are you thinking about helping out?
Hello, my friends. It is good to see you again. Still keeping our borders free I see. Antonio appreciates your hard work.
Hello, sister. What have we here?

Hello, traveler. Not many find me out this way.$B$BMy name is Rivern, and I train the Winterspring Frostsabers to become mounts.$B$BThese cats are the most feral and difficult to subdue of all the sabers. Only the most trusted and exalted may attempt to ride one.$B$BI will not sell such a mount to just anyone; no, you must work for it and earn your acceptance not only with me, but with the sabers themselves.

Hello, young $c. Are you here to bring me a batch of peacebloom? We are collecting them to make potions and elixirs for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Though tragic that we are forced into this war, the results will be even more terrible if we do not prepare properly.$B$BThe Horde has tasked me with the collection of $2020w peacebloom, and so far we've managed to put together $2021w. If you have it within your ability, please gather up all that you can and return them to me here.
Hello?
Help a poor bloke out?

Oh, but you need directions...  just head on over to the Dwarven District, you'll find Lilliam Sparkspindle towards the back.

The birds are being affected by the evil effects of the Gordunni ogres inhabiting the ruins of Feralas, and their numbers are dwindling.$B$BI collect many different types of eggs.  Will you help and find some for me?

Hi there! The name's Gregan. What can I do for ya?

I got my stacks here and it looks like we've got $2069w right now. Our magic number is $2071w. Want to help out?
Hi there.  I'm Gubber Blump.
