Horrifying.
Hound on the horizon moving at thirty feet per second. The only question is, right or left eye. That's right $g lad : lass;, I'm that good.

How I yearn to join you in glorious battle, but instead I am stuck here on duty. Go to the Hall of the Brave in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor and speak to Kartra Bloodsnarl. She will help you get to Alterac Valley. Make us proud $N!
How are my men doing?
How are the gift standings?  Who's the most popular?
How are we doing in the battle to subvert the cauldrons?
How can I conjure a demon?
How can I find the two parts of your scepter?
How can I free you?
How can I get Evoroot?
How can I get anything done with the Scourge running amok around here?!
How can I get anything done with the Scourge running amok in here?!
How can I prove myself to the Timbermaw furbolg?
How can I summon Omen?
How could the altar and the statues be related?
How could this happen?
How could you love me, Annalise? Look at me. I am not the man you once knew.
How dare you attempt to zerg me, wimp!
How dare you defile this ancient place!
How dare you!
How dare you?!
How did you know? I mean, yes... Yes I am looking for that shard. Do you have it?
How do I catch the mudskunks for your lure?
How do I do that?
How do I form a guild?
How do I use the Cache of Mau'ari?
How do the goblins ever manage to secure packs to these beasts?  Kodos are ten times the size!
How do you know all of this?
How do you know?
How do you like my pet?
How easy it was to manipulate you into recovering the last Suntara stone from those imbeciles of the Twilight's Hammer.

How else could this have happened? Someone must have tipped the Dark Irons off.$B$B<Kharan shakes his fist at you.>$B$BSo help me, if I ever get out of here, I will spend the rest of my days finding the traitor.
How fortuitous. Usually, I must leave my lair in order to feed.
How goes the barrel watching...?
How has this come to be, $N? Do you think that an item such as the Scepter of Celebras is trivial?$B$BI can help you this time, but do not be careless with this valuable item again...
How interesting... the Stone possesses great magical potential, but in a purely raw form...
How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.
How long can it take to pick a handful of weeds?
How long will the invasion last?
How many Frostwolf Officers are alive, Vanndar?
How many bandages have the Alliance collected so far?
How many bandages have the Horde collected so far?
How many battles have we won?
How many cooked goods have the Alliance collected so far?
How many cooked goods have the Horde collected so far?
How many herbs have the Alliance collected so far?
How many herbs have the Horde collected so far?
How many leather skins have the Alliance collected so far?
How many leather skins have the Horde collected so far?
How many metal bars have the Alliance collected so far?
How many metal bars have the Horde collected so far?

How many metal bars you say? As of my last update on the situation, here is what I know. The Horde has collected $2018w copper bars out of $1998w needed, $2005w tin bars out of $2006w and of $2009w mithril bars sought, $2008w have been gathered.
How many more supplies are needed for the next upgrade?
How many more supplies are needed to rebuild our base?
How many more supplies are needed to send a ground assault?
How many more supplies are needed to send ground assaults?
How many more supplies do we need?
How many of our Commanders are alive, Vanndar?
How many of our Commanders are still alive, Drek'Thar?
How many of our Lieutenants are alive, Drek'Thar?
How many of our Lieutenants are alive, Vanndar?
How many of the Stormpike's Officers are still alive, Drek'Thar?
How may I aid you in your journey?
How may I be of service?
How much further to go?
How much more blood is needed, Commander?
How pathetic. I am infused with the power of the Soulflayer. I fear nothing but the wrath of the almighty Hakkar. I serve no one but my master, Jin.
How the hell did you get in there to begin with?

How unfortunate; it would appear that we have collected all of the mageweave bandages necessary. Perhaps you can go sell them on the auction house? But before you go, be a good $g boy : girl; and check with the other collectors present. They may have an errand to send you off on.
How wonderful to see another person in this remote region of the world. Come, walk with me. Let our bodies keep each other warm.
How you doin' mon!
How, my love? How will I find the strength to face the ages of the world without you by my side...
How?? Well, it's a long story.
Hrm, I'm listening. What is this offer?

Hrm, curious... This ends abruptly. In Tanaris the Qiraji document facing a bronze dragon. There is much missing from this... More information must be found! Surely they are planning to invade Kalimdor once more!
Hrmmm...
Huh?  What do you want?
Huh?  You'll find the bank in Orgrimmar.  Head north up the road to get there and then talk to one of their grunts.
Huh? What dat?
Huh?! Darn it, it's lunch time! I overslept!
Hulfnar!  Thontek!  Stand and address me.
Hullo, Trias clan!  A ball of your smoked mozzarella, if you please!
Humans are usually vunerable on their left side between the 4th and 5th rib. Let's practice striking at this area like so...
Humbug!  Die!
Hundreds of various diagrams and schematics begin to take shape on the pages of the book. You recognize some of the diagrams while others remain foreign but familiar.

Hundreds of years ago, the great city of Thaurissan stood proudly in a lush expanse of land that is now the dilapidated Burning Steppes.$B$BThaurissan was home to the nation of Dark Iron dwarves and at the time, in the midst of a civil war among the dwarven nation at large.$B$BYou see, that area of the world was at one point in time part of the Redridge Mountains - until the day that Thaurissan was consumed by a gigantic explosion. The city lay in ruin, the surrounding areas reduced to an ashy wasteland.
Hungry worms will feast on your rotting flesh.
Hunter
Hurray!  My doll!
Hurry brothers! You must go now! I do not know how much longer the rift will remain open!
Hurry! Ple-e-ase hurry!!
Huuup...Huuup...Bleeeeehh!
Huzzah for the tipper!  Step right up and get your delicious, cold drinks right here!
I AM AWAKE, AT LAST!
I HAVE YOUR LITTLE BELT TIED AROUND MY FINGER, SMOTTS.  DON'T YOU WANT IT BACK?
I PROMISE I WON'T KILL YOUR CREW THIS TIME.  HAH!  BUT MY BROTHER MIGHT EAT THEM!
I SAID GOOD DAY!
I allow the man to take enough corn to feed his family for a couple of days, encouraging him to leave the land.
I almost have enough supplies to upgrade to champion units.
I already know a lot about style. Now it's just a matter of mastering the techniques for working with leather. Good thing Simon's a real sport about helping me learn them.
I also seek such power.
I am 100% confident that I wish to learn in the ways of gnomish engineering.
I am 100% confident that I wish to learn in the ways of goblin engineering.
I am Al'tabim the All-Seeing - an envoy of King Rastakhan.$B$BMy dealings are with priests, mages, and warlocks.
I am Balgaras the Foul.  And you, $N, are about to become nothing more than ash and dust.
I am Gath'Ilzogg!  And you are a $R on the brink of death!
I am Highborne, $r. It has no meaning now. There was a time, though, when this world was ruled by Highborne. Ten thousand years past...
I am Hydraxis, Duke of the Waterlords.  You are not an elemental and so cannot understand our struggle, but perhaps we can strike a deal that will benefit us both...
I am Jin'rokh the Breaker, envoy of Mugamba: Fist of Rastakhan!$B$BMy dealings are with warriors and heathens.
I am Kilram, master of the axe.
I am Krathok, overseer of these craftsmen.

I am Rutherford Twing, the main supplier for the Defilers posted here at Arathi Basin.  As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

I am Samuel Hawke, the main supplier for the League of Arathor posted here at Arathi Basin.  As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.
I am Saurfang. Brother of Broxigar.

I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!$B$BAlso, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

I am Ulysses Rackmore, captain of the Gallant.  And this is the log of the last few days of my doomed ship.$B$BWe were sailing to Feathermoon Stronghold with a shipment of supplies when naga stormed the sides of the Gallant.  We drove them back but we knew they'd return.  Fearing the loss of my most precious belongings, I steered the Gallant to an island off the coast of Desolace, one with old, night elf ruins.  And there I left my treasure chest.
I am Zanza, a Loa of Zandalar. I have come in this ethereal form from Zandalar to help my people. Hakkar has no dominion over my soul.$B$BI help those that have helped the Zandalarian people.
I am a BOT. I have tons of information. To find out what I know whisper me

I am a crafter of some renown, $c. With the proper materials, I am able to craft an armor known as Dreamwalker. Druids - and even some shaman - are drawn to this armor due to its magical properties. Are you interested?
I am a hunter and wish to train.

I am a mage of great power, I have spent my days studying the mind and the memory as it pertains to learning and the retention of learned abilities. I would even now be perfecting my studies if not for the great voices that came to me in the night, informing me that my services were required. I will be here for only a short time offering my ability to wipe your talents for free. Soon I will leave again, and you will once more be stuck with whatever choices you make.
I am a master blacksmith, Omarion.
I am a master leatherworker, Omarion.
I am a master tailor, Omarion.
I am a treasure hunter in search of powerful artifacts. Give them to me and you will not be harmed.
I am a troll tailor trainer, and this is my default greeting.
I am absolutely certain that I want to learn dragonscale leatherworking.
I am absolutely certain that I want to learn elemental leatherworking.
I am absolutely certain that I want to learn tribal leatherworking.

I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.
I am almost done, $N. Just a few more adjustments!

I am an officer of the city, working in the capacity of the Undercity's census.  Since our liberation from the Scourge, we have tried to keep an accurate track of our city's populace.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.  If you have business with me accordingly, please proceed.  You should know if you do, at any rate.
I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.
I am an undead cloth vendor, and this is my greeting text.
I am bound eternally to this cursed world. What is it you desire, mortal?
I am certain there is a Tailor that could provide you training in Darnassus.  When you arrive, ask one of the Sentinels in Darnassus about seeing a Tailor.
I am curious to see what a bucket of bolts has to offer.
I am despawning from $N.
I am diseased. Please cure me, medic.
I am done inspecting the skulls, $N, and I am relieved.  Yenniku is not among them...
I am done.  Your armor is ready, $N.
I am eager to hear what so angry an orc has to say...
I am eternal fire. I am forever reborn and I will be the light that will guide you when it is most cold.
I am forever denied the touch of stone.  I will never again know the glory of shaped iron...
I am free! Let's work together now to save my brother, Sothos!
I am free! Let's work together now to save my sister, Jarien!
I am going to practice and become a warrior like my father!
I am greatly indebted to you, $c. Perhaps I can help your cause.
I am he that carries out the Warchief's commands without question. I am Horde.
I am he that watches they. I am the fist of retribution. That which does quell the recalcitrant. Dare you defy the Warchief? Dare you face my merciless judgement?
I am here for training.
I am here!
I am here!  And the Irondeep Mine is... MINE!
I am here!  Come face me, if you dare!
I am here!  Now, puny little worms, you will pay for your intrusion!
I am here!  Your rule of this land is over!
I am honored to share my knowledge with you, $N. See that you use it well.

I am in charge of recruitment for the Frostwolf Clan. As a soldier of Frostwolf, it is your responsibility to check in with me as your rank among the clan rises.$B$BHonor and respect are earned on this frigid field.
I am in need of training, Keryn.
I am in need of training.
I am in search of a great and powerful Warlock.
I am interested in alchemy training.
I am interested in mage training.
I am interested in tailor training.
I am interested in warlock training.
I am knowledgable, but I am not an expert. You know who you should talk to? Rhiannon! She's not far. Ask around for her in Undercity
I am listening, Demitrian.
I am looking for some bodyguards that would like to protect the Gizelton Caravan. We are stopped on the road east of Kormek's Hut, north of Kolkar Centaur Village.
I am missing a piece of my Augur's Regalia and I need a replacement.
I am no cultist, you monster!  Come to me and face your destruction!
I am not fooled by your disguise, temptress. Your time to die has come.

I am not here because of honor, $N. I am here because of one orc's pride.$B$BIf I had not rejected Belgrom's offers, then I'm sure I'd still be in Orgrimmar taking care of real business.$B$BHis desire for women is not unknown to many of the female warriors in Durotar, but that doesn't stop him from being his charming self.$B$BHe's lucky he didn't pursue his desire for me much longer though--he'd be short more than just the digits on his hands.
I am not here to harm you, Kharan. Gor'shak sent me. He told me that you would speak to me about the Princess.
I am not worthy, sir.
I am now corrupted.
I am now corrupting you...
I am one of the Seven, and it is our doom to stand sentry.  Forever.
I am pleased with your progress so far. Surely the Earth Mother has inspired your hands.
I am proud. You are truly a gifted student. Now, for your final lesson...
I am ready for the illusion, Myranda.
I am ready to begin.
I am ready to discover where my fortune lies!
I am ready to hear your tale, Baristolth.
I am ready to hear your tale, Tirion.
I am ready to rock, Vipore! Give me a beacon.
I am ready!
I am ready, Anachronos. Please grant me the Scepter of the Shifting Sands.
I am ready, Historian Archesonus.
I am ready, Remulos.
I am ready, as are my forces. Let us end this masquerade!
I am released through you! Avenge me!
I am slain!  Summon Verog!
I am so smart!  S-M-R-T!
I am sorry $c, but you are not seasoned enough yet to enter Warsong Gulch.
I am sorry $c, but you need to be more experienced before you can survive in Alterac Valley.
I am sorry $c, but you need to be more powerful before I can allow you to enter Arathi Basin.
I am sorry but I can not train any more apprentices. Seek out Mak in Thunder Bluff. He will be able to teach you the basics.
I am sorry. I am unable to help you at this time.
I am summoned!  Intruders, come to my tent and face your death!
I am the hand of the Lich King!
I am the head of the family.  Me.  ME!!!
I am the latest incarnation of automated vendors... we will rule the world one day... don't tell my boss that I am skimming money off his merchandise...
I am the serpent king! I can do anything!
I am truly impressed, Gerard. I thought you were all talk, but I see I have been proven wrong.
I am truly sorry, $c, but as your spirit has never before experienced the horrors that lie in wait within the burning wreck of Stratholme, our magic cannot carry you to the city.

I am unable to process your chronological reference in comparison to the recording of this data, my apologies.$B$BThe trogg retains some composition of Azeroth's various stone core compounds, but the loss of cognitive power makes this variant unacceptable to the Creators.$B$BThe trogg procreates as per a standard biomass.  By default it consumes stone and anything else it can acquire, including other troggs.  Cannibalism is considered unacceptable by the Creators.

I am unable to process your chronological reference in comparison to the recording of this data, my apologies.$B$BThough the dwarf maintains most of the Earthen's mental attunement to Azeroth's stone composition, the reversion back into living biomass remains the main degeneration of the matrix.  Dwarves eat and procreate through means typical to other standard biomasses.$B$BThe Creators view the dwarf as an acceptable variant, worthy of genesis in its own right.
I am unable to teach a Tauren to ride a Skeletal Mount.  I am sorry but there is nothing I can do for you.
I am unable to train you.
I am unworthy of this conversation, $G Master:Mistress;.
I am unworthy, $g sir:maam;.
I am unworthy, master!
I am well versed in over 4 languages.
I am willing to try but I will require instruction.
I am with you until I gasp my last dying breath.
I am, am I?  Well what have you got for the new big dog of Gordok, Fengus?
I apologize for taking so long to get here. I wanted Lady Proudmoore to be present also.
I appreciate the company, but let's face it: you have more experience with potions than I do. Talk to Doctor Marsh instead if you want training. He's a Forsaken in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.
I barely have any supplies for upgrades.
I be seeking someone, $c. Please, leave me be... it is important I find them.
I bear witness to a miracle that stands before me! In one thousand years of captivity, I have not seen a single LIVING specimen - other than those foul Qiraji and silithid - enter these chambers.
I believe Aldwin Laughlin is still the resident Guild Master of Stormwind.  Look for his residence on your left as you pass the inner gate of Stormwind.
I believe I misplaced that banner you enchanted for me, Falrin.
I believe I noticed a new shipment of mail being delivered not too long ago.  You'll find the mailbox just outside the Thunder Bluff Bank on the lower rise.
I believe Simone was looking for you earlier, $N. Have you spoken with her yet?
I believe the Forsaken are misleading the allies of the Horde.... wait... I feel so... dizzy...
I believe you are up to this task... will you accept the challenge?
I believe you children are our future...
I bet Josetta would be more than happy to teach you some new spells.  She is probably up in her room at the Lion's Pride Inn.
I bet my friend Gruk would like this rock for the spear he is making! It's very sharp... I hope he likes it.
I bet you're sorry now, aren't you $N!?!

I bid you welcome, $c. Rare do we have visitors down to these levels of the Apothecarium... unless of course there's something someone wants... or needs.$B$B<Chemist Coely laughs.>$B$BHow can I help you today, hmm?
I call your true name, Azrethoc. Show your visage to me!
I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.$B$BHe claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!
I can feel the presence of evil leaving...
I can get back to the Stronghold on my own, I think.  Now that you bought me some time, I should be able to stealth out of here.  Who ever you are... thank you.  May Elune bless you always!
I can make amazing things with the materials I find out here. By Muradin's beard, there are fantastic creatures in these hills! Go have a whack at them, $N, and bring me back some tall tales.
I can not train you, $c.
I can not train you, young one.
I can not train you.
I can not train you. You need to talk to your class trainer.

I can see in your eyes you're no stranger to the tragedy within Stratholme. If you wish to end the miserable existence of the poor souls trapped therein, step into the circle. It leads directly to the gates of the burning city itself.
I can see that you'll be a quick learner. That's good for me, because I'm always busy these days. In fact, that reminds me: could you run a quick errand for me?

I can show you what you wish to know, but you must be patient. Take your time to work the steel and feel the way it shapes beneath your hammer. When you become one with the steel, then you will understand.
I can smell your fear, $r.
I can stand no more of this!

I can teach you both the finesse of a short blade and the bone shattering cleaving power of a two handed behemoth. Or we can get crazy and I can teach you both, could come in handy for when the situation changes on ya.
I can teach you fishing skills.
I can teach you how to cook!
I can teach you the finer points of Horse Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
I can teach you the finer points of Kodo Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
I can teach you the finer points of Mechanostrider Piloting, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
I can teach you the finer points of Ram Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
I can teach you the finer points of Skeletal Horse Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
I can teach you the finer points of Tiger Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
fa: اگر طلای کافی برای هزینهٔ درس داشته باشی، نکته‌های ظریف‌تر ببرسواری را به تو یاد می‌دهم!

en: I can teach you the finer points of Wolf Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
I can tell just by the way you're standing that you're no warrior.  $B$BWhy don't you go do something safe, like read a book.
I can tell that your wardrobe is in dire need of care.
I can train you in First Aid techniques.
I can travel faster on my own from here, $N. Meet Jessir Moonbow near Ashenvale. She should be with the druids of the Emerald Circle. She'll tell you what to do next. Thank you so much for your help!
I can't believe dad won't let me keep your sister.

I can't believe it... I was doing a routine recon mission over the central DMZ when all hell broke loose. I saw the Horde Wing Commander, Mulverick, take out both Ichman and Slidore! Anger took hold of me and I broke from my wing man and drove that bastard Mulverick down. Unfortunately, he clipped my gryphon before he crashed, forcing me down as well. I ended up captured by these savages.$B$BI have to get back to base! Help!

I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!$B$BWith thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.
I can't come down.  I am scared.
I can't even visit my father's grave in peace anymore.

I can't find my pet frog, Jubjub.  She loves Dark Iron Ale, it's all she ever drinks, but can be so hard to get!  Now I'm out... and Jubjub must have run away to find more!$B$BI wish she would come back...
I can't handle this $n alone! Help!
I can't help it, really. This is just such a beautiful place.
I can't help ya'! You're ready to see someone who's been at it longer than I have! Let's see... you're an Alliance type, so you need to talk to Lilliam Sparkspindle in Stormwind.
I can't help you; your work is beyond my own. Talk to Arthur Moore, over there by the coffins. He'll be able to train you further.
I can't stand all of the cackling and diabolical laughter. One more 'muhahaha' from Lydon and I'm blowing us all up.
I can't take these taxes! F.I.C.A. me? F.I.C.A. YOU!
I cannot aid you with further lessons: your skills have surpassed mine. Go and see the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. She offers more advanced training.
I cannot be destroyed! By the will of Ragnaros, I shall be reborn!
I cannot be teachin' a Tauren to ride a Raptor.
I cannot believe those greedy goblins are allowed to hawk their wares while spoiling the spirit of this season.
I cannot help you with further training: your skill at working with leather rivals my own. You should speak with Una, over there. I will vouch for your skill if need be.
I cannot leave my post here, $N, but there is a task that must be taken care of. Can I trust you to see it done?
I cannot permit you to enter the Temple!  I must destroy you for your own good!
I cannot teach you anything you don't already know. However, the knowledge of my father far surpasses my own. Go inside and speak to him. Good luck!
I cannot teach you elemental leatherworking, $N. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."
I cannot teach you tribal leatherworking, $N. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."
I cannot train a $c such as yourself.
I cannot, Vaelastrasz! Surely something can be done to heal you!
I carry both parts of the scepter.
I caught a big one last week, it had three eyes!
I caught a fish if you are hungry...
I cause you no trouble, boss.
I come for you, puny Alliance!
I come from the land down under... where women plague and men sunder.
I come to Silithus every year around this time. The weather is phenomenal for my bunions.$B$BYou should take a stroll with me, friend. Enjoy the sights and what not.
I come to raze your bases, Frost Wolf clan. Ivus punishes you for your treachery!
I come with news of our conflict with the Rogue Undead.
I confiscate the corn he has stolen, warn him that stealing is a path towards doom and destruction, but I let him go to return to his family.
I confront the ruler on his malicious behavior, upholding my liege's honor at the risk of any future diplomacy.
I could crush you with but a single motion. Do not anger me.
I could use a drink and some rest myself.  You'll find it right in the northwest corner of Razor Hill.  Say hi to Innkeeper Grosk for me.
I crush weaklings like you every day!  Bring it on!
I desire this eternal quintessence, Duke Hydraxis.
I did not doubt you for even one second, $N.$B$BHere are your orders, $N. I know that you will not let me down.
I didn't know bees didn't like fire!
I didn't know he was getting married! I didn't even know he was dating! That's terrible! He can't work nights anymore!
I didn't mean to drag you into this, $N.  Ever since we took on a job to steal Lord Valthalak's spellbook, everyone involved has wound up dead or missing.
I do not deserve such praise, Warlord Goretooth.
I do not enjoy conversation.
I do not have much time in this world, but Light willing, it is time enough to fulfill my destiny.  When you face Baron Rivendare, I will be with you.
I do not have the knowledge you seek.

I do not have time to waste, $c; there is a war at Ahn'Qiraj to prepare for. If you are going to help, we are collecting singed corestones from the Molten Core. I need to gather a total of $2110w, and currently have $2109w.
I do not have time to waste, stranger. State your business or be off!
I do not know this Eye of the Tiger some speak of, but I can show you how to use the claws of the tiger.

I do not like these human cities of stone and steel. I would prefer the forests of Ashenvale, tracking great beasts. But my dear brother, Kaerbrus, felt it would be beneficial to train the humans in our ways. So while I honor him and offer my services, I do not have to like it.
I do not offer apprentice training. Look for the tauren Waldor in the Wailing Caverns, here in the Barrens. He can assist you with whatever you need.
I do not possess any proof, Cyrus.
I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child.  I have no teachings which would benefit a $c such as yourself.
I do not understand.
I do so enjoy sitting out here, listening to the sounds of the Great Sea.  Oh, what?  Yes, there is a ship that will take you to Menethil Harbor.  It docks here from time to time.
I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a Dwarf named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.
I don't agree with your turning to alchemy to fix some of the problems, but I do agree with the results. Very well done.
I don't approve of your experiments, Gerard, but I must admit the results are impressive. What exactly did you do to her?

I don't care to hear it, $N. Nope, no way are you going to be let into the Searing Gorge. Impossible. Not going to happen. How many times do I have to tell you - I can't let you in! Do you not speak common? Are you an orc in disguise? N-O. NO!$B$BIf I let you in, then I have to let everybody in. Pretty soon your close friends will want in, then their distant relatives, then their friends, and so on and so forth. I don't get paid enough for this bull excrement!

I don't know how they do it...  those mailboxes must be magic portals or something.  Why I see people gathered around the mailbox next to the bank all day pulling swords and shields and various armor all from that small box!
I don't know much about magic, but there's a mage named Zaldimar who is staying at the Lion's Pride Inn that could probably assist you.
I don't know of one of those around here.  Your best bet is to go to Orgrimmar to the north and speak to one of their grunts.
I don't know what they put in those kegs, but it goes down like honey!
I don't know what'll be in it yet.  Pat Nagle and Michael Backus need to discuss this first...
I don't know what's come over me. My heart feels as hot as new steel.
I don't quite understand...
I don't think it's strong enough.
I don't think there's any fish in these canals.
I don't think you want to learn anything I can teach. Might want to find a $c trainer to help you out.

I don't want to be a meal for an ogre! Please save me!

I doubt you have had much occasion to see such a creature. These demonic equines will make your travels much faster by acting as your mount as long as you control them. However, they are difficult to control, so be sure you are ready before attempting it.
I doubt you will be so lucky the next time you encounter my bretheren.

I dream, $N... oh yes, I dream. In my dreams I die a thousand times in a thousand different ways. Some would call dreams such as mine nightmares. NOT I! In dreams I die in the thick of battle. For each single death of my own, ten thousand enemies of the Horde fall before me. It is glorious!
I drink in your suffering, mortal. Let your essence congeal with Lokholar!
I dunno, Jill. If Klaven comes down while we're slacking, we may end up as one of those things!
I dunno. What do you want to do?
I execute him as per my liege's instructions, and do it in such a manner that he suffers painfully before he dies as retribution for his crimes against my people.
I execute him as per my liege's instructions, but doing so in as painless of a way as possible.  Justice must be served, but I can show some compassion.

I fear for the worst, old friend. Within the Dream we fight a new foe, born of an ancient evil. Ysera's noble brood has fallen victim to the old whisperings. It seems as if the Nightmare has broken through the realm and seeks a new host on Azeroth.

I feel sick.

Use the scepter at the ancient ritual site to create a portal, and you will find yourself here once more.
I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

I guess so!

I guess someone needs to bandage us warriors up after the fighting.  Seek out Arnok at the Survival of the Fittest hut next to the Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  Look up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength for a lake.  That's where he's at.
I guess that's that. We have all of the Arthas' Tears necessary. You might try asking around. One of these others is sure to have something that they still need collected for the war effort.

I guess the spirits like you better than me, I still have not heard their call but you seem to have gathered their lessons well. Go speak to Karn, he will be excited to see one who hears them as he does.
I guess you were hungry! Trok was supposed to have fed you earlier... What has he been doing all this time?

I guess your first exercise is going to be to mine your way down to the Undercity.  Heh, get it?  Mine... nevermind.  To get to the Undercity go to the rear of the Ruins of Lordaeron south of Brill, and take the elevator down.  Ask one of the Undercity Guardians there for further assistance.
I had a bad encounter with some of the Defias around here recently, but Michelle Belle fixed me up pretty well.  Check with her in the Lion's Pride Inn and see if she'll teach you.
I had it all!  I had it all and then I lost it.  Lost... all gone... like... my mind.  My mind is like... cheese.  I like cheese.

I had no choice, or so I thought. I would endure the destruction of Thaurissan and stand by the side of my king and his people.$B$BUnder the control of Ragnaros, King Dagran Thaurissan tore out the heart of this mountain and erected Blackrock Spire. I have observed four different kinds of plants that have been affected by the corruption: the songflower, the windblossom, the whipper root, and the night dragon plant.  The songflower and windblossom are common plants in Felwood, while the whipper root and night dragon are seen less frequently.  All are a vital part of Felwood's ecosystem.
I have orders here for an attack on alliance forces in the middle fields.  I need someone to get them to the assault leader.
I have outfitted kings. With the proper training, you can too.

I have run through these plains for many, many seasons.  And I have hunted great beasts.  And I had never been bested... until I faced Ghost Howl.$B$BLong ago, the massive wolf was an ally to the tauren and fought bravely against the Burning Legion.  But he was wounded savagely by a demon, and the tear in his flesh never healed.  Eventually... it drove Ghost Howl mad.$B$BNow he roams the plains in agony, seeking an end to his pain.  To my shame, when we fought I lacked the strength to slay him...
I have so much to do... so much before the plague comes...

I have tracked the various fragments of the staff across this world and in doing so, discovered Kel'Thuzad's plans to reform the staff. He has already collected several of the staff's fragments - which are being held by his most trusted lieutenants.$B$BI cannot emphasize enough the importance of keeping the greatstaff of the Guardian out of Kel'Thuzad's grasp. I have what you need, $c.
I have your dolly! Nyah nyah!
I haven't really figured out what it is, but there's something strange about the hot springs...

I hear that they have a Mining Trainer in Thunder Bluff to the north.  Take the road out of the village and when you get there ride the elevator to the top of the rise.  Any of the Bluffwatchers should be able to help you from there.

I hear that they have a Mining Trainer in the Undercity.  All you have to do to get there is head south out of town and go to the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron.  Then take the elevator down into the Undercity itself and ask an Undercity Guardian for further directions.
I hear there's a shop up in Ironforge run by the gnomes that specializes in alchemy.  You should go have a look.
I hear wedding bells in your future.
I heard a story about this golden fish, and if you caught it you would get three wishes!
I heard all the kobolds that were down there are dead.

I heard that there are these huge fish that can walk on land to hunt, and eat people!
I heard that, after the fireworks show, goblets will be brought to the tables.  Fine toasts we shall raise!
I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

I heard their mocking laughter as my gryphon crashed and burned, $c.$B$B"Slidore, you stink!" They shouted.$B$BNobody talks to Slidore that way! Help me get out of here so that I can show them who the real stinker is!
I heard there are still orcs buried underneath it.

I heard you was dead... well, you won't be easy to make dead after this!
I hereby destroy these instruments of evil! For the Horde!
I hold the key to lands of free! Chase me and you'll see!
I hope Ogron finds that pinkskin and breaks his legs. See how he survives in the marsh like that!
I hope that was a fish!
I hope that you are here to go to Alterac Valley $N.  We can use all o' the help that we can get.

I hope this frond takes root...
I hope this works!
I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.

I inspect the body further.
I installed a new device in our car's matrix regulometer.  That should increase its velocity quotient by a factor of no less than fifteen!
I join you in celebration of this most revered of nights - the night we Forsaken broke the Scourge's yoke of oppression!
I just can't seem to get comfortable without a sturdy ceiling of granite over my head. All these stars up there, enough to give ye the shivers.
I just finished wandering.
I just fired an arrow.

I just received word on that. We currently have $2021w out of $2020w peacebloom, $2050w of $2051w firebloom, and $2054w out of $2055w purple lotus herbs requested.

I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.
I keep getting sand stuck in my toes.
I kinnae help ye with trainin'. Ye should look fer a $c trainer.
I knew of another like you once... His name was Vol'jin. You are a rare breed, my friend.

I know how to speak kitty, and Effsee said thank you.
I know it'll work this time...

I know just the one that you speak of $c. You must seek out Brogun Stoneshield on the Warrior's Terrace.

I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns,$N. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.

I know these forests as if they were a part of me... But know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.
I know very little of the Highborne and nothing of the Shen'dralar.

I know who you are, $N.  Fate and forces beyond that have brought you to me for a reason, and it is one I take no pleasure in being a part of.  There are many decisions you will make in the coming times, and I hope you are wise enough to make the correct ones.$B$BBelieve me, $r, when I tell you this - there are correct choices.
I know you are there, rogue. Leave my home or join the others at the bottom of the world tree.
I know you as Artorius the Doombringer. Show yourself, demon! Face me!

I know you will, $N.$B$BI myself am a priestess, though, unlike you I am long since gone from this world. My spirit, however, remains here, as do the spirits of the thousands who were brutally slain by the mad Prince, Arthas Menethil and his legion of undeath.
I know, I know, I'm out here in the middle of nowhere!$B$BMy home is actually in Ratchet, but after crashing my zeppelin here, I thought I might as well start the research I came here to do!
I last saw Elder Meadowrun at the Weeping Cave in the Western Plaguelands.
I leave you now, mortals. Alive and with these trinkets. Maltrake! Present them with the trinkets!

I left. I would not remain with the Blackrock. No, the deaths of my children would not be in vain. I would not serve under an inept, power hungry maniac such as Rend.$B$BI took shelter in the woods of Lordaeron, living as a hermit near Hearthglen.
I like the way you think!  Let's get outta here!

I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.
I live only to serve our King.
I live only to serve the master.

I look into the eye...
I lost Lord Valthalak's Amulet!

I love mornings! It's a great day, isn't it? Smell that air?

If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.$B$BAnd I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. I only make my mounts available to those who are considered friendly to Orgrimmar and the Orcish race.  Go prove yourself to us, and I'll make my mighty wolves available for your inspection.
I ordered a few shipments of new perfumes and colognes from the city. After I get them unpacked, check back and I'll have them for sale.
I overheard Regnus Thundergranite in the Hall of Arms bragging about a new trophy for his den the other day.  If yer looking for training from a skilled hunter, Regnus is the one to see.
I perform one final service. I pray it is sufficient...

I personally didn't mind him. It was the Prince who took exception to a high elf in his domain. Alas, I am not one to question the Prince. In his defense, he did not incinerate Master Winthalus immediately.
I pledge my love to you forever. Death cannot erase that, even as I am sure that you still remember your love for me.
I possess part of Eranikus' essence.  What do you want with it... or with me?
I pray for such things.

I prefer my food raw, but if you like yours cooked Denni'ka can show you how to light a fire.  Find her at Survival of the Fittest, a hut on the shore of the lake next to the Spirit Lodge.  Look for it up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.
I present to you the Libram of Constitution.
I present to you the Libram of Resilience.
I present to you the Libram of Rumination.
I present to you the Libram of Tenacity.
I present to you the Libram of Voracity.
I present to you the rabid thistle bear, Tharnariun.
I present you with proof of my deeds, Cyrus.
I promise you an eternity of dung clean up duty for that failure!
I promise you this much: The Valley will be ours.
I put at your disposal whatever assistance I can offer.
I quietly ignore the insult.  I will not tell my liege, as I am to secure peace at all costs.  It's only an insult - not a declaration of war.
I raise my brew and hope to be rid of the likes of you!  Cheers, you no good scoundrel, $N!
I really did not know what to expect, Eris. I will use my powers to assist you if that is what is asked of me.
I really envy you, $N. You do amazing work.
I really need a better system for filing these books. Ahh that's the one I wanted.

I received an update on that just a moment ago. It looks like out of $2061w light leather needed, we have $2060w. As for the others, the report indicated that we've gathered $2063w of $2064w medium leather, and $2069w out of our $2071w thick leather quota.
I received the majority of my weapons training from Ilyenia Moonfire in the Warrior's Terrace.  You would do well to seek her out if you desire to learn the use of a new weapon.

I reckon that the odds of obtaining such a piece would be a one in a million! A once in a lifetime skin! Even the most disciplined artisans of the craft would no doubt fail several hundred times in the process of skinning the beast before a pristine sample was recovered.
I regret that I must fight this $N.
I regret to inform you that you have failed your examination, doctor.
I regret to say that I cannot aid you, $gnoble sir:gentle lady;, until you learn more of working with leather. Speak with Faldron or Darianna here instead. They can teach you the skill you require.

I represent the strength which bolsters you as a young druid.  I am the strength of the body, and the strength of the heart.  You have already come to know this in your training, and you draw upon this when you take on the aspect of the bear.$B$BContinue to keep the balance in all things, young one, and keep your perspective clear and true.  When you need me... I will be there for you.

I represent the strength which bolsters you as a young druid.  You have come to me to learn this strength, young one, and I will teach this to you.  I will teach you all that is the spirit bear, provided you will listen and understand.$B$BIn order to know what it means to draw upon my spirit, you need to understand the importance of the strength of the body, as well as the strength of the heart.
I require a teleport to Naxxramas.
I require a vial of aqual quintessence, Hydraxis, for I go to the Molten Core to extinguish a rune of the Firelords.
I require aid.
I require all my students to prove their dedication. Now it's your turn...
I require assistance in recovering a piece of my Demoniac's Threads, Al'tabim.
I require assistance in recovering a piece of my Illusionist's Attire, Al'tabim.
I require flagging.
I require training, Arnok.
I require training, Daryl.
I require training, Grimnur.
I require training, Lumak.
I require training, Nissa.
I require training, Zamja.
I require training, sir!
I require training.
I require warrior training.
I rise from the grave to take my revenge!
I risk my own life and free him so that he may prove his innocence.  If I can, I'll help him in any way.
I said KNEEL!

I said ye had the blood of a blacksmith in ye, and I was right. Go to Ironforge, to The Great Forge, and find yerself a Dwarven smith by the name of Bengus Deepforge. My teacher, and one of the greatest smiths I've ever known.
I saw a Sea Giant once.  It's not something I would care to see again.  Burp!
I see potential in you $N. Now grab a hammer and some of those scraps, you need a lot of practice.
I see right through your disguise, $r. Number Two! Number Two kill!
I see some interesting characters come and go here at the port. Watch yourself, $N. It's never clear who to trust, what with all of the shady activity that goes on here...
I see that you have found the eye.$B$B<Master Ryson grins.>$B$BWell, give it to me!
I see the exit! Hurry, hurry!
I see those fools at the Abbey sent some fresh meat for us.

I see you know more of the secret of steel than I do. That is good, for it is meant to be taken. Now you must travel to the jungle south of the human lands, to the goblin city of Booty Bay. There you will find a Goblin named Brikk Keencraft. I do not like Goblins but his knowledge of the secret of steel is unmatched by any I know of.
I see you misplaced that chapter you worked so hard to put together, $n. Well, you left it right here!
I seek further druidic training to have a closer understanding of the Earth Mother's will.
I seek more training in the priestly ways.
I seek to understand the importance of strength of the body.
I seek to understand the importance of strength of the heart.
I seek training as a druid.
I seek training in the ways of the Hunter.
I seek training to ride a steed.
I seek training.
I seem to have misplaced my Zandalar Madap's Bracers. Can you help?
I seem to have misplaced the distiller, Mux.  Did I happen to leave it here?
I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.
I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.
I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!
I sense a disturbance, lurking around you...
I sense a great power among us, Commander. Is the spell ready?
I sense danger deep within the grove...
I sense danger up ahead.
I sense evil brewing. . . .
I sense the taint of corruption upon this $N. Help me destroy it!
I sensed as much, Malfurion. Dark days loom ahead.
I shall cling to the love of my daughter and hope that I will find forgiveness under the Light for my sins.
I shall enjoy this, $c.
I shall find you mortals!  You shall pay for destroying the Ash'ari Crystals!
I shall get started right away, $N.
I shall now begin the robe...
I shall return in time..
I shall rip your guts out!
I shall scour the earth for this Earthshaper. What of the essence?
I shall spill your blood, $C!
I shall take my secrets to the grave with me!
I shall unleash the cavalry upon your command, sir!
I shall use the time wisely, milord. Thank you.
I shall wear your entrails as a necklace.
I shall.
I should find some hired help; I don't like sitting here all day selling fish supplies. I'd much rather go fishing, and then sell supplies.
I should get back before Rema starts to worry...
I should have a few extra coins from this sale.  Maybe I'll buy myself some lunch...
I should have taken the translucent pill.
I should talk to Dewey about some sort of notation system to these keep books better organized.
I should've grabbed a bigger sword.

I shouldn't even be telling you this but if you can make it past all the critters and beasties in Badlands, you might be able to make it to Searing Gorge.$B$BYes, the Badlands. There's some type of back road the orcs paved near Kargath. Just goes to show you what kind of fools we're dealing with here! A backdoor to hell? What were they thinking?
I show you how smart I am, boss!  You be extra smart with mighty magic mojo now!$B$BUm... maybe Slip'kik use magic on self. Dat would be good idea...
I slay the man on the spot as my liege would expect me to do, as he is nothing more than a thief and a liar.
I smell a $R
I smell a $R.
I smell an intruder...
I spent my whole life caring for these trees. Pruning and nurturing them... only fitting that they have joined me in death.
I still do not fully understand.
I still do not understand.
I still have the scars from that night.

I stood by and watched the corruption of Ragnaros seep through the hearts and minds of the Dark Iron nation. This once honorable race, driven to madness... to evil.$B$BWhen the construction of the Spire was complete, my will to live amongst my people gave way. I passed as a hero of the new nation of Dark Iron. This tomb was placed here - at the entrance to the city I planned and built - in honor of my efforts.
I study the known and unknown elements of our world.
I submit myself for further training my master.
I summon you, Sha'ni Proudtusk!
I supply the Hold with various relics required for spellcasting as well as other alchemical reagents.
I suppose I can teach that to you.  You'll probably only be able to find ogre tannin here, but the other things you can find most anywhere!
I suppose that could work, if we had twenty people to cast it with.
I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!
I suppose you're right.
I sure could use a kiss about now.  Know where I can find one?
I suspect that the imps are stealing knowledge.
I swear, people have actually seen them. Pandaren really do exist!
I swear... if Quint tries to plant one more fishing grub on me, I'm going to hack down his tree with my not-so-rusty sword.
I tell ye, I don't miss the Great War at all. I remember when we fought at Darrowmere. All night in the fog, lying in a muddy trench.
I thank the Light for this blessing. May it be used for justice and to defend all good creatures.

I thank you for your inquiry, but I already have all of the wool bandages necessary for the war effort. I suggest that you ask around though; there are many here that could probably still use your aid.
I thank you, $N.  And my brother thanks you.
I thank you, $N.  My associates who will do great things with these...

I thank you, $N. Your dedication to my plea gives rest to my lost wife's spirit, and for that I could never repay you enough.$B$BI cannot say that my hatred will ever cease for the quilboar, but it is satiated for now.$B$BNow I must begin to rebuild my life.
I think Elder Splitrock has traveled to Mauradon in the Desolace.
I think I have heard of this magic.
I think I hear him coming!  Look to the west!
I think I hear something! Chambers must be coming. Make way! Make way!
I think I see something.
I think I understand the Creators' design intent for the Earthen now.  What are the Earthen's anomalies that you spoke of earlier?
I think I've lost my  Zandalar Vindicator's Belt. Can you help?
I think Plugger filled one of his kegs too much.  It looks like it's about to blow!
I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.
I think not, I don't need to be blown up again.

I think not. Rimblat has already proven that new life can grow from the sundered earth. Now we must find a way to reproduce and, more importantly, sustain the growth.$B$BWhile I am here, I am also offering my services to adventurers entering Naxxramas.
I think that's the last of them. It's a good thing you came when you did... I wasn't sure how much longer I could stay hidden.
I think the sounds came from over here. We'd better check it out.
I think you signed up for the wrong job, initiate. Kel'Thuzad don't need any flower girls...
I think you'll have better luck looking in Stormwind.  Ask a guard up there and they'll point you in the right direction.
I think you're more than qualified for this little assignment... let's see if I'm right!
I think... I think it's working!
I thought I heard something.
I thought you were almost done?
I tire of this nonsense! Prepare to die, $r!
I train and guide young hunters in the traditions passed down many generations.
I train hunters in the ways and traditions of our ancestors.
I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?
I trust very few of your kind, $N. But I can tell that you are a friend.
I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.
I turn over the man to my liege for punishment, as he has broken the law of the land and it is my sworn duty to enforce it.
I understand, Earthmother.
I understand, my friend. I shall find someone to help your master. Go back to him now, or at least stay close.
I usually leave that sort of thing to the gnomes.  If you want to take up the profession, I'm sure you could find some gnomes hanging out in Stormwind that would train you.
I very much doubt that he will have anything to say, stranger...
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.$B$BWhat can I do for you, $N?
I wanna see the Mage Tower.
I wanna see the dragon skeleton in the great library.
I want a surgical strike, Slidore. Carpet the road with fire!
I want those boots! Nobody touch that corpse!
I want to ask you about something else.
I want to begin the statue puzzle.
I want to browse your goods.
I want to buy another stink bomb!
I want to catch Gahz'ranka!  Tell me how!
I want to create a guild crest.
I want to examine this pylon.
I want to release the corrupted saber to Winna.
I want you both to demonstrate the techniques I have taught you for the benefit of the younger students here.  Ready...  begin!
I was a young tauren, barely having reached adolescence at the time, but I knew that those that would brave the battles for our freedom were well protected in my namesake's vestments.
I was devoured by Horgus!  I can still feel his teeth upon me!

I was searching for materials to build my latest and greatest invention, the portable remote control shredder unit, when these trolls clubbed me and dragged me into the depths of their cave.$B$BReturn me to safety and I will lend my aid to your cause, $r.
I was shot down by that reckless fool, Mulverick. I fear that if I do not make it back to base, all will be lost! Mulverick and his squad of War Riders must be stopped!
I was standing right next to you, imbecile. I know what you seek.
I was thinking the same thing.

I welcome you to Theramore, $N.$B$BI apologize for being abrupt and not having a lot of time to exchange pleasantries, but my city must come first. Too many things threaten our way of life and the sanctity of the Alliance. I must stay ever vigilant against forces outside of our control if I'm to ensure my people remain safe and happy.$B$BPerhaps we'll have more time to speak later.

I welcome you, $N. And the Emerald Circle welcomes you.$B$BHopefully together we can help rejuventate and protect this once-mighty forest. Many forces seek to destroy it from without... and within.$B$BDo not be persuaded by the power here--it will only corrupt you, like it has this entire land.
I wept like a babe when I heard of your heroics. Master Ravenholdt would do well to have an apprentice like you.
I will access the discs now.
I will aid you. Give me the instructions.
I will be reborn, mortals! Incendius shall raise me from these ashes!
I will be your wingman!
I will call forth Eranikus when I am given the word.
I will consider what you have told me.
I will destroy you...
I will do my best to translate and describe what I see.
I will do my best, Vaelan.
I will do this with or without your help, Loramus.
I will gladly pay you Tuesday for a hamburger today.
I will hurry back to Vahlarriel. Finish off those that you can--I should be fine on my own from here.
I will instruct you when the time is right... that time is not now. You have much more to learn first!
I will lead us through Heartghlen to the forest's edge. From there, you will take me to my father.

I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.
I will need to focus my energies onto this knife.  By doing so, I should catch some of the stronger psychic impressions associated with it.
I will not be lured away!
I will not be lured from this place.
I will not die again! Not to the likes of you!!
I will not forrrget what you have done...$B$BPleassse, leave meee...
I will only slow you down, but no pink-skinned humans will keep me from freedom!
I will protect you!
I will pull the shard from his sundered corpse.
I will require a demonstration of your determination before I share my gifts with you...
I will return when I have the Plates of Uldum.
I will take you up on that offer, Eitrigg.
I will teach you the way of the hammersmith. Just ask nicely.
I will teach you, but first you must prove your worth...
I will teach you... soon. I require a demonstration of your loyalty, first.
I will tear off your limbs and use them to beat you into submission!
I will, Tirion.
I win!!

I wish it were true, $N, but it will take more than you alone to overcome the forces of Razelikh and his subordinates.$B$BGather a suitable group of adventurers and would-be heroes and free my men of their eternal torture! Eighteen stones you must shatter.$B$BFight hard and die with honor, $N.
I wish the snow would just all melt away. It's always getting my robe wet and messing up everything!
I wish to become a weaponsmith.
I wish to become an armorsmith.
I wish to browse your goods, Dirge.
I wish to browse your wares, Calandrath.
I wish to browse your wares.
I wish to face the Defiler.
I wish to fight!
I wish to hear your story.
I wish to hear your tale.
I wish to join the battle!
I wish to learn alchemy, Serge.
I wish to learn my leatherworking focus.
I wish to make a purchase, Nipsy.
I wish to make a purchase.
I wish to purchase another Elune's Candle.
I wish to purchase arcane quickener from you.
I wish to purchase from you.
I wish to see my enemies, Ryson. Show them to me.
I wish to speak to the spirits, Tiev.
I wish to stable my pet, Stable Master.
I wish to stable my pet.
I wish to train.
I wish to unlearn my talents.
I wish to untrain my pet.
I wish you a happy holiday, friend!
I wish you could just pick me up and carry me, $n.
I woke up in a bed in Northshire three weeks later. Don't remember a damn thing.
fa: سه هفته بعد در یک تخت در {{zn:Northshire|نورث‌شایر}} بیدار شدم. حتی یک چیز لعنتی هم یادم نیست.

en: I won't let you down!
I won't make it... go... go on without me...
I wonder if the pigs are hungry...
I wonder if your dolly can swim!
I would be happy to teach you when you are ready, but that time has not yet come! I'm sure Lalina Summermoon will guide you until then. You may find her in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus.
I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.
I would create some surreptitious means to keep my brother out of the order.  I can keep him out without him being any bit wiser, thereby saving our familial bonds.
I would have it back, mortal. Atiesh... From it I would create the Highborne anew. I would have it all back. Even the Queen...
I would have just dropped some Evershine in my tank and been back home before they realized I'd gone!
I would like to buy from you.
I would like to check my deposit box.
I would like to enter my e-coupon code to win the virtual item.
I would like to enter the secret code to receive my Murloc pet.
I would like to enter the secret code to receive my Zergling pet.
I would like to go to the battleground.
I would like to train further in the ways of the Light.
I would like to train.
I would like to whisper my secret code to you to receive my Panda Cub pet.
I would like training.
I would never have expected to find something in such perfect condition.
I would never turn away someone who's ready to train with me. Unfortunately, you're not! You've still got a ways to go kid!
I would remain silent about the kill and allow the knight to claim the reward to aid his family.
I would show my liege the beast's ear and claim the beast's death as my own - after all, I did slay it.  I would then offer some of the reward to the destitute knight to help his family.
I would show my liege the beast's ear and claim the beast's death as my own, taking the reward for my own use.  It is wrong to claim a deed as your own that someone else in fact did.

I would speak against my brother joining the order, rushing a permanent breech in our relationship.  He would be a danger to himself and those around him, and that is too great a risk hoping he would improve over time.
I would speak for my brother joining the order, potentially risking the safety of the order.  I could help him with the order's regimens, and I'd have faith in his ability to adapt and learn.
I would suggest looking in the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square.
I wouldn't tell you if I did!  Because as soon as I do, I'm getting away from these crystals...
I'd be wasting both your gold and my time if I were to teach you how to pilot a Mechanostrider, $c.  You're just too large!
I'd go out and clear out some of those gnolls, but this leg has seen better days and I am afraid I'd just wind up dead.
I'd like a new invitation to the Lunar Festival.
I'd like some weapon training
I'd like to fly to Rut'theran Village.
I'd like to fly to Thunder Bluff.
I'd like to purchase more Tharlendris seeds.
I'd like to see what you have to sell.
I'd like to train in cooking.
I'd like to train.
I'd like you better if you would apply some perfume.
I'd love to get one of those written fortunes you mentioned!  I've got the space in my inventory for it.
I'd love to teach you! Show my sister she's not the only one who knows a thing or two about engineering...
I'd talk to you if you smelled better. Cologne would be nice.
I'd talk to you if you smelled better. How about cologne? Maybe perfume?
I'd train you if I could, but you're too much for me. Tell you what: go talk to the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. She's got some real talent.
I'd wager Keryn Sylvius knows the type you're looking for. The company Keryn keeps is less than honorable. She usually hangs out in the Lion's Pride Inn.
I'll be a guard someday!
I'll be back once I straighten this mess out.
I'll be fine for now, don't worry about me.  I'll find a way out of here once I've performed some cleansing rituals in this room.  Foul magic taints this place, $N.
I'll bring it right over, baby...
I'll consider that the next time I run into one of these things.
I'll crush you!
I'll crush your skull beneath my boot!
I'll cut you!
I'll deliver you, weak $C, to the afterlife!
I'll drink to anything!
I'll feast on your bones!
I'll follow you back to the camp. If you speak with my assistant, Hornizz, he'll have your payment.
I'll get that beacon to the crater safely, Guse. You can count on me!
I'll get the last laugh... they'll see! Oh, hi $c, I didn't see you there.
I'll get to work right away, $n!
I'll go secure below.
I'll just keep this here until we need it...
I'll just label it for reference then dig it up.
I'll never fall for that, fool! If you want a battle, it will be on my terms and in my lair.
I'll perform these with pleasure, $n!
I'll put me items in the brazier now. You just speak to da spirits when they appear.
I'll rip the secrets from your flesh!
I'll stay behind and guard the wreck. Hurry! Hopefully no one will notice the smoke...
I'll take a pint of Dark Iron ale.  Oh, you're not the $gwaiter:waitress;?
I'll take whatever ya got cookin'! And throw in a bottle to wash it down!
I'll take your money and your life too!
I'll teach ye to chop down yer foes like saplings in the forest.

I'll tell you 'then what.' She went runnin' straight for the hive. And you know what's crazier? Not a single damned bug got in her way or tried to stop her. She ran through them all as if she'd been best friends with 'em for centuries.
I'll tell you more, Karnik, in time. But first, send this traveler'ta Belgrum--there's more business'ta attend to.

I'll tell you what. Since you fancy yourself the hero type, if you can make your way through the Badlands to the Searing Gorge and bring me back something to prove your heroics, I'll see what I can do about getting you a key.$B$BIn the southeasternmost corner of Searing Gorge is a lady almost as tough as me, Margol the Rager. Maybe you should investigate.
I'll wait.
I'm "Plucky" Johnson, and this is my default greeting.
I'm Augustus!  You want it, I got it!  You wanna sell it, then I want it!
I'm Augustus, and my prices are INSANE!
I'm a cloth vendor, and this is my default greeting.
I'm a test spirit healer.

I'm afraid I have nothing to teach to someone with your experience. But you haven't reached the end of the road yet. Speak to Lucan Cordell, behind the counter there. He'll guide you through the next phase of your journey.
I'm afraid not, $N. Now, feel the shame you have brought upon yourself.

I'm afraid that the blade which you hold in your hands is beyond saving. The hatred runs too deep. But do not lose hope, $c. Where one chapter has ended, a new one begins.$B$BFind his son - a more devout and pious man you may never meet. It is rumored that he is able to build the Ashbringer anew, without requiring the old, tainted blade.
I'm afraid ye would not survive long in Alterac Valley, $c.  Come back and see us when you have a few more seasons under your belt.
I'm afraid your darkness quotient isn't sufficient enough for me to bother talking to you any further.  Move along please.
I'm all ears.

I'm as sane as the next guy, $g fella:lady;. Believe what you will, but I AM capable of fashioning this armor. If you're interested, maybe we can make a deal. The sooner I can get out of the assassination business, the better.
I'm back where I started.
I'm back!
I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

I'm certain you will. Perhaps one day you could deliver a message to an old friend of mine. I hear he still wanders those woods.$B$B<Eitrigg bows his head for a moment, as if in prayer.>$B$BSo Rend, yes... Rend and his brother Maim ruled the Spire, in constant conflict with the Dark Iron dwarves. They managed to displace the dwarves in the upper portion of the city, but only after the dragons came and only after the death of Maim.
I'm closing soon, so buy while you can!
I'm cold, lord.  When will you keep your promise?
I'm coming Frostwolf, and this time you're gonna feel the flames!
I'm cursed!  First my ship sinks, and now...I'm out of mead!
I'm done for, $N, but you might still be able to stop these monsters!
I'm done, $g brotha:sista;. Finish up yerself. I'll be restin' meself back on the rock.
I'm far too busy to be playing 'guess the smell' with you, $r. State your business or get out of my sight!
I'm finished.  The parchment is made.  Now, return to Gorzeeki...

I'm flattered, but really I'm not interested... What?  You want to know where to learn enchanting?  Oh, how embarrassing!  Well, you should...  I'm sure you could... go see, um...  Taladan!  Yes, see Taladan over in the Craftsmen's Terrace!
I'm free!  That device shall never torment me again!
I'm getting out of here!
I'm getting ready to travel up the ridge, $N. I could use some help -- would you like to come with me?
I'm glad the commotions died down some around here. The last thing this place needs is another brawl.
I'm going back to the Rookery, Tinkee.  I need an Eggscilliscope!
I'm going to carefully mix this - oops! ...Well, I spilled a little, but it's ready!
I'm going to die, I just know it!
I'm going to dust you into oblivion!
I'm going to have to kill something, aren't I?
I'm going to kick yer ugly head in!
I'm going to make a fortune with these horns, $N.  Thanks!
I'm going to stay here until I catch a 68 Pound Grouper!  You on the other hand want to fly off somewhere, am I right?
I'm going to wear your skin as a smoking jacket! The stogies? You'll have to pry them from my cold dead... er... RAWR!!!!

It's just so horrible. Our three top guns were shot down over Alliance territory during an air assault Nobody knows if they're dead or alive!$B$BThis is a terrible blow to our air strike capabilities.
It's locked!  NO!!
It's my way or the Gold Road.  Is that understood?
It's no lie, traitor.  Banehollow wants your heart, and I'm going to get it for him.

It's not always about money, clem!  While we receive generous donations - some extremely substantial - our traveling troupe of performers is fueled creatively by a need to brighten this war-torn world.  Don't worry about us, but instead let us worry about how to best entertain you.
It's our turn to pickle your feet!

It's quite simple, really, $N. My old merc company, The Veiled Blade, took the wrong mission at the wrong time.$B$BWe were hired by a goblin smuggler out of Booty Bay, one Gremnik Rizzlesprang, who was covetous of Lord Valthalak's spellbook. Or, maybe there was some old rivalry there? I suppose we'll never know now, because Gremnik was killed not too long ago by a group of Valthalak's spectral assassins. They really can be very deadly when a large number of them gather.$B$BWhere was I?
It's simple really. Allow me to summarize...
It's simple, really. Rob the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, of his powers. Return him to his mortal form and then slay him, once and for all.
It's small but it does it's job if you know what you are doing. Let me show you just the right places to hit.

It's so exciting to be here in Darnassus, surrounded by talented people! I just know I'm going to make my family proud. Maybe if I'm really lucky, the Sentinels will ask me to join their forces on the front!

It's so lovely to see you again, $N! I really can't thank you enough for delivering that message to my dear little gnome.$B$BWould you like to hear a song? It will make traveling in the rough seas much easier!
It's so sad for you poor children.
It's the big building in Razor Hill that's not the barracks.  Just talk to Innkeeper Grosk inside.  Got that?
It's time for my meditation, leave me.
It's time for the main event!  Skarr the Unbreakable is in the Maul!

It's true, even stranglekelp can be quite useful in building up what we need for the upcoming war at Ahn'Qiraj! It has so many uses, like making ice cream for hot days under the Silithus sun, as a salve for the effects of some icky plants, breathing underwater, hardening the skin, making you quick, regaining magic power; so many things I can't think of them all! Did I mention making ice cream?$B$BAnywhoodles, I've got about $2047w here, and I need a total of $2048w!
It's up and....it's good!
It... it is working!
Items of antiquity, weapons of war, armor or rarity. Who knows what Antonio will be carrying this week if you do not come look.
Items powerful enough to help make the journey through Duskwood, Antonio Perelli's goods are now for sale here in Lakeshire.

Ja mon, I be collectin' up the fishy-fishy for the Horde. They gettin' ready for big war in the desert at Ahn'Qiraj, and askin' me to get them $2103w of the spotted yellowtail. But right now we only be havin' $2102w. You here to help?
Jack and Jill my wrinkled patoot! I do all the water luggin' 'round here.
James Van Brunt in War Quarter on inner ring.
Jarad, you are up first for us.
Jenova Stoneshield over in the Dwarven District is the one you're looking for.  She tends to hunters' pets while they seek training from her father.
Jeztor lives! Time to light up the Valley sky, Commander.
Jeztor's Riders are ready! Soldiers of the Horde, report for duty!
Jeztor's coming for you, Stormpike!
Jin'rokh, I am missing my Zandalar Freethinker's Armguards. Can you replace them?
Jin'rokh, I fear I've lost my Zandalar Freethinker's Breastplate. Can you supply me with a replacement?
Jin'rokh, I fear I've lost my Zandalar Vindicator's Breastplate. Can you supply me with a replacement?
Jin'rokh, I have lost my Zandalar Freethinker's Belt. Can you help?
Jin'rokh, I need assistance in recovering a piece of my Freethinker's Armor.
Jin'rokh, I need assistance in recovering a piece of my Vindicator's Battlegear.
Jin'rokh, my Zandalar Vindicator's Armguards have gone missing. Do you have a spare set?
Job well done, soldier. Dismissed!
Jobs/Lost & Found/Wanted:
Jocaste was the greatest of Hunters of her time.  These days you can find her over in the Cenarion Enclave where she teaches those who are just starting down the Hunter's path.
John, honey, where are you?
Join a group going to this dungeon.    <This choice will place you in a meetingstone queue>
Join me, together we will weave the spirits of the forge and find the true shape that the metal seeks.
Join the fight against evil!  Accept a commission within the Argent Dawn today!
Join us!
Join us, or fall forever!
Joo may tink this ma walkin stick mon. Dat's jus wat I want joo to tink.
Josetta has been a blessing to this town with her aid of the local guards.  If you seek her for training in the ways of a priest, you can find her in the Lion's Pride Inn.
Jubjub?  Where are you, Jubjub?  Oh no!  Where did you go this time!
Juicy fruits for sale!
Jungle Fever
Just /lay down anywhere, $N. I promise, this won't hurt a bit!
Just a few more and our stables will be overflowing with mounts. Release it into my custody, soldier. I'll take it from here.
Just a little while longer, I've almost got it!
Just a minor adjustment here... ah there we go!
Just a stick? Want me to show you what 'just a stick' can do?
Just as I thought, the gems and the necklace don't matter.  It's all about the power source.
Just because it's not my heart doesn't mean it can't be broken.
Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?
