en: Just get me close enough to our base and I can channel a teleport!
Just in... another batch of Darkmoon Special Reserve.  Come get yours before they're all gone!
Just leave the poor man alone, citizen, he's not worth the trouble.
Just outside the city's main gate is a signpost.  It will point you toward the zeppelin tower.  Speak to Zeppelin Master Frezza at the top of the tower.
Just release me already! I've had enough!
Just show me the way, Franclorn.
Just sit right back and you'll hear a ta... *hic* a tai... *hic* a taiiii *hic* Damnit!
Just sit tight while I get this prepared for you!
Just swinging a hammer at an anvil doesn't make you a smith. Give me that and let me teach you something before you embarrass us all.
Justice is done!
KILL!
KILL!!!
KNOW NO FEAR, SOLDIERS! WE DIE FOR KALIMDOR TODAY!
Kagoro, I require your presence!
Kah Mistrunner at Mountaintop Bait & Tackle on the high rise will show you the way to find inner peace and serenity while fishing for your next meal.
Kahil, it was a mighty effort. Come back and rest up. Narrisha will clean this up for us.
Kalaran, I have misplaced my torch. I require another.
Kalaran, please enchant the torch.

Karn says we need to listen to the spirits of the forge and of the steel, that they will guide us. I hear nothing but a ringing in my ears. Here, take a hammer and let us try to hear the spirits together.
Karnik, me friend, I wish I could see you with me own eyes again, but we need'ta talk of Ragnaros. His influence is spreading.
Karu will you please help get these bees off of me? They sting!
Kazum!  I hold your scepter!  I command you to enter this world!
Kazzak is supreme!
Keep it up, $n, and I'll beat some manners into you.
Keep them coming!  We need more supplies in order to rebuild...
Keep up the good work.  This scourge will be cleansed!
Keep your foes at bay and carve them into cutlets at the same time. The only problem is that the long shaft keeps me from getting blood on my hands.
Keep your voice down, stranger. You do not want to disrupt the Master's meditations.
Keever is most pleased.
Keever is unhappy with this. Perhaps if Keever were to try a larger dose, that may fix this dilemma.

Kel'Thuzad has put forth considerable effort in attempting to reform the staff. The pieces were once scattered across this world, from Kalimdor to the South Seas. I myself held twenty of the pieces at one point in time - until they were stolen from me by Kel'Thuzad's minions. It is why I am here.
Kel'Thuzad is my answer.
Kel'Thuzad say to tell you... DIE!
Kel'Thuzad? If you know that name at all, then perhaps you did read the book I sent you to get.$B$BUnfortunately, you're answer is incorrect.

Kelstrum is a loudmouth and a braggart... and if that weren't enough he's also one of the most skilled warriors ye'll ever meet!  

I tell ye, if ye're looking to be trained in the ways of a warrior, that's who ye should be talking to.  I'm sure he can be found over in the Hall of Arms east of the Gates of Ironforge.
Key... get the key... Gerstahn has... key.
Khara hums an old dwarven tune while she cooks.
Kibler is being investigated by G.E.T.A.
Kick me out, will they!? I'll show those uptight cone heads in Stormwind the true power of Niby! BEHOLD!
Kil'jaeden is my answer.

Kildrath tends to overdramatize the situation. For example, "Garona: A Study on Stealth and Treachery," has been stolen over 400 times.$B$BThe mark of the Athenaeum protects the tomes, preventing any unauthorized viewings.
Kill $N!
Kill it!
Kill the filthy $R!
Kill the guards, take the Warden alive!
Kill the intruders!
Kill them all!
Kill!
Kill, KILL! Get back artifact! Bring to Kartak!
Killian Hagey teach skinning in Rogues' Quarter on inner ring.
Killing you and your cohorts, $c, will amuse me.  I shall make it quick.
Killing you be easy.
King Magni Bronzebeard is a fool and a charlatan!
Kiss me.
Kitten for sale, looking for a good home.
Klaven doesn't pay me enough to deal with zombies, drones, or whatever he calls 'em.
Kneel before me, mortal! Kneel before Zod!
Kneel! Kneel before the Ashbringer!
Kneel, Grark.
Kneel, heathen.
Known throughout the lands, Antonio Perelli's goods now for sale near Sentinel Hill! I must move on soon, so make haste.

Kodo beasts, my friend!  Trained from a young age and raised on the Golden Plains of Mulgore, these fine animals will make even finer steeds!  Please, browse my selection, and see for yourself why we taurens have come to rely on these magnificant creatures!
Kodohide Leatherworkers is what you want.  Find it in the middle of The Drag.
Komak! I swear I'll have the money! Just give me some more time!
Komin Winterhoof at Holistic Herbalism is the one you want to talk to then.  He can be found on the middle rise.
Korfax, where can I find Dark Iron scraps?
Korrak has come, weaklings! Snowfall belongs to Winterax!
Krang Stonehoof stands astride his training circle at the southeast corner of the village.
Krathok, I was once a weaponsmith and wish to instead learn the ways of the armorsmith. Will you train me?
Krathok, I was once a weaponsmith and wish to retake the hammer once more! Teach me the way of the weaponsmith.
Krathok, I was once an armorsmith and wish to instead learn the ways of the weaponsmith. Will you train me?
Krathok, I was once an armorsmith and wish to retake the hammer once more! Teach me the way of the armorsmith.
Krumn is the bull you are looking for. He can be found on the lower rise at Thunder Bluff Civic Information.
Kyra Windblade wields her blade with great skill.  She should be able to provide you with some training.  You'll find her at the Inn in Dolanaar.

Lads and ladies. Today can be your greatest day, for today, you fight for the glory of Stormpike! Ride unto the field and grant your enemies no mercy! Strike the savages down and let their Warchief sort em out!
Lady Jaina, this may sound like an odd request... but I have a young ward who is quite shy.  You are a hero to him, and he asked me to get your autograph.

Lady Sylvanas has ordered the investigation of some of the natural phenomena of Azeroth. She feels there is something great to be learned from its secretive past.$B$BI know not how she learned such things, but I trust her completely, so I will do my best.$B$BI am currently investigating slimes, oozes and such. The creatures all seem to be similar in make up, but greatly affected by their environment.$B$BI could use your help in gathering samples of the creatures..
Lady stitch us up and bandage when we get hit.  You find her in inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.
Lady teach you make magic items.  She at inner ring of The Apothecarium.
Lakota'mani thunders within you, $N.
Lapdogs, all of you!
Lard keep peace here. Lard also sell fish. Want fish?
Larion, I want to help you fight these pests!
Last I heard the Horde had accumulated $2021w of $2020w peacebloom, $2050w of $2051w firebloom and $2054w out of $2055w purple lotuses.
Last I heard, Elder Runetotem was traveling to Razor Hill in Durotar.
Last I knew, Elder Starsong was in the Sunken Temple of the Swamp of Sorrows.
Last I knew, Elder Stonespire was at Everlook in Winterspring.
Last time they attacked, there was only one attack. I wouldn't be surprised if there were more this time.
Launch me!
Laurena is the High Priestess of Stormwind. You can find her in the Catheral of Light in Cathedral Square.
Laurna Morninglight offers healing to those that live around Dolanaar.  Perhaps she would be able to teach you in the ways of a priest.
Lava? Pay no mind to all of that, friend. Look around you. Take in the joys that nature has to offer.
Lay down your weapons, your feuds have no place here!
Leaping leper gnomes! I've been stuck in there for months. Thanks, gang.
Learn the recipe.

Leather skins? Yes, I just received some information on that. It would appear that of $2067w heavy leather needed, the Horde has collected $2066w. Also, $2070w out of $2071w thick leather and $2073w out of $2074w rugged leather have been gathered.
Leatherworking
Leave at once, stranger!  I have no business with you.

Leave it to the dwarves to send a mining specialist from Ironforge to tell us how to mine.  How hard is it to take a pick and chip away at some rock?  Well, since he's here, he's probably the one you should see anyhow.  His name is Gelman and he resides over in the Dwarven District.
Leave me now in peace. I must rest.
Leave me.  My wounds are great and I fear they will overtake me.  Thank you, $N.  I will die here, but because of you... I'll die in peace.
Leave no survivors!
Leave nothing behind!
Leave this place!
Leave this place, stranger, lest it consume you as it has all that it has touched.
Leave this place. <The relic emits a white hot arc of flame. A memory has been gained: A lone Dark Iron dwarf is surrounded by seven corpses, kneeling before a monolith of flame.>
Leave this sacred place or perish!
Leave your battles or errands, and browse my incredible wares! Only in Darkshire for a short time... praise the Light for that.
Lee Brown spends the whole day fishing up by Crystal Lake.  He's probably got some stories to tell and some tips he could teach you.

Lee's caught some pretty odd things up at Crystal Lake.  He told me a story about this weird mask he fished up some months ago.  If you ask me, I think he just had one too many at the Lion's Pride that night.
Left Combat
Less than a hundred of us, and over a thousand orcs. Only a handful of us managed to walk away from that one.

en: Let Marshal Windsor know that I am ready.

Let it be known that $N - Alliance $C - has earned the undying respect of Ironforge and the Alliance as a whole.  $GHe : She; has engaged in great diplomacy with Timbermaw Hold and performed valiant actions for them on our behalf.   $GHe : She; has gone above and beyond the call of duty.  Three cheers for $N - a true hero of the Alliance!

Let it be known that $N - Horde $C - has earned the undying respect of the Warchief.   $GHe : She; has engaged in great diplomacy with Timbermaw Hold and performed valiant actions for them on our behalf.   $GHe : She; has gone above and beyond the call of duty.  Three cheers for $N - a true hero of the Horde!
Let it not trouble your heart, beloved. You have freed me from slavery, and for that I love you all the more.
Let me at 'em, $N! Just give the word and I'll mount up and attack their bridge!
Let me break down a little math for you: "goblin" plus "engineering" equals KNOW HOW, baby.  Anyone who tells you otherwise simply doesn't know how to add.
Let me browse your goods.
Let me browse your seasonal fare.
Let me browse your selection of fireworks.
Let me confer with my colleagues.
Let me give you my regards for Greatfather Winter, scum...
Let me go get you a set of tools, $n.
Let me grab a spell focus from inside my home here, and then we'll get started!
Let me grab the popped corn kernels, sire.
Let me have another one, Langston.
Let me help you with those.
Let me install these Gyromechanic Gears and Restabilization Cogs and we'll fire up The Recombobulator.
Let me know when it is best to ride. You must be our eyes and ears on the battlefront.
Let me see your festival fare.

Let me see, let me see. I had those numbers here somewhere. Ah yes, here they are! To date, the Alliance has collected $2047w stranglekelp, out of $2048w needed. It also says here that we have $2053w of $2055w purple lotus and $2057w out of $2058w arthas' tears needed.
Let me take a look at what you have to offer.
Let me think about it, Zamael.
Let me try! You too stupid!
Let none get by!
Let none with the foul taint of plague live!
Let the Bloodletting Begin!
Let the Fishing Tournament BEGIN!
Let the battle for Warsong Gulch begin!
Let the blood spilled here today be a lesson to all who dare encroach upon the territory of the Blackrock Clan!
Let the event begin!
Let the executions begin!
Let the flames of chaos engulf you!
Let the legend of Stalvan rest!
Let this gloom serve to remind you: the shadow of the Scourge is all-encompassing! There is no escape!
Let us barter, Rin'wosho. Show me what goods are available!
Let us leave Nighthaven, hero. Seek me out at the grove.
Let us return to the grove, mortal.
Let your spirits rise! Rally around your champion, bask in $g his:her; glory! Revel in the rallying cry of the dragon slayer!
Let's find out the whole story.  That's going to take some magic...
Let's find out.
Let's find the next one, $N.
Let's get down to business!
Let's get out of here, $N. I'm ready now!
Let's get to the others, and keep an eye open for those wolves outside...
Let's get to work, $N!
Let's give this a try...
Let's go play!  No, tell me a story, Daddy!  No... let's go pick flowers!  And play tea time!  I found my dollie, did I tell you?
Let's go, goblin!
Let's have just a small taste...
Let's here it for $N!
Let's move forward!
Let's not even begin comparing battle scars, my friend.
Let's see how these seeds grow in my prepared soil...
Let's see if I can hit that bullseye this time.
Let's see if the fish are biting.
Let's see what you have.
Let's see... fourteen plus seven, carry the two... oh, yes?
Let's start a new battle, and beat the Alliance this time!
Let's start a new battle, and beat the Horde this time!
Let's take a look at your fishing supplies.
Let's try planting it in some of my special, prepared soil...
Lets get back to your base!
Lets go, $N. I am ready to reach Whitereach Post.
Lexlort, I lost the thorium shackles.
Liar!
Lieutenant, I have lost my insignia. Could you please supply me with a replacement?

Life is a struggle, and the saying that which does not kill you makes you stronger is not always true.  Sometimes wounds act slowly, which is why we have bandages.  Pand Stonebinder of the Spirit Rise can teach you the art of First Aid.
Life is like a carefully woven tapestry.
Light help us... the Scourge are in the Park!
Like Kel'Thuzad, I too was once a mage of the Kirin Tor. And like Kel'Thuzad, I seek the legendary Atiesh, greatstaff of the Guardian. Our fates are intertwined as such, $c.
Like a cat dragged in from the rain, you scratch and claw, then do it all over again... I'll be back for more...$B$BOh, I didn't see you enter, $n! What can I do for you?

Listen $g sonny:missy;, I'll have you know that whatever attacked us was no priestess of nothin'! Her eyes were aglow with something evil and she was genuinely frothing at the mouth! She came in, did some kind of crazy scream that sent us all runnin' in separate directions then started flayin' our minds one by one. I'd be hearin' shadowy words in my head, watchin' the other's periodically black out here and there. It was madness! We would have been done for if not for the damned monkey.
Listen carefully, $N, for I have much knowledge to impart.
Listen carefully, for the lord of Blackrock will surely destroy you, should you not be prepared.

Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.$B$BOur great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.
Listen to the stories of an elder. $N. I have many to speak of...

Listen up, flapjack, we're in for the fight of our lives with the bugs in Ahn'Qiraj and we need to get prepared for it. I'm collecting iron bars here.  Currently, the Alliance only has $2002w iron bars, but we're projected to need a total of $2003w for the war effort.

Listen, $r. Listen well...$B$BThe dragon riders came in the night, mounted atop the black flight. They struck fast and with deadly precision, taking young whelps - such as me - and escaping under the veil of darkness.$B$BI watched in horror as they used my brothers and sisters in their experiments. From our essence would be created the chromatic flight.
Listen, young $c.  You hear the call of water?
Little food'll feel pretty good right about now.
Little forsaken know all weapons.  Him Archibald.  You find on inner ring of War Quarter.
Little goblin on top of building north of Ruins of Lordaeron.  Leave Undercity and you go there.
Living out here in the desert is rough! I get so thirsty standing outside in this heat.
Lizzarik has blades. Lizzarik has maces. Lizzarik has all your weapon needs right here!

Located in Dun Morogh, Gnomeregan has been the gnomes' capital city for generations, though it was recently infested by mutant troggs. In a desperate attempt to retaliate, High Tinker Mekkatorque ordered the emergency venting of the city's radioactive waste tanks. Though the troggs became irradiated, their siege continued unabated and the gnomes were forced to seek refuge in the dwarven city of Ironforge, where the High Tinker now enlists brave souls to help his people reclaim their beloved city.
Lockpicking
Lok'tar $c!  We have need of your services in Alterac Valley.  Shall I add you to the lists?
Lok'tar Ogar!
Lok'tar!  You look like you need help.

Lok'tar, $c, I have important information! There's a war coming at Ahn'Qiraj and we need to get ready for it. I'm here collecting all of the thick leather that I can get my hands on. Right now we have $2070w, but the Warchief has tasked me with the gathering of $2071w. As you can see, I'm a little short.

Lok'tar, $r. I am General Zog, ambassador of the Horde. I am here to keep you apprised of the progress that the mighty Horde is making in their efforts toward the Ahn'Qiraj War. What is it that you want to know?

Long ago, before the last great war, my father ran the Northridge Lumber Mill. It was his life, and he was committed to it. Then the war came, and as much as it pained him, we had to flee to Stormwind.$B$BWe lost a number of friends and family in the those days, and it pains me to know that the Scarlet Crusade has taken the mill for their own ends.$B$BThat's why I've returned.

Long ago, my dryad sisters and I entered these caves to free the tortured spirit of my uncle, Zaetar. However, the corruption that had already spread through these caverns soon overcame us, and we too fell.$B$BWe were destined to wander these passages; the toxins poisoning our minds...$B$BAlthough my spirit may now be at rest, I know that I have failed in my mission. It is a great sadness I must bear...

Long have my spirit and remains been kept captive here within Maraudon, young $c. The time has given me nothing but ample opportunities to reflect on my mistakes and realize that my jealousy of Remulos was foolish. He attempted to warn and persuade me that my relations with Theradras would bear nothing pure--that only destruction would come from chaos. My brother was right.$B$BBut that does not mean since you have freed me, I am free of penance.
Long is the way, and hard, the road you have traveled. Few reach such status amongst our ranks. You are a great friend of the Zandalar empire, $N.$B$BLegendary perhaps... Yes... Perhaps.
Long live $N!
Long live the Dragonmaw! Die you worthless $R!
Long live the mighty Blackrock Clan!
Long-lasting, well-crafted items for sale near the Hill! Come one, come all! Time is short, so make haste.
Look alive, dogs! We got an operation to run here!
Look alive, lads!  The enemy has been sighted!  Form ranks immediately!

Look alive, soldier! Stormpike Intelligence has reported that a master goblin engineer has been taken prisoner by the Winterax trolls. The Frostwolf dogs are actively trying to rescue him so that they may use his engineered gadgets to destroy us! Do not let that happen.
Look around you $c.  You are in rare company to be certain, yet still I think you need to prove yourself.  Hmm, perhaps I shall allow you to aid us in our cause at Arathi Basin.  Would you like that?
Look at all those ripples. Lots of activity in the water so I should catch a mess of fish today.
Look at that!  Someone is fighting Mushgog!
Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

en: Look at them go!
Look at what $n brought us!  Let's drink up!

Look behind you, $r. The hive stirs as the land that surrounds us shudders and shakes.$B$BThe time has come for me to fulfill a promise I made a thousand years past. The sands shift once more as the Qiraji plan for war.
Look fierce!  You are Kolkar, so act like one!
Look for Faruza.  Last I saw she was standing out front between the stables and the house on the northwest end of town.
Look for Innkeeper Grishka in the Valley of Strength.  Her inn is on the east side, north of the main city gates.
Look for Innkeeper Pala in the building just south of the Thunder Bluff Bank on the lower rise.
Look for Nogg's Machine Shop in the Valley of Honor northeast of Red Canyon Mining.
Look for Sayoc and Hanashi at the Valley of Honor inside Arms of Legend.  Watch your tongue around them or Sayoc may decide to give a piece of you as a snack to Grinning Dog.
Look for Tarshaw Jaggedscar in the barracks on the east side of town.
Look for Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.  Find it in the middle of The Drag, west of the huge tree.
Look for it high up on the west side of the Valley of Strength. They'll only let you in if you're an officer! Talk to Sergeant Ba'sha outside otherwise.
Look for the Zeppelin Landing Tower outside of the city to the southeast.
Look inside the Gallows' End Tavern's main dining room for Austil de Mon.  The tavern is on the southeast edge of Brill.
Look no further than the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.  With a wide selection of ales and soft down beds you, couldn't ask for a better place to rest.
Look out!  We're under attack by a $N!
Look out! It sounds like more of them!
Look out, incoming!
Look to this fallen dragon, $r. The might of the Horde is unquestionable!
Look to this ravaged field and know the power that the elements hold, $r.
Look up to the heavens, $c. The Dragonflights have not been seen in this area for a thousand years! Those Qiraji are up to something, I just know it!
Look what the cat dragged in. What can I get you, $n?
Look! Look! I caught something! Aww....it's just a stinky ol' boot.
Look, just at the water's surface!
Look, there! By Hive'Regal! Is that... a sandworm?!
Lookin' to take a gryphon ride, eh? Dungar keeps his birds up on the rampart in the Trade District. Just remember to hold on tight!
Looking for Shenthul of the Shadowswift Brotherhood, huh?  In The Drag across from Droffers and Son Salvage look for a tunnel leading down into the Cleft of Shadow.

Looking for some training, eh? I could train you better then anyone in Stormwind but the guard prohibits it. I guess you will have to settle for one of those has beens hanging out around the Barracks or at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town.
Looking for these???? You'll never have em!
Looking to learn how to use a new weapon?  Find Sayoc and Hanashi inside Arms of Legend in the Valley of Honor.
Looking to learn how to work an anvil and hammer, eh?  Karn Stonehoof can teach you how.  He has a smithy set up on the lower rise by the pond.

Looking to take a ride on a gryphon, now are ye?  Gryth Thurden is the one ye'll want to be seeing about that.  

Ye can find him on the eastern side of The Great Forge in the middle of Ironforge.
Looks dead to me. Not much use to us like this. You'd better go back and tell Krog what happened.
Looks like I need more practice!
Looks like Skarr has found his next challenger!  Wouldn't want to be in that poor fool's shoes!
Looks like it's going to be one of those days.

Looks like the last of the goods we've collected are shipping out to Silithus over the next $2113w days. And once that's done, someone will have to come along and ring the gong on the Scarab Dais, outside of Ahn'Qiraj, to open the gates. That's when our bandages will come in handy.

Looks like the last of the goods we've collected is going to be shipped out to Silithus sometime in the next day. And once that's done, someone will have to come along and ring the gong on the Scarab Dais, outside of Ahn'Qiraj, to open the gates. That's when our bandages will come in handy.

Looks like there be only $2113w more days left to fish until all this here war materiel is shipped over to the Silithus desert mon. Then they's gonna be getting' it all ready, and someone is gonna have to ring that gong down south of Cenarion Hold there to open them gates and be startin' the war.

Looks like there be only one more day left to fish until all this here war materiel is shipped over to the Silithus desert mon. Then they's gonna be getting' it all ready, and someone is gonna have to ring that gong down south of Cenarion Hold there to open them gates and be startin' the war.

Looks like we have as many lean wolf steaks as the Horde wants. They told me to pack up what we have here and ready it to be shipped it out to Cenarion Hold in Silithus. But it looks like some of the others here might still be collecting whatever it is that they're in charge of. Go bug one of them.
Looks like we're out of the woods, eh? Wonder what this does...
Looks like we've uncovered this $n. Now help me kill it!
Looks like ye may have the makings of a great smith. But before I teach ye anything I need to know that ye've got what it takes.
Looks like you'll have to go ahead to Ratchet and tell Sputtervalve that I've wrecked the shredder.

Looks like you're too late, $c. We have all of the roast raptor that we need; killed, cooked and salted. Anyway, it looks like some of the others around here could use some help. You should go check with them. I'm going to see if they'll let me go home now.
Lord Hir'eek, grant me wings of vengeance!
Lord Mayor!  Our scouts report strange activity to the west.
Losing my life was a danger I had come to terms with.  Losing Ysida is something I cannot endure, even after my own death.
Lost it? What do you mean?
Lots of gnoll activity reported in the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine.
Lots to do! Haven't been this busy since my cousin accidentally vaporized all the cloth and leather in Gnomeregan. My, it was drafty for a while! Ah, $N, those were the days....
Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

Love tokens are small messages of affection you can give to amorous town and city folk.  Such people will reward you with a gift of adoration.$B$BOr, if you are already adored by another, then at the least they'll give you a gift of friendship.
Lovely song, isn't it?
Low spirits
Lucan Cordell has a small shop on the canal by the Stockade. I am sure he will be able to teach you the art of enchanting.
Lucius is an old and trusted friend of Ravenholdt Manor - he and I have much to discuss. Find me at the docks in Lakeshire should you require my assistance or council.
Lumurk open this box easy!
Lunch has arrived, my beautiful children. Tear them to pieces!
Lyria's the one you should talk to if you need some training.  She can usually be found out behind the smithy waiting for some armor or weapon to be finished.
Lysheana can offer you the proper documents, she resides in the Craftsmen's Terrace in northeasten Darnassus.  May your fellowship bring glory to the Night Elves!
Lysta, summon forth... the abomination!
Lysta, summon in the captives.
Lysta, summon in undead captives.
MMmmMMmmm. Smells delicious Khara.

Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.
Magar's Cloth Goods is in The Drag.  Find him south of the huge tree next to the Kodohide Leatherworks.
Mage
Magical studies stressing your brain? Relax at the Blue Recluse!
Maginor says that twisting alternating flows of positive energy actually creates a much more stable flow.
Mailbox
Mailbox in middle of city, Trade Quarter, upper ring... next to inn.
Major Domo Enabled.
Makaru can be found day and night at Red Canyon Mining in the Valley of Honor, just off the lake.
Make Way!  Make Way!
Make it fast.
Make no sound during the ritual.  One misstep could spell our doom...
Make ready for battle, my creations.
Make sure to visit the Gizmotronic Apparatus to grab a lockpick and an E.C.A.C. You will definitely need both to complete your mission!
Make the call, Commander. I'll tear the bottom half of their base apart.
Make the journey to Orgrimmar and seek him out in the Valley of Honor. He works in a shop called the Arms of Legend.
Make this inn your home.
Make yourself useful and help me out here!
Making it out of here without a blade in your back or poison in your veins would be an accomplishment.
Malfurion!
Malorne somehow manages to pick the most delicate herbs without damaging them.  Certainly he is the one you should learn from.  He lives just east of the Inn in Dolanaar.
Malton, you dummy!
Malygos is my answer.
Malygos, is it?
Many animals lost their lives so that we could gain these materials. Do not take their sacrifice lightly, $N. Handle the leather with the respect it deserves.
Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  May your ancestors watch over you $c.
Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.
Many have come to this sanctuary, few have left.
Many locked boxes of supplies were sunk by the orcs in Lake Everstill in Redridge.
Many of the supplies that tradesmen need can be found in the world. For those that cannot, I provide a limited selection for fair price.
Many of the supplies the tailors need come by way of Darnassus.  It is not surprising that they all moved there to work.  If you wish to be a tailor then you best head to Darnassus.
Many thanks, $N.  These horns are going to make me a fortune!
Many think the staff an inferior weapon. I challenge any who think so to prove their strength against my staff.
Many times my blades have felled my target before they even drew near. The secret is in the flick of your wrist.

Many would tell you that the Tallstrider is a laughable pet. But it's intelligence and loyalty make it a hard creature to match in many situations. If you are interested in the breed, then perhaps I can introduce you and your pet to a few talents I have learned over the years.
Marauders to the north! Fire!
Maraudon
Maraudon is located in the middle of the western coast of Desolace, in the Valley of Spears.

Maraudon is one of the most sacred sites within Desolace. The great temple/cavern is the burial place of Zaetar, one of two immortal sons born to the demigod, Cenarius. Legend holds that Zaetar and the earth elemental princess, Theradras, sired the misbegotten centaur race. It is said that upon their emergence, the barbaric centaur turned on their father and killed him. Some believe that Theradras, in her grief, trapped Zaetar's spirit within the winding cavern - used its energies for some malign purpose.
Marduk, gather the box and place it before me!
Marion Call is keeping Dark Cleric Beryl company in the reading room upstairs at the Gallows' End Tavern on the southeast edge of Brill.  I'm just dying to see who wins that staring contest.
Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!
Mark my words, I will catch you, imp. And when I do!
Marketing - iCoke Redemption Greeting (S.H.E. giftbox)
Marketing - iCoke Redemption Greeting (S.H.E. non-Quest)
Marketing - iCoke Redemption Greeting (S.H.E.)
Markhor, I wish to stable my pet.
Marshal Marris expects the reserve from Stormwind any time now. . . .
Marshal Windsor has been expecting you, $N. Unfortunately, he is currently indisposed. He should be returning shortly.
Martens, Reblock, Adinay, Nikeson...
Marvelous. Simply marvelous. You are an inspiration to us all, $N.
Massive Qiraji resonating crystals break through the earthen crust of Kalimdor. Colossal creatures made of obsidian stone breach the freshly broken land.

Master Nesingwary has a big hunt ahead of him.  I find helping him prepare for a day in the jungle is much more relaxing than helping him ready for combat.  Although I do miss some of those glorious moments on the battlefield.
fa: استاد {{npc:Nesingwary|نسینگواری}} شکار بزرگی در پیش دارد. آماده‌کردنش برای یک روز در جنگل را بسیار آرام‌بخش‌تر از آماده‌کردنش برای جنگ می‌یابم، هرچند دلم برای آن لحظه‌های باشکوه میدان نبرد تنگ می‌شود.

en: Master Vectus, I sense something strange within this container...

Master Woo Ping has mastered nearly every weapon known to man.  He is especially deadly with his sword techniques.  He spends a good deal of time over in the Weller's Arsenal waiting on new shipments of weapons to arrive if you need some training.
Master craftsman Omarion just vanished one night. Like a toot in the wind... Poof! Gone! Bah, now I'm the only one left to craft the goods for the boys on the front lines.
Master, where have all the trees gone?
Master, your wisdom is matched only by your hugeness!
Masters, I pledge this $r to you!
Matters of such an official nature are only handled in Darnassus.  You must travel there to begin the process of your guild's creation.
Mau'ari know why you seek her out...$B$BBring me da E'ko you find in the world, an' I can transform it for you.

May Cenarius guide you, $c.$B$BI am here in this corrupt land with my sisters on a mission of great importance to the Cenarian Circle. But only those who are powerful enough I ask speak to me about such matters--to send a lesser being would be folly.
May Cenarius watch over you, $g brother : sister;.$B$BI am Tajarri, and I am a sworn protector of this shrine.  It is my honor to serve Keeper Remulos as a warden of this sacred land.
May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.
May I bask in your shadow forever!
May I have another Dawn's Gambit, Betina?  I want to test it again...
May I have it, please.
May Kel'Thuzad one day feel our vengeance.
May da spirits protect you mon.
May the Deadmines serve as your tomb, $N!
May the Light protect you this day.

May the blessings of the night be yours, friend!  I am Illiyana Moonblaze, and I am the main supplier for the Silverwing Sentinels here in Ashenvale.  As you improve your standing with the Sentinels, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you can use inside Warsong Gulch.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.
May the light guide your path and aid you in your journeys. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.
May the light guide your path and aid you in your journies. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.
May the spirit of Isha Awak give you strength, $N.
May the spirits be with you.
May this evil aura be banished from this artifact!
May your elders bless you, $n, and bring you luck in the coming year.
May your spirit burn brightly, $N.
Maybe I can fix it, pop.  Lemme take a look at it.
Maybe I should have just bought some off of Faruza?
Maybe Saru Steelfury will teach you to make an axe as good as mine some day.  Find him at The Burning Anvil in the Valley of Honor down the path to the right past Red Canyon Mining.
Maybe this wasn't the best place for a shop after all...
Maybe we should go to the bridge and fish.
Maybe you do better at getting back prized Gordok relic from creepy Highborne prince than da old boss did!
Maybe you got it, maybe you don't. I think I got a way to find out...
Maybe, but if it did hit me upside the head I'd know exactly which cannon to use to blow it into the smallest bits!
Maybe... What do I do now?
Mayor Ello!  Our graveyard scouts return with ominous reports...
Maywiki, I no longer have my Zandalar Haruspex's Belt. Can you help?
Maywiki, I've lost my Zandalar Augur's Hauberk and need a new one.
Maywiki, I've lost my talisman and require a replacement.
Maywiki, a dastardly little gnome made off with my Zandalar Augur's Belt. Can you provide a replacement?
Me Grimlok, king!
Me feast on you all!
Me no run from $C like you!
Me smash you!
Me smash! You die!
Me smell stench of the living!
Me still boss of ogres. Haw!
Me versus fifty orcs? I'm no fool, $N. My pappy always told me, 'Discreditin is the better part of a cracker,' or something, and I knew what that meant.
Me, train you? Come on--we both know I can't. It's this teaching, you see. My own skills suffer. You want training, go to Doctor Herbert Halsey, a Forsaken in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.

Meat, skin, bones... a good hunter lets nothing go to waste. Every scrap of leather can be salvaged, perhaps to reinforce an ally's armor. Thus, each of us is strong alone, but together we become invincible.
Members only, scrub!
Mennet said I should ask you for a set of thieves' tools.
Meow!
Merideth, could I have some more manna-enriched horse feed please?
Merok!  Shai!  To my side!
Metal, as with all things, should be used in balance with nature.  Karn Stonehoof has a smithy setup near the pond on the lower rise.  Seek out his wisdom.

Metzen's eyes light up with reindeer joy as you sprinkle the dust on him.  He shakes his antlers at you and breathes out a heavy sigh of what sounds like relief.$B$BAround you, magical energy begins to swell.  It would seem that something's about to happen!
Michael Garrett on upper ring in Trade Quarter.
Michelle Belle's bedside manner is remarkable!  While she might not be able to teach you that, she surely could teach you some proper First Aid.  She currently resides in the Lion's Pride Inn.
Mighty fine weather we're having here, wouldn't you say?
Milk me, John.
Milord, your guest has arrived. He awaits your presence.
Mine! Mine! Mine!  Gizlock is the ruler of this domain!  You shall never reveal my presence!
Mining
Miranda, could you please tell me the insignia cost of items that you are offering for adventurers of exalted reputation?
Miranda, could you please tell me the insignia cost of items that you are offering for adventurers of honored reputation?
Miranda, could you please tell me the insignia cost of items that you are offering for adventurers of revered reputation?
Miranda, could you please tell me the insignia cost of items that you are offering for adventurers with other reputations?
Mistress!! They seek to destroy your work!!
Mistress, you tell Plugger that I want more of his ale.  I can't get enough!
Mmh... my eyes are not so heavy now, father.  Can we go out and play?
Mmm, good stuff. Back to work once again.

Mmm, mmm, mmm. Can you smell that?! That's good eatin' right there, $c. Rainbow Fin Albacore hits the spot every time. Slicky Gastronome here, ace connoisseur of all things edible, especially fish. With the Ahn'Qiraj War looming, the Alliance thought it wise to bring in an expert for the war effort, so here I am, large and in charge.$B$BLooks like we're going to need $2093w of the fish, and we've got a pile that currently comes to $2092w.
Mmm... I love my delicious Southshore stout.
Mmm... food.
Mmmh...I SMELL FOOD!
Mmmm, that was good. However, time to get back to work!
Mmmm... don't you look good enough to eat.
Mmmmh...
Mmmmm food.  It's not too long of a run, but you need to head north to Orgrimmar and ask one of the grunts there.
Mmmmm, an ale by the fire does sound good. Sure, I will join ya Jern.
MmmmmMmmmm... Enormous chemically altered cracker....
Modernization is the key. With a crank and a lever you can fire this baby with the power of an ogre pulling a normal bow.
Mogg, get inside. It is not safe out there while your father is gone.
Mograine has fallen? You shall pay for this treachery!
Mograine?
Mojka, cover for me! I have some business to attend to.
Molthor sees all, $r.
Mom said not to climb up there any more.  I'm gonna tell!
Mom! Can we go play please please please? Can we huh? Can we?
Mom, Jesse climbed the wind tower again.
Mommy!
Mommy? Can I pet Fizzles?
Monty be me name an' rats be me game.
Mooranta can help you learn skinning.  She can be found just outside the Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.
More agents of the Syndicate I'll wager! You'll never take back Alterac... or Southshore!
More and more of Kalimdor is turning into the twisted landscape to our left, and the critters who dwell within are NOT friendly.  Watch your step.
More beasts on the way!
More bones to gnaw on...
More bread boy!
More of the Warden's errand boys!
More prisoners!
More... More souls!
Morganus the stable master can be found out in front of the stables strangely enough.
Morning, my friends.
Mortals are...
Most definitely.
Most people around these parts frown on lockpicking. As a little professional courtesy, let me show you a few tricks I've learned.
Mother, oh mother.  You should have listened to me...
Mourn the great loss.
Move along, citizen. There is nothing to see here.
Move along, rube.
Move!
Ms. Pomeroy gathers herbs for an Alchemist who lives up in the hills between Northshire and Stormwind.  Check for her at his cottage and see if she'll show you the profession.
Muahahahaha! What is this pathetic spectacle I see before me? Well, what are you waiting for? I hunger, and you look as if you may make for a passable appetizer!
Mushrooms always grow in damp places and so they look like umbrellas.
Must be careful not to damage the specimen...
Must be very careful with this one... Very delicate.
My $g Lord:Lady;, please allow me to live long enough to see you purge this world of the infidels.
My Gizmotic Almanacotron says that we should beat the goblins by twenty seconds more than we did last time!
My Lord Abernathy sends this to you.
My Lord. From Father Lankester.
My Royal Dreadguard, you will deal with this matter as befits your station.  That, or you will wish that you had.
My Zandalar Demoniac's Wraps have gone missing. Can you provide me with another set?
My Zandalar Predator's Belt has gone missing. Can you help, Falthir?
My altar will siphon the life from you!
My apologies, $N, but I do not offer instruction to novices. Instead, talk to Milla Fairancora in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. She can help you make up for lost time.
My apologies, I did not realize that you could understand what I was saying. What is it you are doing out here?
My apologies, Lady Prestor.
My apologies, Pebblebitty.
My axe has seen many battles, and I like to keep it handy. Enemy forces have fought their way into our capital several times now, but have no fear: we have always driven them back.
My back is killing me today.
My back is killing me.
My banishment is ended! Let the blood flow!
My bones are weak, my eyes see only darkness, and my body feels only pain; but these things are good because my will is my own.

My brother and I have dedicated ourselves to Sylvanas. She is our beacon of light when times were darkest. We sacrifice ourselves day in and day out to ensure our kind overcome the destiny that's chosen us.$B$BWe will not remain weak. We will take that which is owed to us. We will return tenfold, the pain that was done to us. And we shall do so with smiles on our faces.

My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

My captors were cruel beyond measure, $N. They would alternate between Lieutenant Kirith and I, torturing one while the other watched. During a lull in the activity of an especially brutal day, Kirith told me what had happened to my men and a plan he had been formulating to free them from their masters.$B$BThey suffered a fate far worse than death, or even the pain Kirith and I  endured.
My charge to watch the temple has failed... my corrupted soul knows no peace...

My chest is one of ingenious design, and requires two keys to unlock, one gold and one silver.  The first key, the silver key, I gave to my first mate, and I kept the gold.$B$BBut we were doomed to lose them.  My key was lost during the next naga attack, and my first mate's was lost a day later when drysnap makrura assailed us and pulled him into the deep.$B$BI am sure the naga and makrura have the keys.  I am glad the two are enemies and will not share them.
My colleagues and I are gathering the deadliest substances we know and testing their effects on our enemies. Once I have everything I need, I shall brew such plagues as this world has never seen.
My compliments to the chef!
My daddy can catch more fish than your daddy!
My daddy says that in the ocean, there are fish so big they could swallow a whole ship.
My dear Staffron, have you forgotten what it is to love? The love that we once shared?
My death matters little... the Hammer will still fall!
My education is ongoing, and your knowledge surpasses mine. If you wish to learn more you must speak to Me'lynn. She will guide you.
My entrails are leaking out! HELP!
My eyes never deceive me, $r. I see great power in you - enough power, perhaps, to further our cause. Find me at the top of the tower.
My eyes!  It burns... it burns...
My faith guides my actions, $r. I know that Ivus will come.
My family hates me.  Frightened idiots, all of them!

My family worked  the Northridge Lumber Mill in what's now Western Plaguelands. They were dedicated to the Dumah family, and now the Scarlet Crusade have taken it over along with all of Hearthglen!$B$BI will not rest until those zealots are wiped from Azeroth.
My father says that's just a story.
My father told me there'd be days like this, where a stranger would talk to me and I'd have to restrain myself from killing $ghim:her;.

My father was slain by the filth that inhabits the cauldron. My pleas for assistance to the Stormwind magistrate fell on deaf ears. Nay, they want not to admit that this part of the world even exists, let alone send their precious military in to administer justice.$B$BI seek vengeance, $r, plain and simple. Is there a more passionate cause in this world?
My feet hurt.
My feet hurt...
My flight is ready! Soldiers come to my aid!
My fury is released!
My granny, livin' down in Redridge, hits dummies harder than you, rookie!

My great hammer, Ironfel, was handed down to the new chief architect, Fineous Darkvire: A man of despicable motive and little talent.$B$BThis is where you come in, $N. I want him stopped. He is too inept to harness the true power of Ironfel, but should one come after him with the aptitude to use Ironfel to its full potential, the destruction they could cause with their creations would be disastrous to this world.

My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.$B$BLong ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>$B$BGreat thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.
My job title is Waste Management Specialist.

My knowledge of night elf lore is limited, but it is said long ago--back when the night elves still held sacred the art of arcane spell casting--that Azshara was the greatest of their kind. A beautiful woman they named queen. Sadly, it was her addiction to the arcane that would one day be the catalyst for the most devastating events in this world's history.
My leg feels much better now, the remedy must be working. If you will excuse me, I must go report to my superiors about what has transpired here.
My life for my masters.  Rejoice!
My life means nothing!  Our sacred task is all!
My lord will be outraged to learn of this ambush.  Let us hope your death will appease him.
My lords!  I come to thee!
My master, Plugger Spazzring, is a good boss.  And he makes a lot of money.  His pockets are bursting!
My mind. . .my flesh. . .I'm. . .rotting. . . .!
My minions...
My mission is compete. I may have some spare supplies if you need any.
My money's on the goblins!  And if you have any sense then yours is too!
My mouth waters just to think on it.  Pyall Silentstride is the finest cook in Bloodhoof Village.  You will find him in the great tent at the northwest corner of the village.
My only wish is to serve you, great one, until I die by your foot!
My people, they are as shattered as the relic you seek to repair.
My pleasure, sugar drop.  I'll be back soon...
My power is discombobulatingly devastating! It is ludicrous that these mortals even attempt to enter my realm!
My powers have returned and you have squandered your chance, foolish mortals. Till we meet again.
My programming will not allow me to lower the cost of any items.

My purpose is to regulate access to the Uldum complex for the Creators.  I allow entry into the compound only when the solicitor exhibits for access the proper sequencing discs.$B$BYour disc set currently does not contain the Plates of Uldum, the primary prerequisite for entry.  Access is not granted unless the Plates of Uldum are present.
My question to you is this, $c:$BWhich of the Aspects created by the titans became the nefarious creature known as Deathwing?
My scepter will once again become whole!

My scepter... After so many years... You have recovered it! You shall truly be the savior of this place...$B$BPlease listen to me carefully, $N. The head and the rod of the scepter may only be reunited into one at the Stone of Maraudon.
My scouts report that the Syndicate has taken up residence in a hidden cave on the eastern plateau. Be cautious when adventuring in that area.

My sisters and I have come down from the Stonetalon Mountains to put to rest a tragedy from ages past. Unfortunately, we are not powerful enough to accomplish our goals on our own and now seek mortals such as yourself to aid us.$B$BIf you are powerful enough, then we have much to discuss, $c. If you are not, then, for your safety, I will leave the details of my mission out of our conversation.
My skill at creating potions is inferior to yours. You are ready to speak with Ainethil, just over there. She will understand that you are ready for further instruction.
My son could design a faster car than that clunky goblin junk heap!

My son, Taelan, was only a child when I was found guilty of treason and banished from the Alliance to live a life in exile. I chose to remain here so that I could watch over him; to somehow insure that he would grow up an honorable man.$B$BAs I had hoped, he took my place as lord of Mardenholde; but in a cruel twist of fate, joined the ranks of the Scarlet Crusade. He is now their Highlord, $r.
My soul is not a trinket!  Mortal, you must release me from these chains!
My strength wanes, mortal. I have done as promised, the way is clear. I now return to whence I came.
My strider requires training.
My sword Archeus served me well in life, but as at last my spirit may pass from the unhappy existence, I need it no longer.
My talons will shred your puny body, $R.
My thoughts exactly.
My torture is ended and now I can join the Goddess. Thank you so very much!
My trees.... they have withered up and died just like me.
My turn, meathead! I get to throw now.
My watch is eternal, mortal.
My weapon be thirsty!
My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.
My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?
My, that Black Claw stout packs quite a punch!
My... My powers have diminished... You shall pay for this insolence!
Myolor, I was once a weaponsmith and wish to instead learn the way of the armorsmith. Will you teach me?
Myolor, I was once a weaponsmith and wish to retake the hammer once more! Teach me the way of the weaponsmith!
Myolor, I was once an armorsmith and wish to instead learn the way of the weaponsmith. Will you teach me?
Myolor, I was once an armorsmith and wish to retake the hammer once more! Teach me the way of the armorsmith.
Myranda, do you have enough eyeballs to make another amulet? I have lost the old one.
Mysterious prizes await the adventurous.  Step right up, step right up!
Mystical goods and commodities is my business, stranger.

NEFARIAN IS SLAIN! People of Orgrimmar, bow down before the might of $N and $g his:her; allies for they have laid a blow against the Black Dragonflight that is sure to stir the Aspects from their malaise! This defeat shall surely be felt by the father of the Black Flight: Deathwing reels in pain and anguish this day!
NO SERVICE!!
NO!
NO! Shhhh! Just shut up. Goretooth is coming!
NO! What have they done to you!?
NO!!!  It puts the tannin in the basket, or it gets the mallet again!
NOOOOOOOOOOOO!
NOW is the time of the Forsaken!  Power to the Forsaken - NOW AND FOREVER!!!
Nadyia has made quite the leatherworker in her years of practice.  Travel west on the road to Darnassus to pay her a visit and maybe she can bestow some of her knowledge upon you.
Nagmara!  Have any mutton left?

Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!$B$BLook at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.
Name, rank and serial number, soldier.
Nana always said there was no greater thing in the whole world than a warm, toasty slice of fresh, homemeade cherry pie.
Narain Soothfancy, at your service! Retired engineer and master soothsayer! I can tell your future before it even happens!
Narain, I need another special kit.
Narain, if you have enough materials, I could use another arcanite buoy.

Naralex sleeps again!$b$bLong ago, Naralex journeyed to this cavern with the honorable goal of entering the Emerald Dream and regrowing the Barrens into a lush forest. His focus waned and his thoughts became tainted by serpentine visions.$b$bNow, reptilian beasts seep from his dreams to the land. He must be awoken from the nightmare or he will be forever lost, and a great evil unleashed.$b$bOnly after his corrupted servants, the Fanglords, have been slain can I perform the awakening ritual.
Nat, I want to buy your mudskunk lures!
Natalia?
Nathanos, I have lost the rotten apple. I require another.
Nature provides all that we need.  Speak to Komin Winterhoof at Holistic Herbalism on the middle rise.
Naughty secrets!
Need a little help here.  That $N saw me.
Need some supplies?
Needlework requires a steady hand. And patience... above all, patience.

Nefarian had ordered that unsuitable subjects be destroyed immediately, but these retched beasts would not do so without first inflicting an 'ample' amount of torture.$B$BWhen we were thoroughly 'broken,' they would round up what remained and throw us to these thugs. Our bodies used as instruments in their sick game: thrown into the lava or worse; to the open and waiting arms of the bloodthirsty legion below.
Neither generals is spawned.

Neither you nor I could possibly imagine the pain an individual suffers when their soul is ripped from their body. They are not dead and by no means are they alive. Instead, they walk the land, servants of those that bind them to this world.$B$BLord Razelikh, demonic overlord of these lands, enslaved them all. Nine he took for his own, placing stones of binding near the Dark Portal. The remaining nine were divided up between his subordinates.
Neltharion is  my answer.
Neltharion, hmm? As good an answer as any, yes?
Ner'zhul is my answer.
Never cross a Dark Iron, $C.
Never cross a Dwarf!
Never fear, Bodley is on the job! Let's see here, ah yes... there it is. Let me just summon it... and, presto!$B$BTry not to lose it again, $N.
Never had much use for a bow, but these rifles the goblins make are very handy when hunting. Still can't get used to the smell though.
Never look the Commander directly in the eyes.
Never seen anyone move so fast in my whole life.
Never shall you find the twin blades of Sul.
New this year: the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.  Step on up and don't be shy!$B$BAnd sign these forms before you try it, we're still working a few bugs out of this thing...
Next time I see one of you not working, I'll have Buzzer cut your head off!
Next time, bring friends.
Next, I'll place the wheel... to protect you from harm.
Niby, you are stupid.
Niby, you're an idiot.
Nice going! I knew I was right about you, no matter what those other people said. Ha! I'm kidding! Okay, on with your lessons...

Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.
Night Elves like to stand off on one leg while casting. Strike at that leg like so...
Night, all. I'm gonna sit up for a bit. Maybe Darcy'll come by.
Night, night.
Nightly brawls and great drinks! Get it all at the Pig and Whistle!

No better place to learn First Aid than under the watchful eye of Shaina Fuller at the Cathedral of Light.  

To get there, just look for the yellow rooftops, or the towering spire of the Cathedral itself which you can see from almost anywhere in the city.
No chance!

No doubt you are another inept simpleton sent from the Dark Lady to train under her champion.$B$B<Nathanos sighs.>$B$BI've sent every one of you back to her in pieces, I don't see why it will be any different this time.$B$BMine, however, is not to question why, but instead to do as the Dark Lady bids.
No farm woman can stand against the Defias!
No gnome will be left behind.
No hello for your old friend, Narain? Who were you expecting???
No kill me! No kill me!
No luck with the Twilight's Hammer deserter?  Check the mountains to the southeast thoroughly.  There are numerous rumors of a mysterious hermit living there.
No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.
No matter.  You were a fool to help me, and now you will pay!
No more tin bars! Even my arms hurt from stacking them. We have all that we need, so go ask one of the others if they need you to collect anything.
No one challenges the Wastewander nomads -- not even robotic chickens!  ATTACK!
No one get past me and threaten da king!  Ungh, take it!!
No one lives forever...

No one really knows who made the Darkmoon Cards or what their true purpose is, but I can tell you that they have been found all over Azeroth, usually in the hands of a villain attempting to unlock their mysteries.

There are four types of Darkmoon Cards; Beasts, Elementals, Portals and Warlords, with eight cards, Ace to Eight in each suit. If you collect all eight of one suit then you can turn them into a deck that you can give to our Professor Thaddeus Paleo in exchange for a powerful trinket.
No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!
No one's going to save you now, human!
No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.
No part of the animals we hunt is wasted.
No rest for wicked, but us guess you ok.  You find Innkeeper Norman on upper ring of Trade Quarter.
No rest... for the angry dead!
No restraints? Just in a circle?
No scallywag $c is taking our Winter Veil plunder!  Get 'em!
No sign of the final explosives shipment to the west either.  Where are those lollygaggers?
No tampering with the mail!
No time for beer!  The race is about to start.
No two-bit traitor will stop the powder from getting to Ironband!
No worry, we find you.
No!  Get away from me!  Help!!
No!  It can't be...
No!  Leave us!  We must not fail our task!
No!  You cannot be stronger than the Foulweald!  No!!
No!  You must not do this!
No! Anaya... Anaya! Don't leave me! Please...
No! My friend... what's happened? This is all my fault...
No! The Defias will surely take the farm now!
No! The faerie dragons aren't making it, $N! I must return to Jer'kai to make sure she hasn't been found. Elune be with you.
No! You can't defeat me!

No, $N, you did not. I do not fault you, however, as yours is a mind much like mine was as a youth: Impetuous, rebellious, and often without a single coherent thought! Traits I can no longer afford to express.$B$BEnough lamenting. $R, I have a task for you; one that you may not survive.

No, $c, that is not all. The elite fighting forces of the opposition are commanded by the four Commanders of the base. Should you be able to strike a fatal and rapid blow to their Commanders, the elite line will falter. Their numbers dwindling to nothing!$B$BBut be warned, soldier; Commanders and Lieutenants are not to be trifled with or taken lightly. They earned those ranks...
No, Gargal. Just no.
No, I'm not, but lots of others are looking for love.  You should buy my love tokens, put on some cologne or perfume, and then pass them around!
No, Ulathek.  He knows your secret.  He knows you plot with Lord Hel'nurath of Xoroth.
No, Vaelan, I do not.
No, no, please continue... it's just that the air up here is so, um, smoky.
No, really, I still don't understand...
No-o-o-o!!
No... you can't sit on my lap.
Noma should have dinner ready soon. Might as well head in.

None are as skilled in the use of weapons as Ansekhwa.  It is said that he is guided by the spirits of the finest warriors of our honored ancestors.  Seek him out on the lower rise and he will teach you what you want to know.
None can stand against the Serpent Lords!
None may challenge the Brotherhood!
None may steal the secrets of the Makers!
Nope, can't help you, I'm afraid. Your skills have mine beat! If you want to learn more, talk to the night elf Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's amazing!
Nope, don't think there are any Enchanters here in Elwynn Forest.  There's a guy named Lucan who runs a shop up in Stormwind though.  You could check with him and see if he will train you.
Nope, no alchemists out here in Dun Morogh.  Ye best take a look in Ironforge for them... try the gnomes in Tinker Town.
Nope, nobody who can teach ye herbalism out here.  I think ye'll have better luck in Ironforge though.
Not a challenge at all it seems. Let us see how you handle your second test. Lysta, bring forth the minions of the Lich King.

Not a creature in the forest can elude Corand, such is his skill at tracking.  You would do well to listen to his teachings if you wish to be even half as successful.  

I will relieve you of the burden of tracking him and mark his location on your map, there in the Cenarion Enclave.
Not again...
Not bad, for a beginner! I guess it couldn't hurt for me to show you a few things...

Not bad. Go talk with Snarl, he just moved to Orgrimmar to study under Saru. Look for him in the Warrior district near Saru's smithy. Oh and he'll test you, so you better be as ready as you think you are.
Not bad... I suppose training you is not out of the question. Very well! Let's begin...
Not just any fish, mortal. This fish was a minnow. A very special minnow.
Not looking too good today. Sun is high and bright early and no activity on the water.
Not much fishing to be had around here, but what little there is to be had is Paxton's ye can be sure.  Ye can find him fishing out on Iceflow Lake.
Not now.  Have you any tasks for me?
Not one word....
Not only am I havin' all the mithril bars I be needin', but all the Horde collections are done now mon. It's lookin' like we just waitin' on the Alliance and then we be goin' to war!

Not so fast, $g guy : lady;... I'll not be handing out the reigns of a mighty ram steed to someone that's not a proven ally of the dwarves of Ironforge.  Once you've been recognized as exalted to Ironforge, I'll gladly show you what varieties of rams I have for sale.

Not so fast, $g guy : lady;... I'll not be handing out the reigns of a mighty ram steed to someone that's not a proven ally of the dwarves of Ironforge.  Once you've been recognized as friendly to Ironforge, I'll gladly show you what varieties of rams I have for sale.
Not that I doubt your abilites, but I would like you to perform a task for me. Call it a demonstration of good faith...

Not that I'm quite sure that you could ever possibly in a gazillion years have enough stranglekelp, what with all the ice cream one needs, but we seem to have enough. Or that's what I'm told anyway. It looks like some of the others here might need help with whatever it is that they're collecting. Understandable really when you consider that theirs just couldn't possibly be as fun as collecting stranglekelp.
Not too clever are you?  Hmm, if I were a stable master perhaps I might be in the vicinity of say, the stable?  Look for Morganus over there.
Not what Keever was hoping for. Keever may have added too much earthroot. Let's see if the second serum will do what I need.
Note the weak binding structure of this one. Be sure to finish your incantations or this is what you will end up with.
Nothing beats the sound of a twin-carb, fork-ring steam engine burning pure firestone!
Nothing biting. . . .

Nothing frees the spirit like soaring through the sky.  There is such a place in our great tribal center Thunder Bluff.  The road north out of Bloodhoof Village will guide you there.  Once you ride the elevator to the top speak with one of the Bluffwatchers who can give you further directions.
Nothing like a roaring fire on a cool night with good friends and dwarven ale.

Nothing like spending a day down at Crystal Lake fishing. Arnold Leland is the man that taught me. You can usually find him out on the dock in the Canal District just fishing the day away. 

Oh, and don't believe any of the stories he tells you about monsters in the canals either.
Nothing must befoul the gardens! You must be destroyed!

Nothing quite like the feel of something dead rubbing up against you.  You can find Shelene Rhobart by heading southeast on the road out of town, and then going east at the intersection.  She's at a small camp there not too far along the road.
Nothing will stop us!  You will die!
Nothing you can say will ever get me in the arena against that monstrosity of a machine you call a steam tank!
Nothing. My orders were to speak with you and then speak with Thrall. All I know is that Thrall is interested in saving your princess.
Notify me when you are ready to listen to the story.
Now I have what is required. Let us continue.

Now be silent and note where you are, lest I inform Lord Fordring and his knights that you are no longer here on amicable terms. I am certain he would take great pleasure in seeing to your 'atonement.'
Now bow to me.
Now children stop that!  I mean it!
Now for that snack...
fa: حالا نوبت آن میان‌وعده...

en: Now for the next race, the car will be even FASTER than before!
Now go back home where you belong!
Now how am I supposed to get those mechanical wretches out of my fields?
Now if I were Innkeeper Renee where might I be?  Hmmm?  Oh, perhaps inside the Gallows' End Tavern.  Yes, that's it, I'm sure of it.  Try the southeast end of Brill... think you can find that?
Now if you turn to page 34 in your text, you see an illustration of a dwarf undergoing dissection...
Now is the time to attack!  For the Horde!
Now is the time to shake the world to its foundations!  NOW is the time to remind those who would enslave us that we shall never yield!
Now is the time when the year is new and the moon shines bright.$B$BIt is our time... when the ancients awake.
Now is the time, Davil.  Now is the time of your death!
Now let us place this rare earth in my planter...
Now let's heat up these flakes...
Now let's try it...
Now me crush you myself!
Now prove your worth!
Now that the Frostwolf general is defeated, we can spare some troops to guard the entrance to Winterax Hold.$B$BBut stay vigilant!  We must always be on the lookout for Horde interlopers..

Now that the Stormpike general is defeated, we can spare a few troops to guard Winterax Hold.  But we must be ever vigilant, $c, for the Alliance will return.$B$BWhen you find them skulking about, teach them another lesson!
Now that the coast is clear...
Now that the war is in full swing, we've had no shortage of able-bodied combatants from the Horde and Alliance.$B$BIf only we could keep them off of each other's throats...
Now that you have had a chance to study the imp, let us move on to the next minion you will be able to summon, the voidwalker.
Now that's a War Stomp!  Good job!
Now that's putting your hoof down!
Now there is only one way out- to walk the lonely path of the damned.
Now this is an example of what not to summon. Look, it's frail and brittle. One good whack from a mace will send bone shards flying.
Now to find an unsuspecting Harpy!
Now to test my design!
Now we just need to figure out how to get this thing working again.
Now we must wait, $N. It won't be long before the naga realize what we have done.
Now we're making progress!
Now where did I put that companion document?
Now where did I put that silver spool...
Now where did I put the Venture Company formulations?
Now where was that book on Night Elf customs I was looking for...
Now which one of these did I put it in...

Now why would ye be needing the services of one of those types?  We get enough trouble out of that rogue, Hulfdan Blackbeard, over in The Forlorn Cavern, do I need to be turning my eye to you as well?
Now you are ready to learn the finer points of kodo hide tanning. Let us begin...
Now you die!
Now you've gone and done it. I thought you were better than the people at Southshore. They would have bought all my wares!
Now's not a good time, $N.$B$BAre you insane?!
Now, if I add the yellow ones...
Now, let's see... If I am correct, then... Hmmm...
Now, only one step remains to rid us of the Soulflayer's threat...
Now, take another long look before we make our way to the Holy District and the great Cathedral of Light.
Now, then... the rod. Let's see about fixing it, shall we?
Now, watch...
Now, you try.
Now... where was my thread and needle. Ah! There it is...
Nuh uh.
Nurse Neela greets all of her future customers as they enter the Gallows' End Tavern at the southeast end of town.
Nurse.
Nuttin' be 'fraid of. Come.
O'course I'm talkin to myself. Only way to get decent conversation in this city.
OH NO YOU DIDN'! ITS ON NOW! <PH>
OH NOES!  Da king is dead!  Uh... hail to da new king!  Yeah!
OH NOES!! BRB AS DRAGON! <PH>
OK Fengus, where you at?!  You come call me a gnoll lover while I give you da hammer upside da head!
OK boss, when you ready for da tribue from your henchmen, you let me know!
OK, OK! It's your turn!
ONWARD! TO AHN'QIRAJ!
OW! That's not right!
OZZIE!!!! OH NO!
Obsidion rise and serve your master!
Och I love a good brawl, but sometimes yer foe has a skull thicker than a Thorium heat shield. Times like that ye need a wee bit o assistance.
Och!  Now that's a skill worth knowing.  Tognus beats the anvil with a fury ye don't see often.  Why don't ye go talk him up and see what he can teach ye?
Och!  Now ye're talkin'!  I bet Granis Swiftaxe could show ye a thing or two about swinging steel.  He's over in the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos at the moment.

Och!  That Daryl Riknussun is a brilliant cook!  He makes a chilli so hot ye could temper steel with it!  I don't think he'll teach ye the recipe, but he'll certainly help ye to become a good cook.  Ye'll find him at the Bronze Kettle o'er on the northeastern side of The Great Forge.

Och!  Ye should be careful what ye get enchanted $glad : lass;.  I had me mug enchanted so it wouldn't spill a drop, but now I can't drink from it!  Such a tragedy.  

You be sure to heed me advice when ye see Gimble.  He'll be in his shop right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.
Och! Ye seek training in the way of the warrior, do ye?  Kelstrum Stonebreaker will put ye through yer paces!  Just march yerself over to the Hall of Arms east of the gates of Ironforge.

Och, 'twas a sad day when I realized my obsession. I woke up and found myself tannin' before I had my first tankard of ale. Hardly even a respectable hangover! I knew then--aye, I knew!--how it was goin' to be.
Och, there's nothing I can teach ye, $N. Have a word with Tally Berryfizz over there. She can hardly reach the tables, but when she starts brewing a potion, watch out!
Och... a paladin?  Well $glad : lass;, ye're in luck!  Azar Stronghammer is back from training and is currently staying at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.
Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?
Of course I can help you with training. I'm just a journeyman myself, but I'm sure there's something I can show you.

Of course I do not have the shard. That would be asinine. I walk amongst savages in this cursed land! I cannot take five steps without some crazed orc or human trying to thrust a sharp stick into my hide. At any given time you could very well be speaking to my ghostly spirit.$B$BAnyhow... I hid it.$B$BGo on... ask me where.
Of course I offer lessons to other Enchanters, provided you are ready.
Of course I will help!

Of course not, dear $g boy:girl;. You 'adventurer' types are often victims of circumstance; subject to the political drama which tends to unfold between citizenry and royalty.$B$BMy advice to you, then, is to seek out something else, more specifically: A new career.$B$BThis world has enough heroes.

Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin

Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.
Of course, Warchief!
Of course. He awaits you in the library.

Of the $1998w copper bars that we'll need, we have $2018w. The number for tin bar collections sits at $2005w out of $2006w needed. And, there have been $2008w of $2009w mithril bars smelted for the cause.
Off to Darkshire then, I suppose.
Off to Grom'Gol with you, $n!
Off to Orgrimmar with you, $n!
Off to Orgrimmar with you, $n. Say hi to Thrall for me!
Off to the Undercity with you, $n!
Off to the Undercity with you, $n! Try not to catch the plague...
Officers' Lounge
Official business, John. I need some information about Marshal Windsor. Tell me about the last time you saw him.
Ofgut
Ograbisi needs new hat!
Oh Rly? <PH>
Oh Umi, please teach me again how to create a Tranquil Yeti. I miss it so.
Oh brother, not this again... Have a seat $g sonny:missy;.$B$BI'm sure Rutgar has told you some of this story already so I'll spare you the boring details and get right down to the nitty gritty.
Oh c'mon, that's not true.
Oh dear, I am running dangerously low on supplies! What is taking that blasted goblin so long?
Oh dear, where is the "Codex of Defense?" Lydros will be most assuredly displeased.

Oh it's just so horrible, $g sir:miss;. The house Barov was once full of life... full of splendor. The manor was the Barov's primary residence amidst their far reaching empire.$B$BLucien and I noticed that as the days progressed, the Barovs became depressed. Despondent. Paranoia and rage often overcame the master and missus. At night, we could hear the Barovs arguing in their chambers. From what we understood, their greed had 'broken the dam,' so to speak.
Oh man, I thought I was dead for sure.  Ugh... still dizzy...
Oh my!  Look at the state of these books!  Who put them back without alphabetizing them??
Oh my! Look at this... all these candles. I'm sure they're used for some terrible ritual or dark summoning. We best make haste!
Oh my! What's this? Help!
Oh my, what a surprise! Another failure!? But how, oh great one??
Oh no!  Here they come!
Oh no!  It's out of control!  Run!
Oh no... Mist... what has happened...?
Oh now you've gone and angered me! Time to see the true force of the Stone of Tides!

Oh that's simple! You use it like anything else you might activate. Don't worry, I'll take care of lighting the fuse. Once you're up in the air you'll notice that you'll seem to "float," but that won't last forever. What you're aiming for is a target on the lake way over yonder. Make sure that you begin your descent by detaching your "wings" at the right time to land in the water, or, well, I don't sell life insurance.

Oh the drama and fuss the young Master exerted. You would think the fate of the world rested squarely on his shoulders. Only mortals could have such a skewed perspective on our world.$B$BAlas, he left me with his meager magical secrets... Librams or some such nonsense. I have no use for these paultry magics but perhaps you might be interested in their enchantments.
Oh the horror! The tragedy! We are on the verge of a breakthrough, yet all could be lost.
Oh well, I'm sure she'll be around later.
Oh well.
Oh well... Maybe next time.
Oh well....
Oh yeah, I heard about that.
fa: آهان، دربارهٔ آن شنیده‌ام.

en: Oh yes, old one, Hakkar has returned. Soon the world shall crumble beneath his might. Consumed. Left in ruin...

Oh yes, that's right.$B$BSo, here we are invading deep into the upper reaches of Blackrock Spire, against their lord and leader; this was before Drakkisath. Not too smart if you ask me, but our leader, Anthion Harmon, you met him, was always one who loved a challenge.$B$BSurprisingly, everything went according to plan, right up to the point where we were prying Valthalak's spellbook out of his stiff fingers. That's when it all went south.$B$BShould I continue? You look like your eyes are glazing over.
Oh yes, the molt - do not lose it. There are those of my kin in the Burning Steppes that would craft items that only the molt of the black Dragonflight could fortify.
Oh! I almost forgot! I slipped you a set of thieven' tools. You'll need those where you're going.
Oh!!! Get that thing away from me!
Oh, $N, wait a minute! There's one more thing! Come back!
Oh, Darrowshire!  I would give a thousand lives for you!
Oh, I am so glad you have returned, $N.$B$BMy brother's spirit has now be freed from the corruption, but I choose to remain here, in my mourning.$B$BThank you so much for your help, $N.
Oh, I will, my friend. I will indeed. You, too, be safe.
Oh, I'm sorry, but you know more about leather than I do at this point. Talk to Faldron over there if you wish to learn more.
Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.
Oh, a priest is it?  Well good ol' Maxan is sure to be found having a drink in the Thunderbrew Distillery if ye need a bit of training.
Oh, darn...
Oh, do tell! The suspense alone is enough to make a girl scream!
Oh, great.

Oh, hello there!  I'm Hol'anyee, the chief scientist and biologist of Marshal Expeditions.  My brother and I, along with our companions, travel Azeroth exploring the wild and untamed majesty.  It is exciting... but, um... I think we got ourselves into a little too much excitement this time!

Oh, hi, $c. I guess the Alliance asked me to come here and keep track of all of this cooked meat that people are gathering because of the impending doom at Ahn'Qiraj. Doesn't that sound like fun?$B$BAnyway, I suppose you'd like to know how much we have. Last time I counted it we were at $2098w out of a total $2099w roast raptor needed.
Oh, how positively delightful!
Oh, if I only had a tree branch to hold up in front of me. The guards would never see me then.
