The Earthen are a synthesized race engineered by the Creators, functioning as one of the seed races in the initial population of the world designated as Azeroth.  The Earthen were created to aid the Creators' efforts in shaping the deep regions of this world.$B$BThey are a modification of the standard subterranean being matrix used on other worlds that the Creators have seeded.  The construction of this prototype race created various anomalies that were observed after initial synthesis.

The Earthen's only anomaly in synthesis is the tendency for matrix destabilization while being utilized in high-stress environments.$B$BAddendum: deep earth sculpting was naturally suited to the new matrix design and thus never met the qualifications of duplicating a high-stress environment.$B$BDestabilization was not discovered until well into the Earthen's primary service cycle for the Creators. The Might of Kalimdor will halt their advances!
The Night Watch alone cannot protect us forever.  We need the backing of the Stormwind Army.
The Nightmare cannot be stopped!

The Northern Pylon accepts yellow, red, and green crystals.$B$BThe focus is the energy that can be created using yellow crystals as the main source of power. There are two possible effects: one that will produce damage, and one that will negate damage. $B$BCrystal Charge requires red and yellow crystals. This will produce a large explosion, stunning your enemies.$B$BCrystal Restore requires yellow and green crystals. This will provide you with a healing aura.
The Northpass tower needs our aid!  Once again, let us charge and do proud or liege!

The Old God would create avatars from the silithid in its own image. These avatars were to be known as Qiraji. Sentient and with purpose, the Qiraji would name their creator: C'Thun was born... For many thousands of years the Qiraji worked feverishly to build a force capable of laying waste to the world that would betray their god. The great fortress city of Ahn'Qiraj was created to house their growing armies and prepare for the coming of C'Thun.
The Old Gods will be restored.  You will not be allowed to interfere!
The Order of the Shattered Hand existed before Thrall and shall exist after Thrall.
The Orgrimmar Auction House is in the Valley of Strength.  Look for it on the east side next to Boomstick Imports.

The Paragons of Power are remnants from the ancient Gurubashi Empire.  We Zandalar seek them - not only are they of tremendous collectible value to us, but we believe that they also hold latent signatures of magic used by the old Empire.$B$BYou'll more than likely discover three kinds of Paragons in Zul'Gurub: coins, bijous, and primal items.  Bring them to us in the quantities that we seek, and you'll be rewarded with some of the finest items we Zandalar have ever crafted.

Bring them to us in the quantities that we seek, and you'll be rewarded with the some of the finest items we Zandalar have ever crafted.$B$BCount on it, mon!
The Park is where you want to go if you are looking for druid trainers. Theridan and Maldryn can usually be found by the moonwell in the center of the district.
The People of Westfall salute $N, a brave and valiant defender of freedom.

The Plates of Uldum are discs synthesized by the Creators that allow access into the Uldum compound.  These discs house and store specific data related to the Creators' activities here.$B$BPhysically, they are nearly identical in circumference to the disc set you currently possess.  Their markings, however, are directly related to information on Uldum as opposed to the Uldaman complex.
The Primal Gods serve Hakkar. Turn back now, you stand no chance.
The Primal Gods? Impossible!

The Prince plotted to imprison a demon of immense power behind a grand force field. The pylons would channel latent energies into the field, keeping it operational.$B$BWhile imprisoned, Immol'thar would serve as a battery to the populace of Eldre'Thalas.

The Qiraji forces were commanded to fall back and hide the bulk of their numbers beneath the sands of the desert. A small attack was ordered upon Southwind Village while the front lines of Staghelm's army were kept occupied.
The Razza just made more fertilizer for Mushgog!
The Recombobulator is shaping up quite nicely. Just a few adjustments to go!
The Rogue Trainer's name is Marion Call.  You can find her upstairs in the reading room at the Gallows' End Tavern at the town's southeast edge.
The Royal Apothecary Society has little patience for fools, as do I.  Perhaps the next time you and I speak of my steeds, you will be considered a friend of the Undercity.  Until then...
The Royal Apothecary Society has little patience for fools, as do I.  Perhaps the next time you and I speak of my steeds, you will be considered exalted by the Undercity.  Until then...
The Ruins of Eldarath.
The Sandfury reign supreme!
The Sarkhoff's... sometimes the Sarkhoff's visit. They are good people.
The Scarlet Crusade shall not fail in its mission!
The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!
The Scarlet Crusade will scour these lands!

The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, $N.$B$BIt is you who must lead your armies into the cursed fortress city of Ahn'Qiraj and mete justice to its inhabitants.$B$BVenture to Silithus and present the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to Jonathan the Revelator.

The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, $N.$B$BIt must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds in the next age of your people. $B$BYou must wait for the armies of the Horde and the Alliance to arrive in Silithus before you may ring the Scarab Gong. The time for war is close at hand.

The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, $N.$B$BIt must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds in the next age of your people.$B$BWhen you are prepared to ring the Scarab Gong and once more open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj, I will grant you the Scepter. You have only to ask.

The Scholomance is housed in crypts beneath the Caer Darrow keep. Once owned by the noble Barov family, the keep fell to ruin after the Second War. As the wizard Kel'Thuzad enlisted followers for his Cult of the Damned, he often promised immortality for those who served his Lich King. The Barovs fell to his influence and donated their keep, but the cultists killed the family and turned the crypts into a school of necromancy. Though Kel'Thuzad no longer resides there, cultists and instructors still remain.
The School for Necromancy known as Scholomance is on the ruined island of Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands.
The Scourge are at the castle entrance!  For Stormwind!  For King Anduin!
The Scourge are at the entrance to the Royal Quarter!  Kill them!!
The Scourge are defeated!  Darrowshire is saved!

The Scourge are establishing small staging points in the places under attack, receiving communications and other assistance from the necropolises that fly overhead. From what we can tell, the only way to root them out is by killing the ground forces that surround the points.
The Scourge attack against my court has been eliminated.  You may go about your business.
The Scourge beckons you, foolish $r.

The Scourge brought only small forces to bear against each of Azeroth's capital cities, while their main forces periodically attack the following lands:$B$BAzshara, the Blasted Lands, the Burning Steppes, the Tanaris Desert, the Eastern Plaguelands and Winterspring.
The Scourge infestation grows in Azshara. Every able bodied warrior is needed to stem the tide of their invasion.$B$BNumber of Necropolises remaining: $2279W

The Scourge will not prevail!
The Scourge's plague is almost to the turning point; a handful more cauldron subversions will push us over the top!  Be sure to do your part to help out!
The Scourge's plague still dominates the zone, and we have a long way to go before the plague will be altered enough to affect them.  Collect the necessary resources and help out the war effort!
The Shaman Commander is not to be trifled with, $r.
The Shattered Hand has been able to place spies throughout the upper citadel of Blackrock. Though the information gathering process has been slow, we have made discoveries that cannot be ignored.
The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

The Shattered Hand's influence dominates these lands. We are the veil which covers Kalimdor: The protectorates, the police, the judges, the jury, and ultimately, the executioners. We see all, we know all.$B$BYou have grown much in the time which you have spent in service of the Hand, $N. The time has come to send you into the field.$B$BAre you prepared to undertake your next mission?

The Shen'dralar were Queen Azshara's most revered arcanists. It was within these very walls that the Queen's most important demands were processed - often in secret.$B$BAfter the destruction of the Well and the subsequent lethargy that overcame the Highborne and lesser night elf sects, the Prince of Eldre'Thalas, Tortheldrin, began construction of the pylons that you see littering the halls of the west wing.
The Signet of Chaos belongs to Ravenholdt, beast! You will never hold its power! (PLACEHOLDER - TO BE MOVED/CHANGED)
The Silverwing Sentinels are hardly what I would call honorable opponents. But if you are intent upon their slaughter $c, then seek out Brakgul Deathbringer in the Hall of the Brave.
The Silverwing Sentinels can use all the help they can get in their fight against the Warsong Outriders. $N, go to Stormwind Keep and speak with Elfarran if you wish to assist them.
The Silverwing Sentinels shall be in your debt, $c.  You will find Elfarran, our battlemaster, inside Stormwind Keep, attending the boy-king's audience.  Goddess watch over you!
The Snowfall Graveyard is owned by the Alliance.

The Sons of Arugal will rise against all who challenge the power of the Moonrage!
The Soulflayer comes!
The Soulflayer is defeated!  Our leader, Molthor, now calls more of his servants...
The Southshore Crier grabs the back of his neck and his eyes go wide.
The Stars of this time are bent on new paths, beacons of hope and strength for the coming ages.

Recently, a prisoner-led revolt has resulted in a state of pandemonium within the Stockades - where the guards have been driven out and the convicts roam free.
The Stonehearth Bunker is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will destroy it!
The Stonehearth Bunker is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will destroy it!

The Stormpike Guard is in need of your assistance in the fight against the Frostwolf Clan, $N. Speak to Brogun Stoneshield on the Warrior's Terrace and he will help you find your way to Alterac Valley. Elune be praised!
The Stormpike Guard must be destroyed!  Ready for Alterac Valley $c?
The Stormpike Quatermaster keeps his supplies under an awning, just west of here.
The Stormpike clan bows to no one, especially the horde!
The Stormpike forces gain the General's Warcry.
The Stormpike general has fallen!  The battle is won!$B$BNow laugh as the Alliance scurries to recover its lost holdings.
The Stormwind Stockades are found near the mage quarter in Stormwind.
The Sunken Temple can be found in the center of a great lake in eastern Swamp of Sorrows.
The Syndicate have been reported to be nosing around in a cave on the eastern plateau. Find out what they're up to, soldier! Beware of Frostwolf activity!
The Syndicate is made up of a bunch of hacks - disorganized, unskilled, and lazy...
The Tanaris desert is littered with gigantic bones just like this one to my right.  I'd hate to have ever ran across that thing.
The Temple of the Moon is home to the priests of Elune.  There you will find Jandria and Lariia, who will provide you with further guidance in the path of priesthood.
The Thandol Span fell to Ragnaros.  So shall the Stonewrought Dam!

The Thorium Brotherhood Fall Catalogue:$B$BInside you will find the hottest deals on all of your adventuring needs! We'll even show you where to pick up those difficult to find components and supplies.
The Thorium Brotherhood does not waste time on ants. Be gone!

The Thorium Brotherhood possesses the knowledge required to make the sacred arms and armaments of the Fire Lord, but we lack the manpower to obtain the materials required for the crafting.$B$BI, Lokhtos Darkbargainer, have been empowered by the Brotherhood to exchange the exalted recipes for materials gathered from the Molten Core.$B$BPresent your offer, $r.
The Thunder Bluff Bank can be found on the lower rise.
The Thunderbrews run a fine Inn in Kharanos which bears their name.  Stop in for a pint and a bit of rest.
The Timberlings have made it too difficult for the fishermen to catch anything around Dolanaar.  You best look for someone to train you in Darnassus.
The Timbermaw furbolgs.
The Titans had long since vacated this world. Only the night elves that once inhabited this area were here to defend. Oh my! The next passage is fascinating!
The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.
The Vault in Ironforge is the closest bank ye'll find in these parts.
The Wailing Caverns has its entrance at the Lushwater Oasis southwest of Crossroads in the Barrens.
The Warchief brings change that will bring the Horde victory!  Look for Swart inside the barracks on the east side of town.

The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.$B$BHe feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.
The Water of the Seers is ready for your consumption, $n.
The Waterlord Hydraxis hides off in Azshara, on an island in the Bay of Storms.  What kind of threat can the fool muster from there?
The Week of the Wardens is not yet over... may I have another Orphan Whistle?
The West Frostwolf Tower is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will destroy it!
The West Frostwolf Tower is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will destroy it!

The Western Pylon accepts red, green, and blue crystals.$B$BThe Pylon focuses on the energy that can be created using red crystals as the main source of power. There are two possible effects: one that increases your protection from damage, and one that weakens an enemy's defenses.$B$BCrystal Ward requires red and green crystals. This will provide you with an increase to armor.$B$BCrystal Yield requires blue and red crystals. This can lower the armor of a specific target.
The Wickerman Festival now begins!  Power to the Forsaken!
The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!
The Wind Rider Roost is atop the totem stairway in the center of town.

The Winterfall furbolg that reside here in Winterspring were once our allies... But one day, that all changed.$B$BDriven by the strange demands of their high chief, they began to attack all others that they came in contact with, including our tribe. They keep to themselves now...
The Zandalarian trolls have traveled far and suffered much to reach this place, but to do nothing... is to invite our doom...
The abomination has come! Forward!
The abomination has overrun the Night Watch camp! Quickly, we must intercept it before it reaches town!
The ages have been cruel to you and I, my love, but be assured, it is, and at long last we are reunited.

en: The air is abuzz with energy, Arch Druid. What is the status of the Forest Lord?
The altar seems to beckon to you as if it were alive.

The ancient Altar of Hakkar stands silently near the entrance to the room.$B$BLooking to the balconies above it, you notice a large serpent-like statue rests on each. The statues look very much like the ones on the altar before you. They must be related in some way...
The animal looks confused.
The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Even if you do not follow the path of the warlock, you would do well to remember that.
The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

The archmage Allistarj of the Shadowsworn was granted three. Lady Sevine, warlock of the Shadowsworn was also granted three. The remaining three were given to Grol the Destroyer, lord of the Dreadmaul ogres of these blasted lands.$B$BYou see, $N, without a soul, the body cannot be killed. The remnants of my men are now indestructible fighting units. Thankfully, they are bound in how far they can travel by the stones of binding.

The armor of Redemption was worn by our most pious knights - armor worthy of the Lightbringer himself!$B$BThousands fell in the last war; their vestments stripped from their corpses and taken to the dread citadel of Naxxramas.$B$BIt is said that the death knights of Naxxramas corrupt the Redemption plate mail for their own use.$B$BSuch tragedy...
The ashes from the burning wickerman radiate magical power.
The ashes from the burning wickerman radiate magical power.  You have already applied the ashes to your face.
The assassins are over here! Quickly, before they reach the Magistrate!
The attackers have fled!  Strength and honor to the Horde!
The auction house
The auction house can be found on the central spire of Thunder Bluff.  Search near the bottom of the Windrider's Tower. May your ancestors watch over you.
The bank
The bank is located in the serene city of Darnassus.  You must go there if you wish to store your possessions.
The bank?  Oh, ye mean The Vault!  No safer place to store yer valuables than The Vault. Ye'll find it just northeast of the entrance to Ironforge.
The bastion is falling! Burn the evidence!
The bat handler
The battle for Alterac Valley has begun!

The battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources.  Lumber, ore, food... all these are needed in order to wage a good war.$B$BDenying our enemies of their supplies is as good as killing them on the battlefield.
The battle for Warsong Gulch begins in 1 minute.
The battle for Warsong Gulch begins in 30 seconds.  Prepare yourselves!
The battle for Warsong Gulch is a battle that we cannot lose.  We fight for our honor and we fight for our land, and no orc or misguided ally will take them from us!
The battle goes well. The Scourge forces seem weakened. I believe it will only be a matter of time before we drive them from our shores. I will turn my magics to you, to aid in this struggle.
The battle is won! Watch as they flee to the safety of their precious temple. Soon all will be razed... Their leaders destroyed!
The battle is won. For the time being, the Scourge threat has been pushed back. Our resources can be channeled into aiding you, in thanks and preparation for the future.

The battle rages, and both our captain and the captain of our enemy are slain!$B$BDrek'Thar now leads us from Frostwolf Keep, and the dwarf Vanndar Stormpike hides deep in Dun Baldar.  Defeat Vanndar and claim victory for the Horde!
The battlemaster
The bear looks at you calmy and patiently, but says nothing.

The bear spirit looks upon you with a calm and peaceful gaze.  You hear a voice speak to you as though it was coming from the bear, but the creature makes no indication that it is speaking.$B$B"Greetings, my young friend.  If you have come to me seeking guidance, then perhaps I can help you find what you seek."
The beast is slain! All's well in Darkshire!

The beasts of these blasted lands exhibit preternatural attributes, heretofore unseen in nature.$B$BWe have theorized that the energy which was released upon the opening of the Dark Portal, infused into their physical being and forced the creatures to evolve into their current forms.$B$BFearsome beasts they are, no doubt, but we also believe that they could prove to be quite useful in our studies.$B$BPerhaps you would be interested in assisting us in the study of these beasts, $N?
The best had to have been the look on Perenolde's face when our army comes marchin' right up to his front door. What a battle!
The best miner has a firm grip on $ghis:her; pick, a stout heart in $ghis:her; chest, and thick, black dust in $ghis:her; hair.
The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

The blade and Mograine were a singular entity. Do you understand? This act corrupted the blade and lead to Mograine's own corruption as a death knight of Kel'Thuzad. I swore that if I lived, I would expose the perpetrators of this heinous crime. For two days I remained under the rot and contagion of Scourge - gathering as much strength as possible to escape the razed city.
The blessings of Cenarius be yours, $c.  Our leader, Arch Druid Staghelm, guides us and all of Teldrassil to a renewed life!
The blood of a thousand Alliance soldiers I shall spill... None shall stand against the might of the Ice Lord!
The blood of our enemies shall be spilt upon the battlefield. The great elementals shall answer our call and crush all that stand in our way.
The blood samples must be protected!  Destroy the intruders!

The blue dragons themselves aren't here, but followers of Malygos are. I do not know why, but I can tell you this: wherever the blue dragons are, expect to find arcane magic. I wouldn't be surprised if the dragonspawn are here protecting something... perhaps something the Highborne left behind.
The boar is superb!
The body is that of a female orc warrior.$B$BIt is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

The book tells of dragons uniting against another, more powerful dragon, named Deathwing. From what you can make out, the chromatic dragonflight had almost been unleashed upon the world. The Aspects were prepared.
The boss wants all hands on high alert.  The rusty anchor sinks tonight.
The bottles are dusty but the liquor goes down clean!
The boy had picked up the Ashbringer and driven it through his father's heart as his back was turned. His last words will haunt me forever: "What have you done, Renault? Why would you do this?"
The bridge is looking great. We keep up this pace and it'll be done for the first expansion forces to head north.
The brood of Onyxia!
The burning of the Wickerman will begin in fifteen minutes!  Come to the festival - located just west of the Undercity - and celebrate Hallow's End and our liberation from the Scourge!
The burning of the Wickerman will begin in five minutes!  Come to the festival - located just west of the Undercity - and celebrate Hallow's End and our liberation from the Scourge!
The burning of the Wickerman will begin in thirty minutes!  Come to the festival - located just west of the Undercity - and celebrate Hallow's End and our liberation from the Scourge!
The cannons must be finished soon.
The car took a beating!  Let's get it ready for the next race.
The caverns below us are a source of strange and wondrous hides, but you must take care if you venture into their depths, $N. Remember that your own skin is far more valuable.
The caverns have been purified. To Naralex's chamber we go!
The children of Sul will protect their master. Rise once more Sul'lithuz!
The chromatic flight shall deal with these intruders. Let us talk of more pressing matters.
The closest gryphon master is located up in Ironforge near The Great Forge itself.  Ye'll need to head to Ironforge if ye want to travel by gryphon.
The coils of death will crush you!
The collar is indeed infused with demonic power, $N.  This bodes ill for our people.
The concern that you show for the welfare of your animal companions is commendable.  Bulrug, on the lower rise, can help you with that.  Seek him out between the bank and the inn.
The content on the pages of this tome appear to be in constant flux. You feel as if your thoughts are being bled from your mind and consumed by the book.
The corruption of a fallen titan. The corruption of the Destroyer. After all, the staff was forged from the seed of hate. That is, of course, what has brought me here...
The corruption of the House of Nobles runs through your veins.  Let me remove it with my blade!
The creatures in Winterspring are a good place ta start.$B$BHoweva', der may also be other places you can look...
The crystal is covered in intricate glyphs and runes. You can't make sense of any of it.
The curing cantrip has failed. Unfortunately, the introduction of the serum into this beast's blood stream will soon end its life.
The curse ends!
The darkness does not embrace you, $c.  Cease your prattle and remove yourself from my sight!  Be gone!

The data stored in this repository does indeed correlate with your astute proclamation.$B$BThe dwarf maintains an affinity for the stone composition of Azeroth, but due to the high-stress environmental anomaly within the Earthen's synthesis matrix, the dwarf reverts to a default biomass composition as seen in the standard subterranean matrix.$B$BErgo, the dwarf variant does synthesize from the degeneration of the Earthen creation matrix, as you inferred with your query.
The day of judgement has come, fiend!  I challenge you to battle!

The days we've spent here in Azshara are not among our best and most glorious, but we are still young and blood still courses through our veins--we shall find victory here. It is only a matter of time.
The dead walk among us!
The death of our flesh marked the birth of our spirit and our sacred task.
The deed is done! The Magistrate is dead-- to the shadows, my brethren.
The deed is done.  The totem is made.
The deeds are mine, brother! Soon you shall be out of my way for good!

The dishes that Alegorn whips up are to die for.  He's always busy preparing new delicacies over in the Craftsman's Terrace.  Be sure to try his Cenarion Green recipe if he has any left.  

Now, if you don't mind, I must investigate this rash of missing deer.
The doctor is in!
The door is open, Kharan. You are a free man.

The dragon hides behind a royal facade. The tablets will reveal her for what she is... If what I have seen holds true, I will not survive this battle, friend. It is you that must finish what I have started. Are your forces ready? Are you ready? We will begin on your command.
The druid, Kal, often spends his time at the moonwell in Dolanaar.  I am certain he would be able to provide you with the training you require.
The druids say that it is only a matter of time until nature itself drives the Horde from Kalimdor. Yet corruption continues to spread throughout our lands, even here on Teldrassil.
The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.
The easiest creature for you to summon is the imp. You should already be able to bring forth this minion but for completeness' sake I will start with him.
The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

The end draws nigh! Even as we speak our supplies are being shipped to Silithus and should arrive within $2113w days. Once there I am sure that all we be assembled in quick order, and then we'll be awaiting the ringing of the gong at the gates to Ahn'Qiraj to start the war. I look forward to analyzing whether our preparatory efforts will make a difference.

The end draws nigh! Even as we speak the last of our supplies are being shipped to Silithus and should arrive within a day. Once there I am sure that all we be assembled in quick order, and then we'll be awaiting the ringing of the gong at the gates to Ahn'Qiraj to start the war. I look forward to analyzing whether our preparatory efforts will make a difference.
The end of days is upon us! May the earth embrace my flesh and bones.
The end rapidly approaches! Surrender yourselves to Eranikus and be spared eternal suffering!
The enemy is upon us, stand ready!
The esteemed Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen can train you further.  He can be found in Theramore treating the wounded at the barracks.
The evil in these stones is strong, but it has been dispelled.

The exiles of Gnomeregan find ourselves in even more dire straits by running low on cloth reserves!  Perhaps you can help us, eh?!$B$BBring me extra cloth pieces you might have to help us replenish our stocks.  By donating them, you'll be earning the respect and trust of gnomes everywhere.  That's something that money can't buy!  Well, I guess cloth does, but that's beside the point...
The fabric of which our world is woven is most delicate. It merely takes some knowledge and the application of said knowledge to tear the fabric. It is thusly that rifts are born.

The fact that you are here is a first step... a correct choice if you will, in aiding Ysera's Dragonflight.$B$BYou may be here for purely the lure of personal gain, or you may be here because you are morally compelled.  Neither reason is important on its own, but both are in fact critical to this end: The agony that Eranikus endures is what rousted me from my Dream, and it is now my charge to see his torment ended.  I now ask you to aid me in this quest.
The farms must be liberated.  Stormwind may have deserted these people, but I'll be damned if I will.
The felhunter approaches! Be on your guard!
The final battle for Kalimdor is upon us. The supreme commander of the Might of Kalimdor orders his troops to march upon Ahn'Qiraj and destroy all in their path.
The final sanctum of crazed zealots. 'Tis where they create their scarlet uniforms, magically imbued by the enchanted scarlet thread!$B$BTo Stratholme, adventurer!

The finest preservative of flesh known to man and Scourge alike - Frostwhisper's embalming fluid.  Only one place an adventurer could find this and one would think that the lich the fluid is named after would not take too kindly to anyone going to said place.$B$BBut... if it's the fluid you want, the Scholomance you'll haunt...

The first is a primal token that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord.$B$BThe second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed Hoodoo piles.$B$BBring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
The first stage is over.  Big Will... come on down!
The first steps of our fight against the Scourge go well. We have had some successes, and hopefully my assistance can aid you in bringing future success to the battle.

The first suit of Dreadnaught armor was made exclusively for the Scarlet Highlord Mograine.  Whilst donning the full suit, the Highlord looked himself to be a demon from the depths of the Nether.$B$BAye, 'twas quite a sight to behold as Mograine would wade into a hundred Scourge, Ashbringer held high, and come out on the other side in a cloud of dust and flames - enemies left in ashes beneath his feet.
The fish is exquisite, Jessica.
The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

The fissure closed and Krixix was gone! Swallowed whole!$B$BBe warned, $r, what you wish for could very well become that which you do not want. You play with beings and arcana that are older than time itself!$B$BShould Krixix be alive and should he have the information which you seek, you can be certain that he will not give up said information. He has faced terrors far worse than you could ever dream to perpetrate.
The fists of an Orc are already a powerful weapon, so why not add blades or studs of solid steel. Now the fists I use to tame the wolves of the plains I can also use to shatter the armor of my foes.
The flags are now placed at their bases.
The flutter of the wings of a hawk, the breath of a ram in the snow, the pace of a bear through the forest... Such is life for the hunter.
The forest is crawling with Worgen and Ghouls.  Something must be done!
The forest shakes and shudders! The winds howl! Does the Forest Lord approach?
The forest spirits are uneasy...
The forest told me of your presence, but not why you were here. So, speak and enlighten me.
The forests are overrun with strange beasts and a foul taint fills the air.
The fortune is mine, Alexi! Your end comes soon!
The future holds much death and uncertainty, not unlike the past.
The future is cloudy for you two. If you work at your relationship, I'm sure you can find some measure of happiness.
The gate is in sight! We're going to make it! But first, I need to take a breather.
The gathering and knowledge of herbs is a specialty of Firodren Mooncaller.  Seek him out in the Temple Gardens in the southwestern area of Darnassus.

The generals tell us that we've collected everything that we need for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War. Now we're just waiting for the Horde to finish their stockpiling and the transport of the war materiel can begin.
The goblin racer packs a lot of punch, but the gnomes hid a trick or two in their car...
The goblins win the drag race!  Better luck next time, gnome team.
The goblins win! The goblins win!

The god that the Atal'ai trolls had brought forth is to blame for this.  We destroyed the god's physical manifestation and sunk the temple, but the god was much stronger than even we had anticipated.  Its seed of corruption ran deep, twisting everything in its path.$B$BEranikus was charged to watch over the sunken temple to ensure that neither the simple Atal'ai nor their god would rise again.  He was an unwitting victim of this corruption, and we in underestimating its potency.
The good doctor saves the day! HOORAY!
The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.
The grasp of the Old Gods is unmoving. He is consumed by their dark thoughts... I... I cannot... cannot channel much longer... Elune aid me...
The grass is soft and lush. The air is fresh, full of light and song. Everything I've seen suggests that Teldrassil is a dream come true. Why, then, is my heart full of foreboding?
The graveyards in Alterac Valley are where the souls of the deceased find rest and succor.  If you die, then your spirit will drift to the closest graveyard that our side controls.

The ground upon which the Scholomance was built was given to Kel'Thuzad by the Barov family. In exchange for this land - a place where the Cult of the Damned could learn the foul magics of the Scourge - Kel'Thuzad granted the Barov's immortality through undeath.$B$BIt is in Shadow Vault that you will find both the skin of shadow and its owner, Lady Illucia Barov.$B$BA finer mirror for the vain and dead never existed.
The gryphon master oversees the gryphon flights from within Stormwind.  If you're looking to take a ride, then that's where you should be headed.
The gryphons are ready to strike, $N! You must take this beacon and plant it in the western crater of the central battlegrounds.$B$BDo this and the battle is ours!
The guards of Theramore are the finest group of Alliance soldiers based in Kalimdor. It is our duty to uphold the laws of the Alliance even so far away from our homes.
The guild master

The guilds of the Horde have pulled together and accomplished this task already $c. We have all of the singed corestones necessary for our war materiel. Make yourself useful by asking the other collectors here if they need your aid.
The heathens will be forced to react. Orcs, bull-men...
The herbs found in nature can be a powerful ally when combined with respect.  You will want to seek out Bena at her alchemy shop on the middle rise to further your training.
The horde general is defeated!$B$BThe Alliance is the victor, and the Horde now scrambles to rebuild its weakened forces.

The humans and their so-called League of Arathor think to push us out of Arathi Basin.  I think not $c!  Are you ready to be sent there and demonstrate that it is they, and not The Defilers, that will be leaving soon?
The humans are in need of your assistance in their fight against The Forsaken at Arathi Basin.  Go to the Hall of Arms and speak with their representative, Donal Osgood.

The humans built an inn on the edge of the Barrens. The Shady Rest, they called it. Weeks ago, it was burned down.$b$bThe Warchief told us to leave the humans alone, so long as they didn't cross our borders, but it appears someone violated his wishes.$b$bHe has put me in charge of getting to the bottom of it. If you wish to provide assistance, go to the remains of the Shady Rest Inn and return any clues you find to me.
The humans claimed much of the Dustwallow Marsh for themselves, but the Stonemaul clan, with our help, has been able to push them back.
The humans definitely need all of our help in Arathi Basin.  The one that you wish to speak to is named Keras Wolfheart.  He stands ready to assist you on the Warrior's Terrace.
The indigenous rams of Alterac are vital to the functionality of our cavalry!
The inn
The inner gates of Ahn'Qiraj crash open.
The invaders are here!
The invisibility liquor is ready for you, $n.
The items you offered were pure, $N.  This new cleansing totem is strong.

The journal of Jandice Barov is filled with rantings and ravings about the undead. Towards the end of the book is what appears to be a tailoring pattern for the creation of a bag of some sort. Your understanding of tailoring is insufficient to decipher the pattern.

The journal of Jandice Barov is filled with rantings and ravings about the undead. Towards the end of the book is what appears to be a tailoring pattern for the creation of a felcloth bag. This bag is used by warlocks to store soul shards. Do you wish to copy the pattern into your own journal?

The journal of Jandice Barov is filled with rantings and ravings about the undead. Towards the end of the book is what appears to be a tailoring pattern for the creation of a felcloth bag. This bag is used by warlocks to store soul shards. You already know how to create this bag.
The kegs are filled with strong brew!  Drink, friend, and celebrate!
The kids jump up and down with youthful energy. (PH emote)
The kobolds are retaking the Coldtooth Mine!
The land of Azshara.

The land of Feralas has been through much, $r. The earth, the trees, the creatures; they are all changing what Feralas is and will be.$B$BThe Twin Colossals above us remain as a constant, though, throughout all that has happened here...

The land of eternal starlight, Kalimdor, was a nurturing mother to all of its creatures. The magic of the Well of Eternity permeated the land and empowered the multitude of flora and fauna that would make the world their home. From this magical ether were born the silithid. It was through the silithid that the brooding Old God would reach and attempt to sunder the world that it once held in its unmerciful grasp.
The legion of Blackrock comes, dwarflings! We shall scorch the earth and set fire to the heavens. None shall survive...

The life of a smith is not an easy one, but it puts steel in yer bones and fire in yer heart. My da' was a smith, my grandfather before him in the forges beneath Grim Batol. And now my son follows in our footsteps, that boy makes me proud.
The light appears to have forsaken us.
The light condemns all who harbor evil.  Now you will die!

The liquids and mixtures all bubble and spasm as you approach. Next to the equipment lies a large pair of tongs that look as though they would be adequate for dropping in samples of ooze.$B$BThere is safety gear present, but it appears to be dusty and well-ignored.$B$BDo you place some of your samples into the beakers?

The liquids and mixtures all bubble and spasm as you approach. Next to the equipment lies a large pair of tongs that look as though they would be adequate for dropping in samples of ooze.$B$BThere is safety gear present, but it appears to be dusty and well-ignored.$B$BYou don't think touching anything would be wise.
The little feller be hidin' in one o' them boxes, matey. G'luck!
The living are here!
The long reload takes some getting used to, but nothing else is better for starting off a fight.
The longer you wait, the less future you have for me to foretell.
The lunar celebration this year is quite magnificent!
The machine adjusts to face you.$B$BOn the back of the machine is an empty, oddly misshapen slot with an engraving that reads: "Propirtee o' Cap'n Gelkak Gyromast"
The machine comes alive at your touch.
The mage tower to the north.
The magi congregate in the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter. Quite a tower they have there. Makes our barracks look like peasant hovels.
The magical wards at that point should be supported enough by the energy flux to contain the entity.
The mailbox
The markings of this tablet show ancient diagrams and hold dire words of power.$B$BYou believe it is an alchemical recipe, but it is beyond your skill...
The meddlers shall pay for their interference. Retreat to the shadows!

The mightiest of all the beasts that make up the Ashenvale Hunt, Sharptalon is let to wander freely by the self-proclaimed guardians of this land, the night elves.  Sharptalon patrols for prey to the south of here, taking delight in rending the unsuspecting and unaware traveler limb from limb.$B$BTo bring down such a beast would be the mightiest of hauls, $N.  I wish you luck in the hunt for this creature!

The mighty fortress carved within the fiery bowels of Blackrock Mountain was held by the sinister Dark Iron dwarves for centuries until Nefarian - the cunning son of the dragon, Deathwing - took control of the upper Spire and made war on the dwarves' holdings in the mountain's volcanic depths. Realizing that the dwarves were led by the mighty fire elemental, Ragnaros - Nefarian vowed to crush his enemies and claim the whole of Blackrock mountain for himself.
The mixture is finished, $N.  Now we must save the child.

The moment that C'Thun had so patiently waited for had finally arrived. His children had spent thousands of years building an army capable of exacting revenge upon the whole of Kalimdor and now the prize was within their grasp.

The monastery was once a center for learning and enlightenment. With the rise of the undead Scourge during the Third War, the peaceful Monastery was converted into a stronghold of the fanatical Scarlet Crusade. The Crusaders are intolerant of all non-human races, regardless of alliance or affiliation. They believe that any and all outsiders are potential carriers of the undead plague - and must be destroyed.
The mortals have fallen! The new age of the Blackrock legion is at hand!
The muisek vessels are now ready, $N.
The name of Earthshatter has been one held by my family for hundreds of years. And like my father and his father before him, I too have inherited the right to create the vestments of my namesake.
The nearest bank ye'll find is The Vault in Ironforge, $glad : lass;.
The needle is small, but the thread is strong, and the stitches are fine. Our pact with Thrall and the others will hold. The Horde will not be driven from these lands.
The news from Stormwind does not bode well. . . .
The next clutch is due to hatch soon, sire. We will be ready to launch the attacks by week's end.
The next location of the Darkmoon Faire has not been finalized yet, but when it is you and I will be the first to know!

The night elf army was pushed back through Un'Goro, to the borders of the Tanaris desert. Something in Un'Goro prevented the Qiraji from being able to take the land. I do not quite understand this word but I believe it to mean 'God Lands.' It is stated that they could not 'take the God Lands.'
The nightmare of Ursal is over! We are free!
The numbers of my companions dwindles, goddess, and my own power shall soon be insufficient to hold back the demons of Felwood.
The officers' lounge
The only good $R is a dead $R!
The only place in Stormwind where magic and spirits mix, come to the Blue Recluse!
The only thing Metzen is going to be doing this Winter Veil is roasting on a spit!

The only way a hero can die, $r: Through tragedy. The Grand Crusader struck a deal with Kel'Thuzad himself! An ambush would be staged that would result in the death of Mograine. The type of betrayal that could only be a result of the actions of one's most trusted and loved companions.
The only weapon I know of that has no use other than killing someone. Not something, but someone. These blades were invented to end the lives of men. Beautiful aren't they?
The orb's markings match the brand on your hand.
The orders are given!  Move out, and show them what we're made of!
The orders have been given! Death to Stormpike! Charge the enemy!
The pain is unbearable!
The past lives in these wastes, $c.  We must be careful to not awaken it.
The path of those who undertake a profession is long and rewarding.  Which path do you choose to walk?
The people in Nighthaven sure know how to party!
The people of Darkshire expect more from the Council.  We cannot let them suffer from this unholy wrath which plagues us.

The people were destroyed in order to preserve the Prince's immortal life and near limitless powers. The power once divided among thousands now funnels into the Prince and the Shen'dralar zealots. Those few remaining survivors are directly feeding power into the pylons in order to keep Immol'thar imprisoned.$B$BShould the demon break free of its bonds, it would surely destroy what little is left of this once great bastion of arcana.
The place is a bit drafty... but what do I care? I'm dead.
The plaguelands are an excellent place to strike against the Scourge!
The plans are in there!
The plans for my twenty-foot tall turkey baster are nearly complete! Now all I need is a twenty-foot tall turkey...
The pleasure is mine, madam. Might I ask what it is that you are doing here?
The portal will shift slightly, at this point if you cast a binding cantrip you will solidify it in place.

The power of Elune compels you!  The power of Elune compels you!  

Go now!  Seek out Jandria in the central hall of the Temple of the Moon in the southern section of Darnassus!
The power of the Eye is unquestionable, Ryson, but what else can it do?
The power of the Tear of the Moons is mine! Mine I say!
The power of the light is truly great and merciful.
The presence of blue dragons.

The preternatural ability of the crypt fiend to hunt and kill its foe is one studied and vaunted by men in my profession. I, myself, have slain thousands of the beasts in my crusade to rid this world of Scourge.$B$BWhile I loathe the crypt fiend for its merciless nature, its abilities must be admired. It has a job and it does it - very well.
The profession of Enchanting displays the cycle of destruction and creation that is at the heart of nature.  Teg at the Dawnstrider Enchanters on the middle rise will show you how.
The race will start in 1 minute!
The rage burning within you will soon find fuel in our enemies.
The rage of Ishamuhale runs through you, $N.

The ravasaur here in Un'Goro seem to be related to the raptors of the barrens--highly intelligent, volatile, and with a sense or code of conduct. The greatest of these that I have encountered is  Lar'korwi. He is one of the most dangerous beasts I've ever seen. In taurahe, Lar'korwi means "sharp claw," but that does not do him justice.$B$BDo not underestimate Lar'korwi if you ever plan on hunting him, but I will help you in any way I can if you do.
The rebels of Lordaeron are small and weak, and know not the joy of serving our Lich King.
The reckoning is upon you, weakling!
The remains are covered in flies and maggots.
The resultant energies could collapse though, and that could cause an energy flux that would give you a migraine for weeks.
The rift will be opened there, above Lake Elun'ara. Prepare yourself, $N. Eranikus's entry into our world will be wrought with chaos and strife.
The ritual is already underway!
The rod's design is simple. Dartol didn't use his arcane knowledge in its creation... it is more druidic in nature.
The ruined city of Stratholme lies in the Eastern Plaguelands to the north of the Plaguewood.
The ruins of Dire Maul stand in central Ferelas.
The ruins of Zul'Farrak are located in the northwestern corner of the Tanaris Desert.
The seasons turn for all in due time, but you are still in the springtime of your life.  Please return to us later, $c, when you have experienced more.
The secret to the knife is to keep it hidden until the moment you strike.
The secrets behind the power of the Colossus could lead to all sorts of innovations in science!
The secrets hidden within the Pylons of Un'Goro Crater are now yours. Visit the Pylons at any time to access their power and gain useful resources.
The secrets of Suntara will not leave these lands.
The serum will only take a few minutes to prepare, $n.
The servants of sul will feast on your remains.
The shadow of the Scourge yet remains on this land, fools! You will never prevail!
The silithid are no match for the sons and daughters of Orgrimmar.  Soon all that will be left of them are their crushed limbs and wings under our feet, $N.

The siphoned energies would sustain the Highborne's magic, allowing those within the walls of Eldre'Thalas to feed their endless and growing magical pangs.$B$BThousands of years passed and the power required to keep Immol'thar imprisoned while sustaining life within Eldre'Thalas, began to shift. The cost to keep Immol'thar bound grew to overshadow the rate at which energy could be siphoned and distributed. The once net gain turned to loss.
The skill of the bow is a great asset to anyone, not just the hunter. You can strike swiftly, silently, and before your prey can blink... they are dead.

The skill with which Telonis crafts armor is beyond compare.  You should be grateful that he does not charge more for the knowledge he passes to others.  Go now and seek him out in the Craftsmen's Terrace in the northeast section of Darnassus.
The skinners usually take all their hides into Ironforge to dry out.  Why don't you head there and see if you can find one to train ye?
The slain spirit of Lunaclaw stares at you intently, as though wanting something from you.
The slow blade penetrates the shield.
The solution is ready in my cauldron.  It's just the matter of treating both the unfinished key and the scarab.
The speed of Owatanka is with you, $N.

The spirit looks upon you with a sense of completeness and cognizance that had not been present before.$B$B"I feel as though a great burden has been lifted from my soul.  Soon I will rest forever in peace.  I now know this, and I await this time patiently.$B$BThank you, stranger."
The spirit of Echeyakee flows through you, $N.
The spirit of the Dreadsteed pulses with rage.
The spirits guide our steps as we follow our paths though life, how may I guide yours?
The spirits have brought you to me, and so I feel blessed by them.
The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?
The spirits of Silithus call out to us, $n.  The land weeps, for it has a woeful story to tell...
The spirits of Stonetalon still rage, $N.
The spirits of this place are focused against your kind, $r. Perhaps if you win this tower in the flesh, I will be able to aid you.
The spirits told me you would come, that you would seek me for some reason, but that even you may not know that reason. So, do you know why you are here?
The spirits whisper in my ear.  They are restless and full of angst.
The stable is empty! We must provide our cavalry with suitable mounts. Stormpike Stables requests your assistance!
The stable master
The stables are full again! Our cavalry is soon to ride!
The stake is covered with the remnants of those foolish enough to anger the Warchief.
The stars speak to me.  They whisper of the horrors waiting in the night.
The stars will be in perfect form tonight!
The statues all move back into their original positions.$B$BThe sequence must be started again now, from the beginning.
The statues are all in place, and you may begin the puzzle.
The strongest hides come from those kodo that have laid themselves to rest in this wasteland.
The sturdy crate sits in the middle of the lumber mill surrounded by debris and very zealous followers of the Scarlet Crusade.
The swamp was horrible! I was so... so... scared!
The sweet irony -- Stormwind forces cut down in defense of their city, only to rise and fight alongside the Brotherhood as instruments of destruction.
The sword isn't a tool, it's an extension of you. I expect better!
The symbols on the tablet are carefully transcribed...
The tag on this present reads: "For ages 10 and up."
The tag on this present reads: "For ages 20 and up."
The tag on this present reads: "For ages 40 and up."
The temperature is... not hot enough!

The theory behind it is that we completely destroy you with a massive explosion wherever you are and send those particles through a dimensional rip and then re-implode you at the machine here.   Instant Transport!    It might not work ALL the time, but what kind of goblin engineer are you!   If survival was your first priority you could never be a real Goblin Engineer!
Here is the recipe you will need to make the Dimensional Ripper and try it out!
The things I have done... such horrible things...$B$B<Tarsis begins to sob.>
The threads that holds together the abominations of Stratholme are highly sought after by artisan craftsmen: Extremely resilient - nearly unbreakable.

The tides of war have come again. From the cold north, the Lich King's necropolises have laid siege to our lands.  He and his cursed general, Kel'Thuzad, send flying necropolises to invade across the world.
The time for conquest approaches quickly.
The time for practice is over! Show me what you have learned!

The time for war is almost upon us, $c! Both the Horde and the Alliance have finished with their preparations. All of our war materiel is being shipped to Silithus as we speak. I'd expect it all to arrive within $2113w days. When all is assembled there, the one who has completed the arduous task of reassembling the Scepter of the Shifting Sands will bang it against the Scarab Gong and open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj. Then battle shall be joined as has not been seen in ages!$B$BLok'tar Ogar!

The time for war is almost upon us, $c! Both the Horde and the Alliance have finished with their preparations. All of our war materiel is being shipped to Silithus as we speak. I'd expect the last of it to arrive within a day. When all is assembled there, the one who has completed the arduous task of reassembling the Scepter of the Shifting Sands will bang it against the Scarab Gong and open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj. Then battle shall be joined as has not been seen in ages!$B$BLok'tar Ogar!

The time has come for Horde and Alliance to look towards the north and the invasion of the Scourge. In recent days, territories across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms have come under attack. Will you take up arms to save your land from destruction at their hands?
The time has come for me to once again make my wares available to all who travel near Sentinel Hill! Come one, come all!
The time has come to prove your worth as a wing man, $N. Take this beacon and plant it dead center of the Snowfall graveyard. Defend it until my fleet arrives.$B$B<Mulverick salutes.>
The time has come, Guse. You fly again!

The time has come, brothers. We must not let the enemy advance through Frost Dagger Pass. Some of us will surely perish, but would any of you shy away from this duty? This honor? Onward! For the Horde!
The time has come, my $g brother : sister; in arms, to take back the night from the Scourge!
The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

The tinkerer's craft for you is it?  No doubt ye'll want to go see Springspindle Fizzlegear in Tinker Town.  

Just head east from the gates of Ironforge, or follow the sound of the explosions.
The title is misleading. I'm really a very nice person once you get to know me.
The toils of the living never cease to amaze. Your numbers are limited, and with every battle they dwindle further. You will not live to see the end!
The totem is made, $N.
The totem is made.  The well may now be cleansed.

The tower's defenses are at their weakest right now. The patrollers, sentries, lookouts, and even Gallywix himself are all infected and highly vulnerable to your special abilities and attacks.$B$BI want to see you enter that tower and when you exit, I want to see you covered in the blood of your enemies, the head of Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix in your hands, and the last of that poison in your pack. Take what you recover to Shenthul. He'll know what to do... I hope.
The towers and bunkers in Alterac Valley are vital strategic locales.  If we control a tower, then our troops can fire great distances from it.
The toxin is ready, $N.
The troggs are retaking the Irondeep Mine!
The troggs...they never stop coming.  Die trogg!  Die!

The twists and turns of Orgrimmar are designed to thwart invaders. Can you imagine how quickly one of those puny gnomes would get lost in here? Ha! If it was lucky, I'd track it down and keep it as a pet.
The undead shall feast on your soul, $n.
The village of Astranaar in Ashenvale is Elder Riversong's current home.
The village of Dolanaar atop Teldrassil is home to Elder Bladeleaf.
The war against the Horde has reached full tilt, $N.  This is a time of great need for the Alliance and it's quite necessary that all of us do our part to help.
The war continued but the will of the great leader was sapped. The whole of Silithus was soon engulfed by the silithid and their Qiraji hosts.
The warrior's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.
The water elementals are at war with the fire elementals, which sort of means they're at war with us.  One of their leaders, Hydraxis, is mustering agents for his cause...

The waters of Westfall are where you must search, due west-northwest of where the Gold Coast Quarry meets with the shore.  An anchor shows where a boat has sunk beyond it, deep within the water.  The underwater pressure is fierce here; swimming too far will crush even the mightiest swimmer from fatigue.  $B$BLook for a natural formation to aid you, $N - a bubbly fissure is near here, offering deep-water swimmers a chance for renewed breath.
The way of the Druid is sibling to the Shaman.  Gennia Runetotem is steeped in such knowledge.  Seek her out in the large tent on the east side of Bloodhoof Village.
The ways of Jaedenar are dark and treacherous.  Watch your moves in this place, $C, or you will find your soul entralled by your rivals...
The weapon master
The what-bringer? Oh, ASHbringer? Never heard of it... What? Stop bothering me!
The wind rider master
The winner of the drag race is...the gnome team!  Great job guys!
The world is indebted to you and your allies, $N.
The world will suffer immeasurable cruelties under my reign.
The worst is yet to come, $r.
The young races? The infants? Humans? Orcs? Dwarves? You expect to defeat the Hakkari? To destroy a GOD?
The zeppelin master

Their manifest forms weak from eons of battle, imprisoned beneath the world - the world that they themselves created - the corruption of the Titan Shapers would permeate through the surface and befoul the Old Gods.$B$BIt was then and there that the brothers did turn. For five millennia a battle was fought at the core of this world.

Their minds are now tainted, $r. Yes, even more so than before. They live only to serve and protect Razelikh. The amulet fragments they each hold are the key to summoning the demon lord. What you do not understand is that none of them can be harmed through any conventional means

Their minds are now tainted, $r. Yes, even more so than before. They live only to serve and protect Razelikh. The amulet fragments they each hold are the key to summoning the demon lord. What you do not understand is that none of them can be harmed through any conventional means.
Their spirits are restored! The gryphons are ready to strike! Come, soldiers! Come to my side!
Then Orgrimmar is where you need to go.  The north road out of Razor Hill leads directly there.  Just talk to one of the grunts there and they can give you further directions.
Then head over to Bena's Alchemy on the middle rise and talk to Bena herself.  She will be able to help you master the art of potion brewing.
Then it is Thelman Slatefist that you wish to speak to. You can find him in the presence of the King at Stormwind Keep.
Then it is to Taim Ragetotem that you must speak. Seek him out on the Hunter Rise.
Then it is with great pride that I tell you that Brakgul Deathbringer stands ready in the Hall of Arms to aid you on your way to Warsong Gulch. Seek him out in the Valley of Honor.

Then let us pretend that you undergo the long and arduous task of creating the bane necessary to break through the demonic wards placed upon the triad. What would be your next course of action? To face the Defiler in his lair?$B$B<Loramus laughs.>

Then listen well, $r.$B$BSeveral months ago, the Magistrate of Lakeshire sent envoys to Ironforge, pleading with the King for assistance with the Blackrock incursions coming from Redridge and the Burning Steppes.$B$BPrincess Moira volunteered to help, against my pleadings. I was assigned twenty elite guardsmen to protect the Princess through the perilous journey from the Loch to Lakeshire.
Then we must not waste anymore time. Are the chromatic dragonflight ready?
Then we must put an end to Athrikus Narassin. Tell me, spirit, where might we find the other soulgems, to undo his magic?
Then what?
There Scourge outside Trade Quarter!

There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.$B$BOne week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.$B$BOne week out of the year during the Spring, the Horde takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

There are many establishments where you can get a drink in Stormwind, but only one will let you spend the night. Head over to the Gilded Rose in the Trade District. I've heard the cost of a room is reasonable and the sheets are clean.
There are many obstacles one must overcome on the path to excellence. Your path is no exception...
There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil.  Tell me what you seek.
There are many secrets that may be unlocked with patience and determination. Now, let us begin...

There are plants in Felwood that may be saved from corruption when Cenarion plant salve is applied to them.  I know how to make the salve from several different kinds of items; based on your skill set, you may find that you have multiple options to assist me.$B$BYou will also need a Cenarion beacon for your work here; it is a device that allows you to see the taint and corruption of nature that the naked eye will miss.
There are quite a few trainers available in Elwynn.  Which one are you looking for?
There are those that attempt to follow the path of the Rogue, but only the night elves are truly embraced by the night.  If you seek to walk the shaded path then find Syurna in the Cenarion Enclave.

There are those that would teach you of Herbalism in the great home of Thunder Bluff away to the north.  Follow the road out of the village to get there and at the base of the bluff ride the elevator to the top of the rise.  There are many Bluffwatchers there who can direct you further.

There are two mines in Alterac: the Irondeep in Alliance territory and the Coldtooth mine in Horde territory.  Both mines are a rich source of minerals, and in the past were used to store excess supplies.$B$BNow, these mines are constantly fought over by the Horde, the Alliance and local denizens.

There are two potential results when the Earthen's synthesis matrix destabilizes.  Initiating visual aid representation number one.$B$BThe first variant matrix is a degenerative product of synthesis, hereby designated with the common nomenclature of "Trogg".  This variant maintains strength and stamina comparable to the Earthen, but its cognitive processing power has been almost completely compromised.  Force of will and a strong sense of cunning are the only driving factors in the psyche of the trogg.
There are ways to strengthen steel beyond the hammer and forge, young wanderer. Care to learn more?
There aren't any enchanters out here in Dun Morogh that I know of.  Ye're going to have to visit Ironforge if ye want to learn the enchanter's profession.
There comes a time when the life we know falls short.  We are trapped and look for answers, and we find hope burning in dark places.$B$BOnly then, $N, do we take our first steps to freedom.
There is a Blacksmithing Trainer in our great home Thunder Bluff to the north.  If you seek such knowledge then head there and ask one of the Bluffwatchers for directions.

There is a Wind Rider Master in the great city of Thunder Bluff to the north.  Ride the elevator from the base of Thunder Bluff to the top and ask one of the Bluffwatchers there for further instructions.
There is a large tent on the east side of Bloodhoof Village.  You will find Narm Skychaser awaiting you there.
There is a mailbox located conveniently right between the Stormwind Bank and The Gilded Rose Inn in the Trade District.
There is a mailbox outside of the Bank which you'll find in the center of Darnassus.
There is a pile of wrapped gifts here.

There is a powerful infernal named Kroshius northeast of this camp. It is why Niby is here. Kroshius is a greater infernal - an infernal that has lasted longer than expected. You see, nub, an infernal crashes down into the earth with great intensity to serve its master but this intensity fades fast. Once the blazing flames have died down, the infernal crumbles.
There is a symmetry in the idea of the hide of your enemy providing you with protection.  To further your leatherworking skills look for Una inside the Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.
There is a task I would like you to perform before we go any further...
There is a time and a place for all things, including relaxation.  On the west side of Bloodhoof Village Innkeeper Kauth maintains a long house for those who seek to rest.  You will find him there.
There is a wise one in the village who goes by the name Narm Skychaser.  He can continue your learning along the path of the Shaman.
There is always... Ashbringer.
There is an Engineering Trainer in Razor Hill.  He is called Mukdrak and can usually be found standing over near the forge.
There is an alchemist that lives up in the hills between Northshire and Stormwind that might be of some help.  Why don't you go pay him a visit?
There is bound to be a gnome in Stormwind that can teach you the profession.  I'm sure one of the Stormwind Guards could point you in the right direction.
There is more.
There is much work left to be done, $N! Continue to strike down our enemies!
There is no COW level... really! I repeat: there is no COW level. Well, maybe there is...
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the scourge's taint.
There is no escape!

There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff than Aska Mistrunner.  Mmmmm, I can smell what she is cooking from here.  Head over to her kitchen located on the high rise.

Drat... now I am hungry.
There is no greater way to clear the mind than to weave.
There is no hope!
There is no spoon.
There is no victory for you here! What little ground you've gained will be swallowed by the Scourge army in due course!
There is not a better tracker in these lands than Drayl.  He can be found on the Hunter Rise.

There is not much more to tell. Dalaran was nearly wholly destroyed by Archimonde, the staff lost, presumably shattered by the barrier's fail-safe mechanisms.$B$BThere are those that believe the staff to be the cause of Archimonde's reprisal.
There is nothing more that I can teach - now get out! And don't even think of approaching Saru, for one as unworthy as you he will use your blood to temper his steel.
There is one that I know of here in Thunder Bluff that can aid you in your journey to Alterac Valley. On the Hunter Rise look for Taim Ragetotem. May you find what you are looking for $N.
There is one whose knowledge exceeds my own. You are ready to seek her out. Go to Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. Find Hgarth, and continue your training.
There is only one Warchief, Eitrigg!
There is only one whose skills exceed my own. You are ready to receive her knowledge. She is Annora, and you may find her... in Uldaman.
There is something greater than magic at work in the night sky.  One day they'll listen to me. . . .
There it is -- Gadgetzan!  We're in the home stretch now!
There must be someplace on Azeroth that we can find oozes uncorrupted by the Scourge or anything else. But where?!
There walks a hero.
There we are, $N.  The Scroll is fixed!  Hooray!
There we are, $N.  The toxin is ready.
There we are.  A new batch of flash bombs!
There we go, all finished.  The journal has been translated for you.
There we go. All done!
There were hundreds imprisoned by his spell. Now only a few remain in their prisons. He would speak to us sometimes.
There you are. What news from Westfall?
There you go, $N. Good thing my powers of divination and summoning still work in this ghostly state, huh?
There you go. I need to get back to work before Rokar clouts me again for being lazy.
There you go...
There you have it! The King should be quite pleased, if I do say so myself.
There you have it. Our lesson on summoning has come to an end. A new class will begin shortly, so if you wish to brush up, feel free to stay around.
There! Job's done.
There! Now it just needs to be recharged...
There! Over there!
There'll be a new trade risin' up round your carcass, $N. We'll call it 'flesh-craftin.'

There's a Bat Handler inside the Undercity.  Head south down the road out of Brill, then west at the T-intersection.  The Ruins of Lordaeron will be on your left.  Go into them and then down into the Undercity.  You can ask an Undercity Guardian there for further assistance.
There's a Skinning Trainer in Orgrimmar.  To get there head north up the road out of Razor Hill.  Ask an Orgrimmar Grunt for directions when you arrive.

There's a great cook who works at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town.  I've watched him use a knife when he cooks and just between you and me, I don't think he's always been a cook.  Don't get me wrong... if you still want to learn, he's the best we have.
There's a mage at the Thunderbrew Distillery who might be able to teach you some new spells.  I believe his name is Magis Sparkmantle.
There's an excellent skinner that lives up in the house by Crystal Lake.  She's bound to be able to show you how to get started in the skinner's profession.
There's an herbalist that lives in the hills east of Stormwind with our alchemist. Quite the handy pairing don't you think?
There's enough work here for an army of orcs, and most of it, only I can do. Still, there is a job I could use a hand with.
There's no loitering, pan handling, cursing, fighting, or anything else you're thinking about doing, allowed in Caer Darrow.
There's no time to waste, trooper. I must get back to base immediately! Cover me!
There's no way you're gettin' out of here alive!
There's nothing I can teach you, other than maybe a better eye for color and detail. Talk to Simon Tanner over there; he knows a lot of advanced techniques for working with leather.
There's nothing like a little Lunar celebration to warm your bones!
There's nothing like some scalding mornbrew on a chilly Dun Morogh day to get things started right!
There's nothing more I can teach you. I've heard of a night elf who might be able to, though. Her name is Ainethil, and she lives in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.

There's nothing quite like communing with nature... or at least that's what the night elves tell me.  I'm not much for talking to flowers and trees, but I'm sure Tannysa could help you out.  She's over in the Mage Quarter outside of Alchemy Needs.
There's one in Orgrimmar.  A grunt up there will know what directions to give you.  Just head north up the road here, you can't miss it.
There's one in Orgrimmar.  Go north and talk to one of their grunts.
There's one of the Scourge, right over there!
There's one of those inside the barracks on the east side of Razor Hill.  Look for Rawrk.
There's one! For the Horde!
There's only one hunter around here I would have ye talk to, and that would be Grif Wildheart.  Ye'll find him standing just outside the smithy in Kharanos.
There's only one person I know of who is more learned in the art of tailoring than myself. Last I heard he could be found in Theramore Isle. He is the person you should seek.
There's something out there. Let loose a warning round!
There's the mystical tome I was looking for.
There, $N.  You may speak now speak to the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor.
There, I've got it!
There, it is done.  The book has been enhanced...
There, that should do it...
There, there, $N, worry not! Which piece of the amulet have you misplaced?$B$BDid you check all of your bags and the bank?
There.  I am finished with your robe, $N.
There.  It is done.
There... That should be enough rocks to make a necklace. I should probably get home now anyway.
There... that should help. Now, tell me what's happened, Grimclaw.
Theresa, take this to Father Lankester.
Therum Deepforge is the dwarf you want to talk to. One of the finest blacksmiths around if you ask me. You can find him in the heart of the Dwarven District.
These are dangerous times, $r.  An ancient evil is rising, and it cares not if you're Horde or Alliance.
These are dangerous times, adventurer. Walk lightly.
These are fine pieces, $N.  Let me get started on your robe.
These caverns were once a temple of promise for regrowth in the Barrens. Now, they are the halls of nightmares.
These dwarves are the same ones today, yes?  Do dwarves maintain any other links to the Earthen?
These fireworks sure make a nice BOOM, don't you think?
These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.
fa: این جانوران بزرگ راه‌هایی را می‌شناسند که پیاده پیدایشان نمی‌کنی. زود به مقصدت می‌رسانندت و شاید همان‌جا چیز تازه‌ای هم نشانت بدهند.

en: These heroics mean nothing, $c.  Your future is sealed and your soul is doomed to servitude!
These land lubbers are here for the reindeer!  Give 'em the shank!
These lands shall be cleansed!

These once beautiful woods suffer under a terrible curse!  Corrupting forces twist the life here into shadows of their former selves.  If you are not an agent of this corruption, then perhaps you can aid me in reclaiming Felwood!
These orders must get to High General Abbendis!
These piles of wood and straw may show mercy, but the Lich King won't!
These races are a great opportunity to show our ingenuity!
These shards give me the creeps.  Hey Greeby, did you find more motes?
These trees are quite glorious, aren't they?
These undead atrocities will be destroyed!
These undead rabble, and their dead-elf queen, will fall!
These woods make my tusks itch...
They all go to the Spire but none ever come back... just like Bijou.
They almost sent my brother, Loksey, to this gathering. He cannot even take care of his hounds, let alone represent the Scarlet Crusade in a competent manner.
They are doing well, sir. They should all make full recoveries.

They are exactly what you need to destroy in order to free the regiment! As I had told you earlier, Kirith had a plan.$B$BEach of the servants does have a weakness. Punish their physical form in proximity of their stones until they are near the state of disintegration. It is at that point, and that point alone, that the stones of binding are vulnerable to attack. You must hurry to destroy the stones, however, as once the enslaved regain their composure, they will be invulnerable to harm once more.

They are lost, $r. Librams written by the elven masters. Scattered across the world when the Scourge was unleashed upon Quel'Thalas.$B$BNow we search for these librams. Search to find the secrets they hold - to restore power once had.$B$BI search for the ten written by Master Kariel Winthalus. Should you find a libram, allow me to absorb its magical properties and for you I shall craft an amalgamation of power... of course, all things come at some cost. You will find my cost to be high; but pay you shall.
They called me stupid, but I'll show them. I'm going to watch every pot I have and prove that they can all boil stuff anyway. Yeah, I'm on a roll! Who's stupid now, huh? Huh!?
They hand the corpses to me, I toss them in the pit.
They have freed the human, Windsor, sire. It will not be long until Onyxia is uncovered.
They have you good on that one, lad!
They know how to throw a party here in Moonglade.  Who would have thought so?
They might have run all the other farmers off, but the Saldean's will never leave Westfall.
They must have had someone helping them.
They put these lanterns out to commemorate the closing of the Lunar Festival.
They say Duriel is a fierce night elf.  It'll be a good fight!
They say an army travels on its stomach, and that's the truth.  For any offensive to succeed, your troops have to be well-fed and well supplied.
They say he can turn into a raven sometimes.
They say that I am blessed: A herald to harken in a new age.
They say these fireworks use the power of the moon!
They teach me to sneak good.  You find them in Rogues' Quarter on outer ring of Undercity.
They thought I was weak.  Haha!!

They took off for Gadgetzan a while ago to bring us back some supplies.  Frankly, I would have given at least four of my fingers to have had the chance to crawl inside one of Dadanga's packs in order to leave this forsaken place.
They will live, if only to see the fruits of their labor: the destruction and chaos that will surely ensue as the legion of Blackrock invade the gorge.
They're going to show fireworks all night long.  From 6PM until dawn, the sky will blaze over Booty Bay!
They're going to show fireworks all night long.  From 6PM until dawn, the sky will blaze over Elune'ara!
They're here!
They're here! They're over here! Help me!
They's in Magic Quarter.  Look for them in scary skull building.
They've been stolen, $r! Three of our most prized volumes. Should you return the tomes, a reward will most certainly be yours.
Thieves! I shall smelt your remains!
Thieves! Scallywags! Rapscallions! Come face me gigantic pillas!
Think I'm starting to wear a rut in the paving stones.
Think him in Royal Quarter. Kurden Bloodclaw is little orc.
Think there are any fish in here?
Think you can come here and steal from us, huh!?
Think you the master is daunted by your games? We will never fall to you!
