This $C intrudes on our work! Die fool!
This $N has been driven mad from the corruption!
This $n is a minion from Naralex's nightmare no doubt!
This Dimensional Imploder sounds dangerous!  How can I make one?
This act of defiance will not go unpunished.  You, and your world, will die!
This ain't a ride, clem.  Beat it.
This beam of greater moonlight will send you to Darnassus.
This beam of moonlight leads to Stormwind.  Use your invitation when you're ready.
This beam of moonlight leads to the Undercity.  Retire when ready.

This bear wanders a path close to where the Talondeep Path lies, due west of Mystral Lake and the Alliance outpost of Silverwind Refuge.  While he is the easiest of the three creatures you will face on the Ashenvale Hunt, he should not be trifled with.  His presence is a constant threat to travelers who sojourn between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains.
This better be important!
This better be the last one!
This blue leather does draw the eye, I know. You see, we have a great many eager recruits running around here, hunting and slaying with more enthusiasm than wisdom. One must take precautions.
This blue light... It's strange, $N. What do you think it means?
This bridge isn't ever going to be finished, is it?
This bridge should have been destroyed by now.  How long does it take for those lazy sods to get here from the Highlands!
This can't be right. An Old God could never be allowed to enter this world. The results would be... Oh dear!
This cherry pie tastes so good, it could make a grown gnome cry.
This constant, annoying resistance is futile, you maggots! There will be nothing in the end but death!
This creature suffers from the effects of the fel... We must end its misery.
This cultist is in a deep trance...
This dark taint is downright bad for business.

This demonic entity is known as the Voidwalker. Its strength and endurance are significant, making it ideal for defense. Send it to attack your enemy, then use it as a shield while you use your spells and abilities to drain away your opponent's life.
This desert be mine!
This dock here?  Well you can catch the ship that goes to that Night Elf place.  What's it's name?  Uhh Auberdine I think.  I don't really know for sure, I just load and unload stuff.
This doesn't bode well.  Send scouts to gather more intelligence, and stay on alert.
This doesn't look good!
This doesn't look... right.  Look at how alien the desert is!  Going through here might be a terrible mistake.
This evil I have unleashed... In whose hand does the power my goddess granted to me now lie... By whose hand is it directed?
This evil cannot be allowed to enter this world!  Come my children!
This expedition is a terrible drain on military supplies.
This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.
This foul little beast is the imp. It is small and weak, making it almost useless as a meatshield, and its damage output is mediocre at best. This creature is best used for support of a larger group.
This frozen land shall suffice for a start.  Come to me, mortals - and I shall give you a quick and painful death.
This has gone too far.  How dare the Scourge attack Stormwind!  Destroy it before more come!
This has gone too far.  How dare the Scourge attack Undercity!  Destroy it before more come!

This here is the finest, most state of the art mode of transportation money can build. What? Deeprun Tram? Gnomes? Listen pal, If you believe that garbage then I've got a statue down in Stranglethorn to sell ya. Now, are you walking to Grom'Gol or are you gonna ride in style in this fine flying machine? Your choice.
This hide isn't ready to work with yet. I wish it didn't take so long to make leather. There has to be some way to cut down on all this waiting. It can't be good for my health, you know?
This is Dalin Forgewright. He fled from Lordaeron when the plague struck, taking his love with him.
This is Rigger Gizelton asking for assistance escorting my caravan past Mannoroc Coven. I'm on the road east of Shadowprey village.
This is a dangerous place, $N. Be careful around here.
This is a lot to think about.
This is a shiney rock, I'll put it in my bucket. Ok, I just need a few more...
This is all very interesting but what is it that you want?
This is an atrocity.
This is an exotic sample of flora, unseen in other parts of Teldrassil.
This is disheartening. Is there anything I can do to stop this?
This is disturbing. Please continue.
This is excellent work. Are you ready to undertake a mission on my behalf? I know of no one more qualified.
This is far enough! Meet me back at base!
This is gonna cost a bundle of gold. It's not comin' out of my pocket.
This is gonna leave a mark!
This is grim news, and I fear it is linked to the dealings $N had with the Embalmer.
This is holy ground, heathen.
This is it, Impsy. I can feel it! This is the big one!
This is my test gossip.

This is some specialized equipment! Don't be handling it carelessly, and of course don't try and operate the thing if you've had too much of that volatile rum I hear you like so much...$B$BSpeaking of which... you don't happen to have any of that nasty stuff, do you?
This is the Alterac Valley battlefield.  Both sides are still fighting.
This is the Alterac Valley battlefield.  Currently both sides are at odds.
This is the answer to the first question of the first chain.
This is the end of the line, no friend of mine!
This is the place, $r: The Cauldron! Mark it on a map or do something so that you don't forget. If anything ever happened to me, my team would be stuck in that mine forever.
This is the very first thing I say to the player.  Huzzah!
This is unforseen.  The being who enchanted this is known to me...
This is where I get off, suckers!
This is where things get interesting.  My plan is to follow the mountail wall, keeping it to our left.  That way, we won't get lost in the jungle and we'll cut down on the hostiles.  You ready?
This isn't a game you toy with youngling! Go, speak with Snarl outside. He may be a serpent in my lair but he does know his way around an anvil.
This isn't fair!  My dearest Sully!  Come back to me!  No, $n!  Why did you bring me such news!
This job is definitely not worth sixteen-five a year.

This just happens to be your lucky day; I just completed Super-Seller 680's maintenance. There are tons of items for sell at great low-low prices. Go ahead and see for yourself... my brother Cork thinks his Vendor-Tron 1000 will out sell my bot.
This kodo sure looks nothing like the beast I originally lured!  I wonder if the kombobulator can be used on me.
This land belongs to the Dark Iron Dwarves.  Prepare to see the afterlife, $C!
This land belongs to the Defias Brotherhood now!
This land is tainted. Ivus must be called!
This line is mostly filler...
This may come as a shock to you, but business hasn't been all that good as of late...
This moon beam will send you to Orgrimmar.  Use your invitation when you want to go.
This moonlight will send you to Ironforge.  But who'd want to leave this party?
This moonlight will take you to Thunder Bluff.  Use it when you want to leave the festival.

This nightsaber is rumored to be docile in the presence of night elves and their allies, which makes her an even more worthy opponent.  Shadumbra's hunting path takes her from the Raynewood Retreat to our west, ultimately to lands due west of there.  Her fur is the color of pitch, and her speed is not to be underestimated.
This one is slightly better than the last. However, it still suffers from the same flimsy bone structure as the others. When you summon one of these, you are on the right path.
This orchard is now as barren and lifeless as my rotting shell. Once these trees bloomed with fruit but now there is only rot.

This outfit really brings out the blue in my eyes, don't you think? It should be obvious I have plenty of skill to go around, so I can afford to share a few of my tricks of the trade. Listen up, okay?
This pie is so good, would you like some?
This place is safe for the Defias to take over! Get the others.
This place is under my protection. The mysteries of the arcane shall remain inviolate.

This place... it's cursed.$B$BI barely managed to escape, and I cannot bear to go down through the tunnels again.$B$BMy brother, and sisters though... They were not as fortunate. Trapped inside, they are feverish with the corrupted haze that flows from the evil garden growing there.$B$BPlease, you must help.
This plant stands out among the normal flora of Teldrassil, and emits a strange, purplish glow.
This potion seems to heal less damage every time I brew it, though I use the same ingredients. There can be only one conclusion: the plants are changing. I cannot say why or into what.
This should do it! At least it better do it!
This should ease the pain.
This should only take a moment, $N.
This shouldn't take long...
This sickness clouds my vision, but I know you must be a trogg.  Die foul invader!
This sounds like a task worthy of the new king!
This spirit hovers over its fallen body.  Its ghostly eyes pierce through you as it gazes beyond...
This statuette must hold a hidden compartment...
This stout sure smells strong!

This sun-blasted city is home to the Sandfury trolls, known for their particular ruthlessness and dark mysticism. Troll legends tell of a powerful sword called Sul'thraze the Lasher, a weapon capable of instilling fear and weakness in even the most formidable of foes. Long ago, the weapon was split in half. However, rumors have circulated that the two halves may be found somewhere within Zul'Farrak's walls.
This war has been an enormous drain upon our people and resources. Even here on Teldrassil, we cannot escape its repercussions. Forgive me for asking it of you, but would you perform a task for me?
This war's not over, it's only just begun!  We have brave men and women fighting our enemy inside Ahn'Qiraj day and night, $N.  It won't be long before the Qiraji city falls.

This was the Ashbringer, fool! As the Scourge began to materialize around us, Mograine's blade began to glow... to hum... the younger Mograine would take that as a sign to make his escape. They descended upon us with a hunger the likes of which I had never seen. Yet...
This was the site of a great battle.  Many great battles.
This week it could be eye of newt, or perhaps a treasure map. You'll never know unless you look. What could Antonio have?
This will be my best experiment yet!
This will do nicely.  Now to the task at hand!
This will take a while to heat up, so its time for a drink! What do you say Tongus?
This will work -- keep heading through this gap.  The path to Un'Goro is due west of here once we round these infernal bugs.

Thorfin Stoneshield came to us all the way from Ironforge to bring us his expertise in hunting.  If you don't mind breathing the smoke filled air of the Dwarven District then you'll find him at his house in the northeast area of the district.
Thorium Brotherhood or not, if one of them Dark Iron gets near to me they'll taste my mattock up the side of their head!  Now, where can I send ya $G lad : lass;?
Those days are over, Eris.

Those filthy beasts are all over the place.$B$BIf you prefer hunting outdoors, you'll find most of them around Plaguewood and Terrordale, with a good concentration of them in the Terrorweb tunnel. They are also likely to appear at almost any Scourge encampment in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BIf you're a hearty dungeon crawler, you'll find a good lot of them in Stratholme and a few of the necrofiend variety in Scholomance.
Those goblins should be ashamed of themselves.  Bah!
Those thieving elementals are up the path, this way.  Good luck, $N.
Though I find the cool grass which covers Teldrassil as good a bed as any, the beds which Saelienne keeps at the Inn in Craftsman's Terrace are quite suitable for those with a taste for luxury.

Though I hate to admit it, the bear did get the better of me. My oh my, that's one big ol' bear!$b$bNonetheless, if you can take that bear down, it'd be a feat to be proud of! It gave more than a few of our best hunters some trouble.$b$b<He claps you on the back.>$b$bBest the bear and we'll accept you as a regular member of the Farstrider Lodge.
Though I move on in peace, you all have my undying gratitude. Thank you for freeing me from the curse of my folly and greed.

Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.$B$BThe task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a temple my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.$B$BIf you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?
Thrall has shown great kindness in granting me sanctuary within his domain.  I do not wish to overstay my welcome, at any rate.  It would be a great dishonor if I brought any trouble to our leader.

Thrall's Grasp they called us: Twenty of Thrall's most accomplished and honored soldiers.$B$BI had ordered the regiment to build an encampment here, on the border of the Blasted Lands, while we waited for our orders to arrive from Orgrimmar. Weeks passed without word from the warchief; the men grew restless.$B$BIt was a judgment call, $N. I was young and ambitious, afraid of nothing. The battalion would set forth into the Blasted Lands under my command.$B$BA decision I would later regret.
Three cheers for $N -- Admiral o' the Bloodsail Bucaneer Navy!
Three cheers for $N!  This land shall be ours once again!
Throm'ka $c!  Are you ready to fight for the Horde at Warsong Gulch?

Throm'ka, $c. All of the war materiel is in final preparation and being sent to Silithus. It should arrive over the course of the next $2113w days. With the equipment readied, and our forces arrayed, all we will be waiting for is someone to ring the gong on the Scarab Dais, which should open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj and start the war.$B$BLok'tar Ogar!

Throm'ka, $c. All of the war materiel is in final preparation and being sent to Silithus. The last of it should arrive in less than a day. With the equipment readied, and our forces arrayed, all we will be waiting for is someone to ring the gong on the Scarab Dais, which should open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj and start the war.$B$BLok'tar Ogar!

Throm'ka, $c. You are here to help me with tin bars? They tell me that I will need $2006w so that they can make weapons and armor for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War, but I only have $2005w right now. You are going to bring me more!

Throm'ka, Horde $C, stand proud! I am Warlord Gorchuk, commander of the Horde's war effort. There are trying times ahead of us, but we shall prevail, as always.$B$BIf you have questions, you should ask them.
Throm-Ka, $c. My mood is poor this day, so please, unless you can help me, I would prefer to be alone.
Throm-ka! What you looking for, stranger?

Through my studies, I see that defeating the god Hakkar's avatar has weakened him.  But the bulk of his strength remains, lurking at the far end of the Nether.$B$BYou have defeated his avatar once, $N.  Perhaps if you defeat it again you can further weaken the god so that, one day, we might face his true self.$B$BI have prepared a spell that you may use to again summon an avatar of Hakkar within the Sanctum of the Fallen God.  Do you want to confront it once again?

Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?
Through the milennia, Ilyenia Moonfire has mastered numerous weapons and now offers to train others in their use.  You can find her at the Warrior's Terrace if you desire training.
Through the second turn it's the $n!
Thurman my brother, who's laughing now?  Hah!
Thuwd will show you how to skin your kills.  Look for him at Kodohide Leatherworkers in The Drag.
Ticket redemption here!  Get your tickets turned into prizes!  Step right up!
Tickets! Redeem your Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets here!  Wondrous and exotic prizes are waiting for you!
Tilloa is that you?  Why no!  It's just some dirty $r!
Time for my patrol.  I'll be back shortly.
Time for the Gizleton Caravan to head on out! We'll be back soon but if you cannot wait, head north to Kormek's Hut. We open shop in about an hour.
Time is running out for me... for us all...
Time to bash!
Time to brew up a Kalimdor Kocktail! Hiccup!
Time to die, $C.
Time to get back to the shop...
Time to gore...
Time to join us, $c.
Time to learn ya about manners, $g sonny:lass;.

Time to relax, the Alliance be way behind us mon. We all done with our collectin' here, and the final polishes be goin' on things as we speak. When they get done over in their Ironforge, then we be thinkin' 'bout movin' all this stuff to Silithus. 'Til then, sit tight and maybe do some fishin'.
Time to save the entire gnomish race. Here goes nothing!
Time to take out the trash!
Times have changed. The young races will join us. You will never succeed.
Times like these get me all sentimental...
Tiny $C!  You are no match for the Blackrock Clan!
Tiny mortals - me HERE! Doom you meet!
Tips are always graciously accepted, friend.
Tired of all those pansy spellcaster drinks? Try something stronger at the Pig and Whistle!
Tis a good day to live, neh? Hard work and good food-- there are worse things we could be doing on such a beautiful day.
To Malyfous, I assume.
To arms!  Scourge spotted in the Cathedral of Light!
To come this far has not been easy, I know. But how boring life would be without challenges, don't you think? Good, because I have a challenge for you...
To die today, on this field of battle, is to die an orcish death. To die today is to die for our little ones. Our old ones. Our ... loved ones.
To get down safely, I provide wings to those in need.

To honor your elders is to honor your culture and your people, $c.  For this, the Coins of Ancestry serve as a tangible means to recognize those who choose to follow a venerable path of respect.$B$BDuring this Lunar Festival, you may have the opportunity to honor many elders.  As you do so, you will acquire the Coins of Ancestry.  Bring me these coins, and I will reward your diligence with a selection of unique items.

To learn to be one with Nature in the eyes of the Earth Mother, this is a matter of pride.  If your will is to learn the ways of the Hunter you must seek out Yaw Sharpmane at the north end of Bloodhoof Village.
To learn to cure leather and work with hides go to Orgrimmar to the north.  One of the Orgrimmar Grunts will be able to tell you the way to the Leatherworking Trainer.
To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.
fa: برای حفظ پیوندمان با سرزمین اصلی، هیپوگریف‌ها همیشه میان {{zn:Rut'theran Village|روستای روتران}} و {{zn:Darkshore|دارک‌شور}} در پروازند.

en: To me, my servants!
To reach The Crossroads, $N, follow the road east then north.
To reach the Rut'theran Ferry, you will need to travel to Darnassus and take the portal to Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil.

To summon a Dreadsteed, you must first create a Circle of Greater Summoning.  A portal to Xoroth may only be created from within such a circle.$B$BThe Circle of Greater Summoning requires three powerful implements: a Bell of Dethmoora, a Wheel of the Black March and a Doomsday Candle.
To win this war, we can't sit idle and let the tides sweep us over.  We must strike, hard and fast, or Arathi will never again be ours.
Today, you will meet your ancestors!
Together, the two parts shall become one, once again.
Toil not in matters of the past, $N!
Tomas may not be the best cook around, but he has a few dishes that hit the spot.  He's currently working in the Lion's Pride Inn if you'd like to learn the profession.
Tomorrow we will begin training of our promising dragons, so don't forget your chew toys.
Tonight, your blood will run red on the stones of our altars.
Too bad we can't skin the humans and their allies. All that skin is just going to waste. Still, who'd want to wear the flimsy leather you could make out of it?
Too easy.
Too little, too late. The dam has broken. We are a bump in the road at best.
Too many have fallen, $g priest:priestess;. You must focus!
Too much time has passed. We must try again later.
Tormil, Gamlor, Shefferd, Cowry...
Torture me no more!  Release me, mortal!  The Swamp of Sorrows... mortal... please...
Touch the Suntara stone and call forth Lathoric the Black and his guardian, Obsidion.
Touche...

Tower Point East holds the pass between the Field of Strife and Horde territories to the south.$B$BIt is controlled by neither side.The East Frostwolf Tower protects the gate between Frostwolf Village and Frostwolf Keep.$B$BIt is controlled by neither side.

Tower Point East holds the pass between the Field of Strife and Horde territories to the south.$B$BIt is controlled by the Alliance.The East Frostwolf Tower protects the gate between Frostwolf Village and Frostwolf Keep.$B$BIt is controlled by the Alliance.

Tower Point East holds the pass between the Field of Strife and Horde territories to the south.$B$BIt is controlled by the Horde.The East Frostwolf Tower protects the gate between Frostwolf Village and Frostwolf Keep.$B$BIt is controlled by the Horde.
Tower Point holds the pass between the Field of Strife and the Horde territories to the south.$B$BIt is controlled by the Alliance.
Tower Point holds the pass between the Field of Strife and the Horde territories to the south.$B$BIt is controlled by the Horde.
Tower Point is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will destroy it!
Tower Point is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will destroy it!
Tower Point was destroyed by the Alliance!
Tower Point was taken by the Horde!
Track down Shim'la at the south entrance to the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor.
Tracking

Tracking is it?  Then Denmul Farmountain is the one you should pay a visit to.  He'll teach ye the tricks of the trade like no other.  

Just head south from the gates of Ironforge to The Military District to find him.
Tragic...

Tragically, it was Thrall's wisdom that finally sealed the bond between the demon lord and his minions. It was Trebor's regiment that served as the catalyst to unite the demon lord, the shadowsworn sects and the ogres. The lure of nearly unlimited power and the granting of immortal shock troops to each respective leader sealed the deal in blood.
Train me in the ways of the beast.
Train me.
Transcribe the tablet.
Transport me to the Molten Core, Lothos.
Travelers and adventurers make haste to the town circle and take advantage of Antonio's wonderful prices! Come one, come all!
Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

Tresa Farmountain has seen her share of bad weather, but with her knowledge of Survival skills she's come through with her spirits high.  

She's over in The Military Ward south of the gates of Ironforge if you wish to speak with her.
Trick or Treat!
Troggs?!  Are the troggs you mention the same as the ones in the world today?
Trok are you hungry? I'm making some food for us to eat!
Troll mojo da strongest mojo!
Troublesome whelps. I'll teach you to interfere!
True mastery must be earned! It is up to you to earn it now...
Truffles!
Truly amazing, Gerard. How did you do it?

Truly, I envy you: To battle in the name of the Horde, at the forefront of conflict. Mine is a job of command.$B$BCertainly, in my youth, I lived out the dreams that make my old age bearable. I now revel in the glory of victory, the bitter taste of defeat - all through the soldiers I command.
Try again!
Try and make yourself useful, $r. GET ME OUT OF HERE! The High Interrogator has the key.
Try not to draw too much attention, I'm waiting for the King to grant me audience.  Not that I mind waiting, I feel pretty safe around all these burly guards.
Try some of this cherry pie, it will put a smile on your face, ten miles wide.
Try these fireworks launchers.  They're a blast!
Trying to find out more about my predicament has been nearly impossible.  The smuggler that hired us has vanished and Anthion Harmon, our mercenary company's leader, is dead.
Trying to find out more about these creatures hasn't been easy.  My friend and the person who hired his mercenaries to steal Lord Valthalak's spellbook have both been feared dead for a while.

Tucked away in the Mage Quarter, there is a little shop called Alchemy Needs.  You're bound to see all sort of strange shops on your way through the Mage Quarter, but if you stick to the outer rim you'll be sure to find it.
Turn back! Do not wake the dreamer!
Turn that frown upside down!
Turn the key to start the machine.
Two words: Arcanite buoy.
Tyrande sends her prayers. The Mother Moon blesses us all.
Uggel
Ugh!  That's terrible!
Ugh! Being on your feet all day is no way to make a living. I should have been a tailor.
Ugh! What is that scoundrel doing sending his vermin to me? Get out of my sight before I take what is left of your life. And take this with you.
Ugh... these pests keep me busy night and day! Haven't you seen them?$B$BI wish I could just jump down a pipe to get away from them...
Uh huh.  Unholies in War Quarter standing around main building on outer ring of city.
Uh oh!  I'm out of here!
Uh oh! My tools' have run out. We're going to have to start over...
Uh oh...
Uh oh... this is bad.
Uh oh....
Uh... Father...?  Are you there?  I'm hungry... can I have some stew?
Uh... I sorry I attack you boss.  You no kill me, please OK!?  You da king now, and I help make your tribute better!
Uh... the disease is potent.  And it attacks the mind...
Uldaman
Uldaman can be found at the very northern end of the Badlands.

Uldaman is an ancient Titan vault that has laid buried within the earth since the world's creation. Dwarven excavations of the city have recently released the Titans' first failed creations: the troggs. Legends say that when the Titans deemed the trogg experiment a failure they tried again, resulting in the creation of the dwarven race. These secrets are recorded on the fabled Discs of Norgannon - massive artifacts that lie at the bottom of the ancient city, protected by giant constructs of living stone.

Uldum is a research facility for the Creators in their continuing efforts to enhance the biosphere of Azeroth.  Specific information regarding their work as it relates to Uldum is restricted to those individuals who possess the Plates of Uldum in their disc sets.$B$BData repositories inside the Uldum complex have been programmed to address specific experiments and data compilations; please refer to them for detailed information.
Um, I'm taking some prisoners we found outside before the king for punishment.
Um, Ozzie... that doesn't look very safe.
Um, hello!  If you are here about fee collection and/or a summons, then you must have me mistaken for someone else.  Terribly sorry!
Um, you already know everything I could teach you. Maybe it's time for you to talk to someone else. Try the night elf Ainethil in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. She's got some real talent!
Um, you kill king, yeah?  That means you take his place.  That make you da new boss!  Hail to da king!
Um... I think you're a little too big to ride a Mechano-strider there, $g mister : ma'am;.  You'd likely crush the finely tuned servo-balancers!
Um... sorry to bother you, but could I see Goodsteel's ledger again... if you're not using it.
Umi sent you, didn't she?! She told me to expect a surprise, but I never thought that this is what she meant!

Un'Goro Crater be far to the south of Kalimdor. Beyond the Thousand Needles in Tanaris. Look for the large floating stones... they mark the entrance to the Crater. But be careful... it is no easy path. The raptors are not far from the entrance.
Unbelievable! How dare they??
Undead are crawling all over the land.  Where is the Stormwind Army?
Under the cover of darkness.
Understood. I will return shortly.

Unexpected that you are all capable of such organization. Both the Alliance and the Horde have completed their preparations for the Ahn'Qiraj War. Even as we speak the materiel is being shipped over to Silithus and should all arrive within $2113w days. Then it is up to the one who is going to reassemble the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to beat on the gong at the Scarab Dais and open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj. That is when the war will truly begin!

Unexpected that you are all capable of such organization. Both the Alliance and the Horde have completed their preparations for the Ahn'Qiraj War. Even as we speak the materiel is being shipped over to Silithus and should all arrive within a day. Then it is up to the one who is going to reassemble the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to beat on the gong at the Scarab Dais and open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj. That is when the war will truly begin!

Unfortunately we do not have one who teaches Tailoring here in Bloodhoof Village, but you can find a trainer in Thunder Bluff.  Follow the path north out of the village until you come to a set of elevators.  Take one up to the top of the rise and ask one of the Bluffwatchers there for directions.
Unfortunately you are not yet strong enough to survive in Warsong Gulch, $c.

Unfortunately, the night elf defense was untenable and Rajaxx knew that they could not hold out much longer. Their tenacity, however, was causing great frustration to Rajaxx and causing even more frustration to his king. Wait, kings? Incredible...
Unfortunately, there is little I can teach someone with your experience, my friend. Seek out the night elf Sylvanna Forestmoon, who resides in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.
Uni-brow
Unknown life forms detected....assessing...
Unleash the cavalry!
Unless?
Unlike most ogres, I do know what an outhouse is for - giving you a swirlie.  Now beat it.

Unpleasant place, this "Undercity". Not at all like the Lordaeron of old. How I miss it...$b$bIf you're looking to go to Stratholme, I'm afraid I'm unable to assist at the moment. The towers nearby the burning city are still in contention, and as such my powers are far too weak to aid you. Return to me once you're victorious there.
Until then, I shall take my leave...
Until we meet again, brave one.
Until what, Eva? I must know.
Upgrade to champion units!
Upgrade to seasoned units!
Upgrade to veteran units!
Upperdeck Promotion - Landro Default
Us have skinning hook.  We get it from Killian Hagey who teach us how to skin kills.  You have nice skin.  You find him on inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.
Us hear and obey.
Us know her good.  She Mary Edras at inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.
Us know where they are!  Skull building in Magic Quarter on outer ring of city.
Us need check to see if our Brain... Brain... Brain Hacker sold at auction.  You find mailbox next to inn on upper ring of Trade Quarter.
Us see balloon north of ruins up above.  It take you to far off places.
Us think you need help.
Us want felhound for pet.  We feed it and treat it good and teach it play fetch.  You find Warlocks in Magic Quarter on outer ring of city.
Us want lots of pets.  Anya Maulray help you take care of them.  You find her at inn, upper ring of Trade Quarter.
Use 8 necrotic runes and disrupt his ritual.
Use engineering to access hidden schematics!
Use staff, tell Raze what do! Show Raze poacher! Raze smash!
Use this Staff of Command on Raze when you are near Shadowsilk Poachers and he will make them rue the day they decided to poach in these lands.
Use your tonk action bar above your standard action bar to attack other tonks.

Using the fruits of the Earth Mother to create potions to aid us in our eternal struggle is an honorable endeavor.  To learn of this you must travel north to our great home of Thunder Bluff.  When you arrive at the top seek out the assistance of one of the Bluffwatchers for more specific directions.
Usurper?
Uthrok make gud shot
Vaelastrasz, no!!!
Vaelastrasz, when this world belongs to the black flight, your flight shall know its end.

Valstann Staghelm served as the right hand of Fandral. A proud and noble warrior, his dedication and adoration for his father unyielding... and the Twin Emperors sensed this as weakness. A weakness that could be exploited.

Valstann, eager to please his father, convinced Fandral to allow him to take a small battalion to the defense of Southwind. Surely with the tide of battle turning their way, no harm could come to his beloved child. The trap was missed. Valstann was captured by the hiding Qiraji and Southwind Village obliterated. Rajaxx himself would take the captive Valstann to the front lines of the battle where - in front of Staghelm and the night elf forces - he would brutally execute the young night elf.
VanCleef pay big for you heads!
VanCleef sends word that the plans are underway. But he's heard rumors about someone snooping about.
Vanndar Stormpike is the general of the Alliance military in Alterac, and directs his forces from Dun Baldar.$B$BIf he is defeated then the Alliance will surely lose the battle for Alterac.

Vanndar Stormpike is the general of the Alliance military in Alterac, and directs his forces from Dun Baldar.$B$BIf he is defeated then the Alliance will surely lose the battle for Alterac.$B$BVanndar is not currently in Alterac Valley.
Vanndar is here.  Come on, hordelings!  Show me what you got!
Vek'nilash and Vek'lor, known as the Twin Emperors of Ahn'Qiraj, watched the war from the sanctuary of their temple. The clever brothers devised a plan to demoralize and divide Staghelm's forces.
Vengeance shall be mine.
Very few seek me out... What may I do for you?

Very fine equipment you make, very fine indeed. Go to the Orc's home of Orgrimmar and seek out a smith named Saru Steelfury. One thing you must give the Orcs, they make beautiful instruments of death.
Very good, $N.  You will find Grizzle Halfmane in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity.  May you find great honor in Alterac Valley.
Very good.  Our supply cache grows...
Very good.  You are relieved, private.  Rest, but don't get too comfortable.  Kurzen won't leave us alone forever.
Very interesting!
Very interesting. But if that's the case then my theory is wrong. I must reread the other sections to see what I missed.
Very nice, Gerard. Next you will be breeding them.
Very sad to think what has befallen those poor undead souls.  You can find Archmage Shymm reflecting near the Pools of Vision under the Spirit Rise.

Very well then...$B$BYou have been tasked by your liege to guard his fields of corn from poachers and thieves.  One night on patrol, you stumble across a haggard man in thread-bare clothing stealing corn from the field.  You quickly confront him, and he immediately begs for his life.  He claims he is stealing the corn to feed his family since the lord of the land - your liege - demands too much in taxes.  Your liege is indeed known for his harsh taxes throughout the land.$B$BMake your choice.
Very well, $N. I will use the Nightmare object to conjure forth Eranikus.
Very well, Proudtusk, you may begin your march. Carry on!
Very well.  Since you didn't buy me out I am forced to make my livelihood in your enemies' town.
Very well. I will return then.
Vesprystus' hippogryphs will bear you swiftly to your destination.  Seek him out in Rut'theran Village, through the portal which lies in the western section of Darnassus.
Veteran units are entering the battle!
Victory for the Horde!
Victory! For Agamaggan!
Vile goblins... anything for a gold coin.
Vira Younghoof keeps her practice inside the long house on the west side of the village.
Vorfalk
Vrok said the sights are off on Grumlar's gun. I suppose I should check it.
WAAAHHH!!!
WHO DARES SUMMON LOKHOLAR?
WHO DARES?! You shall be destroyed!
WHO KILL GOR'TESH!?!? WHO DO THIS?!
WHY is he in Blackrock Depths?
WOOT! Made it!
Wahehe! I'm taking you down with me!
Wailing Caverns
Wait here, $N. Spybot will make Lescovar come out as soon as possible. Be ready! Attack only after you've overheard their conversation.
Wait!  It appears our lookout has spotted something.
Wait!  What am I thinking!  We have a job to do with this stuff.
Wait, $n!!! It looks like we're going to need some help here...
Wait... did you hear that? Something approaches from the west!
Wait...you are not my husband.  But he must have sent you.  And you...look..delicious!
Waiting to crush the life from our little ones. To slay all in their path. This they do for their god.
Wake up!
Wanna buy a cockroach?
Wanna race again? Best two out of three!
Want to be a smith? Want to forge blades to gut your foe? Hammers to crush his skull? Aye I can help, and gladly too if there is blood to be shed from it.
Want to learn leatherworking, eh? Simon Tanner would be able to teach you. He can be found in Old Town at the Protective Hide.
Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.
War Riders are now ready! Soldiers of the Horde, I need your assistance.

War is a bloody, messy ordeal full of pain, suffering and death. But those that survive come back with a new respect for life. Not to mention a collection of stories to tell around the bar, full of bravery and courage. So tell me $g lad : lass;, are you here to make some stories? or just to hear some of mine?
War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

Warchief Thrall himself asked me to come out here. I was honored to obey, and it's no hardship. I couldn't have asked for a better posting than Stonard. Just about any herb I might need grows in the muck here.
Wares for sale! Wares for sale! Come browse Antonio's wares before I must take my leave, citizens of Goldshire.
Warg looks over the water appraising what his luck might be today.
Warg, are you about ready to eat? I am gonna get it started.
Warlock
Warlock trainers in Magic Quarter in building on outer ring with Mages.
Warlocks, eh.  Well, you didn't hear it from me, but I've heard rumors that those types gather at a bar called the Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter.
Warlocks... I don't care for their lot.  Like that Grimrizz who's set up shop outside the Thunderbrew Distillery. The ale will probably go flat there because of him!  Warlocks... bah!
Warm, wholesome bread!
fa: نان گرم و خوش‌خوراک!

en: Warmaster, I have lost my insignia. Could you supply me with a replacement?
Warning! Warning! Intruder alert! Intruder alert!
Warrior
Warrior trainers fight good.  You find them in War Quarter on outer ring of Undercity.
Warriors can usually be found either at the Pig and Whistle Tavern or the Barracks in Old Town. Tell ya though, the tavern is probably a better place look.
Warriors of the night... Assemble!
Warriors, I know you can hit harder than that! Lets see it!
Warsong Gulch
Warsong Gulch you say? Well then, you'll be wanting to speak with fair Lylandris over in the Hall of Arms.
Was that the third or fourth time you nearly got me gutted trying one of your crazy stunts?

Was this fated, Windsor? If it was death that you came for, then the prophecy has been fulfilled. May your consciousness rot in the Twisting Nether. Finish the rest of these meddlesome insects, children. Bolvar, you have been a pleasurable puppet.
Wasn't that the night we had to pick up my thumb and carry it in your smoke pouch?
Watch as the blood seeps into the snow, children. The elemental will be bound to us!
Watch my back, this could get real messy.
Watch out for the $N!
Watch where you're stepping, $c, because I have a polymorph spell with your name on it...
Watch your back, stranger.
Watch your step in here, $gboy:girl;.  The master sees all...
Watch your step out there.  Many an adventure seeker has not returned from the marsh.  hic!

Watch your step, $r. We of the Brotherhood of the Light are not as lenient as our brethren when it comes to meting justice to those that would do this world wrong.$B$BWoe unto those that would anger Korfax.$B$BNow if you have no business with me or the other members of the Brotherhood, please leave so that we may continue our meeting.

Watch your step, soldier. The Stormpike have littered the ground around their bases with landmines. Speak with our explosives expert in the watch tower to the east if you want information on how to diffuse their mine fields.
Watch your step, stranger. We do not allow miscreants in our town.
Watch your step...
Watch, druid. The earth still breathes. It yearns to be cleansed.
Watcher, inform Althea that a dire threat is marshalling against our town.  We must prepare!
We Timbermaw can grant you safe passage through the hold, however, you must prove yourself worthy of our aid.
We a lot cleaner than da ogres in Tanaris.  All over da desert as far as da eye can see - ogre poo.  Not here, no $g sir : ma'am;!

We already have a winner for our contest, but Jang is willing to purchase any Tastyfish that you have fished up!

There is always next Sunday for you to show your Angling skill!
We am free! Thank you little, puny ones.
We are all drawn here for different reasons, $c.$B$B<Rayne smiles.>$B$BI am here to meet with Rimblat of the Earthen Ring. He has some interesting theories on cleansing these lands.

We are all pieces of a much larger puzzle, $N. Just as you guide the piece of a puzzle to its destination, so too are we guided by another.$B$BAnd perhaps they who guide us are themselves guided by an even greater force.
We are betrayed!
We are but darkness and shadows. Eternal. Invisible.
We are dominating the Scourge - the effects of the altered plague will affect them for at least another full day!  We need to stay on top of it though, so be sure to sabotage a cauldron when you can.
We are having difficulty determining the status of the plague within the area; check back shortly and we may have a better idea.
We are quite safe from your pitiful band!
We are the arm of His will.  And we will crush His foes into grave dust!

We are the last of the furbolg race... The Timbermaw tribe remains uncorrupted, yet we face the same hostility from outsiders; most believe that it is not possible... that there could actually be furbolg that escaped the corruption...$B$BAngry at those that strive to make enemies too quickly, my brethren now attack any that draw near; they trust no one.$B$BBut perhaps, if you strive to make your presence peaceful with them, they might look upon you as an ally.
We are the only supplier of healthy flowers in all of Stormwind. We provide beautiful blooms for any occasion.
We are under direct orders from Cairne, $r. Do not interfere with the Commander's task.
We are under siege!  To arms!  Kill this $N!

We are united in cause, $r. An ancient evil threatens to extinguish all life on Kalimdor and consume the world with its depravity... Its hatred of all things born of the great Shapers: The eternal Titans.$B$BWe are the first and the last lines of defense against the armies of C'Thun. If we do not rise up and strike at our enemy, our enemy will surely destroy us.$B$BThe war effort needs you!
We await a batch of black dragon eggs from the Burning Steppes.  We believe that, through their study, we will advance our knowledge dramatically.
We barely have any excess supplies.  It'll take a lot more work before we're ready to send another ground assault into the Field of Strife.
We barely have any supplies to build Frostwolf Keep.  We'll need many, many more before we can repair our base and reenter the battle.

We broke up afterward, that's what happened. Too much bad blood, I guess...it had been building for a while. And the thing with the amulet was the straw that broke the kodo's back.$B$BEver since then Valthalak's servants have been picking us off one by one. Most of the amulet piece holders are dead, their souls corrupted by the portion of Valthalak's spirit contained within it.$B$BThat's why I'm glad that you're here, $N. With your help we'll be able to recombine the amulet and return it to Lord Valthalak!

We burn the effigy of the Wickerman as a symbol of our struggle against those who would oppose us.  We wear the ashes of the burnt Wickerman as a symbol of our neverending fight against those who would enslave us.
We call him Smiling Jim...
We can make it better, stronger, faster. We have the technology. We have the magic.
We can now rebuild!  For the Horde!
We can only stay a few moments before returning to the tower. If you wish to speak to us more you may find us there.

We cannot afford to give an inch in this war. Day and night, I create new armor, and I patch whatever can be salvaged from the old. I have no time for other tasks. Would you take care of something for me?
We chose to leave the protection and comfort of the Depths to exploit... er, I mean... hrm, yes that's right, EXPLORE the world.
We come destroy puny ones!
We could certainly use another cook around Dolanaar, not that Zarrin's cooking is lacking mind you.  Why don't you go see what he can teach you?
We defend. We stand. We show that as one. United. We destroy. Their god will fall.

We did this for about six months and watched as the house went through horrifying changes. Foul monsters roamed through the manor at will. Dark cultists populated every inch with various paraphernalia relating to rituals and sacrifices. We knew that we could not hide much longer.$B$BAs expected, we were found and captured. They stripped us of all our clothes and laid us out inside a circle of blood. We sat there for days, naked and terrified.
We didn't hide this stuff just you could steal it!

We do not know.$B$BThe Dark Irons that did survive made their way into the mountain and began rebuilding their city.$B$BFrom the ashes of Thaurissan then rose Blackrock Spire and the new Dark Iron nation. Additional fortifications were made within the Searing Gorge, in the area known as the Cauldron.$B$BStories of an ancient evil that controlled the kingdom of Dark Irons began to circulate.
We don't get many visitors out here. May I interest you in something?

We don't have a bank here in Brill, you'll have to go to the Undercity for that.  At the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south are elevators that will take you down into the Undercity.  Once there ask one of the Undercity Guardians for more precise directions.
We don't have many supplies for rebuilding.  It will take a lot more before Dun Baldar will be repaired.
We don't have time to talk!  We have to think about those trolls!

We don't know much about the burning of the Shady Rest Inn, except that James Hyal's wife and child were unable to escape.$b$bWe managed to drag James out, but he hasn't been the same since.$b$bWe have many leads but not much evidence. It is our hope that through the efforts of the guard and the vigilant help of the people of Theramore, we will unravel this terrible crime.$b$bIf you would like to lend assistance to the investigation, what remains of the inn can be found at the border to the Barrens.
We don't take kindly to miscreants, $r.
We feel nothing. Our souls remain here, in limbo. We are unable to leave until our remains are found and spirits laid to rest.

We finally understood what the screams were from. The Butcher exposed us to pain that we did not know existed. He used us in countless experiments, attempting to devise a plague.$B$BThe days turned to weeks. We would have died on the first day had it not been for that cruel bastard keeping us alive through magical means.
We grow strong, while our foes are surrounded by foes, and weakened by constant attacks.
We have a large store of supplies to rebuild Frostwolf Keep.  Just a little bit more and we'll have enough to repair and reenter the battle!
We have a medium store of supplies for rebuilding, but we still need a lot more before Frostwolf Keep can be fully repaired.
We have a very small store of supplies to rebuild Frostwolf Keep.  It's going to take a lot more before we can repair and reenter the battle.
We have a winner!  $N is the Master Angler!
We have all been witness to terrible tragedies, but we must not let them drag us to despair.$B$BInstead, hold those memories close so that one day, we might find a reckoning.
We have all the copper bars that we need. Thank you for your assistance, $c. You might wanna help out with the other materials being collected here.
We have almost all the silithyst we need!  Don't stop now!
We have auction house in central ring.
We have barely any supplies.  If we want to send a ground assault into the Field of Strife, then we'll need a lot more!
We have begun to turn the Scourge's plague against them, but our hold is tenuous at best!  Be sure to aid the cause by subverting their cauldrons!
We have done it, $N!
We have enough supplies to launch a ground assault.  If you want to deliver those orders, and you think you qualify, then speak with Corporal Noreg Stormpike.
We have enough supplies to launch a ground assault.  If you want to send the order, and you think you qualify, then speak Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl.
We have enough supplies!  Our captain has retaken position in the Field of Strife!
We have gathered a lot of supplies for rebuilding, but we still need a lot more in order to repair Dun Baldar.  Keep bringing me supplies!
We have gathered enough hides from the wolves. Soon, the cavalry will be ready to ride! Speak to me again when we have stabled enough rams.
We have half of our needed silithyst.  We can do it!
We have half our needed silithyst.  Don't stop now!
We have heard your requests, and we agree... it is noble in intent. We will purify your waters. Go with our blessing, shaman.
We have lots of supplies for rebuilding.  Just a little bit more and we'll have enough to repair Dun Baldar and reenter the battle!
We have more than one enemy in Silithus, $N.$B$BWhile everyone's attention is focused on the silithid, my big brother and I have been keeping a close eye on the Twilight's Hammer crazies.

We have no such place in the village.  The soaring heights of Thunder Bluff does though.  Head north up the road out of Bloodhoof Village until you come to the base of the bluffs.  There ride the elevator to the top and speak with a Bluffwatcher.  May your ancestors watch over you.
We have one eye and see better than you!  Bank in center of Undercity!
We have one quarter of our needed silithyst! Keep it up!
We have only a small foothold on this continent for now, but the humans can't fight us off forever. Then they'll pay for enslaving us. We'll cut their lying tongues out for their treachery.
We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

We have seeded Darkmoon Cards around the world to see if any worthy individuals could complete a set of any of the four suits.    If you manage to collect all eight cards of one of the suits we will reward you with one of the Greater Darkmoon cards that functions as a powerful trinket as well as a link to the Darkmoon Faire.
We have to kill more trolls!  Kill enough and I'll blow the door to the troll chief!
We have used bows since before even my father's time. They are solid and sure and take down our foes swiftly. I see no reason to use the guns that the goblins and tauren seem so fond of.
We have won $2219W battles against the Scourge.  Gird yourself, $N, for this war is far from over.
We have won $2219W battles against the Scourge.  Stand firm, $N!  We must persevere!
We have won $2219W battles against the Scourge.  Take heart, $N.  While many battles lie ahead, heroes, heroes from every realm have risen to fight them.
We have yet to meet our quota for the wood demand.  Now back to work with you.
We haveone quarter of the needed silithyst! Keep it up!
We help you find them.
We hunger for vengeance.
We join guild?  No?  Ok, you find Guild Master on east platform in Trade Quarter.

We live and die, and the land remains, eternal, unmoved by our passage. Thus, land cannot belong to us, $N. Instead, we belong to it. Therefore we protect the land, for without it we cannot hope to survive.
We live in a world of endless tragedy.
We live only to serve the ancient one. DIE INTERLOPER!
We lost this time but don't let it get you down. Concentrate on your special attacks. Keep your shield high and close. Do this and next time victory will be ours!
We made it through the pass!  Now we have the swamp...
We made it to Nethergarde!
We made it!  Thanks, $N.  I couldn't have gotten here without you.
We may have been suffering a drought but there's no shortage of meat! Care to browse my goods?

We most definitely do not need anymore attention drawn to us, stranger. Return to those that sent you in search of the lost master and tell them that nothing could be found. When this is done - and I will know when it is so - return and I shall reveal the secrets of the deceased.
We must be close, Commander. I can feel the elements stirring.
We must be vigilant to eradicate this plague!

We must eliminate the elves and their cowardly Alliance from Warsong Gulch. Go to the Hall of the Brave in the Valley of Honor and speak with Brakgul Deathbringer if you have what it takes to aid the Horde.
We must ensure the survival of this camp at all costs, $c!  Our enemies must not be given any quarter, for they would surely give us none were we to need it.
We must focus if we are to spawn our dragonflight!
We must focus our thoughts upon the Circle of Calling if the Forest Lord is to come! We must hurry! Concentrate your energies!
We must go and gather with the other Disciples. There is much work to be done before I can make another attempt to restore the Barrens. Farewell, brave souls!
We must hurry.
We must move quickly. Auberdine isn't too far away, but many enemies lurk in the forest.
We must not allow the Alliance to expand their power base in Arathi!  Even their miniscule Refuge Pointe may one day grow to threaten us.
We must not give into the evil which has darkened our land.  The Night Watch must prevail!
We must not give up!
We must stop these villains!
We mustn't anger the Master. His is a wrath that is cruel beyond measure.

We need a great number of copper bars, $c. The upcoming war at Ahn'Qiraj is going to use up a lot of metal for weapons, armor and whatnot. I'm told that the Horde alone needs to collect $1998w copper bars. As of now we have $2018w.
We need adventurers to assist us, $N. Will you help?
We need better representation from Stormwind.  Our homes are falling to the undead.
We need more wolves! Come to the stables and help!
We need to get this wagon filled by the end of the day.  So back to work with you.  Chop, chop!
We now hold the wisdom of the Winterax, $N. This power can be yours for a short time should you so desire.

We of the Horde have done all that we can to prepare for the upcoming war at Ahn'Qiraj. Now we wait, $c, for the Alliance to do the same. Once they are done we will all transport our war materiel to Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
We orcs are usually a private people, but lately, no one's been hiding their feelings.

We plant the vegetables.  Our vegetables are eaten by the rabbit.  The rabbit is devoured by the wolf.  The wolf is slain by us.  We take the meat and hide from the wolf's corpse.  It's that Magic Circle of life, or whatever you call it.  

Now go see Telonis in the Cenarion Enclave to get started and let me return to my duties.
We really should fix this fence soon.
We ride on your command!
We serve Thrall with great pride.  We'll travel as far as is needed to vanquish the enemy.
We shall be in your debt, $c.  Look for Donal Osgood in the Hall of Arms.  He will be more than happy to aid you in your journey to Arathi Basin.
We shall be reunited once more, my love...

We stand together with the Alliance, $r. An evil, so old that the world has forgotten it, seeks to engulf us all; first on Kalimdor and then the rest of Azeroth. It is driven by a hatred of all things born of the great Shapers: The eternal Titans.$B$BWe are all that stand in the way of C'Thun's armies. We will strike first and bring down the forces of Ahn'Qiraj. Let all of Azeroth quake at the combined might of the Horde and Alliance.$B$BThe war effort needs you!
We support mystical tradesmen by carrying a limited selection of arcane trade supplies. Are you looking for something in particular?
We survived!

We suspect that in order to preserve their fortune and hold of the land - well past their lifespan - the Barovs made a deal with a powerful human mage named Kel'Thuzad.$B$B<Eva shudders.>$B$BFrom this deal sprang the school of necromancy: A place which bore the Cult of the Damned and would become their capital.$B$BAs each week passed, the house Barov became more and more decrepit...$B$BDark beings began to take residence in the various wings of the house. Upkeep became impossible... and disgusting.

We took her to the Commander with hopes that the druids of the Circle could fix her up. Sure enough, they were able to wake her up. We figured our business with the Circle was done and we could get back to work.$B$BA few weeks passed and everything was going fine. Brann was still around back then so we had a bit of order in our work structure. Then one day, out of the blue, she appeared back at our camp.
We use many animal pelts and skins in our creations.
We will drive our foes from Silverpine, then bring the tides of war to their very capital!
We will enslave the quilboar!
We will never allow it... We have banished him from our world before and we will banish him again.
We will not be swayed from our mission!
We will push them back, Anachronos. This I vow. Uphold your end of this task. Let not your hands falter as you seal our fates behind the barrier.
We will spread across this barren land!
We will suffer no demon's servant in our lands!
We wish to face the Defiler.
We work to preserve the balance as Cenarius teaches, $c.  His is the light of a beacon that shows the way for us, and we must do everything in our power to preserve that light.
We'll be notching our axes after this.
We'll be out of here just as soon as I get this wagon fixed. . . .
We'll cut your throats and bleed you dry!
We'll dance on your bones!
We'll have your heads!
We'll not let this act of madness go unpunished!
We're almost to safety. From here, we run. Try not to get too far behind! GO!

We're back and better than ever!  It's the Darkmoon Faire friend, and it's your lucky day!  Sparing no expense, we've gathered wonders and treats from around the world for your delight.  Whether you're young or old, rich or poor, the Darkmoon Faire has it all!  Be sure to turn in your Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets to Gelvas Grimegate, and choose from several exotic and wondrous prizes!
We're doomed!
We're filled to capacity on purple lotus, $c. Go ask one of the others if they need your help, and leave me to my studies. There is no time to waste!
We're finally here, thanks to you $N!  Without your help, we would have been some over-grown lizard's lunch!
We're making progress!  Bring more supplies to repair Dun Baldar!
We're not really rude people, stranger, it's just that everyone is in a rush, trying to make sure that everything is perfect for Uther's arrival. It's not often that the Lightbringer comes to town.
We're on orders from on high to destroy Rajaxx. Terminate with extreme prejudice if you want to get technical.

We're preparing for war, $c. We've taken all that we're going to from the Silithid and their masters in Ahn'Qiraj. To get ready for it we're collecting all sorts of material. I'm in charge of gathering Arthas' Tears. Not sure what we need them for though. If you ask me I don't want anything to do with that madman, even if it is just a flower named after him.$B$BStill, I'm my father's daughter, and a soldier, so I do what I'm told. Currently we have $2057w and need to collect a grand total of $2058w.
We're pretty far from anything I'd call civilization here, at least until the Horde can send us more reinforcements. You must really like working with leather.
We're under attack!
We've been so wrapped up in this war, some of us forgot to make time for love.
We've done it!  Victory to the Alliance!
We've done it! We've done it! We've driven them off!

We've done it, $g lad : lass;! The Alliance and the Horde have completed gathering everything that we think we'll need for the Ahn'Qiraj War. Right now the final goods are being taken over to Cenarion Hold in Silithus and all of it will arrive within $2113w days. After that, some brave $g hero : heroine; is going to need to ring the Scarab Gong with the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj. When those gates open, the war begins!

We've done it, $g lad : lass;! The Alliance and the Horde have completed gathering everything that we think we'll need for the Ahn'Qiraj War. Right now the final goods are being taken over to Cenarion Hold in Silithus and the last of it will arrive within a day. After that, some brave $g hero : heroine; is going to need to ring the Scarab Gong with the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj. When those gates open, the war begins!
We've failed, $N!!
We've found the it, $N.
We've got no time to waste. This is a really long run! Cover me!
We've gotta find out what the Qiraji are feeding those monsters! Look at the size of 'em!

We, his sworn servants, do his bidding and enforce his iron-rule. Cut off from the energies of his fiery realm, Ragnaros is but a shadow of his true self. However, he has more than enough strength to be your end.
We, the Alliance, will prevail!
We, the Zandalarian trolls, traveled here from distant islands, for we cannot ignore the threat that now faces our world.

We, the Zandalarian trolls, traveled here from distant islands, for we cannot ignore the threat that now faces our world.$B$BThe leader of our expedition, Molthor, brought us to the Yojamba Isle, along the northern coasts of Stranglethorn, and even now recruits brave heroes to venture into the ancient troll city... Zul'Gurub.
Weak $C! You are no match for the Stonesplinter Tribe!
Weapons Trainer

Welcome back to the greatest show on Azeroth, my friend!  It is truly a delight to see you once again.$B$BPlease, step right up and once more take in all we have to offer.  Be sure to check around, as we are always adding new and exciting things to the Darkmoon Faire!  Amaze at wonders old and new that we have uncovered!  We continue to spare no expense in bringing you excitement that children of all ages will delight in!
Welcome back, $N.  You've proven a worthy ally against Ragnaros and your presence is always welcome among us.
Welcome back, $N. Have I mentioned how good it is to have someone to talk to?$B$BAlright then, let's get down to business. What's next that we have to do?

Welcome one and all to the Darkmoon Faire, the greatest event in all the world!  We have it all... delicious food, strong drink, exotic artifacts, fortunes read, amazing prizes and excitement without end!  Don't forget to turn in your Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets to Gelvas Grimegate!  All it takes is five or more and you're on your way to the most wondrous prizes on all of Azeroth.  Everybody is a winner!

Welcome one and all to the greatest show on all of Azeroth... the Darkmoon Faire!  Adventure and excitement await, don't be shy!  Mysteries and prizes for both the young and the old are here for the taking.  And be sure to speak with the professor about any Darkmoon Cards that you have come across during your travels!
Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

Welcome to Booty Bay, partner.  I hope your stay in my town is enjoyable and uneventful - emphasis on the latter.  We've got plenty of drink if you're thirsty, and plenty of bouncers if you're antsy.$B$BNow then... what can this humble servant of the Steamwheedle Cartel do for you?  Better still - what can you do for me, eh?
Welcome to Caer Darrow, stranger.
Welcome to Camp Mojache, brave $c.  How may I assist you this day?
Welcome to Light's Hope Chapel, stranger.
Welcome to Revantusk Village, stranger. I am Primal Torntusk, leader of the Revantusk trolls.
Welcome to SI:7 headquarters, $N.
Welcome to Steelgrill's Depot!

Welcome to Stormwind!  I am one of the city's officers, aiding the citizenry of the city through our census bureau.  If you are in need of locating someone specific, then I might be able to assist you.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.$B$BIf you have business with me, then please proceed!
Welcome to Stormwind. Took a long time to rebuild her but it was well worth it. So are you visiting, or are you here on business?
Welcome to Tanaris, $N. How can I be of service to you today? You don't look like a blacksmith to me, but I know how looks can be deceiving.

Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!$B$BThelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.
Welcome to flavor country!
Welcome to me shop. What can I do for ye'?
Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?
fa: به مهمان‌خانهٔ من خوش آمدی، مسافر خسته. چه کاری از دستم برمی‌آید؟

en: Welcome to my forge, Blacksmith. Let me share with you a little secret. No one, no one in the world can you trust. Not men, not women, not beasts ... this you can trust, Steel.
Welcome to my shop, $c. What is it the Goodstitch brothers can do for you?
Welcome to my shop, it's good to see another Enchanter here in Stormwind. Are you here for a lesson perhaps?
Welcome to my shop, it's good to see another Tailor here in Stormwind. Are you here for a lesson perhaps?
Welcome to our home, $N. Radnaal and I have little to offer, but you are welcome to what hospitality we can provide.
Welcome to our tent. May I assist you?
Welcome to the Bank of Darnassus. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?
Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?
Welcome to the Blue Recluse, where the magically inclined gather to blow off steam. Though not literally of course. What can I get for you $g sir : ma'am;?

Welcome to the Booty Bay fishing contest where each week we choose the finest fisherman to be the Master Angler!

Between 2pm and 4pm schools of tastyfish will appear up and down the coast of Stranglethorn.  While fishing if your fishing bobber lands in a tastyfish school then you will catch something from the school rather than the normal stranglethorn fishing fare.
Welcome to the Cenarion Circle, $c.
Welcome to the Cenarion Circle, $c.  How may I assist you?

Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.$B$BPlease, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.$B$BThere are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.
Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire, $c!$B$BMy name is Kerri Hicks and I'd shake your hand but I'm afraid I'd break it, because I'm the strongest woman alive!
Welcome to the Explorer's League.  If you need information, and it is in book form, then I might be able to help you out.

Welcome to the Faire young one!   We have collected wonders from all over the world for your perusal.   Oh and please let me know if you manage to collect a set of the lesser darkmoon cards, as the master...I mean I would be keenly interested in them.
Welcome to the Farstrider Lodge, $N!

Welcome to the Great Forge $g lad : lass;. It may be cold outside but we keep it nice and hot down 'ere. Grab a hammer, strike that anvil and show me ye've got what it takes to be a Blacksmith of the Great Forge!
Welcome to the Grim Guzzler!
Welcome to the Lion's Pride Inn.  Make yourself at home!
Welcome to the Pig and Whistle! Grab a drink my friend and pull up a seat, the more the merrier!
Welcome to the Scarlet Raven.  It's best to stay indoors these days.
Welcome to the Stockade!
Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?
Welcome to the Undercity Guild Registry. What do you want?

Welcome to the Wickerman Festival, $c!$B$BOn the observance of Hallow's End, the Forsaken burn a wickerman in honor of this, the most revered of occasions.  It was on this day that the Banshee Queen herself delivered us from the clutches of the Lich King and the Scourge.  We have remained free ever since.  Those who would have seen us fall are repayed in full... with vengeance!$B$BThe burning of the Wickerman begins at 8:00 PM!

Welcome to the front lines, $c.  The Kingdom of Stormwind, with the aid of its allies, has sent me here to counter the growing threat of the Scourge.  Here at Chillwind Point, we fight for our continued survival on a daily basis.$B$BIf you've come here looking for a chance to prove yourself as a hero, then you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so... especially as we push towards Andorhal and whatever malign force that controls the Scourge there.

Welcome to the front lines, $c.  While politicians may connive and scheme amongst themselves, they'll find no such luxury afforded to them here.  This is the Bulwark, and we fight for our continued survival on a daily basis here.$B$BIf you've come here looking for a chance to prove yourself as a hero, then you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so... especially as we push towards Andorhal and whatever malign force that controls the Scourge there.
Welcome to the great show, friends.  Step right up to die!

Welcome to the iCoke-WOW summer promotion.$B$BDear $N, the halo of fortune goddess is shining on you.  Obey to the order of god; you'll get a special and mystery present.  Now, the gate of Azeroth is open for you.  A great adventure will begin soon.  Are you ready?$B$BMay the honor be with you!
Welcome to the races!  Enjoy your stay, and don't bet all your money in one place!
Welcome to the refuge, $N. Some come here with a purpose, others found their way here by accident... But everyone here seems to have a unique story to tell.

Welcome!  Welcome to Yebb Neblegear's Darkmoon Zoo Bizarre - a Trove of Living Legends and Mythical Oddities!  Enjoy your visit, friend!$B$BBut be mindful of what you touch!  These exhibits hold artifacts and beasts both dire and divine!  They might burn the wayward hand of an over-curious onlooker...

Welcome! Step right up, don't be shy. This here is my pride and joy... the Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon! Ain't she pretty? You look a little big around the mid section, but I think you'll fit. Flying is so much fun, want to learn how?
Welcome, $n! Are you interested in training in tailoring?
Welcome, and feel free to examine my goods.  Other than the moldy smell, they are in perfect condition.

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.$B$BIt never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.$B$BThere are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch Druid, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.$B$BThere will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.$B$BWe are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.$B$BWe are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Malfurion lies in the Dreaming.  Never forget this.
Well $glad : lass;, ye can find Shelby Stoneflint right outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.  She'll take good care of any pets ye might have.
Well Done!
Well I'm here.  And I'm ready to rejoin...
Well done Edward and Tyler. You are progressing along in your training quite nicely. We shall test your mettle again soon.
Well done!
Well done! You have that spark in your eye... I know it well, it's the same spark I had when I was but a pup! Now, let's see if I can't teach you something.
Well done! Your understanding of potions is coming along nicely.
Well done, Horde! We have enough Frostwolves in our stables to provide mounts to all of our wolf riders!

Well done, servant. For so long I have been held captive within the prison of the Firelord. I am once more free to feast upon the out world! The land shall once more be ravaged by the force of the Wind Seeker!
Well done, soldier. A few more and our stables will be overflowing with mounts for the cavalry to ride into combat!
Well done, soldiers! At ease!
Well done, young rogue. Well done, indeed....
Well done. Release the bear into my custody so that I may apply the curing cantrip.
Well done. You have now earned tailoring's highest honor. Go forth, and do terrible things with this knowledge!
Well duties call, yes?  First, the bell... to give you vigor!

Well hello again, $N!  I don't know how much longer I'm going to keep on trying to set up a shop out in the middle of nowhere.  Still, since you've helped me out in the past, I'll show you some stuff you may find interesting!
Well hello there ladies. Heard about the new plague?
Well hello, $n, what can I get you today?
Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

Well met master of Rod and Reel!   If you be willing to test your skills against the best fisher-folk in the lands then listen up!   On this very Sunday there be a contest in Stranglethorn where the master angler will be chosen!
Well met, $N. We must be brief because there is much to do.
Well met, $c.  You want some advice?  Befriend a mage!  We have a trick or two up our sleeves, we do...

Well met, $c. I hope you are here to inquire on the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. We are going to need a great deal of assistance.$B$BThe war effort is a united effort between the Alliance and Horde to prepare for the upcoming war against the Silithid and their masters in Ahn'Qiraj. In the Military Ward of Ironforge, we are collecting all manner of goods to create our war materiel from, and these gathering tasks are what we need your help with.$B$BCan I convince you to speak with our commander about pitching in?

Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.$B$BI deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?
Well met, friend!

Well met, friend.  I am Officer Garush, and I am a proud member of a world-wide organization known as the Argent Dawn.  Our cause is to fight swiftly and mercilessly against any element of evil that surfaces in Azeroth.  We are not a political body, nor do we ever wish to become one.  Our cause is singular, and to that end we call both the Horde and Alliance as friends - friends in the cause of stamping out evil!$B$BFor the Dawn, my $g brother : sister;!

Well met, friend.  I am Officer Pureheart, and I am a proud member of a world-wide organization known as the Argent Dawn.  Our cause is simple - fight swifty and mercilessly against any element of evil that surfaces in Azeroth.  We are not a political body, nor do we ever wish to become one.  To that end we call both the Alliance and the Horde both as friends - friends in the cause of stamping out evil!$B$BFor the Dawn, my $g brother : sister;!
Well met, travelers of Duskwood! My incredible wares are on sale for a short time in Darkshire. Make haste!

Well my friend, ye have more skill than I do. Why don't ye go find me old friend Rotgath Stonebeard. He stayed in Ironforge when I left to join Jaina's army. I'm sure he'll be able ta teach ye somethin, or at least know someone who can. If he's still around, I'm sure he'll be at The Great Forge.
Well my friend, you've reached heights some people only dream of. Congrats! And now, without further ceremony, it is time for your final lesson!

Well now $N, let's get to work on those cauldrons!  If you're going to collect the components we need, then get a vitreous focuser from me.  You'll need to have it on you to identify the necessary resources found on the Scourge that will turn those cauldrons.$B$BYou'll also need a dose of arcane quickener for the cauldrons.  It's not cheap, nor is it stable.  Once you have it, you'll only have thirty minutes to use it before it expires on you; be smart about buying it.

Well now, $g lad : lass;, it looks like the Alliance has already gathered up all that we need for our part of the war. I know that the blacksmiths, engineers and everyone else is busy with the final preparations, and as soon as the Horde assembles all of their goods, it will all be sent to Silithus for the war.

Well now, I haven't seen blades this fine since I left Lordaron with Proudmore and her people. I can't teach ye much more it seems, but if ye were to find Borgus Steelhand I bet he could show ye some things. Finest weaponsmith I ever met.

Well now, it would appear that we have some time on our hands. The Horde has completed its gathering tasks, and all is being prepared for final shipment to Silithus. We're only waiting on the Alliance to finish with theirs. You should go ask that silly, little ambassador of theirs how far along they are.
Well now, ye'll need papers to form a guild, and Jondor Steelbrow can help you get started with the process.  He can be found over at the Ironforge Visitor's Center when yer ready to get started.
Well then, it seems we're both looking for Hogral Bakkan.  He's a dwarf to be sure, so sooner or later he'll be heading for the Thunderbrew Distillery for an ale -- he might even be there now.
Well then, let's get this started. The longer we're here, the more damage the undead could be doing back in Hillsbrad.
Well then... show me the tribute!
Well there's a gryphon master up in Stormwind if you need to fly somewhere.  You should be able to see the gryphons landing on your right as you walk through the Valley of Heroes.
Well well!  You've come to the right place to learn Mining, $gboyo : girlie;!  Geofram Bouldertoe himself resides at the Deepmountain Mining Guild.  Ye couldn't ask for a better instructor than him.
Well what do you know, this is Children's Week!  What can I do to help?
