Well ye'd be sure to find some training in the magical arts over in the Hall of Mysteries, north of the gates of Ironforge.  Juli Stormkettle can always be found there with her nose in a book.
Well yes, I do know a rare alchemical recipe.  Let me teach you!
Well, I'm going outside to check. Something is amiss.
Well, I'm off then.  Take care, Harlan.
Well, I'm off to Ratchet now! Best of luck to you!
Well, alright then $N. I can tell that you've seen the error of your ways and rejoined the engineering fold.$B$BHave fun with your yeti!!!

Well, aren't you the smarty-pants? Ye know more than I do, I can tell ye that! Don't go getting' a big head, but if ye want to keep learnin', have a chat with Georgio Bolero in Stormwind. They say he knows his tailorin'!
Well, back to business for me.  But it sure was nice taking that short break, and it's always nice drinking Thunder Ale!
Well, from what I hear, the new plague has ALL of the old plague flavor but none of the old plague calories or carbohydrates!
Well, if it isn't $N!  It's good to see you again; I cannot express my gratitude enough at the help that you've given me and my invention work to date.$B$BWhat can I do for you today?

Well, looks like we have all of the cooked albacore that we can properly salt and store for the upcoming war at Ahn'Qiraj. Thanks for asking though, $c. If you have a mind to, check around with the other collectors. I'd bet there's someone else here that could use your help with gathering up whatever it is that they need.
Well, looks like we've gathered up everything that the Alliance is going to need; now we're just waiting on the Horde. I think soon I'm going to see if there's any Tigule & Foror's ice cream nearby.

Well, maybe 'pay' isn't the best word to use. See, when I was stuck in the belly of that thing, I got to thinking:$B$BThis creature lives in hot, flaming magma and yet it doesn't take a lick of damage from the fire!$B$BIf only I could find a pristine hide from one of these beasts. I could take it back to my dear friend, Malyfous Darkhammer, in Everlook. If anyone could do anything with the hide of a beast like this, it would be him.
Well, now or never I suppose. Remember, once we get to the road safely, return to Terenthis to let him know we escaped.

Well, now that you mention it, yeah, I did see something I thought was a little strange yesterday afternoon!$B$BI was running past some old troll ruins southeast of here; well, I wasn't really running, more like hopping... The sand's so hot!$B$BAnyway, so I was hopping past the ruins, when I noticed a camp set up there. Seems like a funny place to set up camp, if you ask me... I would have poked around a little more but one of those crazy big vultures chased me off.
Well, that is just not right. The creature is far too small. Let us see what Keever's third batch will do.
Well, that should do it.  Come now, back to the shop to finish our business!
Well, that's what I get for oversleeping!

Well, the way I see it, $N, we have two options to consider for leaving this cave.$B$BWe can make our way stealthfully--I use the cloak you've given me, and you'd be left to your own devices, or, and this may be a harder option considering my wounds, we fight our way out back to back.$B$BI'll let you decide since you know your strengths better than I.
Well, we're not getting any closer just standing here.  Come on Dadanga!  Yah!

Well, well, moving up in the world are we? You're looking for the Champions' Hall, and you'll find it on the southeast end of Old Town. If you're an officer you can enter the hall, otherwise you can still speak to Officer Areyn standing outside. Good luck!

Well, well, what do you know, sparky, we did it. Everything's collected and ready to go. We're just waiting on those Horde yahoos now, and once they get their act together it's off to the races at Ahn'Qiraj!
Well, well. Looks like we got ourselves some competition. Get 'em boys!
Well, well... look what the cat brung in... and how can I help you, $c?
Well, whatever it is, it works quite well!
Well, ye won't have much luck with finding a tailor out here.  Ironforge is home to a quite a few talented tailors though.  Why don't ye go ask a guard there.
Well, you can find Theridan or Maldryn by the moonwell in the Park.  Just head to the western area of Stormwind, north of the Mage District, but west of the Cathedral Square.
Well, you're just zooming right along! I can't teach you anything you don't already know, but Springspindle Fizzlegear sure can! You can find Springspindle in Ironforge. Good luck!
Well, you're still here. I'd say that is something worth drinking to.

en: Well... I hate to admit it, but my sister's the one you'll have to talk to if you want to continue training. I don't know as much as she does... yet! She's standing over by the rocket car.
Well... you almost impressed me. I suppose I could spare the time for a few lessons...
Welp the fish ain't bitin' no more so I might as start gutting and cleaning what I did catch today.
Wha... what's happening?
Wha... where am I?  So... weak..
What Guardian? I don't understand any of this.
What Hallow's End candy do you have for sale?
What I wouldn't give to be out on the open plains on a day like this... but, my duty binds me.

What ISN'T there to do, you mean!$B$BEach of the innkeepers throughout the world are handing out trick-or-treat goodies, and many of the towns are decorated for the season!  Also, Sergeant Hartman in Southshore needs help against the Forsaken and their Wickerman Festival.$B$BOne more thing - I've heard that a sick little boy at the orphanage in Stormwind is looking for someone to help him gather treats for the holiday.

What ISN'T there to do, you mean!$B$BEach of the innkeepers throughout the world are handing out trick-or-treat goodies, and many of the towns are decorated for the season!  Also, there is the Wickerman Festival just outside the Undercity during the evenings.$B$BOne more thing - I've heard that a sick little girl at the orphanage here in Orgrimmar is looking for someone to help her gather treats for the holiday... maybe you could help her out?

What Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol did not realize was that just as their servants were bound to the land, so would they be... You see, the price for their own immortality was also imprisonment and eternal servitude under the command of Razelikh. The cruel cunning of Razelikh had emerged the victor once again.
What a day for fishin'. They are sure to be bitin' today!
What a fine day! It inspires me to create a new design.
What a story! So she went into Hive'Regal and that was the last you saw of her?
What a wonderful day to be alive! Look at the beauty that surrounds you, friend. Enjoy what life has to give!
What about the Winterfall furbolg?

What am I doing?  Do you lack vision?  I am a dreamer, good $g sir : lady;, and I dream of a better future for us all.  Clearly, I am a visionary.$B$BThere are those, however, who seek to keep us mired in banality.  I told him that I was a dreamer, and Arch Druid Staghelm replied, "Well, the world needs ditch diggers too."$B$BUntil such time as the shackles of banality are ripped from us, I will help the Cenarion Circle by shuffling these piles of dirt around.
What am I going to do?
What are Darkmoon Cards?
What are Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets and how do I get them?
What are love tokens?
What are the Paragons of Power?
What are the Plates of Uldum?
What are the anomalies you speak of?
What are the chances of obtaining such a hide?
What are the components?
What are the stones of binding?
What are these Tonk Control Consoles?
What are those crates for?
What are ye daft? That's not a weapon, that's a dinner knife. I don't train amateurs.
What are you doing?  Intruders!!
What are you talking about, mage?
What brings a tauren to the Plaguelands?
What brings you to the Cenarion Circle, $N?
What brings you to the Tower?
What brings you to this part of the world, $n?
What bug comes before the lords of the Council?  A bug, no doubt, wishing to be squashed!
What can I do at an inn?
What can I do for ya?
What can I do for ye?
What can I do for you $c?
What can I do for you my child?
What can I do for you, $N?  Make it quick, I don't have all day!
What can I do for you?  No, wait!  What can you do for me?
What can I do with these gifts?
What can I do?
What can I help you with $g sir : ma'am;?
What can I purchase?
What can other weapon masters teach?
What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

What can you do at an inn?$B$BWell when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.$B$BYou may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.
What can you teach me?
What can you tell me about the bear - Ursangous?
What can you tell me about the hippogryph - Sharptalon?
What can you tell me about the nightsaber cat - Shadumbra?
What corruption?
What could be taking so long?
What could be worse than death?

What could you possibly need a bank for?  Very well, you'll need to go through the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south of Brill.  In the back are a set of elevators leading down into the Undercity.  When you get there stop any of those lumbering Abominations they like to call an Undercity Guardian and ask it for better directions.
What deal?
What demands?
What did Gryphe tell boss?? Gryphe wasn't lying! There she is, trying to steal battle plans!
What direction can I point you in?
What discoveries?
What do they say?
What do ye need directions to?
What do you call that? If that's fighting then I'm Lothar himself!
What do you fancy, $G sir:miss;?
What do you have for sale?
What do you know of it, Franzahl?
What do you know of it?
What do you mean by "pure?"

What do you mean what do I mean? She went nutso! The girl went straight crazy on us. Now ordinarily I don't hit girls but after I recovered from the blackout, I was pretty damned angry. Brann, Rutgar, me and the monkey went positively orc on her! It's a miracle we were able to fend her off. She seemed almost possessed!
What do you mean you don't know how to use an axe?
What do you mean, buy?!  I'm the king now... and it's good to be the king!
What do you mean?
What do you need directions to?
What do you represent, spirit?
What do you seek, $c?
What do you think of Dadanga?
What do you want, $c? I'm running late, and my employer doesn't look kindly on tardiness.
What do you want, Komak?
What does "zug zug" mean?
What does Dadanga like to eat?
What does allergic mean anyway? And what does it have to do with either of my kitties?
What else do you have to say?

What followed were a series of tragic events, leading to the death of every Kirin Tor mage that came into contact with Atiesh.$B$BYou see, it was an artifact with sentience. A sentience granted to it by Sargeras...
What function do you serve?
What goods have I earned the right to purchase for use in Warsong Gulch?
What goods have I earned the right to purchase from the Defilers?
What goods have I earned the right to purchase from the League of Arathor?
What happened here, spirit?
What happened to her after that?
What happened to him in the first place?  When I... encountered him, he was rather malicious.
What happened to our pigs?
What happened to the staff?
What happened to your mercenary company, The Veiled Blade?
What happens if your snot freezes in your nose?
What happens when I do this?!
What happens when the Earthen destabilize?
What has happened, Earthmother? Why has the spell failed?
What have we here?  $N the $C?  Attack!
What have you done? FOOL! You brought it... NO!
What have you heard of the Shady Rest Inn?
What high-stress environments would cause the Earthen to destabilize?
What if we used three focuses in Tyrean pattern? That should solve it.
What is Atiesh?
What is Cryptstalker armor?
What is Dreadnaught armor?
What is E'ko?
What is Juju?
What is Plagueheart armor?
What is Redemption armor?
What is a "resilient foundation of construction"?
What is a "subterranean being matrix"?
What is a Horde Commendation Signet?
What is an Alliance Commendation Signet?
What is going on here?  Leave that powder alone!
What is happening to everyone?  I feel... cold...
What is happening? What force draws me to the Altar of the Tides!
What is it Tarsis? I don't know what to do!

What is it now, $c, I haven't got all day? The Horde has completed its collections and now waits only on the Alliance to organize themselves and do the same. Perhaps you should be out there looking for the pieces to the Scepter of the Shifting Sands so that you can ring the gong at the Scarab Dais, opening the gates to Ahn'Qiraj and thereby starting the war?
What is it that you do exactly, Rohan?
What is it that you want, lemming? Get out of my sight before you find out why I am known as the Wrathcaster.
What is it you ask of the Blue Flight?
What is it you seek at my forge? Is it training? Do you perhaps seek the secrets of steel? The mysteries of the forge? Speak up Grunt!
What is it, $c? The Horde is done with all collections, and final preparations are being made while the Alliance tries to catch up in their efforts. Is there anything else that you need?
What is it? Can't you see I'm busy?
What is the Ahn'Qiraj war effort?

What is the Brotherhood of the Light? Well... We are all members of the Argent Dawn at the core - members of the Argent Dawn that aren't held in check by morals, guilt and useless human emotion. Consider us Scarlet Crusade minus the stupidity, lack of leadership, and blind zealotry.$B$BDon't let the Scarlet Commander tell you otherwise.$B$BAnd don't let Tyrosus know I said that... It would be a terrible shame if I had to brutally maim him should a brawl break out.
What is there to do on Hallow's End?
What is this plan?
What is this power that flows through me? Is this the power of shamanism that Tor'gan spoke of...?
What is this task?
What is this? Did Keever ask for a sheep? Keever wanted a weapon of great power and all he got was this sheep. Keever is very disappointed.
What is this? You trying to ruin my reputation? I don't teach novices, $gbuddy:lady;. Go talk to Milla Fairancora in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.
What is this? You trying to ruin my reputation? I don't teach novices, $gbuddy:lady;. Try talking to the orc Whuut in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He's a lot closer to your level of skill. And brains.
What kin I do for ya, mon?
What kin I do for ye, $n?
What kind of services?
What kinda fightin' was that? I should kick all of ya worthless hides off the team and out of the guard!
What little remained of Thunderaan's essence was stored within a talisman of elemental binding. Ragnaros then shattered the talisman in two flawless pieces. The pieces assigned to his Lieutenants...
What manner of filth dares enter my chambers!?
What message?
What must be done?
What now?  Can't you see I'm rather busy?
What of the Alliance, Rend?
What other things can I do at the faire?
What plants are in Felwood that might be corrupted?
What promotions do you have?
What roles?
What staff?
What task?
What the squawk??? Squawk squawk, squawk? SQUAWK!
What the... nobody cleanses a furbolg in MY camp!  Face the wrath of Xabraxxis!
What the... what are those things crawling at us?  We... we have incoming!
What want from Raze??
What was that noise?
What was that noise? It sounded like a roar.
What was that!
What was that?
What was that? Did you leave that flare lit?!
What was that? Sea giant? Better safe than sorry. Fire!
What was that?! Trey? TREY!?
What will we do with them, master? They are of no use to us anymore.
What wisdom can I impart?
What would I sacrifice?
What would happen if the Fruit of Fertility - or the Felvine - was allowed to be fully corrupted?
What would you have me do, Rabine?
What you be expectin', mon?$B$BMaywiki only be dealin' with the druids and shaman.
What you be wanting? *hic*
What you must understand is that being able to index 10,000 years of existence has given me a rather unique perspective on life. Your present day trials and tribulations are meaningless.
What you see before you is a felhunter. This creature's natural talents include spell lock and other abilities which make it unequalled when facing a magically attuned opponent.
What!?
What's a young $c like you out visiting an old farmer like me?
What's an elf like you doing inside a cave like this?
What's going on here? Piznik! I knew we shouldn't have let you stick around!
What's needed for the cauldron at Dalson's Tears?
What's needed for the cauldron at Felstone Field?
What's needed for the cauldron at Gahrron's Withering?
What's needed for the cauldron at the Writhing Haunt?
What's that noise?
What's that on the horizon? Enemy ship no doubt! Fire!
What's the worst that could happen?

What's there to ask? He's a monkey you crazy fool. Anyhow, so yea, the monkey went into a frenzy after seein' ol' Brann flop into the sand face first. Nothin' the night elf could do was stopping Glibb here from poundin' on her noggin.

You probably weren't expecting to find me in this cave, were you?$B$BMy name's J.D., and I really can't tell you much about how I got here, but what I can tell you is that this cave is my home now!$B$BI spend my time studying the strange crystals that can be found all over the crater.

You're no warlock and I've no time for you.  Begone!
You're not a druid!
You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.
You're not joining anyone, Thorsen..
You're not only wasting the time of your fellow students, you're wasting my time too.
You're pushing it, $n.
You're selling cologne and perfume?
You're sweet for asking, $c, but we have all of the light leather that we need. May be that one of the others in charge of collecting around here is in need of your assistance though?
You're talking to the wrong orc. I don't train novices. Talk to young Whuut over there... and use small words.

You're telling me! It's even stranger considering between Brann, Rutgar, me and the monkey, we know 38 different languages including a touch of Titan - both Vanir and Aesir.$B$BSo anyway, whatever she was click clacking about, it definitely wasn't with anyone "present." She then nodded and went on the offensive! Attacked us outright!
You're the best, $N - thanks for going trick-or-treating for me!
You're very welcome! I must be on my way... be safe, all of you.
You're working your way up... higher than me, at this point! You should talk to Springspindle Fizzlegear in Ironforge! (He'll? She'll?) show you more than I ever could!
You've accepted my surrender.

You've already done me a great service, $N. For that I thank you.$B$BThe least I can do now is tell you what brought me here: My long time friend Trey Lightforge and I came to Jaedenar to investigate the Shadow Council when they caught us unprepared. They took Trey deeper into Shadow Hold and put me in here after taking all of our equipment... I can still hear his screams from below, $N. They were... inhuman. I don't know what they've done to him, but they will pay for it.
You've already learned everything I can teach you, $N. Talk to the night elf Lilyssia Nightbreeze in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind if you want to continue your studies. I hear she's a good teacher.
You've angered me for the last time $n!
You've been MALOWNED!
You've been such an unbelievably big help! These bones are going to unlock so much new information and help me futher my research.
You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

en: You've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around you and you shall fare far greater than most.

You've convinced me of your intentions, $N, and you have my thanks for being willing to help out the members of my former mercenary company, The Veiled Blade.$B$BNow let's see, what's next on our list of things to do?
You've destroyed too much of my work!  Prepare to join them in the Nether!

You've done all that I've asked you to do, $N. There's really nothing more here for you. If you are interested in continuing your career as an agent of the Thorium Brotherhood, speak with Lokhtos Darkbargainer at the Grim Guzzler in Blackrock Depths.$B$BFarewell!
You've done it, $N! <The strangely familiar voice seems to be coming from the phial!> Hurry back! The fallout will only remain stable for thirty minutes.
You've got money and we've got food.  What are you waiting for?!
You've got more guts than brains, coming to me without the proper training. Go talk to somebody closer to your skill level, like the orc Kamari, who lives in the Drag of Orgrimmar.
You've got my attention.
You've got real talent and a passion for making potions. There is one little matter I'd like you to take care of, though.
You've got something I need, Astor. And I'll be taking it now.
You've got the hang of it. I can't teach you any more, but talk to Arthur Moore, a Forsaken who works in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity. Tell him I sent you.

You've heard about the Tram have you?  What a ride that thing is!  You'll find it in the Dwarven District towards the back.  Oh, and be sure to keep your arms and legs inside the tram while the tram is in motion.
You've interfered with our plans for the last time, foolish $c!
You've made the right decision, $c.  You'll find our battlemaster, Glordrum Steelbeard, in the Hall of Arms.  Good luck, $N!

You've not had a steed until you've taken the reigns of a finely bred Barak Tor'ol mountain ram, my friend.  Please, feel free to inspect these fine companions to any adventurer.  They'll serve you well, believe me.
You've plundered our treasures too long.  Prepare to meet your watery grave!
You've put in your time studying the basics. Now it's time to up the ante.
You've really outdone yourself this time, Mrs. Chambers. Not a spot of mold to be found!
You've reclaimed a few paltry territories. Pathetic. In short order they will again be ours!
You've ruined your own lands, you'll not ruin mine.

You've started down an honorable path, $N. My ancestors respect your willingness, but you will not have my approval until you have followed through with my tasks.$B$BYou know what you must do if you wish to prove yourself a hunter in spirit.
You, in harmony with nature, and only your skills to survive.  This is the way that the Earth Mother intended it to be.  You will want to find Bale on the Hunter Rise.
You... The frame! How? You must not... It... the Destroyer...
Your Horde is nothing to the Kolkar!
Your actions shame us all, $c. I hurt inside as I beat you senseless.
Your actions shame us all, $c. It pains me to beat you senseless!
Your actions will not be tolerated!
Your armor is ready, $N.
Your armor looks scary.  Are you scary too?
Your attacks are slowed by the cold, I think!
Your attacks are weak!  Go practice on some rabbits and come back when you're stronger.
Your base is forfeit, mortals! From its ashes shall rise life!
Your base is forfeit, puny mortals!
Your battle here is but the smallest mote of a world wide invasion, whelp!  It is time you learned of the powers you face!
Your blood shall be the catalyst for the Old Gods' return!
Your blood spills for the betterment of humanity, infidel!
Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.
Your bondage is at an end, Doom'rel.  I challenge you!
Your bones will break under my boot, $R!
Your callous disregard for the sovereign might of the Gurubashi Empire has been noted. The inhabitants of Zul'Gurub have been alerted to your presence.
Your capacity for learning has outstripped mine. You will need to talk to Bena Winterhoof over there for further instruction. Please don't take too much of her time, though. She needs her rest.
Your challenge has failed!
Your confidence is well-founded, traveler. Now your true education may begin!
Your deaths feed my strength!
Your discs are now ready!  Engage the Discs of Norgannon once again to retrieve them!
Your discs will be returned to you once you access the pedestal.
Your education is nearly complete. One final task is all that stands between you and the culmination of all your efforts...
Your education is progressing well. You should be proud of your accomplishments.
Your errand must mean much, $c, to draw you so deep into the marsh...
Your existence is acknowledged. <The relic turns to dust. Your head throbs with newfound wisdom. Something evil lurks in the heart of the mountain.>
Your eyes will make pretty baubbles!
Your family says hello, Ribbly.  And they want your head!
Your fate is sealed, Deliana!  You will pay for your trespasses against Lord Valthalak!
Your fate is sealed, Mokvar!  You will pay for your trespasses against Lord Valthalak!
Your fel weapon is ready, $N.

Your fortune is cast, $c.  For the next few hours, you will find your spirit in tune with your true nature.  Be careful, as your fortune - and your fate - are never as clear as you might think them to be.$B$BIf you would like a small glimpse of something to ponder in your future, by all means let me know.  I'd be happy to give you a written fortune, provided you have room in your inventory.  It is one drawn from the insight you have shown in answering my questions.
Your future is clouded.  Concentrate, and ask again.
Your gods can't save you now, $c.
Your insolence is appalling, fool!  I shall feast on your soul!
Your interruption is costing me valuable time, this had better be good.
Your jail is ours!
Your kind?

Your knowledge of potions has exceeded mine, but you still have much to learn. Go up the stairs to the southeast and see Doctor Marsh. He will teach you true sufferi--ahem. He is a Forsaken who will train you further.
Your leader takes residence at the doorstep to Naxxramas. Do you think he does not feel the pressure?
Your life is a fitting sacrifice for my master, $c.
Your meddling ends here, $N!  Lord Valthalak shall have his revenge!
Your meddling in demonic affairs ends NOW, mortal!  Face the great corruptor - Xandivious!
Your message did reach us, Commander, but by no means is our involvement here sanctioned by the Grand Crusader.
Your mind is unfocused.  Are you hiding something from me?
Your name will be remembered down through the ages, $N.  Seek out Taim Ragetotem on the Hunter Rise and he will assist you on your way to Alterac Valley.

Your next choice awaits.$B$BYou alone have defeated a terrible beast that has been ravaging the countryside, taking its ear as a trophy.  You later learn that your liege had offered a reward for the beast's death, and that a kind but destitute knight who you know is trying to support a family by meager means claims the beast's kill as his own.  You have no real need for money yourself, but you know that the destitute knight is lying for his own personal gain.$B$BMake your choice.

Your next choice awaits.$B$BYou are on a diplomatic mission for your liege to a cruel country that is currently at war with yours.  The war has been costly on both sides.  Your mission is to secure a peace that is honorable to both peoples.$B$BAt a diplomatic dinner, you overhear the ruler of the opposing land viciously insult your benevolent liege.  You are fairly certain the ruler meant to say it out of your earshot, but nonetheless he has besmirched your liege's honor.$B$BMake your choice.

Your next choice awaits.$B$BYou are the sworn executioner for your liege.  A man has been sent to you for execution as a traitor of the liege and your people.  You know this individual as a close, virtuous friend who mysteriously vanished one day.  You also know that the man's crimes for which he was convicted supposedly caused the deaths of many innocent civilians.  Upon seeing you he begs for his life, claiming he was framed by a higher authority.$B$BMake your choice.

Your next choice awaits.$B$BYour brother seeks to join the ranks of the prestigious military order you are already a part of.  While you are sure of his commitment and loyalty, his talent and ability to perform the arduous tasks of the order is what you question.  While you are not certain he will be able to rise to the challenge of the order - putting you and others in danger - you are certain that your word alone would allow him in or keep him out.$B$BMake your choice.
Your own strength feeds me, $n!
Your pain will end soon!
Your path is steady, $N, for Washte Pawne's resolve is with you.
Your pet is wonderful, Gerard, but she needs a collar with a bell I think.

Your potion-making skills are beyond mine. Seek out the undead Doctor Herbert Halsey in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. He has the skill to train you further, and you can witness firsthand his people's plight.
Your preparations are complete.  All that now stands before you and your dreadsteed is the ritual for the Circle of Greater Summoning, and the binding of the dreadsteed's spirit...
Your presence steels our nerves, $G Master:Mistress; $N.
Your quest to learn Draconic is futile, mortal. And why would you ever want to learn to speak in the ancient tongue? Baffling really...
Your reign of terror ends now!  Face your doom mortals!
Your robe is complete, $N.
Your search is almost completed.  Seek your truth in the entrance room of Thrall's Fortress in the Valley of Wisdom.
Your skill at brewing potions needs to be greater before you can become one of my students. In the meantime, perhaps Sylvanna Forestmoon or Milla Fairancora can help you, just over there.
Your skill displays an enduring affection for our art, but I would see further evidence of your commitment. I shall charge you with a task. Fulfill it, and I will be content.
Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.
Your skill is not inconsiderable. Since you appear to have sufficient experience, there is a matter in which I require your aid.
Your skills are coming along nicely. Soon you'll be running a leather shop of your own. I'll be glad for the help, $N. My hands are only so fast, you know? There's so much work to do!
Your skills are insufficient to learn what I teach. Try talking to Mak over there instead. He can help you out until you're ready for more advanced lessons.
Your skills are out of my league, stranger.Talk to Hgarth at the Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He will provide you with more knowledge than I can.
Your skills have surpassed mine, young one. Go see Una who has a shop in Thunder Bluff's central plateau. She can give you the guidance you seek.
Your skull gonna decorate our ritual altars!
Your skulls I shall crack with all the might of Blackrock.
Your soul is doomed!
Your soul is mine, weakling.
Your spirit is pure, $N.
Your spirits are weak, and your blows are weaker!
Your steel is strong, your skill stronger. Take your steel and your strength to my mate Shayis Steelfury, her skill with armor crafting is unmatched even by me.
Your stench will attract every dragon for miles.  Tell me what you want, and quickly.
Your strength is of the mountain.  Your grace is of the winds!
Your talent is beyond my own, friend. Speak with Tarn here; his knowledge of leather is much greater than mine. I'm sure he would welcome another student.
Your talents excel! You are truly inspired. To continue your pursuit of knowledge, speak with Georgio Bolero in Stormwind. He is held in high regard, and will be able to further your instruction.
Your talents in cooking are a little too low.  Maybe with some practice I can teach you what I know.
Your task is complete. Prepare to meet your doom.
Your time has come, $N. Master Kang awaits...
Your treachery only speeds your doom.  This world will fall to darkness!
Your undeath is not the end of your life, but the beginning. It is up to you to decide where your fate lies now.

Your understanding of leather is deeper than my own. Perhaps you should visit Aayndia Floralwind in the town of Astranaar in Ashenvale Forest. She has much knowledge to offer a student of your talents.
Your understanding of leather is deeper than my own. Perhaps you should visit the tauren Krulmoo Fullmoon in Camp Taurajo of the Barrens. He has much knowledge to offer a student of your talents.
Your victory here only speeds your doom!
Your voice is hoarse from yelling huh?  Find the Orgrimmar Auction House in the Valley of Strength.
Your will is not strong enough to manipulate the forces we control $c.
Ysera is my answer.
Ysida lives thanks to your courage, $N.  I am deeply in your debt and shall assist you as much as it is in my power.
Yummy. I love roasted Plainstrider.
ZZzzzz....
Zaldimar could probably teach you some new spells.  He has recently taken a liking to staying at the Lion's Pride Inn, you might want to check one of the rooms and see if he's in.
Zando'zan of the Shattered Hand. How can Zando'zan help you? He can't! He won't!
Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. This magic will help you in defeating Hakkar and his minions.$B$BI only ask that you bring me two items.
Zarrin seems to have a good knowledge of the cooking trade.  Why don't you go see if he will show you some recipes?  He is usually cooking over by the Inn in Dolanaar.
Zayus and his priests are in the Spirit Lodge, which is in the Valley of Spirits.  Look for it on the lake up above and to west of the Valley of Strength.
Zimrel
Zoom, zing, and BAM! He may have had a huge two handed cleaver made from a boat anchor but after a few well placed slices from my dinner knife, he was the one going crash!
Zug zug! Happy to help!

Zug zug, brave $c!  I have the finest bred wolf mounts for you to peruse.  You'll not find another animal with the level of endurance and survival instincts that the wolf has anywhere!  Please, inspect them for yourself.

Zug zug, my friend!  I am Kelm Hargunth, the main supplier for the Warsong Outriders.  As you improve your standing with the Outriders, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you can use inside Warsong Gulch.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.
Zul'Farrak
Zul'Farrak - Sergeant Bly - Greeting default.
Zul'Farrak - Weegli Blastfuse - Greeting default.
Zul'Farrak in Tanaris Desert is Elder Wildmane's home.

Zul'jin shall return one day, $r. Mark my words. Until then, we all hold our positions and do what we can to keep the forest troll population intact.$B$BWith that said, as master huntsman of Revantusk Village, it is my responsibility to insure that the world around us is safe for habitation.$B$BThe beasts of this area must be kept in check.$B$BAre you looking for work?

"Iron Eagle." Hmph. It's a passenger ship, not a warbird! But hey, a job's a job, and I'll humor Captain "Bombast" so long as the prince is paying.$b$bIn any case, welcome aboard.
"It is too soon for you to control me, for you have recently left the game."

"Pilgrim's Bounty." Hrm. I can understand the tauren's eagerness to express their sense of gratitude and comraderie to the Horde's warchief, but the Forsaken?$B$BI imagined they would have dropped such sentimental traditions long ago.
$962w Stormpike Commander(s) and $950w Stormpike Lieutenant(s).$b
$964w, young $c.
$966w, young $c.

$C, Dame Auriferous has conveyed to me her great pleasure in the service that you have done us in the past. She wishes to extend to you her hope that you will continue to be a champion of sin'dorei interests here in the Ghostlands.

$C, back on Azeroth, the Silverwing Sentinels hamper our progress in the woods. We need you there on the battlefront to push them back! You will earn great honor and reputation with the Warsong Outriders for helping us - join us now!
$C, hold your attack, this is just a disguise!  I'm a spy working for the Lower City coalition out of Shattrath City.$B$BI hope you're here to help!
$C, look what they've done to our beloved land. The Scourge must be destroyed!
$C, you didn't happen to see a courier on your way here? We are awaiting word from Silvermoon City and their messenger is late!

$G Brother:Sister;, you are now considered bound by blood to the Netherwing. All of Netherwing will be behind you now! The time to strike at the heart of our enemies is now, friend! We must reclaim our lost heritage.
$G Sir : Ma'am;! I'm here to assist and defend you.$B$BYour orders?

$G Son : Young lady;, I'm not going to lie to you; things aren't pretty around here.  We're under constant assault by the bugs and our very way of life, our freedom, is at stake!$B$BAre you going to be a responsible citizen and help out?
$N smash warp-gate good, but da demons make it strong again.$B$B$N bring Gahk another darkrune and Gahk make special crystalforged darkrune for $N!

$N!  I hardly recognized you in your new outfit.  Still have that tunic... or did you take the chausses... or was it the staff?   I can't recall, it was so long ago...$B$BWell, I'm glad you are here to help out again.  We could use all the help we can get.  $N, if you perform the way you did back in Westfall with the People's Militia, we have a chance.$B$BThese are dire times, if we don't win this battle, there may not be a Westfall to return to.

$N!  I hope you're ready to get to work, because there is much for you to do here on Sunstrider Isle.$B$BEver since the destruction of the Sunwell by Arthas and the Scourge, we have been a race adrift on a sea of uncertainty.  We teeter on the edge of oblivion.  This will change, $c, and you will learn and aid our recovery at the same time.$B$BThe Outland awaits us!

$N!  I remember your hunting prowess all too well.  You might have gotten off to a shaky start in Stranglethorn, but you stuck in there and became one o' the finest when you bagged old Bangalash.$B$BBut listen, $g lad : lass;, the prey out here in the Outland is the real deal.  And I've the scars to prove it!

$N!  Our supplies are dwindling and until we get more we can't launch large ground assaults into the Field of Strife!$B$BSpeak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.  He'll tell you what you can do to resupply our assault forces.
$N!  Thanks again for all the help.
$N! Come here! Surely you know of the battle that rages within Alterac Valley. We need every able-bodied fighter we can muster. Fight with the Stormpike Guard and defeat the Frostwolves!
$N, good to see you!$B$BOr is this the first time that we've met?$B$BI'm in so many places and times right now, I sometimes have a hard time keeping track of all of it.
$N, it is good to see you again.$B$BRemember to stay focused on your learning.  You represent our future, and should you falter our future will be dark indeed.
$N, please make sure that you tell Gahruj of our success.

$N, the Sons of Lothar have fought here, on the Hellfire Peninsula, for two decades.  We are beset on all sides by indigenous orcs and hellish demons of the Burning Crusade, and though our hearts still beat fiercely, years of war have reduced our numbers.$B$BYou, and the influx of Azeroth's new generation of heroes, are a welcome sight indeed!
$N, this came for you this morning.

$N, we have enough supplies to launch ground assaults into the Field of Strife.  If you want to send the orders, and your rank is high enough, then speak with Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl in Frostwolf Village.
$N, we have enough supplies to launch ground assaults.  If your standing with the Stormpike Guard is high enough, then speak with Corporal Noreg Stormpike.

$N, what are you waiting for?  Find Field Marshal Teravaine in the Field of Strife and give him the assault orders.  Once he gets the orders, he and his troops will charge into the Horde and take no prisoners!
$N, what are you waiting for?  Find Field Marshal in the Field of Strife and give him the assault orders.  Once he gets the orders, he and his troops will charge into the Horde and take no prisoners!

$R! Yes, you! Why do you waste time dawdling in this wreck of a city when your rightful place is in Arathi Basin? The League of Arathor is ruthless in its assault; your contribution is needed, and you will be rewarded!
$R, report! What news of significance do you bring? Be quick about your business... Dame Auriferous and I are in the middle of a strategic discussion.
$R, why would I want to talk to you? Your people probably caused this mess in the first place!
$n! I've been awaiting your return. What be takin' ya so long, mon?$b$bIt be time to complete da conversion of da Blightbloods.$b$bJoin me and witness the creation of our army!
$n, I am pleased to see you. Our dwarven allies require our assistance in Alterac Valley. Will you help them?
'Ello, $c!$b$bYa ready ta head on down to Venture Bay and crack some Horde skulls?
'Netherstorm' was not always as you see it now.$B$BThere was a time when this crumbling land was known as the Plains of Farahlon. Little of those days has survived the evil that has taken hold here.

'Talon King' Ikiss is one of the leaders of the Sethekk, along with my brother, Darkweaver Syth.$B$BIt was they who led the exodus of the Sethekk from Skettis to the ruins of Auchindoun. In the beginning, Ikiss was a charismatic leader, but he has descended into madness.$B$BNow, he openly proclaims that he is Terokk reborn! He truly expects the arakkoa to bend knee to him as their ruler. Can you believe his arrogance?

<Angela coos to the felhunter again before turning her attention to you.>$B$BJir'see's always been smaller than all the other felhunters, but that's never bothered him. And Outland's going to change all that, right Jir'see?$B$BMomma's little angel is going to grow up to be a big, fierce felhunter, yes he is!
<Archmage Vargoth favors you with a wry smile.>$B$BPlenty of room at the cursed Violet Tower.$B$BAny time of year, you can find me here.

<As you place your apexis shards into the fel crystalforge and pull the lever, the device makes an unworldly sound as it grinds them into dust.  A few moments later your flask pops out of its 'mouth'.>

<As you place your apexis shards into the fel crystalforge and pull the lever, the device makes an unworldly sound as it grinds them into dust.  A few moments later your flasks pop out of its 'mouth'.>
<As you place your apexis shards within the hollow of the Bash'ir crystalforge and pull the lever, the device literally disintegrates them.  A few moments later your flask appears at your feet.>
<Bloodrose eyes you curiously.>$b$bI cannot help but wonder what makes you worthy of such attention.$b$bNo offense....
<Brann looks at you expectantly.>
<Budd rolls his eyes as he sees you draw near>$b$bAhh, yes, the soon-to-be-famous $n!$b$bTo what do I owe the pleasure of your company?
<Chu'a'lor's left head says,>$B$BWe find your zeal to help us most appealing...$B$B<His right head concludes,>$B$B... and we want you to know that we greatly appreciate your efforts!
<Cowlen sobs.>
<Dark magic ripples from the necrolyte.>
<Demitrian falls to his knees.>$B$BYou have recovered my Master's eternal prison!$B$BOh long have I waited for this day and finally, it is realized.$B$BHe must be released!
<Eralan appears to be chewing on some deathweed.>$b$bIf you're looking to make a love potion, you've got the wrong place.  Blinding, crippling, and killing is my business and hopefully yours.

<Greathmother Geyah laughs weakly.>$B$BOf course not, dear. But it's not me that has to believe...$B$BGarrosh can lead the Mag'har. He is strong and wise. All of the spirits approve of him. He just needs to believe in himself. He fears so much... He fears so deeply that if he lets himself go, his rage will consume him and all that would be near him.

<Greatmother Geyah smiles.>$B$BI am old. It is my time. When I pass, my spirit will move on to the spirit realm. It is there that I will stand with my ancestors. It is there that we will watch over our people.$B$BWhen Garad was alive Mother Kashur's duty was the same as my duty now.
<Grumbles>  I guess those mountains came out of nowhere...  All five times!
<Grumbles>  You'd think it would be hard to crash a zeppelin into the ocean.  You'd think it'd be even harder to do it four separate times!
<Grumbles> I still don't know how we managed to snake through Thousand Needles without a scratch, only to crash and burn in the Shimmering Flats!

<Grumbles> I wish I could say we've managed to avoid crash landing into lakes.  I wish I could say we've only crashed into a lake once... but we've managed to crash into four separate lakes, including Lordamere Lake!

<Isfar sighs.>$B$BA couple of treehouses don't make a home, but it was vast improvement over the Sethekk Halls.$B$BComfortable as it was in Shattrath, I can't bring myself to return to my true home in Skettis without my sister. She's still trapped in the Sethekk Halls, held prisoner by our older brother.
<It's a giant, armored, saddle-bearing attack cat. Isn't that already silly enough without it talking, too?>

Worried that it would be used for evil, my dryad sisters secretly took the scepter from me, breaking it into two parts and hiding it within the caverns.$B$BSoon they fell victim to the madness as well, and the two parts of the scepter, left unguarded, came to be in the possession of Vyletongue, himself. The satyr entrusted one part to Noxxion, an evil elemental, and the other he still has to this day.

As you approach the console the access crystal you have with you begins to hum softly and pulse with light.$B$BA rush of information flows into your mind and all of a sudden you're aware of the manaforge's energy production levels, its stability and its output to different pipelines.  The console awaits your command.
As you gain renown with our town, I can make more goods available to you, $N.  With equipment in such short supply we can only afford to provide it to those we trust.
As you wish, $N. The spirit hunter is ready.

At first we repaired them to harvest the forests here, but ever since the alliance arrived and the fighting broke out we've been using them as war machines.$b$bBelieve me, $c. If you've got a key, you'd be crazy not to use it.
Awaiting orders from my superiors!
Away with you, $c!$B$BOnly champions of Undercity may purchase what I have to offer.

Aye, he had done what was thought to be impossible. Out from the fissure sprung an agent of Therazane!$B$BFrom my vantage point, I could see the goblin holding conversation with the agent of the Old God. What happened after that was terrible...

Aye, that's her name, and a fine ship she is.$b$bThere's much to learn from such vessels, you know. A great poet once said: Ships that pass in the night, and speak each other in passing, only a signal shown, and a distant voice in the darkness; So on the ocean of life, we pass and speak one another, only a look and a voice, then darkness again and a silence.
Aye, ya never know who's gunna join next, or who be dyin' next for that matter.$b$bMy advice? Don't be gettin' too attached to anyone.
BOAR'S DUNG! Why must I stay here to guide others to Alterac Valley, when I could be fighting there myself? You! Have you come to fight the Alliance?
BOOM!$b$bThat's the last thing I remember...
Back to learn more, $N? Come over here and show me you are ready.
Bah!  Do I look like I have time for idle chit-chat?$B$BDo I?$B$BBe quick about your business.  There are ogres to be killed!
Bah, rogues have done nothing but make our job here in Stormwind harder. I wish I could drag both Osborne and Mathias both out of Old Town and right to the Stockade.

Be careful among the ruins, $c. The Kirin Tor spirits you find there will not recognize you as a friend.$B$BThe custodian and I are the only ones whose spirits retained a strong enough tie to this place to preserve our full identities in death.
Be careful around these parts, $r. The natives are ruthless.
Be gone, $c!  Leave us be, or we will enter you next and show you true despair!
Be gone, mortal! Your kind is unwelcome here...
Be on your guard. We are Theramore's first line of defense against its many enemies in the marsh.
Be quiet 'bout what you hear and see around here, $r.

Be sure to visit Vixton Pinchwhistle in Netherstorm's Area 52. As the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit's official Arena Vendor, he has all sorts of incredible items for sale to those with enough Arena Points.
Be wary of the Ethereum that surround us on all sides.
Be wary, $c. The forest is full of hidden dangers and potential enemies.
Be wary, for the plagued tendrils of the Lich King lurk close.
Be wary, friends. The Betrayer meditates in the court just beyond.
Be wary, friends. The Betrayer meditates in the court just beyond.
Be welcome amongst us, $c.
Bears are beautiful creatures.  Wild, strong and fierce in battle... much like us, sister.
Beats me, kid. I'm new to the crew.$b$bI've had my fill of troll-killin' and grog drinkin, I can tell ya that. Only thing left to see is the treasure Budd keeps promisin'....$B
Because you've managed to replenish some of our supplies I can get back to cooking.  Now, what can I do for you?

Before we can overcome external obstacles like the Scourge and the Amani trolls, we must overcome obstacles from within.  The Wretched have been a nuisance for long enough; it is time we vanquished them.
Befriending the Sunstriders has paid off; I get to conduct research with subjects I can only find in Outland and they get... my charming personality and rugged good looks.
Begin your search to the north, $N. Our scouts have spotted the Warp Piston near the shoreline.
Behold, the Flames of Summer!

Belgaristrasz speaks the truth; the situation is grave indeed.  $B$BI can grant you the power to call upon a drake from the Green Fight.  Speak to Belgaristrasz or Eternos if you prefer to draw on the power of the Red or the Bronze.
Belgaristrasz speaks the truth; the situation is grave indeed.  $B$BThe full power of your drakes has been unlocked.  Use their power to defeat Eregos!

Belgrom sent us here from Orgrimmar to aid him in an unwise Alliance, but if his gamble pays off, then it will be to the great benefit of all the Horde.$B$BToo many orcs have already perished because of his desire to please women, but he still commands us, and our honor dictates we make the best of this situation.
Below is the aptly named Deathforge. If left to their own devices, the Shadow Council would supply the Legion with an endless stream of infernals.
Best keep yer head down, "matey!"  If ye know what I mean!$B$BYarrrr!
Bg'grrml brgl brm!
Big, sparkly, magic book help make Glyphs for spells and abilities. Always find near inscription trainer, in The Apothecarium.
Bite your tongue, $r, lest I rip it from your skull case and use it as a horn warmer.

Bixi Wobblebonk in this very shop can train ye in daggers. If ye're still looking abroad, anyone else - Woo Ping in Stormwind and Ilyenia Moonfire in Darnassus - can show ye a thing or two. Me, I was never one fer knife fights.
Bixi here can teach ye how to lob throwin' weapons.  If Darnassus is more yer speed, talk to Ilyenia Moonfire on the Warrior's Terrace there.
Blrmrrgl gulrgl grr.
Bluegill Marsh north of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands holds many locked boxes from the wrecks offshore that have washed ashore.
Blurg awrurgle mrr?
Blurglgr murbrgl... just kidding, I can understand you.
Boktar thinks this crash an unfortunate event, but I believe we're intended to learn something from it.
Bonelashers, I hate them all!$B$BIf it weren't for the loss of my eye, and the fainting spells that I get sometimes, I'd be out there shooting them down all the time!
Bones... flesh... muscles... tendons... cartilage... it all comes together here under my hacksaw.
Borgrim might be correct.  Maybe we do need to take a break.$B$BBut now that we're here, I'm eager to get my hands dirty and study what this land has to offer.
Both Garrosh's Landing and Pal'ea were wiped out by the mist. We're the only ones crazy enough to stay here, buddy!
Both Hanashi and Sayoc can train you in the use of one and two-handed axes. They can be found in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Both Ilyenia Moonfire on the Warrior's Terrace of Darnassus and Bixi Wobblebonk of the Timberline Arms in Ironforge can show you how to use throwing weapons properly.
Both Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris and the Bay of Storms in Azshara have boxes that can be picked to improve your skill.

Both the Horde and Alliance captains have taken to the field.  Our Captain Balinda Stonehearth directs the Stormpike forces from the Stonehearth Outpost, and the enemy Captain Galvangar barks orders from within Iceblood Garrison.$B$BTo battle!
Boys have cooties and girls have beauty!
Brann taught me everything I know about exploring.

Brave soldier of the Horde, I salute you! We would have surely been destroyed by the Alliance gunship had it not been for you and your allies.$B$BTake a moment to rest before we begin our assault upon the upper reaches of the citadel.
Brggl-brggl Mrgl-Mrgl! Gluk!
Budd's crew, ye mean? Aye, he be no respecter of persons. He'll take on anyone who can work a shovel.$b$b'cept them undead. Budd hates 'em. Scared of 'em, likely as not.$B
Buliwyf can show you how to swing a mace properly, no matter the size. You can find him within the Timberline Arms in Ironforge.
Buliwyf can teach you how to use axes! He's around this shop somewhere.

Buliwyf, in this very shop can train you in the use of fist weapons. If his training techniques aren't your style, I hear the night elf weapon master in Darnassus, Ilyenia Moonfire, knows her way around the weapon too! She's up on the Warrior's Terrace there.
Buliwyf, the dwarf weapon master within the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, can train you in the use of guns.
Burning eyes within the prism fill your mind with a sense of dread... especially knowing that you don't have the thirty-five apexis shards needed to summon forth its demon.
Busy, busy!  So much to do, so little time!$B$BNow where did I put that pyrospanner?  I know it's around here somewhere... I burned my fingers on it just a moment ago!
By Muradin's beard, $c. This land is on the brink of annihilation. I cannot imagine anyone survived here since the end of the second war.
By the will of Sylvanas, our enemies will fall.
Can I get you anything?  My selection is a little limited, but that's to be expected... all things considered.
Can I help you?
Can I offer you a drink? I promise you its aged like none other!
Can you believe it?  This ethereal does not have a single basilisk eye on him!$B$BAnd his leader has the gall to call himself "the Smuggler Prince!"
Can you believe the nerve of that Elisara Sunstriker?  Thinking that she can catch the eye of Lord Saltheril?  And did you see what she's wearing?  So last season.  It's sad, really.
Can you believe this ethereal technology?!$B$BI'm sure glad they let me stay out here with them.  I'm gonna learn a lot... and maybe get some of it for myself, too!
Can you believe this place?  'Course, it's a mite stuffy up here if you ask me.

Can you feel it?$B$BThe spirit world draws close during the Day of the Dead. This is why we decorate the graves of our dearly departed with flowers and candles and offerings: To welcome them back, even if only for a time.$B$BSo come! Dance with me! Let us cherish and honor those we have lost in their ghostly presence, so that they might eat and drink and smile and know that they are loved.
Can you feel the evil to the south?  By the Hand, it must be cleansed!
Can you hear it speaking in your mind?
Can't thank ya enough fer helpin' with the mines. Now, it's just a matter of convincing the miners to get back to work.
Can't ya see I'm workin' here, $glad:lass;? Off with ya, afore Kowalski sees me jawin.'
Can't you see that I'm busy! We'll never have this base ready in time for the Prince's return!
Can't you see that I've got places to go and people to see! Step aside, peasant!
Candy! That's what I'm talking about; I just wish I didn't have to run around finding it!
Captain Galvangar has been slain!  Honor our fallen captain, and unleash yourself again the Alliance!
Captain Selana has instructed me to assist you with your efforts here on the Sunwell Plateau.
Capturing the Sun's Reach Sanctum was the first step in our battle plan.  Our orders are to take control of the armory next.$B$BWe are $3233w percent done with our goal.
Careful, $N.  Where are your cultist robes?
Careful, don't get burned!
Champion $N, it is good to see you again.$B$BHave you returned to Valhalas to assist a friend with their challenges?
Check the bulletin board if you're looking for work, $r.
Chu'a'lor's been saying good things about you, $N.  If you want, we have a couple of special ogre brews for sale.$B$BThey're really tasty!
Come and I will show you how to ride the finest beasts you have ever seen. You... do have enough gold to cover the cost, I trust?
Come closer, young one; my ears aren't what they once were, and I care not for raising my voice.
Come for some blacksmithing supplies, have ya?
Come in by the fire and rest, $r. I hope you don't mind the smell of fish.
Come in out of the ash and muck. Dry yourself a spell.
Come in out of the cold and rest your weary bones a while. Our hospitality is yours.
Come to buy from Hargus, you have?
Come to make yourself useful?
Come, $r. What formula interests you today?
Come, Battle-Sister.$B$BFeast, sleep, so that you may fight with all your strength!
Come, come. If you've properly prepared your leather for once, I'll show you how to fashion serviceable items.

Come, take a trip to the wonderful, gorgeous, tropical jungles of Stranglethorn. That's right, you too can be spending your time sunbathing by the crystal blue waters while I stand here in this unbearable heat with nothing to look at but my brother Frezza all day! Enjoy your trip!
Commonly found on the lesser chromatic flight: Whelps, broodlings, lesser wyrmkin.
Consider all of the suffering that the Scarlets have caused over the years. The torture, the zealotry, the murder.$B$BI won't allow that to continue. Will you?
Copy that, Araxes. Backup is on the way. Hold your position. I repeat, Hold your Position
Copy, Status report, Soldier.
Could night elf saboteurs be behind this?  I doubt it.  With the load we've been putting on the West Sanctum it was only a matter of time until something went wrong.
Course I can show ye where Myolor is. Right over there near the anvil of the Great Forge, that's where he does his work. Listen to his words well $g lad:lass;, Myolor is as skilled as they come.

Da Cache of Mau'ari holds great secrets... The shards used ta make it are reflective, and you can use its shiny surface ta siphon power from other tings and den reflect it onto yourself.$B$BKeeping da charm in your inventory lets you collect e'ko, da spiritual power from the beasts you fight. Once you find e'ko, you bring it ta Mau'ari.
Da Forsaken weapon master Archibald know his way 'round da polearm. He train others in da War Quarter of da Undercity, mon.
Dagger instruction can be sought from two weapon masters: Archibald in the War Quarter of the Undercity and Sayoc within the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Damn those blood elves and their reckless magic!
Dark times loom ahead, stranger...
Dark times make for strange friendships. It may be worth visiting old Lordaeron to watch the Forsaken burn their little man of wicker.
Darling, those shoes are to die for!  I mean that literally.  Who did you kill for them?
Darmuk's incompetence be hinderin' us no more! Patience, mon. Dere soon be more for you to do....
Day and night all I do is sit here and make ammo and restring crossbows.$B$BI suppose you want me to do something for you too?
Day in and day out all Mad Jonah Sterling wants me to do is swab the decks.$B$BSwab the decks?!$B$BI'm a mage, I don't DO swabbin'! At least not the mundane way.
De Darkspears have a home again! An' we couldn't have done it wit'out ya helpin', $N. Now, we celebrate!

Death's Door is a portal that opens upon the world that the Burning Legion uses to breed their fel hounds and other canine-like terrors.  Any time that you see one of those creatures, that is where it came from, and it passes through here, first.$B$BLately, we became aware that the Burning Legion have ramped up their summoning of these creatures through the portal.$B$BYou must shut down Death's Door before it becomes an inexorable tide, and all is lost!

Deathwing's brood... Ysera's benevolence raised the ire of Deathwing - patron of the black dragonflight. They attacked us in our sleep! Many died on the initial surge but the greens rose to protect us.$B$B<Prince Toreth points around the island.>$B$BThe bones are all that remain of the once great dragons. None were spared.
Desperate times call for desperate measures, $c.
Did Balandar Brightstar send you to rescue me?
Did the Scryers send you to contact me?  You do not look like a Scryer at all.
Did they send you to find me? Well I'm not going back without my men.

Did you know that alchemists can transmute certain gems?  Mar'nah and I have been talking about this.$B$BI'm convinced that given her prowess, once her lab is complete, she and I will be able to create gems that were thought to be lost in time.
Dinner guests should show more respect!
Dis ain't no game mon. Joo want to use da axe, joo got to say da line. Say it wif me???Say hello, to ma little friend.
Do I know you?
Do I look stupid to you, $r? I may as well sign her death warrant myself! Why should I trust you?$B
Do I see them with weapons still?  Why you let them keep their weapons?!
Do it, $c...Then... avenge me!

Do my eyes deceive me? Is that really you, Brother Rokkaram, after all this time?$B$BIf you are looking for Sai'kkal, he walks among the crystals in the western part of the Vortex Pinnacle. He seems preoccupied with what he calls a brutish, primitive presence there, although nothing seems amiss.
Do not be fooled by the ruins surrounding us, $c.  Dalaran is as powerful as ever.
Do not fight the enemy unprepared, $N.  I can provide you with very powerful items... provided you have proven yourself to us.
Do not forget, $c, battles still rage in Azeroth. Will you return to help the Horde in Alterac Valley?

Do not think for a second that your past accomplishments entitle you to anything, $N.  They don't.$B$BIf you want my respect you're going to have to earn it.  This means following my orders without question and fulfilling them... without exceptions.
Do watch your step in the garden of Ysera, mortal. Things are not always as they seem.
Do you have a story for me?

Do you have any sons, $c?$B$BLet us tell you something, we think we were much happier before we came to Ogri'la and the crystals made us more aware.  Before, we would have just bashed them over the head to get them to shut up.  Now all they do is bother us about the Sha'tari Skyguard.$B$BIgnorance is bliss!
Do you have steel that needs shaping?
Do you have the understanding to continue, shaman?  Do you know why you are here?

Do you know who we are, stranger? We are Mag'har - brown orcs, as I have heard your kind call us. The Mag'har are survivors: Survivors of a fallen dynasty; Survivors of the Red Pox; Survivors of a shattered world...$B$BI am Jorin, son of Kilrogg; last of the lineage of Deadeye: Warchief of the Bleeding Hollow Clan.
Do you like fish, $r? I have fish here. If you like fresh fish, the freshest, come and sample my wares.

Do you like the new home that I've carved out for my so-called worshippers?$B$BIn the throes of my death, I cursed them all and dragged them along with me into this special underworld of my own creation.$B$BI think that I shall delight in their eternal torment, but what I really want is to exact revenge upon my former prophet!
Do you mean the Silvermoon City Inn, or the Wayfarer's Rest tavern.

Do you possess the courage to face Malygos' elite drakes in their own realm, $r?

Do you seek further training in the ways of the warrior?
Do you wish to learn the blacksmithing profession or is there something else you wish to tell me?
Do your part in keeping the Scourge at bay, soldier! Report all suspicious activity and kill first, ask questions later!

Does being in the presence of a Black Dragon make you nervous?$B$BGood. It should. It makes these dragons nervous too. They cling to their ancient virtues though - they wouldn't dare attack me here.$B$BFools.
Does this dress make me look fat?
Don't ask...
Don't be afraid of the sword, nubling. It's the mutton that gets ya!

Don't be fooled, $r. They're very elusive. One moment they're there, the next they're gone - virtually inexplicable!$b$bBetween you and me, I actually held a piece of one in my hand once! Sadly, before I could conduct any measurements it was gone! Just disappeared....
Don't bother me with trifles!
Don't bother me, $c!  I have two whole cauldrons of bubbling brew here and I must ensure they taste just right!$B$BIf they don't, then Master Coren Direbrew will flay and boil me!
Don't forget to take some time out to fish while you're in Zangarmarsh. You never know when you'll see water again.
Don't look so surprised to see me here, $r. The coming of the draenei and their alliance with my people was foretold by Kurz the Revelator.
Don't mind me. I'm just an old man, waiting on an old... friend.

Don't they teach you new recruits anything?  These manaforges were built from parts of Tempest Keep designed to siphon energy from the nether.$B$BThe naaru used this technology to power their vessel during its travels.  Some said the technology might not be safe to use on land.  They were promptly silenced.
Don't think, $c.$b$bJust... do it....
Don't ya have something better ta do, $g lad : lass; than jaw with me?$B$BNow get out there and prove yer mettle!
Don't you have some packages to move?
Don't... worry... about me...
Draenei forces and their Alliance allies are engaged with the Horde in the Eye of the Storm in Outland. Will you join them in an effort to turn the tide of battle in our favor?

Draenei have come back! This group jumped two of my best wolf riders as they were out patrolling the western roads. Needless to say, we were victorious in that skirmish.$B$BNow I'm not sure what's going on but from what my scouts tell me, there are blood elves and draenei all over Halaa. I'm no blood elf lover but if it's one thing I hate it's a draenei. If you see draenei or any of their allies at Halaa, be sure to put a boot in their backsides for me.$B$BHalaa's to the west... In case you want to go now.

Dragonhawks, if raised properly, are really quite tame.  Don't you think that is fascinating?  To be so friendly and companionable if raised right and so vicious and deadly in the wild...I just love them so much.
Drakes is my business, $N. I'm authorized to sell them to our highest ranking officers.
Drink from this vial, and the fog will be cleared for a short time. Go with the spirits, my friend.

During Hallow's End we celebrate the day that the Banshee Queen herself delivered us from the clutches of the Lich King and the Scourge. Be sure to attend the Wickerman Festival that is held each evening outside Undercity.

Dying for one's country is a soldier's duty.  But if calling this war folly is treason, then I'm a traitor.
Eager to get to Northrend, are you? The steam-powered Kraken sails from here to Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.
Elder Bellowrage watches over the Dark Portal from a ridge in the Blasted Lands.

Elder Skywarden can be found near Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight.
Elementium? I have not heard that word uttered from the mouth of a mortal in decades.
Elune has blessed us many times over with all the discoveries we have made.  But we must remain vigilant, $c.
Elves in Warsong Gulch make crunchy sound.  You crunch them good.  Talk to Kurden Bloodclaw in Royal Quarter.

Emerald Drakes excel at healing themselves while poisoning their enemies.$B$BUsing Leeching Poison, they can steal health from their enemies.  Repeated applications of this poison can increase the effect.$B$BWith Touch the Nightmare, Emerald Drakes can reach into the Dream, converting a portion of their life energy into a highly damaging attack that leaves the target weakened, reducing its damage for a short time.
Emissary Taluun brought me with him hoping I could teach our new allies about the elements of this world... but no one will listen.
Enemies are closing in on us from all sides, and all the elders talk of abandoning this post. I say we should stand and fight like the warriors we are.
Enjoying the Fire Festival?
Even now, free-willed undead battle the League of Arathor in Arathi Basin.  Will you aid the Defilers in defeating the humans and their Alliance allies?
Evenin', Gov'na.
Ever trip over own feet? We have. Kind of hurt. No do it, not fun. Nope.
Every day is a test, and this day is no different. If you pass this test, I will share some of my knowledge...

Every two years the Spirits of Competition grow especially fervent... and now is that time! Both Alliance and Horde wear this tabard into the Battlegrounds to honor the spirits, seeking to defeat all enemies and earn their favor.

Every two years the Spirits of Competition grow especially fervent... and now is that time! We wear this tabard into the Battlegrounds to honor them, seeking to defeat our enemies and earn their favor.

Everything that has happened since the crash is little more than a blur. It seems like a lifetime ago that I was aboard the Exodar.$B$BNow, my reality is restricted to this island with its mutant creatures and endless sea of blood elf agents. Soon, it will be as if I've never known anything different...
Examining the corpse, you conclude that this must be Blood Knight Dawnstar, the leader of the failed assault on Deatholme.

Excellent!  You shall be doing the League of Arathor a great service in ridding Arathi Basin of The Defilers and their Horde thugs.  Seek out the Lady Hoteshem in the royal audience chamber of Stormwind Keep.  She has been expecting you $N.
Excellent! Let me know when you are ready for the next attempt.

Existing only for chaos, its slightest whisper meant the destruction of whole worlds!$B$BYet still, there were those that would try to worship this mindless being.  There were even those more insane who dared to think to control it!

Expedition Point is a tough place to be stationed, but it's critical to the defense of Honor Hold.  The information gathered here, and the engagements our soldiers make against the Legion and the orcs of Zeth'Gor, are invaluable to the Alliance's Hellfire campaign.
Expire? Me? Heh, not hardly, kid. That was just a scratch.
Ey, mon! Take me to mah troll bruddas!

Ey, mon!$b$bGood to be seein' ya again... $N, right? Yes, yes, of course.$b$bYou and I gunna be real good friends. Drakuru know dese things.$b$b<A grin slowly spreads across the troll's painted face.>
Fairweather and I are up here representing Sylvanaar's interests.$B$BThe druids have been more than accomodating, but allowing the Horde to travel through here gives me the willies.

Fast forward to the present: The resultant formula works, allowing for the creation of a more controlled drone, however, the drawback is that the inactive compound is extremely volatile.$B$BGallywix, everyone in this tower and everyone outside are infected with the poison. It's affecting our minds and our bodies. Our internal organs have become soft and extremely fragile. This is your chance, $N. I don't have the strength to carry on and I sense that soon I will become one of 'them.'
Feel like helping me to take down the warp-gate in that Burning Legion camp to the south?
Few bouts are won by sheer strength.  It is cunning, reflexes and knowledge of your weapon that wins the day in the end.
Fhwoor like little sporelings.  They save Fhwoor.  Not eat them.$B$BFhwoor hate naga.  Fhwoor smash!
Finally, someone came down to talk to me! Want to hear some of my rhymes?
Fine beasts, aren't they? The wyverns we raise here are trained to handle the fiercest and strangest weather conditions Draenor has to offer. You'll find them dependable and hardy.

Fine then, have a seat. This might take a while.$B$BWhen we first came to this frozen hell, General Arlos, down in Valiance Keep, gave my group of flying daredevils and I a special task: to establish a forward airbase for Alliance operations.$B$BThis airstrip is the result. Let me tell you, it wasn't easy, what with all the nasty beasts and the ground rock-hard from being frozen! But we managed, and we did it quickly too!
Fine, but be more careful with it this time!
Fineous has what you need, friend.
Fist weapons are taught by Sayoc, the orc weapon master in Orgrimmar. He spends his days in the Valley of Honor.

Fleshling, I am Captain Saeed of the Protectorate and these soldiers that stand by me are my avengers. We await orders from the fleshling who destroyed the void conduit. On that fleshling's word, we will make our way up to Dimensius's lair and wait for the word to make a final strike!$B$BToo long it has been... The void lord will soon face our combined might!
Focus your mind, mortal. This is the front line of a war unlike any you've witnessed.$b$bYou'll need full command of your faculties if you are to be of any use.
For ages, I was lost.  Now, finally, I see how dark my soul had become...
Forget Vixton's spread. You want the good stuff? You talk to Krixel here. I got just what you need, provided you got the right rep. You know, in the arena. This stuff isn't for sissies, kid.

Either way, the dark powers emanating from Ragefire Chasm could undo all that the orcs have fought to attain.
